entries.translation: Can we really find anything on our own, though? Mr. Theodore needs to be here...�

entries.source: 그렇군.. 확실히 들고 나갈 자료 같은 건 없어. 직접 봐야 할 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Right... There are certainly no documents to take. He will have to see it in person...�
My body... has no strength left...�
What... is this...? Schultz... what is...�
Idiot, take cover! Get back here now!�
I cannot... I... cannot do anything, Schultz...�
No, Theodore! Do not come in...!!�
It is a trap... Who could have...�
The spirit power... is draining rapidly...�

entries.source: 슈르츠님.. 나.. 무서워, 사라져 버릴 것 같아..�
entries.translation: Schultz... I am scared... I feel like I am fading away...�
Hold on! Hang in there, somehow!�
Damn it, who is doing this?! Stop it right now! STOP!�
...Let us get out of here... for now.�
|(This is the control panel Tyr destroyed...){�
|(It does not seem to be working.){�

entries.source: |(잘해야 한 번 정도 작동시킬 수 있을 것 같다.){�
entries.translation: |(It looks like it might work at most once.){�

entries.source: 세이브를 할 수 없는 이벤트가 발생합니다.�
entries.translation: An event where you cannot save will begin.�

entries.source: |(정령을 제어하기 위한 장치는 작동하지 않는 것 같다.){�
entries.translation: |(The spirit control device does not seem to work.){�

entries.source: |(제어반에 빈 곳이 있다. 뭔가를 삽입하면 동작할지도 모르겠다.){�
entries.translation: |(There is an empty slot in the panel. Inserting something might make it work.){�
|(I have seen this shape somewhere before...){�

entries.source: |(<얼어붙은 바다의 방주 근처에서 발견{했던... 이렘 도서관에 있는 여자에게 가져다 줬던가 그거?)�
entries.translation: |(<Found near the Ark in the Frozen Sea...{ Was it the one given to that woman in the Irem library?)�
|(Inserted the ancient relic into the device.){�

entries.source: 여기까지 오는 동안.. 잘 견뎠다, 슈르츠.�
entries.translation: You have endured well... to make it this far, Schultz.�
Just one last time... you need to endure it here.�

entries.source: 할 수 있어.. 루레인. 방아쇠를 당겨라..!�
entries.translation: I can do it... Lurain. Pull the trigger...!�

entries.source: 슈르츠. 모든 힘을 방출해요, 하나도 남김없이.�
entries.translation: Schultz. Release all your power, every last bit of it.�

entries.source: 지금, 봉인을 해제하고 완전히 새로운 봉인으로 악몽의 주인을 심연에 가두겠습니다.�
entries.translation: Now, I shall break the seal and bind the Lord of Nightmares into the abyss with an entirely new seal.�

entries.source: 기회는 한번뿐이야. 한번만.. 너의 의지로 그 인간의 신이란 것을 제어해라.�
entries.translation: There is only one chance. Just once... control that so-called human god with your own will.�
Leave it to me! I... will never lose!�
^Fools! Break the seal and create a new one?�

entries.source: ^너희들의 찰라는 나에게 영원이며,;너희들의 영원은 나에게 찰라와 같다!�
entries.translation: ^Your instant is an eternity to me, and your eternity is but an instant!�

entries.source: ^봉인을 해제하는 그 때가;내가 일어날 시간이 되리라!�
entries.translation: ^The moment the seal breaks shall be the hour I rise!�

entries.source: ^그 시간이 주어진다면;날 우롱한 모든 생명에;악몽의 시간을 내리겠노라!�
entries.translation: ^When that time comes, I will bring an age of nightmares upon all life that mocked me!�
^For a cheap imitation like yours could never hold me sealed!�
I am the god of humanity...�

entries.source: 너의 찰라는 나의 찰라와 같으며, 너의 영원은 나의 영원과 같다..�
entries.translation: Your instant is my instant, and your eternity is my eternity...�

entries.source: 지금, 내 너와 함께 영원의 심연을 지키겠으니..!!�
entries.translation: Now, I shall guard the eternal abyss with you...!!�
I leave it to you, Ren!!�

entries.source: ^거의 다 왔다..;이제야 심연의 벽을 찢고;한쪽팔을 내밀었것만!!�
entries.translation: ^I was so close... I finally tore through the abyss and reached my arm out!!�
Lord of Nightmares... you are afraid.�
^Foolish woman, the Descendants are coming...! There is little time left!�

entries.source: ^나의 힘도, 저 모조품의 힘도;이 심연에 모두 가둬두고 너희들이;이겨낼 수 있을 거라고 생각하나!�
entries.translation: ^Do you truly believe you can prevail with both my power and that imitation locked away within this abyss?!�
^Do you still believe the Descendants are your saviors..?!�

entries.source: .. 당신이 뭐라고 해도, 이 세계의 가장 큰 죄악은 당신입니다.�
entries.translation: ...Say what you will, you are the greatest sin of this world.�

entries.source: 당신이 없어도, 우리는 강림자와의 싸움을 이겨낼 거예요.�
entries.translation: Even without you, we will overcome the battle with the Descendants.�
^Heheheh, foolish mortals... that it is the Descendants will... Why...�

entries.source: ^수호자여,;너의 심장이 곧;내 손에 닿을 것 같구나..�
entries.translation: ^Guardian... Soon, your heart shall be within my grasp...�

entries.source: ^나로부터 비롯된 심장,;나를 위해 만들어진 몸이다..;그 갸냘픈 정신으로는;더 이상 지탱할 수 없어..�
entries.translation: ^A heart that came from me, a body crafted for me... Your frail mind cannot sustain it any longer...�
^How many days has it been without food or water?�

entries.source: 미안하네. 너를 위해 만들어진 몸이라 그런지 좀 굶겨도 멀쩡하거든.�
entries.translation: Sorry to disappoint. Being built for you means a little starving does not hurt.�
^Heheheh... Do not think I know nothing of your body...�

entries.source: 어이, 저기다, 봉인석에 힘을 보태 줘!�
entries.translation: Hey, over there! Lend your power to the sealing stone!�
^Mortals... destructive as you are, you ought to serve me...�

entries.source: 고대신을 다시 심연으로 가라앉혔어요. 균열을 잠시 봉합한 것에 불과하지만..�
entries.translation: We cast the ancient god back into the abyss. Though it is only a temporary patch on the rift...�

entries.source: 지난 번 만남 때는.. 상상도 못할 정도의 마법력..�
entries.translation: Such unimaginable magical power... since our last encounter...�

entries.source: 신용을 얻어두는 건 계획대로지만.. 정말 지칠 정도로 무능력하군, 이 길드는..�
entries.translation: Gaining their trust goes as planned... but this guild is exhaustingly incompetent.�
That }Kaze{, how long does he plan to keep me waiting?�
Phew... Anyway, that is enough work for today.�
Let us head home and get some rest.�

entries.source: 물건 납품 자체는 금방 끝날 거야. 뭐 타워라고 특별한 게 있는 건 아니니까 긴장하지 말라고.�
entries.translation: The delivery itself will be quick. Nothing special about the tower, so relax.�
Then why hire an escort mercenary?�
Well... let us just say a bad gut feeling...�

entries.source: 후.. 타워 안에서 무슨 일이 생길지 모르니.�
entries.translation: Phew... Who knows what might happen inside the tower.�

entries.source: 상점에 들러서 준비를 좀 하고 길드로 가는 게 좋겠어.�
entries.translation: I had better stop by the shop to prepare before heading to the guild.�

entries.source: |(}센트럴 타워|.. 웨이드 가의 연구시설로, 그냥은 들어갈 수 없는 곳이다.)�
entries.translation: |(}Central Tower|... Wade family research facility. Cannot just walk in.)�
|There is still work left... Should I quit and rest?|�

entries.source: TIP: 일부 서브 퀘스트는 시나리오 진행 정도에 따라 수행할 수 없게 될 수 있습니다.�
entries.translation: TIP: Some subquests may become unavailable as the main story progresses.�

entries.source: 야간에는 통행제한이 있어. 밖으로는 못 나가.�
entries.translation: There is a curfew at night. You cannot go outside.�

entries.source: 괜히 돌아다니다가 의뢰를 놓치면 카즈가 죽이려 들거야.�
entries.translation: If you wander off and miss a job, Kaze will kill you.�
Have you heard about the Saintess of 9th Street?�

entries.source: 나같은 불구였는데 어느날 갑자기 멀쩡해졌다는군. 게다가 기적까지 일으킨데.�
entries.translation: She was crippled like me, but suddenly healed one day. They say she even works miracles.�

entries.source: 세상이 불공평한 것도 짜증나는데, 신까지 불공평해.. 빌어먹을.�
entries.translation: It is infuriating that the world is unfair, but even God is unfair... Dammit.�

entries.source: 정말 엄청 크다! 엄청! 난 꼭 커서 저기서 일할거야!�
entries.translation: It is so huge! Massive! When I grow up, I am definitely working there!�

entries.source: 저 건물 안에서는 무엇을 연구하고 있는걸까?�
entries.translation: What kind of research are they doing inside that building?�

entries.source: 요즘 센트럴 타워로 들어가는 자재량이 부쩍 줄었어.�
entries.translation: Lately, the amount of materials going into Central Tower has dropped sharply.�

entries.source: 마물들이 진화한 것과 관련이 있는 건지, 아니면 용병길드가 괴멸된 것과 관련이 있는 건지..�
entries.translation: I wonder if it is related to the evolved monsters, or the annihilation of the Mercenary Guild...�

entries.source: 이제 센트럴은 공화국의 수도로 한치의 부족함도 없을 정도로 발전했어.�
entries.translation: Central has developed so much that it is now truly worthy of being the Republic capital.�

entries.source: 의회는 앞으로 공화국 전체의 산업화를 진행할 생각이라는군.�
entries.translation: They say parliament plans to push industrialization across the entire Republic.�

entries.source: 음.. 여행자로서 느끼는 건데, 센트럴은 뭔가 가면을 쓰고 있는 듯한 기분이야.�
entries.translation: Hmm... As a traveler, I cannot help feeling that Central is wearing a mask.�

entries.source: 지금 인간의 능력으로 만들 수 있는 최첨단의 도시인데.. 은근히 비과학적인 소문이 많다고.�
entries.translation: It is the most advanced city humanly possible, yet it is full of unscientific rumors.�

entries.source: 센트럴 타워의 행방불명자라던가.. 늑대 인간의 살인 사건이라던가.. 9번가의 성녀라던가..�
entries.translation: Disappearances at Central Tower... Werewolf murders... The Saintess of 9th Street...�

entries.source: 인류가 현재 사용하고 있는 모든 기술은 저 센트럴 타워에서 나왔다고 해도 과언이 아니야.�
entries.translation: It is no exaggeration that all tech humanity currently uses came from Central Tower.�

entries.source: 웨이드 가문은 저 안에, 도대체 얼마만큼의 천재를 모아둔 걸까?�
entries.translation: Just how many geniuses has House Wade gathered in there?�

entries.source: 1년 전부터 도는 늑대인간의 소문이 그냥 괴담일 뿐일까?�
entries.translation: Could the werewolf rumors from a year ago really just be a ghost story?�

entries.source: 난 그게 인간 사회에 침투한 선주종 일거라고 생각해. 그들에게는 변신 마법도 있으니까.�
entries.translation: I think it is an Ancient that infiltrated human society. They have shapeshifting magic, after all.�

entries.source: 왜 의회에서는 적극적으로 그 사건을 조사하지 않는건지..�
entries.translation: Why is not parliament actively investigating that incident...?�
I am glad my child is enjoying it.�

entries.source: 공화국에서 가장 크고 높은 건물이라는 센트럴 타워를 아이에게 꼭 보여주고 싶었어요.�
entries.translation: I really wanted to show my child Central Tower, the largest and tallest building in the Republic.�

entries.source: 후우.. 센트럴 타워에서 일한다고 하면 다들 부러워하지만..�
entries.translation: Phew... Everyone envies me when I say I work at Central Tower, but...�

entries.source: 엄청 답답하다고, 항상 정해진 구역만 움직여야 되니까.�
entries.translation: It is terribly suffocating. You are confined to designated zones all the time.�

entries.source: 연구를 담당하는 그 소문의 천재들은, 대체 어디에 있는건지 보지도 못해.�
entries.translation: Those rumored geniuses doing the research? Nobody even gets to see where they are.�

entries.source: |(}흑의병|.. 웨이드 가문에서 운영하는 사설부대다. 위험한 놈들이야.)�
entries.translation: |(The }Black Guard|... House Wade private militia. Dangerous bastards.)�
There are not many regular troops on 17th Street.�

entries.source: 웨이드 가의 높은 분들은 정규군보다 자신들의 사설부대인 흑의병을 더 신뢰하거든.�
entries.translation: The high and mighty of House Wade trust their private Black Guard more than regular soldiers.�

entries.source: 나도 흑의병이 되고 싶기는 한데.. 요즘은 모집을 안하는구만.�
entries.translation: I would like to join the Black Guard too, but they have not been recruiting lately.�
It hurts my feelings when you put it like that.�

entries.source: 적어도 지난 석 달간 네가 일한 걸로 보면 말이야, 넌 정말로 머리가 좋은 놈이거든.�
entries.translation: Judging by the work you have done these past three months, you are pretty sharp.�

entries.source: 의뢰인은 정체불명에, 버려진 지하도의 고블린 퇴치라니 아무래도 수상하잖아. 짐작 가는 게 있지?�
entries.translation: An unknown client, goblin extermination in an abandoned underpass... It is fishy. Any ideas?�

entries.source: 이런 의뢰가 자꾸 들어오면 곤란하다고. 지혜를 좀 빌려줘 봐.�
entries.translation: It is trouble if requests like this keep coming in. Lend me some of your wisdom.�
If it is trouble, just do not take requests like that.�
Come on, do not be like that.�

entries.source: }센트럴 타워{와 연결된 수많은 지하도 중 하나일 뿐이야. 높이와 구조를 보면 역시, 잠입이 가능한 루트는 아니었어.�
entries.translation: It is just one of many underpasses linked to }Central Tower{. Given its layout, it is definitely not an infiltration route.�

entries.source: 당연하지. 타워로 잠입할 수 있는 방법 따윈 없어. 웨이드 가에서 철통같이 지키고 있으니까.�
entries.translation: Naturally. Infiltrating the tower is impossible. House Wade guards it like an iron fortress.�

entries.source: 하지만 안에서 빠져 나오기 위한 루트라면 불가능 하진 않아 보이더군.�
entries.translation: However, as an escape route to get out from the inside, it did not seem impossible.�

entries.source: 그 말은.. 이 정체불명의 의뢰인이 타워에서 도망치려고 한다는 거야?�
entries.translation: You mean... this unknown client is trying to flee the tower?�

entries.source: 이 의뢰에 다른 목적이 있다고 한다면 그것 말고는 떠오르는 게 없어.�
entries.translation: If this request has an ulterior motive, I cannot think of anything else.�

entries.source: 그러니까 괜한 일에 얽히기 싫으면 그 쪽 경로로는 의뢰를 받지 말라고. 재수없으면 의회에 찍힐 테니까..�
entries.translation: So if you do not want trouble, do not take jobs for that route. Cross the council, and you are done for...�

entries.source: 돈을 벌고 싶으면 차라리 그 길목에 죽치고 있다가 도망자를 잡는 게 나을걸.�
entries.translation: If you want cash, you would be better off camping that route and catching the runaway.�

entries.source: 흠.. 역시, 수도 한복판에 있기에는 의심스럽단 말이야.. 그 }타워{라는 건물.�
entries.translation: Hmm... A building like the }Tower{ in the center of the capital is suspicious indeed...�

entries.source: 그쪽으로는 뭔가 생각해본 적 없나? }웨이드 가{가 그 안에서 무슨 짓을 하고 있는지.�
entries.translation: Have not you ever thought about it? What }House Wade{ is doing in there?�
No idea. I would like to know myself.�

entries.source: 이봐, 또 오라고! 네 녀석 일은 알찬 걸로 준비해 둘테니!�
entries.translation: Hey, come back soon! I will have some juicy jobs lined up for you!�

entries.source: 버르장머리는 없지만, 어린 놈이 쓸만하단 말이지..�
entries.translation: He lacks manners, but the kid sure is useful...�

entries.source: 단골 고객의 추천을 받아 이 길드를 선택한 거니, 믿을만한 자로 부탁 드립니다.�
entries.translation: I chose this guild on a regular customer recommendation, so please assign someone reliable.�

entries.source: 뭐, 우리 길드원들 중에 못 믿을 사람은 없어. 다만 센트럴 타워는 다들 좀 꺼리는 경향이 있거든..�
entries.translation: Well, none of our guild members are untrustworthy. It is just that people tend to avoid Central Tower...�

entries.source: 센트럴 타워에 들어간다고 하시는데, 호위가 필요하다는군.�
entries.translation: He needs an escort into Central Tower.�

entries.source: 센트럴 타워는 흉흉한 소문이 많아서 그렇지, 생각만큼 위험한 곳은 아닙니다.�
entries.translation: People spread bad rumors about Central Tower, but it is not as dangerous as you think.�

entries.source: 우리는 그저 안내자가 데려다 주는 곳에 물건을 납품하고, 검증이 완료될 때까지 대기만 하면 되죠.�
entries.translation: We just deliver goods where the guide takes us, then wait until inspection is done.�

entries.source: 어려운 일은 아니잖아? 뭘 꺼리는 거야, 용병이 돈 받으면 일을 해야지.�
entries.translation: Does not sound hard. What are you avoiding? A mercenary takes the money and does the job.�

entries.source: 하지만 실제로 타워에서 행방불명 되는 사람이 한 두 명이 아니라고.�
entries.translation: Except more than a few people have gone missing in that tower.�

entries.source: 그런 곳에서 이틀을 머무는 건 아무래도 값을 좀 많이 불러야 할거야.�
entries.translation: Staying two days in a place like that is going to cost you a pretty penny.�
I am sure you will be satisfied with the pay.�

entries.source: 뭐 말만 들으면 쉬워. 그리고 실제로 타워 안에서 의뢰를 수행한 녀석들도 쉬웠다고들 하지.�
entries.translation: Sounds easy enough on paper. And guys who did jobs inside the tower say it was easy, too.�

entries.source: 다만 우리 길드에서도 몇 명이 돌아오질 못했거든. 그것 때문에 다들 타워 쪽 임무는 피하고 있어.�
entries.translation: Trouble is, a few of our own never came back. That is why everyone dodges tower jobs.�

entries.source: 대신 보수는 확실할 거야. 어때, 생각이 있나?�
entries.translation: The pay will be solid, though. Well? Interested?�

entries.source: 좋아. 너는 능력 있는 놈이고.. 그 정도는 투자해야 너도 우리를 믿고 일할 수 있겠지.�
entries.translation: Fine. You have got the skills... That much is worth investing so you will trust us and work.�

entries.source: 이번 일이 끝나면, 정식 단원이 되는 것도 진지하게 생각해 봐.�
entries.translation: Once this job is done, seriously consider becoming an official member.�

entries.source: 좋아, 이 친구가 함께 가줄 거야. 어리긴 해도 우리 길드의 간판 중에 한 명이라고.�
entries.translation: All right, this fellow will go with you. He is young, but he is one of our guild best.�

entries.source: 그런 것 같군요. 용병다운 마음가짐이, 저도 마음에 듭니다.�
entries.translation: Seems so. I like his mercenary mindset, too.�

entries.source: 마음가짐뿐만 아니라 실력도 탑이야. 안심하고 데려갔다 와.�
entries.translation: His skills match his attitude. Take him along with confidence.�
Now then, as for the advance...�

entries.source: 오늘은 더이상 처리할 의뢰가 없네, 너도 들어가서 쉬어.�
entries.translation: No more requests to handle today. Go get some rest.�

entries.source: 아참, 그러고 보니 말하는 걸 잊었는데. 여기 길드 나가서 아래쪽에 있는 건물 알지?�
entries.translation: Oh right, I forgot to mention. You know the building down the street outside the guild?�
A new shop opened up there.�

entries.source: <오늘까지{ 신장개업 이벤트 같은 걸 한다는데 가보는게 어때?�
entries.translation: They are having a grand opening event <until today{. Why not check it out?�

entries.source: 아, 그런데 너는 아직 정식 길드원이 아니니까 달리 혜택은 못 받겠네...�
entries.translation: Ah, but you are not an official member yet, so you would not get perks...�

entries.source: 대장장이한테 가서 보여줘. 오늘 중으로 써야해?�
entries.translation: Show it to the blacksmith. You have to use it today, all right?�
Fine. Does not matter to me.�

entries.source: 널린게 용병 길드지만, 우리 길드는 훨씬 큰 가능성을 가지고 있어.�
entries.translation: Mercenary guilds are everywhere, but ours has much greater potential.�

entries.source: 여긴 공화국의 수도 센트럴이니까.. 너도 그게 의미하는 바는 알고 있겠지?�
entries.translation: This is Central, capital of the Republic... You know what that means, right?�

entries.source: 딱히 정착할 곳이 없다면 정식으로 길드원이 되는 것도 생각해 보라고.�
entries.translation: If you do not have anywhere to settle down, consider joining us officially.�

entries.source: 지금 폭발적으로 늘어난 용병들은 대부분 }성지전쟁{ 때의 정규군들이야.�
entries.translation: Most of these surging mercenaries were regulars during the }Sanctuary War{.�

entries.source: 전쟁이 끝나고 정규군의 규모가 축소되니까, 실업자가 된 놈들이 개나 소나 용병질을 하더군.�
entries.translation: When the war ended and the army downsized, all those unemployed fools became mercenaries.�

entries.source: 덕분에 용병들 몸값이 형편없이 떨어졌어. 전쟁 중일때는 안 이랬는데..�
entries.translation: Thanks to that, mercenary rates plummeted. Was not like this during the war...�

entries.source: 벌써 5년이나 지났나.. }선주종{ 놈들과 전쟁을 하던 때가 그리워지는군..�
entries.translation: Has it been five years already? I miss the days of fighting those }Firstborn{...�

entries.source: 그땐 나도 잘나갔다고. }케프네스 사령관{의 본부대 소속이었으니까.�
entries.translation: I was a big shot back then, serving in }Commander Kefnes{ main unit.�

entries.source: 전쟁이 그 망할 생선 놈들 때문에 끝나지만 않았어도..�
entries.translation: If only the war had not ended because of those damn fish bastards...�
Hey, you are back. Good work.�
I bought a skill I already learned. Crap.�

entries.source: 할 수 없구만. 뜯어서 환불도 안될테고. 너나 가져라.�
entries.translation: Cannot be helped. It is unsealed, so no refunds. Here, you take it.�
I will take it if you are giving it away, but...�

entries.source: 뭐야. 내가 설마 너한테 주려고 주문했다가 쑥쓰러우니까 이미 배운 스킬인 척 한다거나 하고 생각하는 건 아니겠지?�
entries.translation: What? You do not think I bought it for you and got shy, pretending I already knew it, do you?�
As if that would ever happen.�
I never said anything like that.�
Whatever. You know how to use it, right?�
Open your <Bag{, select the <Skill Book{, and hit Use.�

entries.source: 레벨이 되어야 하지만. 레벨이 되는 스킬은 상점에서 사서 바로 익힐 수도 있고.�
entries.translation: You must meet the level req, of course. You can buy and learn available skills at shops.�

entries.source: 주기적으로 새로 배울 스킬이 없나 체크하는 건 기본이지.�
entries.translation: Checking periodically for new skills to learn is basic common sense.�

entries.source: 어이 슈르츠. 상점에 가는 거면 부탁 좀 하자.�
entries.translation: Hey, Schultz. If you are going to the shop, do me a favor.�

entries.source: <스킬북{을 하나 주문해 놨는데 아무래도 배달을 까먹은 것 같다.�
entries.translation: I ordered a <Skill Book{, but I think they forgot to deliver it.�

entries.source: 가서 좀 대신 받아다 주라. 이쪽 길드라고 하면 알거야.�
entries.translation: Could you pick it up for me? Just tell them you are from our guild.�

entries.source: 바다에서 올라온 생선 인간들 말이야, 의회에서 }고대종{이라고 부르는..�
entries.translation: Those fish-men from the sea... the council calls them }Ancients{...�

entries.source: }매도우 힐{을 점령한 뒤로는 더이상 북쪽으로 올라오지 않는다는군.�
entries.translation: Word is they have not marched north since taking }Meadow Hill{.�

entries.source: 그놈들이라도 계속 쳐들어오면 정규군도 좀 더 소집될텐데..�
entries.translation: If they would just keep invading, the regular army might draft more men...�
You know what our wages are like...�
If it has gone, I am screwed...�

entries.source: 혹시 아까 작전 중에 바닥에 반지 같은 거 못 봤냐?�
entries.translation: Did you see something like a ring on the floor during the op earlier?�

entries.source: 그러지 말고 좀. 중요한 거란 말이다. 혹시 박쥐가 물어갔나?�
entries.translation: Come on, man. It is really important. Maybe a bat carried it off?�

entries.source: 박쥐가 무슨 까마귀도 아니고 그걸 왜 먹겠어?�
entries.translation: Bats are not crows. Why would they take a ring?�

entries.source: 하지만 거기 말고는 짚이는 곳이 없는데...�
entries.translation: Still, I cannot think of anywhere else...�
Then go look for it yourself.�

entries.source: 오늘 당직이라서 자리를 비울 수가 없는데... 대신 좀 봐주고 오면 안되겠냐?�
entries.translation: I am on duty today so I cannot leave... Could you check for me? Please?�

entries.source: 꼭 좀! 부탁한다! 사례는 꼭 할테니까!�
entries.translation: Thank you so much! I will definitely reward you!�
If it is that important, go find it yourself.�
Or better yet, do not lose it in the first place.�

entries.source: 정규군 출신인 놈들은 하나같이 }성지전쟁{ 시절을 그리워하더라고.�
entries.translation: Guys from the regular army always miss the }Sanctuary War{.�

entries.source: 그러면서 전쟁은 싫다고 그러지, 순 겁쟁이놈들..�
entries.translation: Yet they claim they hate war. Bunch of cowards...�

entries.source: 왜 밤이 되어도 별이 안보이는 걸까요?�
entries.translation: Why cannot we see the stars even at night?�
Sometimes I want to go to the forest or the sea.�

entries.source: 하지만 엄마 아빠가 바쁘시니까.. 아마 안되겠죠..�
entries.translation: Mom and Dad are too busy, though... Probably not gonna happen...�

entries.source: 용병 젊은이.. 벌써 우리 건물에 들어온지 3달짼가?�
entries.translation: Young mercenary... Has it been three months since you moved in?�

entries.source: 부지런하게 일하는 건 좋지만 이웃들과 인사도 좀 하고 그러렴.�
entries.translation: Working hard is fine, but you should say hi to your neighbors once in a while.�

entries.source: 이 도시에서 이렇게 인간미가 사라져 가는게 아쉬워서 그래..�
entries.translation: It is sad seeing this city lose all its warmth...�
Living alone, what did I expect.�

entries.source: 이제 베인 가문은 너 혼자 뿐이니까..�
entries.translation: You are all that is left of House Bane...�
Trust no one... Be strong... on your own...�

entries.source: 난.. 그냥 이대로 살아남기만 하면 돼?�
entries.translation: Do I... just have to survive like this?�
As the last... descendant of House Bane?�
^I will grant you what you desire most.�
Ah, you are up. Long time no see.�
This is not exactly a pleasant visit.�

entries.source: 미안, 미안. 새벽에 도착했는데, 좋은 꿈을 꾸는 것 같아서 말이야.�
entries.translation: Sorry, sorry. I arrived at dawn, but you looked like you were having a good dream.�

entries.source: 직접 온 걸 보니.. 준비가 끝났군.�
entries.translation: Seeing you come in person... preparations are complete.�

entries.source: 그래, 너의 계획대로 준비가 됐어. 이제.. }센트럴 타워{에 들어갈 수 있다고.�
entries.translation: Yeah, everything set per your plan. Now... you can enter }Central Tower{.�

entries.source: 오늘 길드에 가보면 아마 제랄드 상회에서 의뢰가 들어가 있을거야. 그걸 받으면 돼.�
entries.translation: If you check the guild today, Gerald Merchantry should have posted a request. Just take it.�

entries.source: 네 쪽은 어때? 그 의뢰를 네가 맡지 않으면 의미가 없어.�
entries.translation: What about your end? It is pointless unless you take that request.�

entries.source: 걱정 마. 신뢰도는 충분히 쌓아놨으니까, 원하는 의뢰 정도는 맡을 수 있어.�
entries.translation: Do not worry. I have built up enough trust, so I can pick whatever request I want.�
Still... why come here in person?�

entries.source: 아, 의뢰는 제랄드 상회에서 직접 할거야. 우리가 추적당할 여지는 남기지 말아야지. 그 정도는 알고 있다고.�
entries.translation: Ah, Gerald Merchantry will handle the request directly. We cannot leave any trail. I know that much.�
I came because I have something to give you.�
...The Tower security card... How did you get this?�

entries.source: 그 일이 있기 전까지.. 아버지는 타워에서 일했었으니까.�
entries.translation: Before that happened... my father worked in the Tower.�

entries.source: 슈르츠, 그 카드까지 쓰고 나면.. 앞으로는 타워를 조사할 기회가 쉽게 찾아오지 않을거야.�
entries.translation: Schultz, once you use that card... chances to investigate the Tower will not come easily again.�

entries.source: 그러니 좀 과감하게 움직여서라도.. 어느 정도 소란을 일으켜서라도 우리의 }진정한 적{에 대한 단서를 찾아야 해.�
entries.translation: So even if it means acting boldly... even if it causes a stir, we must find clues about our }true enemy{.�

entries.source: 잡히지만 않는다면, 어차피 모든 책임은 제랄드 상회와 용병 길드 쪽이 지게 되어 있으니까.�
entries.translation: As long as you do not get caught, Gerald Merchantry and the Mercenary Guild will take the blame anyway.�

entries.source: 저 폐쇄적인 타워 안에는 분명히 뭔가 단서가 있을 거야.�
entries.translation: There must be some clue inside that secluded Tower.�

entries.source: 그리고 난 그것이 인간이나 선주종이 아닌 무언가라고 확신하고 있어.�
entries.translation: And I am certain it is neither human nor ancient race.�

entries.source: 우리 }에네스트 가문{이나 너희 }베인 가문{을 괴멸시킨 진정한 적이지.�
entries.translation: The true enemy that wiped out our }House Ernest{ and your }House Bane{.�
The real fight begins... once we uncover who they are...�
You are... as passionate as ever.�
You are the one lacking passion.�

entries.source: 가문의 원수잖아? }웨이드 가{도, 그 배후에 있는 놈들도!�
entries.translation: They are the sworn enemies of our houses! }House Wade{, and whoever behind them!�

entries.source: 알고 있어. 다만 너무 앞서가지는 말라고.�
entries.translation: I know. Just do not get ahead of yourself.�
Yeah... in the end, you are the one moving.�

entries.source: 타워내의 체류 기간은 이틀이야. 움직일 수 있는 건 하루밤 뿐이니까..�
entries.translation: The stay in the Tower is two days. You can only move for one night, so...�

entries.source: 그래. 네가 움직이는 동안, 나는 에네스트 가의 이름으로 자금을 만들어야 하니까.�
entries.translation: Yeah. While you are on the move, I need to raise funds under House Ernest name.�

entries.source: 모든 건.. 우리의 진정한 적과 싸우기 위해.�
entries.translation: Everything... is to fight our true enemy.�
I believe in you, Schultz. See you back in }Rockville{.�

entries.source: 내게.. 이건 복수같은 게 아니야, 카즈.�
entries.translation: To me... this is not revenge, Kaze.�

entries.source: 남은 게 이것 뿐이라서 하고 있는 것 뿐이지..�
entries.translation: It is just all that I have left to do...�
Hey, wait! Do not run off with the <Society Ring{!�

entries.source: 흠.. 책들은 그다지 참고할만한 것들이 없군.�
entries.translation: Hmm... Not many books worth referencing here.�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬에 가봤나? 동쪽의 추운 섬이지만, 도서관의 규모만큼은 거기가 최고인 듯 해.�
entries.translation: Ever been to Moytura? It is cold out east, but its library is unmatched.�

entries.source: 공화국의 심장이라는 센트럴 타워 옆에 있어서 장사는 제법 잘되는 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Being next to Central Tower, the heart of the Republic, business seems good...�

entries.source: 솔직히 말해서, 물건들의 품질이 그다지 좋은건 아닌 것 같아.�
entries.translation: To be honest, the quality of the goods does not seem that great.�

entries.source: 네~ 그런 식으로 새로운 아이템이 생기면 등록해 주시면 돼요.�
entries.translation: Yes! Just register new items like that whenever you get them.�
We look forward to working with you.�
Would you like to hear the explanation again?�

entries.source: 저에게 말을 거신 후, 분류항목에서 <장신구{를 선택하세요.�
entries.translation: Talk to me, then select <Accessories{ from the categories.�
You see the translucent <Society Ring{ at the bottom, right?�
Hello! Arcane Society Magic Items Research Dept.�

entries.source: 세상의 모든 지식의 수집과 공유, 비밀의 해명을 목적으로 하는 집단이랄까요.�
entries.translation: We seek to collect and share knowledge, unraveling the world secrets.�

entries.source: 여러가지 일을 하기는 하는데 저는 그 중에서도 <장비의 수집{을 맡고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: We do various tasks, but my focus is <Equipment Collection{.�

entries.source: 네. 마법장비, 그러니까 `영웅{, ^전설{, <세트{ 장비 같은 것요.�
entries.translation: Yes. Magic gear, like `Heroic{, ^Legendary{, and <Set{ equipment.�

entries.source: 그런 물건의 정보를 모아서 <도감{을 만들고 있어요.�
entries.translation: We catalog their information into a <Compendium{.�

entries.source: 가져다 주면 나한테 무슨 득이 되는데?�
entries.translation: What is in it for me if I bring them?�

entries.source: 아하하... 네 물론 상점에 팔거나 분해해 버리는게 더 이득일 수도 있죠.�
entries.translation: Haha... Well, selling or dismantling them might yield more immediate profit.�

entries.source: 하지만 등록을 하시면 <도감{에서 언제나 아이템 정보를 확인해 보실 수 있구요.�
entries.translation: But once registered, you can view their stats anytime in the <Compendium{.�

entries.source: 많은 기증을 해주시면 명성을 얻으실 수도 있죠.�
entries.translation: Donating many items also earns you fame.�
There are also <Achievements{ linked to the Compendium...�

entries.source: 뭐 그런 거예요. 저희는 기증을 받을 뿐이고 강요하는 건 아니에요.�
entries.translation: That is how it works. We only take donations we never force anyone.�
Would you like to try it yourself?�

entries.source: 저한테 말을 거신 후, 분류항목을 선택하시면요.�
entries.translation: Talk to me, then choose a category.�

entries.source: 가방에 가지고 계신 물건 중에 저희 분류 기준에 맞는... 그러니까 도감에 등록 가능한 물건을 표시해 드릴 거에요.�
entries.translation: Items in your bag eligible for the Compendium will be displayed.�

entries.source: 그 중에 기증하고 싶으신 물건을 선택해 주시면 됩니다.�
entries.translation: Just select the ones you wish to donate.�

entries.source: 한 번 기증하신 장비는 <회수할 수 없으니까{ 신중하게 생각해 주세요.�
entries.translation: Donated items <cannot be retrieved{, so please choose carefully.�

entries.source: 방금 드린 반지를 한 번 등록해 보세요.�
entries.translation: Try registering the ring I just gave you.�

entries.source: 나중이라도 내킬 때 와서 해주시면 됩니다. 저랑 같은 옷을 입은 사람을 보면 말을 걸어 주세요.�
entries.translation: Come back whenever you feel like it. Just speak to anyone dressed like me.�

entries.source: 어서오세요, 센트럴에서 생산된 물품들은 최고의 성능을 보장합니다.�
entries.translation: Welcome! Central-made goods guarantee peak performance.�

entries.source: 스킬은 스킬북만 산다고 익혀지는 게 아니다. 그에 걸맞는 육체의 강인함이 기본임을 잊지말도록.�
entries.translation: Skills are not mastered just by buying books. Never forget the body must match them.�

entries.source: 건너편 길드에서? 딱히 배달해 달라는 소리는 없었는데...�
entries.translation: From the Guild across? They did not mention any delivery...�
What would you like to know?�

entries.source: 재료를 모아오면 아이템을 만들어 줄 수 있지.�
entries.translation: Bring me materials, and I can craft items for you.�

entries.source: 물론 <스킬{메뉴에서 <조합{ 스킬을 써서 네가 직접 만들 수 있지만.�
entries.translation: Of course, you can use the <Combine{ skill from the <Skill{ menu yourself.�

entries.source: 전문 교육을 받은 대장장이들만 만들 수 있는 아이템도 많이 있어.�
entries.translation: Though there are many items only trained blacksmiths can craft.�

entries.source: 뭘 만들 수 있는지는 대장장이 마다 다르니까 꼭 확인해 보라고.�
entries.translation: What each blacksmith can make differs, so be sure to check.�

entries.source: 재료는 몬스터를 잡거나, 아이템을 <분해{해서 얻을 수 있어.�
entries.translation: You can get materials by hunting monsters or by <dismantling{ items.�

entries.source: 있는 재료를 <조합{해서 고급 재료를 만드는 경우도 있다더군.�
entries.translation: I hear you can even <combine{ materials to make higher-grade ones.�

entries.source: 조합으로 나오는 아이템은 몬스터가 떨어뜨리는 것과 다를 때도 있고.�
entries.translation: Items made through combination can be different from monster drops.�

entries.source: 장비를 살 돈이 없거나 원하는 장비가 잘 안나올 때는 조합하는 것도 방법이야.�
entries.translation: If you lack gold or cannot find what you want, try combining.�
You can use <Refining Stones{ to enhance <weapons{ or <armor{.�

entries.source: 성공하면 공격력이나 방어력이 1 올라가고... 운이 좋아서 >대성공{을 하면 2가 오를 때도 있지.�
entries.translation: Success adds 1 ATK or DEF. With luck, a Great Success adds 2.{�

entries.source: 물론 실패해서 더는 제련할 수 없는 경우도 있고. 재수가 없어서 대실패를 하면 장비가 망가질 때도 있지만�
entries.translation: Failures happen too, locking the item from more refining. A Critical Failure might even break it...�
I do not do it on purpose, you know.�
You can get <Refining Stones{ by <dismantling{ equipment.�
And I do not compensate for broken items!�

entries.source: 고급 제련은 성공확률이 높은 <고급제련석{을 쓰는 거야.�
entries.translation: High refining uses <Quality Refining Stones{ with better success rates.�

entries.source: 오브는 <빈 소켓{이 있는 아이템에 결합할 수 있어.�
entries.translation: Orbs can be socketed into items that have <empty sockets{.�

entries.source: 소켓이 있는 아이템은 상점에서 팔지 않으니 몬스터에게서 얻거나 직접 만드는 수 밖에.�
entries.translation: Shops do not sell socketed items, so find them from monsters or craft them yourself.�

entries.source: 오브가 결합된 무기의 성능은 보통 무기랑은 다르다고.�
entries.translation: Weapons fused with Orbs perform far differently from normal ones.�

entries.source: 같은 오브를 반복해서 박으면 <시너지{가 일어나서 성능이 더 올라가.�
entries.translation: Slotting the same Orb repeatedly creates <Synergy{ for even greater power.�

entries.source: 그런데 오브랑 소켓이 있는 장비는 가지고 있나?�
entries.translation: By the way, do you even have an Orb and socketed gear?�

entries.source: 제련처럼 재수 없으면 장비가 망가지거나 이미 결합된 오브가 사라질 때도 있는데...�
entries.translation: Like refining, bad luck might break the gear or destroy slotted Orbs...�
I can do anything except combination.�

entries.source: 재료를 모아오면 아이템을 만들어 줄 수 있지만 아직 준비가 덜되어서 말야.�
entries.translation: I could craft items if you brought materials, but I am not ready yet.�

entries.source: 수고했어. 덕분에 하루 일찍 개시했으니 이건 선물이다.�
entries.translation: Good job. Thanks to you, I opened a day early. Here is a gift.�

entries.source: 어서옵쇼! 개장 직후라 조합은 아직 안되니까 그거 말고는 뭐든 부탁하라고.�
entries.translation: Welcome! Combination is not open yet, but feel free to ask for anything else.�

entries.source: 아, 혹시 준비를 도와줄 생각이 있나?�
entries.translation: Ah, care to help me prepare?�

entries.source: <지하도{ 같은 곳의 바위 틈에 자라니까 잘 찾아보라고.�
entries.translation: It grows in rock crevices in places like the <underpass{, so look closely.�

entries.source: 싫으면 할 수 없지. 그럼 내일까지 기다리라고.�
entries.translation: Suit yourself. Guess you will have to wait until tomorrow.�

entries.source: 아 제길... 몇 장 뿌리지도 않았는데 대체 어서 난거야?�
entries.translation: Damn it... I barely handed any out, where did you get that?�

entries.source: 약속은 약속이니 할 수 없지. 옛다.�
entries.translation: A deal a deal, though. Here.�
Do not just take it and run!�

entries.source: <제련{이나, <조합{이나, <오브 결합{ 같은 걸 할 수 있지.�
납품은 끝났고.. 물품 검수가 끝나면 내일 바로 나갈 수 있어.�
entries.translation: Delivery is done... Once inspection finishes, we can leave tomorrow.�

entries.source: 여긴 방문자들이 머무는 곳이니까.. 이 구역만 벗어나지 않으면 아무 일도 생기지 않을 거야.�
entries.translation: This is a guest area... As long as you stay within it, nothing will happen.�

entries.source: 그냥 여관이라고 생각하고, 배정된 방에서 쉬도록 해.�
entries.translation: Just think of it as an inn and rest in your assigned room.�

entries.source: 생각보다 오래 걸렸어.. 움직일 수 있는 시간이 얼마 없다.�
entries.translation: Took longer than expected... Not much time left to act.�

entries.source: 어차피 방문자 구역에는 볼 일 없어. 이제부터는.. 과감하게 움직이는 게 되겠군.�
entries.translation: No point staying in the visitor zone anyway. Time to... make bold moves.�
It is locked... But this way leads outside.�

entries.source: 센트럴 타워는 선망의 대상이면서도 안좋은 소문이 꽤 많이 나있지.�
entries.translation: Central Tower is an object of envy, but it has plenty of nasty rumors.�

entries.source: 원래 비밀스러운 곳은 다 그런 것 아니겠어? 막상 들어와보면 별 거 없다구.�
entries.translation: Are not all secretive places like that? Once inside, it is really nothing.�

entries.source: 아직 어려보이는데, 어느 상회에서 왔지? 만난 김에 물건 좀 보겠나?�
entries.translation: You look young, which merchant guild sent you? Care to see my wares?�

entries.source: 음.. 너도 호위 용병인가? 아직 미숙해보이는데.. 적당한 값을 주면 스킬북을 좀 양도해 주지.�
entries.translation: Hmm... An escort merc? You seem green... Pay a fair price and I will part with skillbooks.�

entries.source: 젠장, 몇마리가 풀려났나.. 척봐도 온순해 보이진 않는데, 귀찮군..!�
entries.translation: Damn it, a few broke loose... They do not look docile. What a pain...!�

entries.source: 이렇게 되면 누가 나오기를 기다려서 타는 수밖에 없나?�
entries.translation: At this rate, do I just wait for someone to come out and take it?�

entries.source: 이거 실례했군. 이런 데서 마주칠 줄은 몰랐는데 말이야.�
entries.translation: Pardon me. Did not expect to run into anyone here.�

entries.source: 뭐야, 당신은? 나와 만난 적이 있어?�
entries.translation: Who are you? Have we met before?�
Huh? No, no, I meant a living person.�

entries.source: 여기 고대종도 막 풀어줬는데, 사람이 살아있으니 신기하잖아.�
entries.translation: I just released ancient beasts here, so seeing someone alive is quite a shock.�
Are you the one behind this emergency alarm...?�
You could say that. Excuse me for a second.�

entries.source: 아, 이거 사용하려고 그랬나? 미안하게 됐군, 내가 좀 급해서 말이야.�
entries.translation: Ah, were you trying to use this? Sorry about that, but I am in a hurry.�

entries.source: 공들여서 여기저기 사고를 잔뜩 터뜨렸으니, 지금이 빠져나갈 기회라고.�
entries.translation: I went through the trouble of causing all kinds of chaos, so now my chance to slip out.�
Who are you? Why are you trying to run?�

entries.source: }듣는 자{들은 믿을 수가 없거든. 너도 얼른 나가는 게 좋을 거야.�
entries.translation: You cannot trust the }Listeners{. You had better get out of here too.�

entries.source: 녀석들 열 받았으니까, 아마 다른 사람들은 전부 데려가서 }실험체{로 쓸걸?�
entries.translation: Those guys are furious. They will probably drag everyone else off as }test subjects{.�

entries.source: 미안하지만, 비장의 무기가 움직일 때까지 시간이 얼마 없어. 먼저 실례하지.�
entries.translation: Sorry, but I do not have much time until their trump card moves. I will take my leave first.�
Drag them off...? A trump card?�

entries.source: 멍하고 있을 때가 아니야. 어차피 보안키는 불통이고 타워는 비상경보가 내려졌다.�
entries.translation: No time to stand dazed. Security keys are offline and the tower is on emergency alert anyway.�

entries.source: 저 남자를 쫓아가서 잡아야 해. 저 남자는 분명히 무언가를 알고 있다..!�
entries.translation: I must chase that man down and catch him. He definitely knows something...!�

entries.source: }고대종{.. 인가. 용케도 이렇게 온전한 상태로 포획했군.�
entries.translation: An }ancient beast{... Impressive that they captured it in such intact condition.�

entries.source: 이런 걸 잡아서 뭘 연구하고 있는거지? 그냥 단순히.. 적에 대한 분석일까?�
entries.translation: What are they researching with these? Just simply... analyzing the enemy?�

entries.source: 아무래도.. 더 깊숙한 곳까지 파고들 필요가 있겠어..�
entries.translation: Looks like... I will need to dig in even deeper...�

entries.source: 무엇을 얻고 싶어서, 이런 곳까지 오셨는지 물어도 될까요?�
entries.translation: May I ask what you hope to gain by coming all the way here?�

entries.source: 아, 아아. 일을 하러 왔는데, 길을 잃은 것 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: Ah, well. I came for a job and just got lost, that is all.�
(Damn it... }Isabel{... a member of House Wade. This is troublesome...)�

entries.source: 길을 잃으셨군요. 이곳은 잘 모르는 사람이 함부로 돌아다니기엔 좀 위험할 텐데..�
entries.translation: Lost, are you? It is rather dangerous for strangers to wander around here...�
You are not particularly polite, are you?�

entries.source: 용병이 상대에게 예의를 차리면 얕잡아 보이거든. 나이를 떠나서.�
entries.translation: Mercenaries get looked down on if they show politeness. Regardless of age.�

entries.source: 그것보다, 정말로, 길을 잃은 건 아니시겠죠?�
entries.translation: More importantly, you really are not just lost, are you?�

entries.source: 원하는 것도 없이 이런 곳을 헤메실 분으로는 안 보이는데.�
entries.translation: You do not look like someone who would wander here without a purpose.�
Really, I just lost my way.�

entries.source: 어쨌든, 더 깊숙한 곳까지 파고드는 건 권하고 싶지 않아요.�
entries.translation: Regardless, I would not recommend delving any deeper.�

entries.source: 여기까지는 괜찮지만.. 이 구역은 제 관할이거든요.�
entries.translation: Up to here is fine... but this sector is under my jurisdiction.�
Do not worry, it is not because of you.�

entries.source: 좀 불안하더니, 하필 이럴 때 움직이는 군요.�
entries.translation: I had a bad feeling, and they chose this exact moment to make a move.�

entries.source: 아니 어쩌면.. 이 때를 기다린 것일 수도.�
entries.translation: Or maybe... they have been waiting for this chance.�

entries.source: 돌아가서 방문자 구역에 조용히 있는 것이 좋을 거예요. 목숨이 아깝다면.�
entries.translation: You would best return to the visitor area and stay quiet. If you value your life.�

entries.source: 젠장, 대응이 빠른데.. 이제 이건 사용 못하는 건가..�
entries.translation: Damn, they responded fast... Guess I cannot use this anymore...�

entries.source: 무슨 일인지는 모르겠지만, 나 때문은 아니고 웨이드 가에게는 급박한 일이라면..�
entries.translation: Not sure what is going on, but if it is an emergency for House Wade and not about me...�

entries.source: 혼란스러운 틈을 타, 좀 더 탐색할 수 있을지도..�
entries.translation: I might be able to search further while everything in chaos...�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: 바보 같이, 그 지하도를 잊고 있었어.�
entries.translation: Stupid of me, I forgot about that underpass.�

entries.source: 그 남자는 계획적으로 모든 탈출 경로를 확보해 둔거야..�
entries.translation: He planned this, securing every escape route in advance...�
If I do not hurry, he will get away!�
Hmm... Is this... an air vent?�

entries.source: 승강기는 고장 났어. 더 갈 수 없다면 아까 그 }도망자{를 뒤쫓아야 해!�
entries.translation: The lift is broken. If I cannot go further, I have to chase that }fugitive{!�
Security is already triggered. It will not work...�

entries.source: 움직일 수 있을 때 이동해야 해.. 일단은 록빌에 있는 카즈에게 돌아가야 한다.�
entries.translation: I need to move while I still can... First, get back to Kaze in Rockville.�

entries.source: 일단 상황을 좀 알아보자, 센트럴 타워의 일이 어떻게 처리되었는지..�
entries.translation: Let us check the situation first, see how Central Tower handled things...�

entries.source: ... 말단 공무원처럼 보이는 데.. 살짝 찔러볼까.�
entries.translation: ...Looks like a low-level clerk. Maybe I can poke around for info.�
Better steer clear of the Black Guard...�

entries.source: 당장은 안들어가는 게 좋을 것 같군.. 괜한 폐를 끼칠지도 몰라.�
entries.translation: Probably should not go in right now... Might cause unnecessary trouble.�

entries.source: 아직이야.. 상황을 정확히 파악하는 것이 우선이다.�
entries.translation: Not yet... Grasping the situation comes first.�

entries.source: 조만간 저는 이 섬을 떠나야 합니다. 아마도 전방으로 차출될 것 같아요.�
entries.translation: I will have to leave this island soon. Probably getting sent to the front lines.�

entries.source: 뭐 요즘은.. 고대종들도 공격해오지 않는다니까 위험하진 않겠지만..�
entries.translation: Well, they say the ancient species have not attacked lately, so it might not be dangerous...�

entries.source: 역시 고향을 떠나는 건 슬픈 일이죠.�
entries.translation: Still, leaving home is always heartbreaking.�

entries.source: 여전히 전방에서는 간간히 고대종들이 우리의 영역을 공격해온다고 해요.�
entries.translation: They say ancient species still strike our borders from time to time out on the front.�

entries.source: 말이 안통하는 괴물들과 싸우는 곳에 이 사람을 보내야 하다니.. 너무 걱정되네요.�
entries.translation: Sending him off to fight senseless monsters... I am so worried.�

entries.source: 어른들은 참 굉장해요! 도시 밖에는 위험한 짐승들이 우글거리는데 어떻게 이런 도시를 만들었을까요?�
entries.translation: Grown-ups are amazing! Dangerous beasts roam outside, yet they built a city like this!�

entries.source: 전쟁 때 나타난 고대종들도 우리들의 섬에는 감히 쳐들어오지 못한데요!�
entries.translation: They say even the ancient species from the war do not dare attack our island!�

entries.source: 9번가는 선착장이 있는 걸 빼면 그다지 특이할 것 없는 보통의 거리야.�
entries.translation: 9th is just an ordinary street, aside from having the docks.�

entries.source: 하지만 요 앞집에 사는 성녀님 덕분에 제법 많은 사람들이 찾아오지.�
entries.translation: Though quite a few people visit thanks to the Saintess living across the way.�

entries.source: 성녀님이 내리는 치유의 기적은, 겪어보지 않으면 믿을 수 없을 정도라고.�
entries.translation: The healing miracles she performs... you would not believe it unless you saw it.�

entries.source: 센트럴 타워? 어제 반 공화정파가 난동을 부린 모양이던데.. 그리 큰 일은 아닌가 봐.�
entries.translation: Central Tower? Heard anti-republicans caused a fuss yesterday, but it was not a big deal.�
|(As expected, the junior staff know nothing...)�

entries.source: |(}용병|을 찾아가 볼까? 용병길드 하나가 통채로 사라졌으니 뭔가 정보가 있을지도..)�
entries.translation: |(Should I ask a }mercenary|? A whole guild disappeared. They may know something...)�

entries.source: 나중에 꼭 돌아와 사례를 할 테니.. 지금은 귀찮게 굴지 말아줘.�
entries.translation: I will definitely return and repay you later... so please do not pester me now.�
Hey, do not put a lady on the spot.�
Not mine. You can throw it away.�
Miss, a guy like that is...�

entries.source: 난 의회가 하는 일을 항상 지지하고 있어.�
entries.translation: I always support whatever the council does.�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬에서 몇년 전에 반란이 있었다는 건 알고 있지?�
entries.translation: You know there was a rebellion on Moytura Island a few years back, right?�

entries.source: 그 놈들은 무엇이 인간을 위한 건지도 모르고 있는거야. 혼란만 부추기고..�
entries.translation: Those rebels do not even know what is good for mankind. Just stirring up chaos...�

entries.source: 미안하지만 우리 길드는 현재 다른 용병들을 받아들이지 않고 있어.�
entries.translation: Sorry, but our guild is not accepting outside mercenaries right now.�

entries.source: 요즘 센트럴의 다른 길드들에서 스파이들이 난리라고들 해서 말이야..�
entries.translation: Word is, spies from other Central guilds have been running wild lately...�
If you need work, look somewhere else.�

entries.source: 17번가 길드? 그냥 망한 거 아냐? 애초에 근성 없는 놈들이라..�
entries.translation: The 17th Guild? Did not it just go bust? Bunch of slackers from the start...�

entries.source: 혹시, 어제 이후로 새로 내려온 수배서가 있다거나.. 센트럴 주변 경계가 강화되었다거나 하진 않았나?�
entries.translation: By any chance, have any new bounties been posted since yesterday? Or has Central security been tightened?�
Well, no bounties... That is for sure.�

entries.source: 센트럴 주변 경계는 잘 모르겠군. 그런 건 }여행자{에게 물어보는 게 낫지 않아?�
entries.translation: Not sure about Central security. Would not a }traveler{ know better?�
Wait, please just listen to me...�
When did you get ahead of me?�

entries.source: 그게, 앞질러 간 게 아니라.. 함께 온 거예요.�
entries.translation: I did not get ahead... I came with you.�

entries.source: 앞으로 계속.. 이렇게 함께 다녀야 하니까...�
entries.translation: From now on... we need to travel together like this...�

entries.source: 미안하지만, 난 누구를 돌봐줄 만한 사람이 못돼. 생명의 은인이라 해도..�
entries.translation: Sorry, but I am not the type to babysit anyone. Even someone who saved my life...�

entries.source: 차라리 그 아일린이라는 여자에게 신세를 지는 것이 나을 거야.�
entries.translation: You would be better off relying on that woman named Eileen.�
My order still has not arrived yet.�
You made it in time after all!�
You must bring it <before this cargo ship departs{!\u0000�

entries.source: 화물선이 곧 출발하는데 록빌 개발 공단에 보낼 작업복이 딱 하나가 모자라네요.�
entries.translation: The cargo ship is departing soon, but we are short just one work suit for the Rockville Development Complex.�

entries.source: 이게 하나라도 모자라면 위약금을 물어야 해서...�
entries.translation: If even one is missing, I will have to pay a breach penalty...�

entries.source: 충분히 사례를 치르고 매입할테니 혹시 더 준비해 주실 수 있습니까?�
entries.translation: I will pay you handsomely for it, so could you prepare one more?�
You can get one if you ask the <Blacksmith{.�
Ah... Nothing I can do then.�

entries.source: 오늘 저녁에는 오랜만에 황혼 수프를 먹고 싶구만..�
entries.translation: I would love to have some Twilight Soup tonight for the first time in a while...�

entries.source: 내가 젊었을 때는 말이지, 거침없이 나가서 황혼 수프의 재료들을 모아오곤 했지.�
entries.translation: Back in my day, I would boldly head out to gather the ingredients for Twilight Soup myself.�

entries.source: 사먹는 것과는 그 맛의 차원이 달랐는데 말이야.. 허허..�
entries.translation: Tasted completely different from the store-bought stuff... Heh heh...�

entries.source: 의회에서 갑자기 통과시킨 고대종 방어 정책 때문에, 여객선은 운행 안해.�
entries.translation: Because of that Ancient defense policy the Council suddenly passed, passenger ships are not running.�

entries.source: 있는 건 수송선 뿐이니 혹시 탈 생각 있으면 }상점{에 가서 일거리를 건져 봐.�
entries.translation: Only cargo ships are left. If you want a ride, try finding work at the }Shop{.�
Passenger ships bound for Rockville were recently suspended.�

entries.source: 의회에서 갑자기 고대종 방어 계획을 발동해서, 한동안 여객선은 띄우지 말라더군.�
entries.translation: The Council suddenly triggered an Ancient defense plan and told us not to launch passenger ships for a while.�

entries.source: 도대체가.. 뜬금없이 왠 고대종 방어 계획인지. 예고도 없이 말이야..�
entries.translation: Out of nowhere... Why an Ancient defense plan all of a sudden? Without any warning, too...�

entries.source: 이럴 때에 놀러가는 건 포기하는 게 좋아, 아가씨.�
entries.translation: Best give up on pleasure trips at times like this, young lady.�
Is this ship... a cargo ship?�

entries.source: 그래. 록빌 개발 계획에 쓰이는 수송선이라, 이것까지 쉴 수는 없거든.�
entries.translation: Yeah. It is a cargo ship used for Rockville development, so we cannot halt this one.�

entries.source: 정 급한 일이라면 }상점{ 쪽에 알아봐. 운송업자들은 수송선에 탈 수 있으니까..�
entries.translation: If it is urgent, check with the }Shop{. Couriers can board cargo ships...�

entries.source: 여행을 하다보면 정규군들은 괜찮아요. 친절하달까, 순박하달까..�
entries.translation: When traveling, the regular army folks are fine. Kind, maybe even gentle...�

entries.source: 하지만 웨이드 가의 직속부대인 흑의병들은 굉장히 살벌하죠.�
entries.translation: But the Black Guard, House Wade direct unit, are utterly ruthless.�

entries.source: 몰려다니거나 거점이 있는 것도 아니고.. 그들은 무엇을 위한 부대일까요?�
entries.translation: They do not move in packs or have a base... What kind of unit are they, anyway?�

entries.source: 흑의병들이 주변을 좀 서성거리긴 하던데.. 무슨 일이 있긴 있었나봐?�
entries.translation: The Black Guard have been lurking around nearby... Did something happen?�

entries.source: 의회 쪽에선 어제 타워에서 있었던 일에 대해 별 말이 없는데..�
entries.translation: The Council has not said much about what went down at the Tower yesterday...�

entries.source: |(사건은 은폐된 것 같지만.. 흑의병은 좀 귀찮은데.)�
entries.translation: |(The incident seems hushed up... but the Black Guard will be trouble.)�

entries.source: |(어쨌든 우선 센트럴을 벗어나 카즈가 있는 }록빌|로 가야 해. 어떻게든 틈을 찾아보자.)�
entries.translation: |(Either way, I must leave Central and reach }Rockville| where Kaze is. Let us find an opening.)�
Wait, you really need to hear me out.�

entries.source: 이런.. 역시 아직 몸이 회복 덜 되었나.. 헛것이 보이는데..�
entries.translation: Ugh... Guess I have not recovered yet... Seeing things already...�
Finally, you ask... Seriously, that was exhausting...�
I am your Spirit. The one you succeeded, Schultz.�

entries.source: 네가.. 어떻게 내가 꾼 꿈에 대해 알고 있지?�
entries.translation: How do you... know about the dream I had?�

entries.source: 내가 정신을 잃고 있을 때 뭔가 헛소리를 했나? 무슨 수작이지?�
entries.translation: Did I talk in my sleep while I was unconscious? What is the trick here?�
Ah... I have reached my limit...�
It was not a dream, and I am not a trick.�

entries.source: 슈르츠님은 정령의 계승을 승인했고, 뭔지는 몰라도 가장 원하던 것을 얻었을 거예요.�
entries.translation: You accepted the Spirit succession, Schultz. Whatever it was, you must have received what you desired most.�
You are... the last of... House Bane...�
I will not die... I am not gonna die...!�
And... I am the succeeded Spirit.�
From now on, we will be together. Always...�

entries.source: 말도 안 되는 소리야, 그런 일이 있을 리가 없어.�
entries.translation: Nonsense. There is no way that is possible.�
Ugh, fine! Believe what you want!�

entries.source: 어쨌든 저는 슈르츠님 주변에서 밖에 존재할 수 없으니, 그렇게 아세요!�
entries.translation: Either way, I can only exist right beside you, Schultz. So deal with it!�

entries.source: 뭐야.. 도대체 무슨 일이 벌어진 거지?�
entries.translation: What is this... What the hell happened?�

entries.source: 설마.. 그 성녀라는 여자가 나한테 무슨 수작을 부린 건가?�
entries.translation: Could it be... Did that Saintess do something to me?�

entries.source: 선주종들과 사이가 좋을 때는, 이런 선주종식 패션도 유행했었어요.�
entries.translation: When relations with the ancients were good, native fashion like this was popular.�

entries.source: 좀 춥긴하죠.. 아무래도 선주종들은 따뜻한 남쪽섬에 살고 있으니까.�
entries.translation: It is a bit chilly... The natives live on the warm southern islands, after all.�

entries.source: 우리 인간도 따뜻한 섬에서 살려면, 역시 선주종들과의 전쟁밖에 답이 없는 걸까요?�
entries.translation: If we humans want to live on warm islands, is war with the natives really the only answer?�

entries.source: 아일린 언니, 눈 뜰 때가 지난 거 아니에요?�
entries.translation: Eileen, should not he have opened his eyes by now?�

entries.source: 기다려, 이제 육체적인 손상은 거의 회복 되었으니까..�
entries.translation: Wait, his physical wounds are almost healed...�

entries.source: 배에 엄청 큰 구멍이 났잖아? 보통이면 벌써 죽었고, 살았어도 두 달은 치료 받아야 돼.�
entries.translation: He had a huge hole in his belly, right? Normally he would be dead, or bedridden for two months at least.�
The hole in my body is already gone...�

entries.source: 아무것도 얻지 못한 채..;사고만 친 건가..�

entries.translation: I might be a wanted man...�

entries.source: 열심히 영양 공급 해 주고 있으니까. 그게 내 능력이거든.�
entries.translation: I have been steadily providing nourishment. That is my ability, after all.�

entries.source: 근데 몸 참 건강하네.. 이 정도면 믿을 만 하겠죠?�
entries.translation: Still, he is remarkably healthy... Good enough to trust, right?�
You should not push yourself yet.�

entries.source: 우선은 좀 더 누워계세요, 아직 회복이..�
entries.translation: Please lie down a bit longer, you have not fully...�

entries.source: 하여튼 용병이란 사람들은. 정말로 사람 대하는 게 무례하군요.�
entries.translation: Mercenaries... Always so utterly rude to people.�

entries.source: 전 }아일린{이라고 해요. 그리고 여기는 }센트럴 9번가{, 저의 집이구요.�
entries.translation: I am }Eileen{. And this is }Central 9th{, my house.�

entries.source: 난.. 슈르츠다. 내가 용병이란 건 어떻게 알았지?�
entries.translation: I am... Schultz. How did you know I was a mercenary?�

entries.source: 복장이 용병 아니면 도적인데, 도적이면 곤란하잖아요?�
entries.translation: From your outfit, you are either a mercenary or a bandit. A bandit would be troublesome, would not it?�
(Thankfully... does not seem to be an agency under the Council...)\u0000�

entries.source: 잠깐, 아직 좀 더 쉬어야 할 거예요.�
entries.translation: Wait, you still need more rest.�
What state was I in...? How did I get here...?�
You were badly hurt. I thought you were dead...�
Carried you all the way here on her back. Her name is }Ren{.�
I am... in your debt. Thank you.�
I-It was nothing! Anyone would have!�

entries.source: 하지만.. 이 흉터는.. 어떻게 이렇게 부상이 아물 수가..�
entries.translation: Still... these scars... How could wounds like this heal so fast...?�
Yes... So you have heard of me.�

entries.source: 센트럴에 당신의 소문을 못 들어본 사람은 없어.�
entries.translation: Everyone in Central has heard the rumors.�
To think the miracle healing was actually real...�
I will have to pay you handsomely for treatment.�

entries.source: 아니예요, 그건 저 혼자만의 힘이 아니었는 걸요.�
entries.translation: No need. It was not done by my power alone.�

entries.source: 당신이 살아나 준 것 만으로도 기뻐요.. 진심으로.�
entries.translation: I am just glad you survived... sincerely.�

entries.source: 빚 지는 건.. 좋아하지 않아. 다만 지금은 내 길드가 박살 난 것 같으니..�
entries.translation: I do not like owing debts. But my guild seems to have been destroyed...�
I will make sure to repay you later.�

entries.source: 그런 건 아무래도 좋아요. 그것보다 아직..�
entries.translation: Do not worry about that. More importantly, you are not fully--�

entries.source: 아니. 지금.. 마음 편히 쉬고 있을 상황이 못돼, 나는.�
entries.translation: No. I am in no position to rest easy right now.�

entries.source: 내가 상황도 모르고 여기에 있으면 너희들도 위험해 질지 몰라.�
entries.translation: If I stay here without knowing what is happening, you might be in danger too.�

entries.source: 너에게도야. 다음에.. 꼭 사례를 하도록 하지.�
entries.translation: That goes for you too. I will definitely repay you next time.�

entries.source: 사실 9번가의 성녀라는 게 알려지는 것도 좀 부담스러워요.�
entries.translation: Being known as the Saint of 9th Street is a bit burdensome, honestly.�

entries.source: 다행히.. 얘기가 잘 전달 된 모양이네요.�
entries.translation: Fortunately... it seems things were explained well.�

entries.source: 얘기는 했지만, 잘 전달 된 모양은 아니에요.�
entries.translation: I told him, but I would not say it sank in.�
Can you... use }magic{? Are you a }Progenitor{?�
See? I explained everything, and he is still like this.�

entries.source: 뭐.. 어느 날 갑자기 가장 원하던 것을 얻고 정령의 힘을 다루게 되면, 보통은 쉽게 믿을 수 없으니까요.�
entries.translation: Well... if someone suddenly gained what they wanted most and wielded a Spirit power, they would not easily believe it either.�

entries.source: 내가 잠꼬대를 했다고 하기엔 너무 정확하게 알고 있군.�
entries.translation: You know far too much for this to be something I mumbled in my sleep.�
Of course. It is more than just belief.�
You said you heard rumors about me, right?�

entries.source: 사지를 못쓰는 병자였지만, 어느 날 멀쩡하게 일어나 기적의 의술로 사람들을 구해준다고 들었다.�
entries.translation: Bedridden and paralyzed, but one day you stood up and began saving people with miraculous medicine.�
Was that possible because you are a Successor?�

entries.source: 꿈 속에서 계승을 받아들인 그 순간, 완전히 굳어있던 제 몸이 움직이기 시작했어요.�
entries.translation: The moment I accepted the succession in my dream, my completely paralyzed body began to move.�

entries.source: 그리고 저는 정령의 힘을 사용해 사람들을 치유할 수 있게 되었죠.�
entries.translation: And I became able to heal people using the power of a Spirit.�

entries.source: 그 날의 환희는 평생 잊지 못할 거예요. 그건 말 그대로 기적이었으니까.�
entries.translation: I will never forget the joy of that day. It was truly a miracle.�
Then do you have one of these attached to you too?�

entries.source: 제 정령은 렌처럼 실체화 되지 않아요.�
entries.translation: My Spirit does not take physical form like Ren.�

entries.source: 가끔 목소리가 들리긴 하지만.. 보통은 제가 힘을 빌리는 편이죠.�
entries.translation: I hear a voice sometimes, but usually I just borrow its power.�

entries.source: 아마도.. 계승자들마다 정령의 능력이나 형태가 다른 게 아닐까요?�
entries.translation: Perhaps... the Spirit form and power differ for each Successor?�

entries.source: 전 제가 정령이고 슈르츠님이 계승자라는 것 밖에 몰라요.�
entries.translation: All I know is that I am a Spirit and you are a Successor, Schultz.�

entries.source: 목적이라던지, 누가 보냈다던지, 왜 하필 나에게 온 건지..�
entries.translation: The purpose, who sent me, why it had to be me...�

entries.source: 네. 전 슈르츠님이 계승을 승인한 그 때 태어난 걸요.�
entries.translation: Yes. I was born the moment you accepted the succession, Schultz.�

entries.source: 젠장, 정령 계승이라는 건 한 살짜리 애보기냐..�
entries.translation: Damn it. Is spirit succession just babysitting a one-year-old?�

entries.source: 가장 원했던 것을 얻었을 텐데, 조금도 기뻐 보이지 않네요.�
entries.translation: You must have gotten what you wanted most, yet you do not look happy at all.�
There is nothing I wanted most.�
To be stuck with such a grim successor... How despairing...�

entries.source: 하지만 마지막으로 그 꿈을 꿀 때는.. 죽어가고 있었으니..�
entries.translation: When I had that dream for the last time... I was dying...�
All I thought about... was surviving.�

entries.source: 그래서.. 그런 상처를 입고도 살아날 수 있었던 거야..�
entries.translation: That is why... I could survive wounds like that...�
Owing my life... That is the worst.�

entries.source: 나타났다 사라졌다 하는 것 외에 다른 능력은?�
entries.translation: Aside from appearing and disappearing, do you have any other abilities?�
Um... a bit of combat magic?�
I like the sound of that.�
Wow, that is the first positive thing I have heard from you.�

entries.source: 당신을 치료할 때, 마음에 걸리는 게 있었어요.�
entries.translation: While I was treating you, something troubled me.�

entries.source: 계승하던 때에 들렸던 마지막 목소리.. 기억 나시나요?�
entries.translation: Do you remember the last voice you heard during the succession?�
^If you do not wish to lose it...�
In the battle against all other successors...�

entries.source: 최후의 승자가 되어야 한다고 했죠.. 전 그게 항상 마음에 걸렸어요.�
entries.translation: It said you must be the final victor... That has always weighed on my mind.�
Must the successors... truly fight each other?�

entries.source: 적어도 지금은, 그럴 필요성이 전혀 느껴지질 않는데.�
entries.translation: At least right now, I see no need for that whatsoever.�
I am glad to hear you say that...�

entries.source: 그냥 이대로 살아갈 수 있다면, 전 그렇게 하고 싶어요. 다른 계승자들도 그랬으면 하구요.�
entries.translation: If we can just live like this, that is what I want. I hope other successors feel the same.�

entries.source: 동감이야. 하지만.. 정령이 무엇인지 정확히 모르는 상황이라 확신할 수 없군.�
entries.translation: I agree. But... not knowing what spirits truly are, I cannot be certain.�

entries.source: 정말 이 계승에 내 생명이 달렸다면.. 싸워야 할땐 싸워야 할지도 모르지.�
entries.translation: If my life really depends on this succession... I might have to fight when the time comes.�

entries.source: 그냥 기적이라고 해버리기엔 뭔가.. 찝찝하지 않아?�
entries.translation: Does it not feel a bit uneasy... to simply call it a miracle?�

entries.source: 슈르츠, 저에게 치료의 보답을 해주신다고 했죠?�
entries.translation: Schultz, you said you would repay me for treating you, right?�

entries.source: 저를.. }베르날 섬{의 }록빌{까지 데려다 주실 수 있나요?�
entries.translation: Could you take me to }Rockville{ on }Vernal Isle{?�

entries.source: 얼마 전에.. 그곳에 있는 }다른 계승자{가 만나고 싶다는 서신을 보내왔어요.�
entries.translation: A short while ago... }another successor{ there sent a letter asking to meet.�

entries.source: 이름은 }마르크{. 록빌에서 몇 년 전, 갑자기 큰 부를 얻은 사람이에요.�
entries.translation: His name is }Marc{. A man in Rockville who suddenly gained great wealth a few years ago.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 혼자서는 다른 계승자를 만나는 것이 두려워서..�
entries.translation: But... I was afraid to meet another successor alone...�

entries.source: 함께 그 사람을 만나러 가주시지 않을래요?�
entries.translation: Would you come with me to see him?�

entries.source: 록빌이라.. 마치 짜맞춘 것처럼 일이 돌아가는 군.�
entries.translation: Rockville... Things are falling into place almost too neatly.�
I was just about to head to Rockville myself.�

entries.source: 함께 만나 주지. 그 또 다른 계승자와..�
entries.translation: I will go with you. To meet this other successor...�

entries.source: 와, 그럼 언니도 함께 가는 거예요?�
entries.translation: Yay! Are you coming along too, miss?�
Wonderful! The future was looking so bleak...!�

entries.source: 고마워요. 그럼 록빌로 가는 배를 알아 봐야겠네요.�
entries.translation: Thank you. Then we should look for a ship bound for Rockville.�

entries.source: 흠.. 베르날 섬은 }황혼의 다리{가 있으니 혼자라면 걸어서도 갈 수 있지만.�
entries.translation: Hmm... Vernal Isle has the }Twilight Bridge{, so alone I could walk, but...�

entries.source: 록빌로 가는 배 편은 요즘 구하기 힘들다고 들었는데..�
entries.translation: I heard ship tickets to Rockville are hard to come by lately...�

entries.source: 아.. 돈이 모자르시군요. 사실 의향이 있으시면, 기다릴게요.�
entries.translation: Ah... You do not have enough money. If you are interested, I will wait.�

entries.source: 제대로 된 황혼 수프 식당을 만드려면, 사오는 재료로는 부족하죠.�
entries.translation: To make proper Twilight Soup for a diner, store-bought ingredients just will not do.�

entries.source: 식당을 여는 것도 문제지만 재료도 직접 구해와야 할텐데..�
entries.translation: Opening a diner is one thing, but we also have to gather ingredients ourselves...�
Honestly, I just cannot trust that man.�

entries.source: 당장 오늘 저녘 식재료 살 돈도 없는데, 저 남정네는 무슨 배짱으로 식당을 내자는 건지..�
entries.translation: We do not even have money for tonight dinner, yet he talks about opening a diner...�

entries.source: 제 황혼 수프가 맛있긴 하죠.. 하지만 식당을 여는 건 말도 안되는 소리에요.�
entries.translation: My Twilight Soup is good, sure... But opening a diner is out of the question.�

entries.source: 혹시, 황혼 수프 레시피가 필요하지 않으신가요? 여행중이시라면 좋은 먹거리가 될텐데..�
entries.translation: Say, do you need a Twilight Soup recipe? It would make great food for your travels...�

entries.source: 1000골드에 드릴게요. 보시다시피 저희가 지금 당장 돈이 급해서..�
entries.translation: I will give it to you for 1000 Gold. As you see, we desperately need money now...�

entries.source: 에에.. 역시 레시피를 파는 건 욕심이죠..?�
entries.translation: Well... I guess selling recipes was being too greedy, right?�
Central is actually overflowing with people.�

entries.source: 정확히 말하면 제대로 된 일자리가 부족하달까.. 내가 능력이 없어서 이러는 게 아니라고.�
entries.translation: To be precise, decent jobs are lacking... It is not because I lack talent.�

entries.source: 여편네가 요리실력이 좋으니 식당이라도 하나 내볼까 생각 중인데..�
entries.translation: My wife is a great cook, so I am thinking of opening a diner...�

entries.source: 다양한 장비를 사용해보는 것은 굉장히 소중한 경험이죠. 얼마나 많은 경험을 해보셨나요?�
entries.translation: Trying various equipment is a valuable experience. How much have you tried?�

entries.source: 오르비스 군도 말고 다른 땅은 없을까?�
entries.translation: Is there no other land beyond the Orbis Archipelago?�

entries.source: 인간과 선주종은 이 몇 개 안되는 섬을 서로 차지하겠다고 싸워야만 했을까?�
entries.translation: Did humans and natives really have to fight just to claim these few islands?�

entries.source: 사거나 팔 물건이 있나? 매물은 1/5 가격에 받고, 흥정은 없네.�
entries.translation: Looking to buy or sell? I buy at 1/5 price, no bargaining.�
Logan? You mean that lame guy at the inn?�

entries.source: 자넨 바쁘다고 하더니 꽤 여기저기 돌아다닌 모양이군?�
entries.translation: You said you were busy, but you seem to have wandered quite a bit?�

entries.source: 뭐, 알았어. 그 친구라면 돈도 꽤 있을테니.�
entries.translation: Well, fine. He should have plenty of coin anyway.�

entries.source: 오호, 제법 빠른 걸? 벌써 다 모아 온 건가?�
entries.translation: Oho, pretty fast! You gathered everything already?�

entries.source: 급한 일이라고 했잖아. 배는 아직 출항하지 않았겠지?�
entries.translation: I told you it was urgent. The ship has not sailed yet, right?�

entries.source: 다음 배로 보내준다고 그랬는데, 서두르면 이번 것도 탈 수 있겠어.�
entries.translation: I said the next ship, but if we hurry, you might catch this one.�

entries.source: 부지런히 움직여 줬으니, 내 손을 좀 써주지.�
entries.translation: Since you worked diligently, I will pull some strings.�
Are you the manager of this shop?�

entries.source: 그렇소만, 우리 상점에 무슨 볼 일 이라도?�
entries.translation: Yes, do you have business with our shop?�

entries.source: 아니.. 혹시, 록빌로 보낼 물건이 있으면 배달 업무를 맡을 수 있을까 해서.�
entries.translation: Well... If you have goods for Rockville, could I take a delivery job?�
Hmm... You look young, but like a mercenary... A delivery?�

entries.source: 록빌에 급하게 가야 할 일이 생겨서..�
entries.translation: I have urgent business in Rockville...�

entries.source: 돌려 말하기는.. 결국 수송선에 자리를 만들어달라는 얘기로군 그래.�
entries.translation: Beating around the bush... In short, you want a spot on the transport ship.�

entries.source: 그런 거라면 배달보다 적당한 의뢰가 있지. 최근 수급이 원활하지 못한 물품이 좀 있거든.�
entries.translation: In that case, I have a better request than delivery. A few supplies are running low.�

entries.source: 용병이니까, 재료 모으기 정도는 가능 하겠지?�
entries.translation: Since you are a mercenary, gathering materials should be easy, right?�

entries.source: 좋아, 그럼. 마침 록빌 개발 공단에서 요청해온 게 있는데, 그걸 하면 되겠군.�
entries.translation: Good. The Rockville Industrial Complex just requested something, so that will do.�

entries.source: 센트럴 밖에 나가서 }전갈 갑피{를 }10개{만 모아 오시게.�
entries.translation: Go outside Central and collect }10{ }Scorpion Carapaces{.�

entries.source: 배송 신청서는 작성해 두도록 할 테니, 바로 수송선에 탈 수 있을 거야.�
entries.translation: I will prepare the shipping order, so you can board right away.�

entries.source: 당장 수행하지. 수송선에 세 자리만 마련해 줘.�
entries.translation: I will do it right away. Just secure three spots on the ship.�

entries.source: 스킬을 익힌데에 만족하지 말게. 스킬의 위력을 배가시켜주는 }강화 특성{을 개발하는 것도 중요하니까.�
entries.translation: Do not just be content with learning skills. Developing }Enhance Traits{ is key.�
If the materials are ready, try Unique Crafting.�
Good, you brought the right items.�

entries.source: 이건 뭐 내가 교습비 겸 조합비로 받아두지.�
entries.translation: I will take this as a teaching and crafting fee.�

entries.source: 록빌 개발 공단에 보낼 물건이라...추가 선적을 하나 보군.�
entries.translation: Goods for Rockville Industrial Complex... Looks like an extra shipment.�

entries.source: 만드는 거야 자네가 재료만 챙겨오면 만들어 줄 수는 있는데.�
entries.translation: I can craft it if you bring the materials, but...�

entries.source: 필요한 재료가 <분해{를 해야 얻을 수 있는 거라서. 가능하겠나?�
entries.translation: You must <Dismantle{ to get the required materials. Can you do it?�

entries.source: 그럼 어디 시험 삼아서 재료만 한 번 가지고 와 봐.�
entries.translation: Then bring me the materials as a test.�

entries.source: <무기{, <방어구{, <장신구{를 분해해서 재료나, 제련석 같은 걸 얻는거야.�
entries.translation: Dismantling <weapons{, <armor{, or <accessories{ gives materials or refine stones.�
Select <weapons{, <armor{, or <accessories{ in your Bag to see the <Dismantle{ menu.�

entries.source: 보통은 <돈{이나 <재료{가 나오지만 가끔 <포션{이나 <제련석{이 나올 때도 있어.�
entries.translation: Usually gives <gold{ or <materials{, but sometimes <potions{ or <refine stones{.�

entries.source: `영웅{이나 ^전설{, <세트{ 등급의 아이템을 분해하면 드물게 <오브{를 얻을 수 있고.�
돈이 급한 게 아니라면 아무래도 필요없는 장비는 팔기보다는 분해하는게 이득이지.�
entries.translation: Unless strapped for cash, dismantling unwanted gear beats selling it.�

entries.source: 아이템을 분해하면 <저장{이 되어서 되돌릴 수 없으니 조심하고.�
entries.translation: Dismantling items <saves{ progress permanently, so be careful.�
Understand now? Can you do it?�

entries.source: 자, 그럼.. 약간의 전투 능력이라는 걸 좀 볼까?�
entries.translation: Now, then... let us see this combat ability of yours.�

entries.source: 에에? 설마 저에게 사냥을 맡기시려는 거예요?�
entries.translation: Huh? You are not making me hunt alone, are you?�
You said you could fight, did not you?�

entries.source: 제 능력은 계승자가 어느 정도 보조를 해주셔야 되요. 혼자서는 못 해요.�
entries.translation: My power needs support from the Successor. I cannot do it alone!�
Support? You cannot do it alone?�

entries.source: 네.. 계승자가 전투를 통해 저의 마법력을 충전해 주시는 게 필요해요.�
entries.translation: Yes... You need to charge my magic power through combat.�

entries.source: 왼쪽 위에, 보이시죠? 저게 한 단계 찰 때마다, 정령 스킬을 한 번씩 사용할 수 있어요.�
entries.translation: See top-left? Each time that fills one tier, you can use a Spirit skill.�

entries.source: 저를 호출하는 단축키는 스킬 메뉴에서 등록하시면 되구요.�
entries.translation: You can register my summon shortcut in the Skills menu.�

entries.source: 그게 뭐야.. 결국 싸우는 건 나라는 소리잖아. 그것도 능력인가?�
entries.translation: What is that... So in the end, I am the one fighting. Call that an ability?�

entries.source: 일단 마법력을 한 번 모아서 사용해 보세요. 이래봬도, 꽤 쓸 만한 능력이니까요.�
entries.translation: Just charge up magic power and try it! It is actually pretty handy!�

entries.source: 이건 뭐.. 여러 가지로 귀찮군 그래.�
entries.translation: Man... this is a pain in every possible way.�

entries.source: 이것마저도 도움이 안 되면 정말 우울한데.�
entries.translation: If even this is useless, I will really be depressed.�
Just trust me and use it already!�
Is hunting over? How did I do?�

entries.source: 기왕이면 좀 더 멋지고 친절한 계승자님을 만나고 싶었어..�
entries.translation: I wish I had met a cooler, kinder Successor...�

entries.source: 음.. 아까부터 왠지 아일린 언니가 근처에 있는 듯한 느낌인데..�
entries.translation: Hmm... I have felt like Eileen has been nearby for a while now...�

entries.source: 호오.. 저 귀여운 애기가 날 느낀건가?�
entries.translation: Ho-oh... Did that cute little baby sense me?�
A Successor after all... No mistake...�

entries.source: 크크크크.. 싸움질도 제법 하는 것 같고.. 재미 있겠는데?�
entries.translation: Hehehe... Seems he can put up a fight too... This should be fun.�
After waiting this long... I am going to enjoy this... Hehehe...�

entries.source: }흑의병{.. 웨이드 가의 직속 부대인 저놈들이 이 길을 지킨다는 건..�
entries.translation: The }Black Guard{... Wade family private troop guarding this road...�

entries.source: 타워의 사건과 무관하진 않겠지. 지금 눈에 띄면 위험할거야.�
entries.translation: Must be tied to the Tower incident. Getting spotted now is dangerous.�

entries.source: 흑의병 놈들 전부 센트럴 안으로 들어간건가.. 불행중 다행이군.�
entries.translation: Did the Black Guard head into Central?... A blessing in disguise.�

entries.source: 비.. 로군.. 일단 흑의병들은 보이질 않으니 한 시름 놓긴 했는데..�
entries.translation: Rain, huh... Well, no Black Guard in sight, so that is a relief...�

entries.source: 저.. 계승자님, 이쯤에서 좀 쉬어가는 게 어때요?�
entries.translation: Um... Successor, can we take a short rest here?�
I am hungry... and my recovery is so slow...�
I... I do not eat that much!�

entries.source: 다치기도 하고, 밥도 먹고, 아는 건 없고, 이것 참.. 정말로 애보기잖아.�
entries.translation: Gets hurt, eats food, knows nothing... Man, I am basically babysitting.�

entries.source: 정령이라고.. 인간하고 그다지 다른 건 아니에요..�
entries.translation: Being a Spirit does not make me all that different from humans...�
Well... I did not intend to march through the night anyway...�

entries.source: 야영할 만한 곳을 찾아보도록 하지. 그때까진 참아.�
entries.translation: I will find a spot to camp. Bear with it until then.�

entries.source: 혼자서 하는 야영은 익숙한데 말이야.. 부상자까지 함께라니.�
entries.translation: I am used to camping alone... but having an injured passenger is new.�
Right. I picked up that Twilight Soup recipe...�
It has been a while since I camped. Might as well try making it.�

entries.source: 재료는 대충 이근처에서 구할 수 있을 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Should be able to find the ingredients around here...�
How is your recovery coming along?�
Who else would I be talking to, the campfire?�

entries.source: 실체화를 안하고 있는 건 자는 거랑 비슷해서.. 못 들었어요.�
entries.translation: Not being materialized is a lot like sleeping... I did not hear you.�

entries.source: 걱정해 주신 덕분에.. 회복은 거의 끝난 것 같네요.�
entries.translation: Thanks to your concern... I am almost fully recovered.�

entries.source: 그 정도의 상처가 하루 만에 낫다니, 신기하긴 하다만..�
entries.translation: It is baffling how wounds like that healed in a single day, but...�

entries.source: 실체화 안 되는 게 더 편하다면 어째서 굳이 실체화가 되는 거지?�
entries.translation: If staying dematerialized is easier, why materialize at all?�
You really do find me troublesome, do you not?�

entries.source: 아니, 워낙 혼자인 게 익숙할 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: No, I am just used to being alone.�

entries.source: 뭐라고 할까.. 계속 깨어있는 것만큼이나 계속 자는 것도 힘들지 않나요?�
entries.translation: How should I put it... Is not sleeping constantly just as exhausting as staying awake?�

entries.source: 왜 아일린의 정령과 다르게 그런 귀찮은 형태를 띄고 있는 건데?�
entries.translation: Why do you take such a bothersome shape, unlike Eileen spirit?�
...So that is how you really feel?�
Anyone would be curious about this.�

entries.source: 혼자일 땐 신경 쓰지 않았던 것 들까지 신경 써야 한다.. 는 걸 귀찮다고 하면 귀찮은 거겠지.�
entries.translation: Having to worry about things I never had to alone... If that is annoying, then yes, it is.�

entries.source: 저도 몰라요. 정령이 뭐고 왜 제가 이런 형태인지.�
entries.translation: I do not know either. What a spirit is, or why I look like this.�

entries.source: 그럼 슈르츠님은 인간이 왜 그런 모습이고, 무엇을 위해 살고 있는지 다 아시나 보죠?�
entries.translation: Then do you know why humans look the way they do, or why they live, Schultz?�

entries.source: 다치기도 하고 밥도 먹고 아는 것도 없어서 죄송하네요.�
entries.translation: I am sorry that I get hurt, eat food, and know nothing!�

entries.source: 하지만 생명과 맞바꿔 얻은 정령이니 좀 소중히 대해주시면 감사하겠어요.�
entries.translation: Still, I am a spirit gained at the cost of a life, so I would appreciate a little respect!�

entries.source: 알았어. 더 안 물어볼 테니 밥이나 먹자.�
entries.translation: Fine. I will not ask any more, so let us just eat.�
What... kind of food is this?�
Schultz, your cooking is the complete opposite of your personality!�
With food like this, I could look forward to camping...�

entries.source: 이건 황혼섬 특산물로 만든거라 이번 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: This was made from Twilight Isle specialties, so it is a one-time thing.�

entries.source: 부상자도 있고 해서 만들어 본거지, 평소엔 그냥 육포로 때운다. 그러니까 꿈 깨.�
entries.translation: I only made it because you were hurt. Usually, I just eat jerky. So do not get your hopes up.�

entries.source: 좀 아쉽지만 뭐, 전 육포도 좋아요.�
entries.translation: A bit of a shame, but well, I like jerky too.�
Hmm... Is around here good enough?�

entries.source: 자리펴기 전에 좀 더 주변을 정리해두자.�
entries.translation: Let us clear the area a bit more before setting up camp.�
The rain stopped... Today should be easier than yesterday.�
Well then, I will go back inside.�
Are not you fully recovered now?�
You will just find me bothersome anyway.�
Well, I am used to being alone...�

entries.source: 네에, 그러니까. 록빌 도착할 때까지 전 계속 잠이나 잘게요.�
entries.translation: Yes, exactly. So I will just sleep until we reach Rockville.�
Well, if you can do that...�

entries.source: 어쨌든 루퍼스라는 남자도, 흑의병도 황혼섬을 벗어나기 전에는 안심할 수 없는 존재들이니까.�
entries.translation: Anyway, neither that Rufus guy nor the Black Guard will let us relax until we leave Twilight Isle.�
Let us hurry. Twilight Bridge is just ahead.�
That is }Central 17th{.. Going back now is suicide.�

entries.source: 이렇게 큰 다리라니! 그것도 바다 위에!�
entries.translation: Such a massive bridge! And it is over the sea!�
Of course! I was just born, you know...�
Right... You are a one-year-old kid.�
I will go back inside. I will not bother you.�
It is weird. Am I alone or not..?�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: 저기 저 놈이다! 파란 머리의 용병!�
entries.translation: There he is! The blue-haired mercenary!�
I have a bad feeling about this...�

entries.source: 일단 구속해! 반란분자일 가능성이 있으니 조심하고!�
entries.translation: Restrain him! Watch out, he might be an insurgent!�

entries.source: 다리를 봉쇄해! 이 다리를 빠져나가지 못하게 해라!�
entries.translation: Blockade the bridge! Do not let him cross!�

entries.source: 저기 저 놈이다! 파란 머리의 용병!�
entries.translation: There he is! The blue-haired mercenary!�
I have a bad feeling about this...�

entries.source: 일단 구속해! 반란분자일 가능성이 있으니 조심하고!�
entries.translation: Restrain him! Watch out, he might be an insurgent!�

entries.source: 다리를 봉쇄해! 이 다리를 빠져나가지 못하게 해라!�
entries.translation: Blockade the bridge! Do not let him cross!�
Did Rufus go after the twins?�
... North. I feel him moving further north.�
What do we do? Are you just leaving them?�

entries.source: 내 거 아냐. 버려도 돼. 무엇보다.. 지금 내가 간다고 막을 수 있다는 확신이 없어.�
entries.translation: Not my problem. Leave them. Besides... I am not sure I could stop him anyway.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 이대로 계승자가 또 죽어 버리면..!!�
entries.translation: But... if another successor dies like this...!!�

entries.source: 마르크의 정령이.. 내 안에 들어오기 전에 해준 말이 있어.�
entries.translation: Before Marc spirit entered me... it said something.�

entries.source: 이건 우리가 }완성{되어 가는 과정이라고.. 우리는.. 완성되기 위해 태어났다고..�
entries.translation: It said this is the process of us becoming }complete{... We were born to be completed...�

entries.source: 정령의 목적은 모든 계승자가 죽어야 달성된다는 건가..�
entries.translation: So the spirit goal is met once all successors die...�

entries.source: 난 그런거 싫어! 뭐가 되는 지도 모르는 채로 누군가를 죽여야 한다니..�
entries.translation: I hate that! Having to kill without knowing what we become...�

entries.source: 그래. 빌어먹을 똥색 머리 꼬마 따위 죽든 말든 알 바 아니지만...�
entries.translation: Fine. I do not care if that damn brown-haired brat dies, but...�

entries.source: 이대로 너희들의 원래 주인이 원하는 대로 되어가는 건 마음에 안들어.�
entries.translation: I hate playing into whatever your former master wants.�

entries.source: 크크크, 도망갔나.. 너무 재밌어, 참을 수가 없군..!�
entries.translation: Heh heh, ran away, huh... So fun, I cannot get enough...!�

entries.source: 그래, 그래.. }4년{이나 기다렸는데, 천천히 즐겨줘야지.. 천천히...�
entries.translation: Yes, yes... I waited }4 years{, so I should savor this slowly... slowly...�
After taking all those hits, he just walks off...�

entries.source: 저놈은 놀고 있었어. 같은 계승자끼리도 이렇게 힘의 격차가 나다니..�
entries.translation: He was toying with us. Even among successors, this power gap is insane...�

entries.source: 저 사람의 정령이.. 나보다 훨씬 쎈걸까?�
entries.translation: Is his spirit... way stronger than me?�

entries.source: 글쎄.. 하지만 4년을 기다렸다는 게, 녀석이 정령을 계승한지 4년이 되었다는 뜻이라면..�
entries.translation: Who knows... But if waiting four years means he inherited his spirit four years ago...�

entries.source: 그것과 관련 있을지도 모르겠군. 이 힘의 차이는..�
entries.translation: That might explain the difference in power...�

entries.source: 그럼 나도.. 시간이 지나면 더 강해진다는 뜻?�
entries.translation: Then does that mean... I will get stronger over time too?�
How should I know? You tell me.�

entries.source: 후우.. 빌어먹을 꼬마들 때문에 죽을 뻔 했군.�
entries.translation: Phew... Nearly got killed over those damn brats.�

entries.source: 미안. 진짜 오랜만에 남을 도와주려고 움직여봤는데 이 꼴이라니.. 슈르츠님이 삐뚤어진 이유를 알 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Sorry. The one time I try to help, this happens... I get why you are so cynical now.�
Is that supposed to be an apology?�

entries.source: 그래도, 그 아이들.. 구한 거 잖아?�
entries.translation: Still, we... saved those kids, right?�

entries.source: 하아.. 됐다. 그나마 이런저런 정보를 얻었으니 괜찮아. 록빌로 돌아가야 겠어.�
entries.translation: Haa... Forget it. At least we got some intel. Let us head back to Rockville.�

entries.source: 잠시만, 그 남자는 이제 느껴지지 않으니까.. 응급처치부터 하자.�
entries.translation: Hold on, I do not feel that man anymore... Let us patch you up first.�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: 이 동굴은 사유지다.. 출입 금지라고 써있군. 굳이 들어갈 필요는 없지.�
entries.translation: This cave is private property... Says keep out. No need to go in.�

entries.source: 아, 네, 죄송.. 아니. 응, 미안!�
entries.translation: Ah, yes, sorr-- No. Yeah, my bad!�
What is this all of a sudden?�

entries.source: 그래, 전에도 그 남자가 느껴진다고 했었지. 뭔가 공명이라도 하는건가, 정령들끼리?�
entries.translation: Right, you said you could sense that guy before. Are your Spirits resonating or something?�

entries.source: 공명.. 은 뭔지 모르겠지만.. 가까운 곳에 있어.�
entries.translation: Resonance... I do not know, but... they are close.�

entries.source: 있다는 건 확실해. 슈르츠님이 다쳤을 때도.. 이 느낌을 따라 아일린 언니에게 갔었으니까.�
entries.translation: I know they are. When Schultz was hurt... I followed this feeling to Eileen.�
But I do not know who it is... Is it Eileen?�

entries.source: 먼저 가있는 }아일린{일 수도 있고, 아일린에게 만나자고 했다는 다른 계승자.. }마르크{일 수도 있고.�
entries.translation: Could be }Eileen{, who went ahead, or that other Successor who wanted to meet her... }Marc{.�

entries.source: 최악의 경우에는.. 우리보다 앞서 간 그 미치광이, }루퍼스{일 수도 있지.�
entries.translation: Worst case... it could be that lunatic who went ahead of us, }Rufus{.�

entries.source: 헤에? 그.. 그런 걸 어떻게 다 기억해?�
entries.translation: Huh? H-How do you remember all that?�

entries.source: 어쨌든 지금은 방향을 바꿀 수 없어. 여기가 우리의 목적지거든.�
entries.translation: Anyway, we cannot turn back now. This is our destination.�

entries.source: 미리 알면 위험도는 반으로 줄어. 네 느낌이 정확할 때의 얘기지만.�
entries.translation: Knowing beforehand halves the danger. Assuming your gut is right, that is.�
All we can do now is stay sharp and face it head-on.�
Does not look like an ordinary earring.�

entries.source: 공장에서 대충 찍어낸 것 같지는 않고.. 모양을 보니 짝이 있는 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Does not look mass-produced... From the shape, it must have a pair...�

entries.source: 이런 데에 이렇게 돈 들이는 건 이해가 안 간다니까.�
entries.translation: I will never understand why people spend money on things like this.�
Does this go on your ear?�

entries.source: 그냥 버려. 내가 훔쳤소 광고하는 것도 아니고..�
entries.translation: Just leave it. No need to advertise that we stole it...�
Eh? Cannot I just wear it?�

entries.source: 이런 비싼 물건은 쓸데없는 일을 일으킨다고. 그냥 버려두는 게 나아.�
