entries.translation: Expensive junk like that only brings trouble. Better to leave it behind.�
You do not need things like that.�

entries.source: 아니 그냥, 그런거 달고 다니는 건 내 취향이 아니라서..�
entries.translation: No, wearing that kind of stuff just is not my taste...�
Then I will match your taste, Schultz!�

entries.source: 그러고 다니다 주인 눈에 띄면 도둑으로 몰릴걸.�
entries.translation: Walk around like that and if the owner spots you, you will be branded a thief.�
Then I will just give it back.�
I just do not like that kind of thing.�

entries.source: .. 빌어먹을 똥색 머리 꼬마가 있어. 괜히 싸우고 싶진 않군.�
entries.translation: ...That damn brat with the brown hair is here. I do not feel like picking a pointless fight.�
So this is where you have been hiding out.�
Are you sure about this? You are going to fight again...�
Do you have a death wish?�
I-If you are gonna fight, I am hiding.�
No, I just need to ask one question.�
I told you I do not know anything!�

entries.source: 너도 들었겠지? 다른 모든 계승자들과의 싸움에서 최후의 승자가 되라는 목소리.�
entries.translation: You heard it too, did not you? That voice telling you to be the last one standing against all other Successors.�
So... did you come here to fight?�

entries.source: 아니, 네가 싸울 생각이 있는지 알고 싶은거다.�
entries.translation: No. I just want to know if you intend to fight.�

entries.source: 그걸 네가 알아서 뭐하게? 내가 싸우자면 싸우고 안한다면 말거야?�
entries.translation: What is it to you? If I want to fight, we fight if not, we do not? Is that it?�

entries.source: 애초부터 마주치지 않으면 되잖아? 왜 애써서 싸움을 걸고 다녀?�
entries.translation: Would not it be better if we never met at all? Why go around picking fights?�
I have no desire to fight either...�

entries.source: 남이 시키는 싸움 따위 할 생각 없어.�
entries.translation: I have no intention of fighting at someone else command.�

entries.source: 우린 인간들이 없는 곳에서 조용히 살수 있다면.. 그게 다야.�
entries.translation: All we want is to live quietly, somewhere far away from people... That is all.�
A feral stray dog, through and through.�

entries.source: 이대로 숨어 살 생각이라면 됐다. 귀찮게 해서 미안하군.�
entries.translation: If you plan to stay hidden like this, fine. Sorry for bothering you.�

entries.source: 그럴리가 없어. 너도 알잖아, 이 힘과 함께 얻은 게 뭔지...�
entries.translation: No way. You know it too, what we gained alongside this power...�

entries.source: 난 누구도 믿지 않을거야.. 널 지키기 위해서.�
entries.translation: I will not trust anyone... To protect you.�

entries.source: 이 힘을 이용해서, 널 }그 곳{에 데려갈 때까지..�
entries.translation: Until I use this power to take you to }that place{...�

entries.source: 이거이거, 세 손가락이나 썼는데 견뎌내는 꼬마라니. 굉장히 신선한데? 기대 이상이야? 크크크크.�
entries.translation: Well, well! A kid who can endure three of my fingers? How refreshing! Exceeding expectations! Heheheh.�

entries.source: 그것도.. 사랑하는 여동생을 지키면서 싸우는 데도 말이야. 상당히 재밌어. 크크크.�
entries.translation: And while fighting to protect his precious little sister, no less! Quite amusing. Hehehe.�

entries.source: 도대체.. 어른이란 것들은 왜 우릴 가만히 내버려두질 않는거지?�
entries.translation: Why... Why will not you adults just leave us alone?!�

entries.source: 우린 }방주{로 가서 조용히 숨어살거야. 누구에게도 간섭하지 않고, 간섭받지 않고.. 그럼 되잖아?�
entries.translation: We are going to the }Ark{ to live in peace and quiet. We will not meddle with anyone, nor be meddled with... Would not that be enough?!�

entries.source: 어째서, 그것조차 못하게 자꾸 방해하는 거냐고!�
entries.translation: Why do you keep getting in our way, denying us even that?!�

entries.source: 크크크, 꼬마야, 투정 부리지 마. 그렇게 만만한게 세상에 어딨어? 받은 게 있으면 주는 게 있는 게지..�
entries.translation: Hehehe, do not throw a tantrum, kid. The world is not that soft. When you receive something, you have to give something back...�

entries.source: 우린 능력을 받았으니, 원 없이 놀아보자고, 응? 네 손가락 써줄게..!�
entries.translation: We were gifted these abilities, so let us play our hearts out, eh? I will use four fingers for you...!�

entries.source: 티아나.. 내가 전에 말했던 거, 기억하고 있지?�
entries.translation: Tiana... Remember what I told you before?�

entries.source: 알고 있지? 어떻게 해야 할지.. 어디로 가야 할지..�
entries.translation: You know, right? What to do... Where to go...�
I have to. I have to fight until the very end...�
|(I must end this with one blow!)�

entries.source: 아오.. 피 나네.. 너 진짜 완전 마음에 들었다.. 크크크크..�
entries.translation: Ow... Bleeding now... I really, truly like you... Heheheh...�

entries.source: 크리스, 쳐! 협공하면 잡을 수 있다!!�
entries.translation: Chris, strike! We can take him together!!�

entries.source: 젠장, 다시만나면 저 머리의 똥털을 다 뽑아버리겠어, 망할 꼬맹이..!!�
entries.translation: Damn it, next time I see him, I will rip every strand of that crap hair out! That brat...!!�

entries.source: 거기서 살아나온데다가, 이렇게 빨리 찾아오다니... 칭찬해 줄게.�
entries.translation: Not only did you make it out alive, but you found me this fast... I must commend you.�

entries.source: 그럼.. 애써 방해해 줬으니 대신 놀아달라구.�
entries.translation: Well... since you went out of your way to interrupt, play with me instead.�

entries.source: 캬캬캬캬캬! 정말 정말 마음에 든다, 같이 노는 보람이 있겠어!�
entries.translation: Kahahahaha! I really, really like you! This will be worth my time!�

entries.source: 응..? 그 재수없는 똥색머리 꼬마는 안보이는군.�
entries.translation: Huh...? I do not see that annoying brown-haired kid around.�
I knew it... You were really pissed off at that kid...�

entries.source: 하지만.. 정령의 느낌은 굉장히 가까운 곳에 있어. 그냥 가는 게 좋을 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Still... the Spirit presence feels very close. We should probably just get going...�

entries.source: 미안한데, 조금만 크게 얘기해줄래? 내가 도와줄 수 있는 거면 도와줄게.�
entries.translation: Sorry, but could you speak up a bit? If it is something I can help with, I will.�

entries.source: 한 쌍이야. 그 애가 차고 있는거랑, 네가 차고 있는거.�
entries.translation: It is a pair. The one he has, and the one you have.�

entries.source: 아..? 그러네? 이걸 찾고 있었던 거야?�
entries.translation: Oh...? Really? Were you looking for this?�
Do not be so guarded. We are just trying to return it.�
It must be precious to her.�

entries.source: 하지만 이 아이는.. 말을 못하는 걸까?�
entries.translation: Wait, is this child... unable to speak?�

entries.source: 그냥 조심스러운 것 뿐일거야. 뭔가 사연이 있겠지.�
entries.translation: She is probably just being cautious. She must have her reasons.�
They look like twins, but she is the complete opposite of that boy.�

entries.source: 가자. 시끄러운 녀석이 오기 전에.. 조용히 살고 싶다는데 괜히 자극하고 싶지는 않군.�
entries.translation: Let us go before that loud kid shows up... If she wants a quiet life, I would rather not disturb her.�
Brother, you will come back soon, right?�

entries.source: 드디어 좋은 검을 하나 구했어.;강해져서 돌아올게!�
entries.translation: I finally found a good sword! I will come back stronger!�
Hey, if you told me to jump, you should have had a plan--!�
We survived for now, did we not?�

entries.source: 날 수는 있죠. 다만 슈르츠님 근처를 못 벗어나니까 그다지 유용하진 않아요.. 끙!�
entries.translation: I can fly, yes. But I cannot stray far from you, Schultz, so it is not very useful... Oof!�
Good thing the shore was close... Schultz, you are heavy...�
That was... a really close call...�
Thanks to you trusting me and jumping...�

entries.source: 그 상황에서 용케도 이런 생각을 해냈는데?�
entries.translation: How did you even think of that in that situation?�

entries.source: .. 그냥 필사적이었을 뿐이에요. 좋든 싫든.. 괜찮든 귀찮든.. 어쨌든 이제..�
entries.translation: ...I was just desperate. Like it or not... fine or annoying... either way, now...�
We share the same life, after all...�

entries.source: 이제.. 그 }웨이드 가{라는 사람들에게 쫓기는 건가요?�
entries.translation: So now... are we being chased by this }House Wade{?�

entries.source: 그렇다고 봐야지.. 알프레드, 그 남자는 웨이드 가 직속 부대 흑의병의 수장이니까.�
entries.translation: I suppose so... Alfred, that man leads the Black Guard, House Wade direct unit.�

entries.source: 하지만 덕분에 }듣는 자들{라는 것이 존재한다는 건 확신할 수 있게 됐어.�
entries.translation: Though thanks to that, I became certain that the }Listeners{ do exist.�

entries.source: 뭘 듣는다는 건지는 모르겠지만, 카즈와 내가 찾으려 했던 웨이드 가의 배후는.. 그 놈들일거야.�
entries.translation: I do not know what they are listening to, but whoever is behind House Wade, who Kaze and I were looking for... must be them.�

entries.source: 웨이드 가의 배후요? 그런 건 왜 찾으려고..�
entries.translation: Behind House Wade? Why were you looking for that...?�

entries.source: 시시한 복수야. 기억도 나지 않는 가문을 위한.�
entries.translation: Pointless revenge. For a family I cannot even remember.�

entries.source: 사실 난 그런 건 어찌돼도 상관없었는데.�
entries.translation: Truth be told, I did not really care about any of it.�
If you did not care... why seek revenge?�
Because it is the only thing I have left.�

entries.source: 말했잖아. 원하는 것 따위 없는 삶이었다고.�
entries.translation: I told you. My life was one with nothing I ever wanted.�

entries.source: 춥지는 않으시죠? 상처 잘 감싸고 계세요.�
entries.translation: You are not cold, are you? Keep your wound covered properly.�
By the way... what have you been doing over there?�

entries.source: 그 가방에 보면 말린 고기가 있을 텐데..�
entries.translation: There should be dried meat in that bag...�
Ta-da! This is Twilight Soup powder, right?�

entries.source: 어제 먹은 거요. 황혼 수프, 맞죠?�
entries.translation: The one we had yesterday. Twilight Soup, right?�

entries.source: 몸이 안 좋을 땐, 잘 챙겨 먹어야죠.�
entries.translation: When you are unwell, you have to eat well.�
Is that not a bit much for a newborn to cook...?�

entries.source: 가끔 한번쯤은 그냥 믿어주면 안 되요?�
entries.translation: Can you not just trust me for once?�
Besides, for some reason, I feel confident about cooking!�

entries.source: 음.. 글쎄요.. 누구의 경험인지, 어쨌든 많이 해본 것 같은 기분이에요.�
entries.translation: Well... I wonder. Whose experience it is, I feel like I have done it a lot.�
If I had to say, instinct?�
Do not tell me it has done... Please...�
Here, take your time and eat.�

entries.source: 의외로 향은 나쁘지 않은데..? 근데 건더기가.. 음..�
entries.translation: It actually smells pretty good...? But the ingredients... um...�

entries.source: 식기 전에 얼른 먹어요. 수프 해부할 기세로 관찰하지 말고..�
entries.translation: Eat it before it gets cold. Stop dissecting the soup with your eyes...�
I used to like nights alone, you know.�
Anyway... she helped me out today.�
Should I just say it is good...?�
Pretty impressive. I am completely healed.�

entries.source: 회복술은 정령의 기본이죠. 아일린 언니만큼은 못 되지만요.�
entries.translation: Healing magic is basic for spirits. Though not as good as Eileen.�

entries.source: 특출나게 잘하는 건 없고.. 잡다하게 고만고만 한 건가.�
entries.translation: So, jack of all trades, master of none, huh.�
I will take that as a compliment, Mr. Grumpy Successor.�
I did not think it was an insult.�

entries.source: 됐어요. 어쨌든 전, 또 잠이나 잘게요.�
entries.translation: Whatever. In that case, I will just go back to sleep.�
You said sleeping all the time was exhausting too.�

entries.source: 그.. 그럼 나와 있어도 되나요? 하지만 귀찮아 하실 거면서..�
entries.translation: R-Really, I can stay out? But will not I get on your nerves...?�
It is fine. On one condition...�

entries.source: 용병이 존댓말 쓰고 다니면 얕잡아 보인다고. 나이도 어린데.�
entries.translation: Mercenaries get looked down on if they are too polite. Especially when you look young.�

entries.source: 나에게도야. 같이 다니기 불편해. 그러니까, 예의 차리지 말라고.�
entries.translation: With me, too. It is awkward. So stop being polite.�

entries.source: 그것만 지키면, 실체화 해 있어도 상관없어.�
entries.translation: As long as you do that, I do not care if you stay manifested.�

entries.source: 보고 싶은 게 있으면 보고.. 배울 게 있으면 배워야지. 이제 한 살인데.�
entries.translation: If there is something to see, see it. If there is something to learn, learn it. You are only a year old.�

entries.source: 뛰지도 말고. 아직 록빌까지는 한참 남았으니까.�
entries.translation: And do not run. We still have a long way to Rockville.�
Must we let them go like this...?�
You overstepped by acting alone, Lord Alfred.�

entries.source: 루퍼스 외의 계승자들에게는 손을 대선 안된다고 이미 전달받으셨을 텐데...�
entries.translation: I believe you were already told not to touch any Successor other than Rufus...�

entries.source: 죄송합니다만.. 저희 듣는 자들에겐 남은 시간이 얼마 없습니다, 아가씨.�
entries.translation: I apologize, my lady... but we Listeners have so little time left.�

entries.source: 그런만큼, 하나의 변수도 만들어선 안되는 것 아닌가요?�
entries.translation: All the more reason not to create unnecessary variables, is it not?�

entries.source: 알고 계시잖아요? 그들은 그렇게 만들어진 존재라는 걸. 그리고 그렇게 되어야 하는 존재라는 걸.�
entries.translation: You know, do not you? They were created for this. And this is what they must become.�

entries.source: 그렇다면 가주께서는.. 여전히 그들을 방치하실 생각입니까?�
entries.translation: Then the head of the house... still intends to leave them alone?�

entries.source: 우리 손으로 어찌할 수 있는 존재가 아니기에 신이라고 하셨어요.�
entries.translation: He said they are gods precisely because they are beyond our control.�
If intervention is required, separate orders will follow.�

entries.source: 서두르지 않으시면.. 웨이드 가에서도 듣는 자들을 통제할 수 없을 것입니다.�
entries.translation: If we do not hurry... House Wade will no longer be able to control the Listeners.�

entries.source: 고대신의 부활은 이미 목전에 있고, 듣는 자들의 초조함은 극에 달했으니까요.�
entries.translation: The Ancient God resurrection is near, and their impatience has reached its peak.�

entries.source: 이건 듣는 자들만의 문제가 아니랍니다, 알프레드님...�
entries.translation: This is not just a problem for the Listeners, Lord Alfred...�

entries.source: 매복? 아무래도 귀찮은 일에 말려든 것 같은데...�
entries.translation: An ambush? Looks like I have gotten caught up in something annoying...�

entries.source: 이봐 이봐, 순순히 물건을 내놓으면 목숨은 살려주겠다는 말 정도는 해야 하는거 아냐!?�
entries.translation: Hey, hey! Are not you supposed to say hand over the goods and we will spare your life or something!?�

entries.source: |(제이크는 로건이 찾던 서류를 여기에 숨겨 놓은 것 같다...){�
entries.translation: |(Looks like Jake hid the documents Logan was looking for here...){�

entries.source: 아일린을 데려오지 않길 잘한 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Good thing we did not bring Eileen along.�
Yeah... It is a creepy cave.�

entries.source: 마르크란 인간.. 이런 곳으로 아일린을 부른 건가? 완전 요새잖아.�
entries.translation: This Marc guy... Did he really invite Eileen to a place like this? It is a total fortress.�
Still... the door is open, is not it?�

entries.source: 그냥 다른 계승자를 많이 두려워 하는 것일지도..�
entries.translation: Maybe he is just terrified of the other successors...�

entries.source: 제대로 된 초대라곤 보기 힘들지. 어쨌든 면상이나 확인해 보자고.�
entries.translation: Hardly what I would call a proper invitation. Let us go see his face anyway.�

entries.source: 마르크의 3가지 정령 스킬중, 어떤 것을 전승하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: Which of Marc 3 Spirit Skills will you inherit?�

entries.source: 이 정도로 방어시설을 구축하려면 돈이 어마어마 하게 들텐데..�
entries.translation: Building defenses on this scale must have cost an absolute fortune...�

entries.source: 숨어사는 건가, 이곳에서..? 계승자를.. 피하기 위해..?�
entries.translation: Hiding out here, of all places...? Just to avoid... the successors...?�

entries.source: 엄청난 보석이지? 이게 다 이 동굴에서 나오는 건가봐.�
entries.translation: Look at these massive gems! Do they all come from this cave?�
Those minerals are for me alone.�

entries.source: 당신이 마르크인가.. 환영하는 건 아닌 것 같군.�
entries.translation: So you are Marc... Not much of a welcome.�

entries.source: 처음으로 내 안식처에 찾아온 계승자가.. 초대도 하지 않은 너일 줄은 몰랐어, 슈르츠.�
entries.translation: The first successor to find my sanctuary... and it is you, Schultz, an uninvited guest.�

entries.source: 어떻게 날 알고 있지? 너는 다른 계승자들을 모두 알고 있는거냐?�
entries.translation: How do you know me? Do you know all the other successors?�

entries.source: 나는 겁이 많아서... 내가 싸워야 할지도 모를 상대들을 미리 조사해 본 것 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: I am a coward... I merely investigated potential foes I might have to face.�

entries.source: 계승자가 출현한 곳에서는, 반드시 불가사의한 소문이 돌거든. 돈만 있으면 조사가 어렵지는 않지.�
entries.translation: Wherever a successor appears, eerie rumors always follow. With enough money, research is not hard.�

entries.source: 가령 소문의 늑대인간이 용병길드를 전멸시켰는데, 한 명만 시체를 못 찾았다던가.�
entries.translation: For instance, the rumor of a werewolf wiping out a mercenary guild, leaving just one body missing.�
Impressive... The Council should have covered that up.�
There is nothing money cannot uncover.�
Right... So how many did you find?�

entries.source: 글쎄.. 이게 다인지는 모르겠지만, 열심히 찾아낸 거니까 자랑이나 해볼까?�
entries.translation: Well... not sure if that is all of them, but since I worked hard on it, care to hear me brag?�

entries.source: 내가 찾아낸 건 너까지 네 명이야.�
entries.translation: Including you, I have found four.�
The most famous, the }Saint of Central 9th{, }Eileen{.�

entries.source: 그리고 여기 }베르날 섬 북서쪽 흉가{에 출몰하는 쌍둥이 꼬마 귀신.. }크리스{.�
entries.translation: And the twin ghost haunting the }haunted house NW of Vernal{... }Chris{.�

entries.source: |(그 망할 꼬마 이름은 }크리스|인가.. }테오도어|라는 남자는 처음 듣는군.)�
entries.translation: |(So that brat name is }Chris|... Never heard of this }Theodore| guy.)�
|(It seems he has not found Rufus yet...)�

entries.source: |(아니야.. 상당히 입이 가벼운 놈 같은데, 좀 더 정보를 캐내보자.)�
entries.translation: |(No... He talks a lot. Let us get more information.)�

entries.source: 몇 명인지 모르지만 난 계속 탐색할거야. 최후의 승자가 될 때까지..�
entries.translation: I do not know how many there are, but I will keep searching. Until I become the sole victor...�

entries.source: 그렇군. 이곳은 찾아낸 계승자들을 초대해 살해하기 위한 덫이고?�
entries.translation: I see. So this place is a trap to lure successors and kill them?�
Some of them are just kids!�

entries.source: 이.. 이봐, 내 말을 끝까지 들어. 날 무슨 악당처럼 몰지 말라고.�
entries.translation: H-Hey, hear me out! Do not make me sound like some villain!�

entries.source: 죽이는 게 아니면 어떻게 승자가 된다는 거지?�
entries.translation: If not by killing, how else do you plan to win?�

entries.source: 협상을 하자고, 받아들이지 않으면 어쩔 수 없이 죽여야 겠지만.. 난 살인 따위 하고 싶지 않거든.�
entries.translation: Negotiation! I would have to kill if refused, but... I do not actually want to murder anyone.�

entries.source: 계승권을 포기해. 네가 무엇을 얻었는지는 모르겠지만, 내 돈으로 그에 상응하는 보답을 해줄게.�
entries.translation: Relinquish your right of succession. Whatever you gained, I will compensate you with my wealth.�
Relinquish... succession? Is that even possible?�
What, your spirit did not tell you?�

entries.source: 미안하게 됐군. 내 정령은 좀 어설퍼서.�
entries.translation: Sorry about that. My spirit is a bit clumsy.�
Haha, yours is rather cute, though.�

entries.source: 내 정령은 안 싸울거면 그냥 포기하라고 항상 떽떽 거려서 짜증나.�
entries.translation: Mine constantly nagging me to just give up if I will not fight. It is so annoying.�

entries.source: 정령을 버리는 건 쉬워. 그냥 정령과 합의만 되면 돼. 계승자가 진심으로 자신이 얻었던 걸 포기하면 정령으로부터 해방될 수 있지.�
entries.translation: Giving up a spirit is easy. Just agree with it. If a successor sincerely renounces what was gained, they are freed.�

entries.source: 하지만 목숨보다 소중한 게 어디 있겠어? 그냥 얌전히 포기해주면..�
entries.translation: After all, what is more precious than life itself? If you just give it up quietly...�
Why live such a boring life?�

entries.source: 크크크크.. 생각이 물러터졌어, 응? 그렇게 해서 최후의 승자가 되겠다고?�
entries.translation: Heheheh... So soft-hearted, huh? You expect to be the last one standing like that?�

entries.source: 소중한 걸 지키기 위해 싸워야지.. 죽을 때까지, 피떡이 되도록 말이야.. 크크크크..�
entries.translation: You gotta fight to protect what matters... Till you are dead and battered to a pulp... Heheheh...�

entries.source: 자, 너도 정령의 힘을 보여. 싸워야지? 더 강한 자만이 정령의 힘을 가질 수 있어.�
entries.translation: Come on, show me your Spirit power! Fight! Only the strong deserve to wield the Spirit.�

entries.source: 그런 거라고.. 어줍잖게 착한 척하려면 그냥 죽어야지?�
entries.translation: That is how it works... If you are gonna play the clumsy saint, you might as well die, right?�

entries.source: 포.. 포기할게.. 케헥.. 나.. 정령의 힘도.. 내 돈도 다 포기할테니...�
entries.translation: I-I give up... Cough... I will give up the Spirit power... and my money, all of it...�
Heheheh... You are so utterly helpless... How boring...�

entries.source: 뭘 위해 그렇게 미친듯이 계승자를 죽이려는 거냐..!�
entries.translation: Why are you hunting Successors so frantically...?!�

entries.source: 나도 모르지! 크크크크, 이제 하나 잡았으니 알 수 있지 않겠어?�
entries.translation: beats me! Heheheh, now that I bagged one, maybe I will find out!�
^I never thought... I would be the first.�

entries.source: ^역시 돈만으로는 안되나봐.;내 스스로가 강해질 수 없으면..�
entries.translation: ^Money really is not enough. Unless I become strong myself...�
How did you get in here... This space is mine alone...�

entries.source: ^이제, 나도 네가 될거니까..;아니면 갈 데가 없거든.�
entries.translation: ^Now, I am going to become you... I have nowhere else to go, anyway.�
What do you mean? Are you... Marc Spirit?�
^A piece of it. This is the process of us becoming whole.�
^That we were born to become whole...�

entries.source: 크크크.. 캬캬캬캬캬! 그런건가! 역시 그런 거였어!�
entries.translation: Heheh... Kyahahahaha! So that is it! It really was true!�

entries.source: 느껴지지 않나? 죽어버린 이놈의 정령은 우리의 것이 되었어!�
entries.translation: Cannot you feel it? The dead fool Spirit is ours now!�

entries.source: 더 강해질 수 있다.. 여기서 더 강해질 수 있어! 크캬캬캬!�
entries.translation: We can get stronger... Even stronger than this! Kyahaha!�
Huh? Is this place... about to collapse?�

entries.source: 이 동굴.. 광물로 가득찬 보물 동굴 자체가 마르크의 소원이었나..�
entries.translation: This cave... A treasure cave overflowing with ore was Marc wish all along...�

entries.source: 그러니까, 이제 녀석이 }가장 원했던 것{이 사라질 차례라는 거군.�
entries.translation: So now it is time for }what he wanted most{ to disappear.�

entries.source: 너와도 놀고싶지만, 그러다간 나까지 깔려죽겠어. 아쉽지만 난 다음 타겟에게로 먼저 가야겠네. 크크크..�
entries.translation: I would love to play with you too, but I would rather not get crushed. Shame, but I am off to the next target. Hehehe...�

entries.source: }북서쪽 흉가{에 있다는 쌍둥이는 좀 더 즐겁게 해줬으면 하는데, 크크크..�
entries.translation: I hope those twins in the }Northwest Haunted House{ are more fun. Hehehe...�

entries.source: 너는.. 그냥 닥치는 대로 죽이고 다닐 셈이냐?�
entries.translation: Are you... just going to slaughter everyone in sight?�
Why act surprised? That is what this battle has always been.�

entries.source: 강한 자가 사냥하고, 강한 자가 먹고, 강한 자가 더 강해지지. 얼마나 공평하냐, 캬캬캬캬캬캬!�
entries.translation: The strong hunt, the strong feast, and the strong grow stronger. How fair is that?! Kyahahahaha!�

entries.source: 너와는 노는 재미가 있을 것 같았는데 아쉽게도 시간이 없을 것 같네.�
entries.translation: Thought playing with you might be fun, but looks like time up.�

entries.source: 발버둥 쳐보라고, 살아 나오면 놀아줄게. 크크크크..�
entries.translation: Struggle all you want. If you make it out alive, I will play with you. Heheheh...�

entries.source: 어이, 무슨 일이야. 방금 무슨 일이 있었지?�
entries.translation: Hey, what is going on? What just happened?�

entries.source: 마법력이.. 강해졌어. 정말 마르크의 정령이 내 안으로 들어온 걸까?�
entries.translation: My magic power... it grew. Did Marc Spirit really merge into me?�

entries.source: 뭔가 이상해, 내 안에.. 내가 아닌 게 있는 것 같은..�
entries.translation: Something feels wrong... Inside me... like there is something that is not me...�

entries.source: 서둘러, 아마 왼쪽 벽에 제어하는 장치가 있을 거야.�
entries.translation: Hurry! The controls should be on the left wall.�
Got it, leave it to me!�

entries.source: 젠장.. 갇힌 척하고 마르크로부터 정보를 더 얻어내려 했는데.. 일이 꼬였군.�
entries.translation: Damn it... I pretended to be trapped to get info from Marc... This is bad.�
Getting crushed here would be a dog death! Move it!�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: .. 라고 해도.. 슈르츠님 말투랑 별반 다르지 않은걸.�
entries.translation: ...Even so, he sounds just like you, Master Schultz.�

entries.source: 꼬마 같은 소리 하고 있네, 머리에 피도 안 말라 보이는 게.�
entries.translation: Calling me a kid? You are still wet behind the ears yourself!�

entries.source: 행인한테 시비거는 게 멋있는 줄 아는 양아치인 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Just some punk picking fights with strangers to look tough...�

entries.source: 그냥 가는 게 신상에 좋을 거야.�
entries.translation: You had better walk away for your own good.�

entries.source: 호.. 어떻게, 정령으로 잡아먹어 주시기라도 할건가?�
entries.translation: Oh? Why, gonna feed me to your Spirit?�

entries.source: 무슨 소리냐고 물으면서 그렇게 격하게 반응하면 안되지, 머리에 피 마른 꼬마야.�
entries.translation: Do not snap like that if you do not know what I mean, little boy.�
What do you know... about Spirits?�

entries.source: 내가 묻고 싶은 말이야. 난 이제 막 입문했거든, 계승자라는 것에.�
entries.translation: That is my line. I just got initiated into this Successor thing.�

entries.source: 그렇다면 그냥 가라. 우리에게 신경쓰지 말고.�
entries.translation: Then just leave. Mind your own business.�

entries.source: 그 아이가 너의 정령.. 인가? 라기엔.. 쌍둥이 같아 보이는데.. }티아나{라고?�
entries.translation: Is that girl your Spirit? She looks more like your twin... }Tiana{, was it?�

entries.source: 우리는 아무 것도 몰라. 알고 싶은 생각도 없고, 뭔가를 하려는 생각은 더더욱 없어.�
entries.translation: We do not know anything. We do not care to know, and we definitely are not planning anything.�

entries.source: 그러니까 그냥 내버려 둬. 그러면 우리도 그냥 간다.�
entries.translation: So leave us alone. And we will be on our way.�

entries.source: 뭔가 불안해 하는 것 같은데.. 너희.�
너희 같이 재수없게 관심보이는 놈들 때문이야. 어리니까 대충 사기 쳐서 막 이용해 먹을 수 있을 줄 알지?�
entries.translation: Because of shady jerks like you! Thinking you can scam and use us just because we are young!�

entries.source: 죽고싶지 않으면 다시는 우리에게 접근하지마. 우린 누구에게도 이용당하지 않을 거니까..�
entries.translation: If you do not want to die, do not come near us again. We will not let anyone use us!�

entries.source: 우와.. 완전 비뚤어진 애네.. 귀엽게 생겼는데, 하는 짓은 슈르츠님 같아.�
entries.translation: Whoa... What a twisted kid... He is cute, but acts just like Master Schultz.�
Well... It is a rough world out there.�

entries.source: 에에.. 비슷하다고 이해하는 척 하기는.. 열 받았으면서.�
entries.translation: Uh-huh... Pretending you understand him because you are alike... when you are actually mad.�

entries.source: 열 안 받았어. 계승자의 느낌은 어때?�
entries.translation: I am not mad. What does the Successor presence feel like?�

entries.source: 멀어졌어.. 이제 가까운 곳에는 없는 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Fading... Does not seem to be nearby anymore.�

entries.source: 여자애도 귀여웠는데.. 안 됐다. 저런 애랑 같이 다녀야 되다니..�
entries.translation: The girl was cute too... Poor thing, having to hang around someone like that...�
It seemed like he was protecting her.�

entries.source: 저렇게 비뚤어진 애가, 남을 지킨다고? 말도 안돼.�
entries.translation: A twisted kid like that, protecting someone? No way.�
Maybe he became twisted in order to protect her.�

entries.source: 그렇게 말하니까 슈르츠님보다 훨씬 괜찮은 애 같잖아..�
entries.translation: Saying it like that makes him sound way cooler than you, Master Schultz...�

entries.source: 하지만.. 저렇게 보내도 돼? 다른 계승자를 만나려는 거 아니었어?�
entries.translation: But... is it okay to let him go like that? Were not you trying to meet other Successors?�

entries.source: 저렇게 비협조적이면 괜한 충돌만 일어날거야. 좀 더 협조적인 계승자가 필요해.�
entries.translation: If he is that uncooperative, it will only cause pointless clashes. We need someone more willing to talk.�

entries.source: 저 놈이 먼저 싸우려고 들면 문제가 되겠지만..�
entries.translation: Though it will be a problem if that guy tries to pick a fight first...�

entries.source: 도대체 계승자란 건 몇 명이나 되는 거지? 별종들로만 잘도 골랐군 그래.�
entries.translation: Just how many Successors are out there? Whoever picked them sure chose quite the eccentrics.�

entries.source: 내가 어떻게 알아. 네 원래 주인이겠지.�
entries.translation: How should I know? Probably your former master.�
Do you sense any other Successors?�

entries.source: 응. 아까 그 아이들은.. 이미 멀리 벗어난 것 같아.�
entries.translation: No. Those kids from earlier... seem to have already moved far away.�

entries.source: 후. 그럼 카즈가 있는 }에네스트 저택{으로 간다. 이곳에서 사람을 찾는 건, 그 녀석이 더 빠를 거야.�
entries.translation: Whew. Then let us head to }Ernest Manor{ where Kaze is. He will be faster at tracking people down here.�
Hmm... Is that Kaze person a friend of yours?�

entries.source: 뭐.. 돈 많은 단골 의뢰인이랄까. 일단 공통의 목적도 있고.�
entries.translation: Well... more like a wealthy regular client. We do share a common goal for now, though.�
I could not understand a single word of that.�

entries.source: 알 필요 없어. 그보다, 이제부터 아일린이나 마르크를 찾아봐야 하니까 집중해봐.�
entries.translation: You do not need to. More importantly, focus on sensing Eileen or Marc from here on out.�
Do you sense any Successor somewhere in Rockville?�

entries.source: 아까까진 없던 정령이 느껴져. 근데 좀 약한 걸 보니, 건물 안에 있는 것 같기도 하고..�
entries.translation: I sense a Spirit that was not there before. But it feels faint, so they might be inside a building...�

entries.source: 마르크일 가능성이 높은데.. 보면 누가 계승자인지 바로 알 수 있어?�
entries.translation: It is likely Marc... But can you tell who the Successor is just by looking?�

entries.source: 그.. 글쎄, 그냥 근처에 있다, 정도의 느낌이라.. 정확히는..�
entries.translation: W-Well, I only get a vague sense that they are nearby... Nothing exact...�

entries.source: 후.. 부딪혀 보는 수 밖에 없나.�
entries.translation: Whew... Guess we have no choice but to check it out ourselves.�
What are you going to do?�
Go meet the next Successor. Hoping he will be the last.�

entries.source: 마르크가 찾았던 계승자는 아일린, 크리스, 그리고 테오도어라고 했어. 못 만나본건 테오도어 뿐이지.�
entries.translation: Marc said the Successors he sought were Eileen, Chris, and Theodore. Theodore is the only one we have not met.�

entries.source: 슈르츠님은 그런 거 진짜 잘 기억한다..�
entries.translation: You have an amazing memory, Schultz...�

entries.source: 이렘의 천재 학자라고 했어. 이렘이 있는 모이투라 섬으로 가서, 그 남자를 만나볼거야.�
entries.translation: They said he is a genius scholar from Irem. We will head to Moytura Island, where Irem is, and meet him.�

entries.source: 또다른 정보는 없는지.. 싸워야 할 대상인지 알아본다.�
entries.translation: See if there is any other info... and whether he is someone we must fight.�
I hope he is a nice person...�
Do not get your hopes up over nothing.�

entries.source: 카즈에게 모이투라 섬에 다녀온다고 말해둬야 하니, 잠시 들어가 있어.�
entries.translation: I need to let Kaze know we are heading to Moytura Island, so hide inside for a bit.�

entries.source: 남들과 다른 걸 굳이 남들에게 떠벌이고 다녀서 좋을 거 없어.�
entries.translation: No good comes from parading around how different you are from others.�

entries.source: 마음대로 하세요. 저택에 들어가면 알아서 숨을테니까.�
entries.translation: Suit yourself. I will hide on my own once we enter the manor.�

entries.source: 재개발이 되면, 이런 비위생적인 시장에 매일 들락거릴 일도 없어질거야.�
entries.translation: Once redevelopment happens, we will not have to visit this unsanitary market every day.�

entries.source: 센트럴에서는 그냥 집 안에서 모든 걸 바로 구할 수 있다는데, 우리도 그렇게 되겠지?�
entries.translation: I heard in Central you can get everything right at home. Will it be like that for us too?�
We cannot go play at the }haunted house to the northwest{ anymore.�

entries.source: 몇 달 전부터 그 근처에서 괴물을 봤다고, 다치는 사람이 막 늘어났거든요.�
entries.translation: A few months ago people saw monsters around there, and more and more folks got hurt.�
Just a few years ago, we used to hang out there all the time...�

entries.source: 요즘 마을 사람들이 자꾸 }북서쪽의 흉가{에서 뭐가 나온다고 난리야.�
entries.translation: Lately, the villagers keep making a fuss about something lurking in the }haunted house to the northwest{.�

entries.source: 뭐 밤 길에 넘어지기라도 했겠지, 요즘 세상에 귀신은 무슨..�
entries.translation: They probably just tripped in the dark. Ghosts in this day and age? Please...�

entries.source: 난 여기만 지키면 돼. 개발 공단에 기여한 바를 인정 받아야, 나중에도 좋은 자리 차지할 수 있을테니까.�
entries.translation: I just need to guard this spot. If they recognize my service to the Development Complex, I will secure a good post later.�

entries.source: 재개발이 된다는 건 단순하게 마을이 자동화 되는 것만이 아니야.�
entries.translation: Redevelopment is not just about automating the town.�

entries.source: 분명 센트럴처럼 앉아서 편하게 일할 수 있는 일거리들이 들어오겠지?�
entries.translation: Surely comfortable desk jobs like the ones in Central will become available, right?�

entries.source: 지긋 지긋한 농삿일에서 벗어날 수 있어.. 헛헛!�
entries.translation: I can finally escape this dreadful farming... Heheh!�

entries.source: 이거야 원, 마을이 하루종일 쿵땅거리니 정신이 없구먼 그래.�
entries.translation: Good grief, this town is clattering and banging all day long. Gives me a headache.�

entries.source: 젊은 것들은 재개발이 되면 좋아라 하겠지만..�
entries.translation: The young folks might rejoice over redevelopment, but...�
What business do you have with an old man?�

entries.source: 요즘은 재개발이니 뭐니 해서 하도 사람들이 들락거리니 모르겠구만.�
entries.translation: People keep coming and going over redevelopment or whatever, so I have no clue.�

entries.source: 저 아래에 있는 <관청{에 가서 물어보는 건 어떻겠나?�
entries.translation: Why not head down to the <Government Office{ and ask there?�

entries.source: 매일같이 대형 선박들이 왔다갔다 하는데 선착장에는 보트밖에 못대.�
entries.translation: Big cargo ships come and go every day, but only small boats can dock here.�

entries.source: 그래서 난 하루종일 보트로 화물선까지 왔다갔다 하는 걸 반복하고 있지...�
entries.translation: So I spend all day rowing back and forth to the freighter...�

entries.source: 생각이 있으면 일단 선착장부터 크게 좀 짓고 공사를 해야될 것 아냐, 이게 무슨 쓸데없는 노가다냐고!�
entries.translation: If they had any sense, they would build a bigger pier before starting construction. What a pointless chore!�

entries.source: 에네스트 가문은 무슨 대형사고가 터진 뒤로, 엄청 어린 가주가 물려받았다던데..�
entries.translation: I heard after some disaster hit the Ernest family, a young kid took over as head...�

entries.source: 의외로 베르날에서의 평판도 좋고.. 집도 휘황찬란 하군 그래.�
entries.translation: Surprisingly, their reputation in Vernal is good... and the mansion is magnificent.�

entries.source: 어려서부터 큰 돈을 만지면 보통 제정신이 아니기 쉬운데 말이야..�
entries.translation: Usually, handling that much money at a young age goes straight to your head...�

entries.source: 나는.. 의회의 이 무분별한 재개발이 위험하다고 생각해.�
entries.translation: I think... this reckless redevelopment by the Council is dangerous.�

entries.source: 안그래도 공화국에는 추운 섬이 많고 농사 지을 땅이 부족한데...�
entries.translation: The Republic already has so many cold islands and so little farmland...�

entries.source: 늘어나는 인구에 대한 대책은 세우고 있는 걸까?�
entries.translation: Are they even planning for the growing population?�

entries.source: 베르날의 시장은 작지만, 정이 넘치고 유쾌하답니다.�
entries.translation: The market in Vernal is small, but it is warm and lively.�
I told you, just lie low and live quietly.�
I cannot stand remaining in the dark like this.�

entries.source: 너는 가장 원하던 것을 얻었잖아. 이대로가 가장 좋은 것 아닌가?�
entries.translation: You got what you wanted most. Is not this the best way?�

entries.source: 아니.. 두려워요. 제 정령은 렌처럼.. 확인할 수가 없으니까.�
entries.translation: No... I am afraid. Unlike Ren, I cannot see or check my spirit.�

entries.source: 제 정령이 어떻게 변해가는 건지.. 무엇을 원하는 건지.. 그리고 그게 저를 어떻게 변화시킬지..�
entries.translation: How it is changing... what it wants... and how it might change me...�

entries.source: 당신을 만나기 전부터 늘 두려웠어요. 하지만.. 혼자선 아무 것도 할 수 없었죠.�
entries.translation: I have lived in fear even before meeting you. But... I could do nothing alone.�

entries.source: 부탁해요, 방해가 되지는 않을게요. 아니, 제 능력이 있으면 분명히 도움이 될거예요.�
entries.translation: Please, I will not get in the way. In fact, my abilities will surely help.�

entries.source: 그.. 그렇게 하자, 슈르츠님은 많이 다치잖아? 분명 도움이 될거야.�
entries.translation: L-Let her come. You get hurt a lot, Schultz. She will be a big help.�
That is how dangerous it is...�

entries.source: 각오하고.. 있어요. 제 몸은 스스로 지킬 수 있을 거예요.�
entries.translation: I am... prepared. I can protect myself.�
Hey, what is the verdict? We are leaving soon.�
Welcome! Care to take a look at my wares?�

entries.source: 강해지는 데에는 왕도가 없지! 수련, 수련, 수련 뿐이다!�
entries.translation: There is no royal road to strength! Train, train, and train!�

entries.source: 어떤가, 용병 친구. 나에게 자네 장비의 운명을 맡겨보는 것은?�
entries.translation: How about it, mercenary? Care to trust your gear to my hands?�
Have you seen Lord Castler? He is so handsome!�

entries.source: 자상하고, 친절하고.. 전 나중에 카스틀러님께 시집갈 거예요!�
entries.translation: He is kind, caring... I am going to marry him one day!�
I do not know what it means either.�

entries.source: <북쪽 해안 절벽{에 숨겨 놨고 <이렘{으로 간다고 전해달라고만 했어요.�
entries.translation: They just told me to say it is hidden on the <Northern Sea Cliff{ and they went to <Irem{.�

entries.source: 에네스트 가문은 옛날부터 록빌을 지켜주던 훌륭한 가문이었지..�
entries.translation: The Ernest family has protected Rockville since the old days...�

entries.source: 그 강도 사건이 일어나고 마을 전체가 걱정했었는데..�
entries.translation: The whole village worried when that robbery happened...�

entries.source: 카스틀러 도련님이 그렇게 강하게 자라줘서, 정말 다행이라오.�
entries.translation: It is a relief young Master Castler grew up to be so strong.�

entries.source: 농사가 풍년이든 흉년이든 에네스트 가문의 지원이 있어 버텨낼 수 있었어요.�
entries.translation: Whether harvest was good or bad, the Ernests support got us through.�

entries.source: 이제 재개발이 되면 농삿일은 많이 줄어들겠지만..�
entries.translation: Farming will decrease once redevelopment starts, but...�

entries.source: 카스틀러님은 상업에도 많은 신경을 써주시니, 마을은 여전히 번창할 거라고 믿어요.�
entries.translation: Lord Castler cares deeply about commerce, so the village will thrive.�

entries.source: 네, 기억하고 있어요. 센트럴에서 왔다는 사람 말이죠?�
entries.translation: Yes, I remember. The man from Central, right?�

entries.source: 한 달 정도 있을 거라고 선불로 지급해 놓고 그저께 갑자기 사라졌어요.�
entries.translation: He paid upfront saying he would stay for a month, but then vanished the day before yesterday.�
Left all his luggage behind, too...�

entries.source: 게다가 며칠 전에는 센트럴에서 나왔다는 공무원들이 와서 그 짐도 다 가져갔어요.�
entries.translation: On top of that, officials from Central came by a few days ago and took all his belongings.�

entries.source: 괜히 수상한 사람을 들였다고 후회하던 차였어요.�
entries.translation: I was just regretting taking in such a suspicious stranger.�
|(The trail goes cold here... This is troublesome.){�
Mister, what do you think love is?�
The power that moves the world�

entries.source: |(어쨌든 더 찾을 길도 없으니 이쯤 하고 돌아갈까.){�
entries.translation: |(There is no other lead anyway. Should I head back for now?){�

entries.source: <북쪽 해안 절벽{에 숨겨 놨고 <이렘{으로 간다고 했어요.�
entries.translation: He hid it at the <northern coastal cliff{ and said he is going to <Irem{.�

entries.source: 얘는 참... 무슨 소리를 하는 거니?�
entries.translation: Goodness... What are you talking about, sweetie?�

entries.source: 제이크 아저씨가 저렇게 대답하는 사람이 있으면 <북쪽 해안 절벽{에 숨겨 놨고 <이렘{으로 간다고 전해달라고 했는걸.�
entries.translation: Mister Jake told me if someone gives that answer, to tell them he hid it at the <northern coastal cliff{ and is heading to <Irem{.�
Making a child pass along such strange messages...�

entries.source: 다음부터는 하숙도 사람을 좀 알아보고 받아야겠어요.�
entries.translation: Next time, I should really check who I am boarding.�

entries.source: 설마 우리 애한테 무슨 피해가 가는 건 아니겠죠?�
entries.translation: You do not think any harm will come to my child, do you?�

entries.source: 허허, 신문을 만든다는 건 민심을 조율하는 일이지.�
entries.translation: Haha, running a newspaper is all about tuning the public mood.�

entries.source: 재개발이 계속되면서 록빌의 시민들은 때로는 설레이고, 때로는 불안해 하네.�
entries.translation: With ongoing redevelopment, Rockville citizens oscillate between excitement and anxiety.�

entries.source: 그들을 지속적으로 희망차게 만드는 것이 우리의 일이지.�
entries.translation: Keeping them constantly hopeful is our job.�

entries.source: 가끔 의회에서는 말도 안되는 홍보물들이 내려와.�
entries.translation: Sometimes the council sends down ridiculous promotional material.�

entries.source: 사람들이 이걸 믿을까.. 싶기도 한데, 어쨌든 기사화가 되면 믿게 되더라고.�
entries.translation: I wonder if anyone will believe it... but once it is published, people usually do.�

entries.source: 재개발이 된다고, 과연 다들 먹고 살기 편해지기만 할지는 나도 잘 모르겠어.�
entries.translation: Whether redevelopment will truly make life easier for everyone, I am not so sure.�

entries.source: 휴, 휴, 쓸데없는 고민 따위는 할 시간도 없다고?�
entries.translation: Phew, who has time for idle worries?�

entries.source: 하루하루 새로운 정보가 밀려오는데, 받아들이기만 해도 벅차다고?�
entries.translation: New information floods in every day. Just keeping up is overwhelming enough!�

entries.source: 오래된 정보들을 어서 버리고, 새로운 세상을 받아들여야지 않겠어?�
entries.translation: Should not we discard outdated news quickly and embrace the new world?�

entries.source: 한 2주 전에 와서 왠지 모르지만 <웨이드 가{에 대한 걸 묻고 다니더라고?�
entries.translation: He stopped by about two weeks ago, asking around about <House Wade{ for some reason.�

entries.source: 그러다가 갑자기 사라졌는데 어디로 갔는지는 모르겠는데?�
entries.translation: Then he vanished out of nowhere. I have no idea where he went.�

entries.source: 여기는 여관이 없어서 <옆에 있는 민가{에서 하숙했을텐데 거기 아주머니라면 뭔가 알지도 모르겠네?�
entries.translation: There is no inn here, so he must have boarded at the <house next door{. The lady there might know something.�
Why are you looking for him anyway?�

entries.source: 며칠 전에도 센트럴에서 찾으러 온 사람이 있었거든?�
entries.translation: Someone from Central was looking for him a few days ago too.�

entries.source: 뭐 큰 빚이라도 지고 도망다니는 사람인가?�
entries.translation: Is he on the run from some massive debt or something?�

entries.source: 의회에서는 재개발이 완료되면 우리에게 더 큰 역할을 준다고 하더군.�
entries.translation: The council promised us a bigger role once redevelopment finishes.�

entries.source: 하지만 나는 그저 승진하기 위해 이 일을 하고 있는 건 아냐.�
entries.translation: Still, I am not doing this job just to climb the ladder.�

entries.source: 의회에서 주는 일 따위 보다, 사람들에게 유용한 정보를 주는 것이 더 보람차거든.�
entries.translation: Providing useful information to the people is far more rewarding than council tasks.�
To think... there are Successors who actually want to fight...�

entries.source: 계승자는 몇 명일까요? 그리고 그 중에 싸우려는 사람들은 얼마나 될까요?�
entries.translation: How many Successors are there? And how many of them wish to fight?�

entries.source: 가시거미 동굴의 마르크씨는.. 좋은 사람이었으면 해요..�
entries.translation: I hope Marc from the Thorn Spider Cave... is a good person...�

entries.source: 급한 일부터 처리하고 이야기 해 주지.�
entries.translation: Let us handle urgent matters first, then I will explain.�
Schultz, Ren! You made it safely!�
There was a minor incident, though.�
Big sis Eileen! I missed you!�

entries.source: 아, 슈르츠님이 존댓말 하지 말래서.. 앞으로 편하게 얘기해야 돼..�
entries.translation: Ah, Schultz told me not to speak formally... So I should speak casually from now on...�
Oh? What a strange demand from our dear Successor.�

entries.source: |(나이 어린 용병이 존댓말 하면 얕잡아 보인데요.. 하여튼 삐딱해서..)�
entries.translation: |(People look down on a young merc who is too polite... Always so cynical...)�
That is just the world I live in.�

entries.source: 나는 상관없어. 함께 다니려면 그 쪽이 편하겠지.�
entries.translation: Fine by me. It makes traveling together easier anyway.�

entries.source: 함께 다니는 건 }마르크{를 찾을 때 까지야. 여기로 온 걸 보니 당신도 뭔가 단서를 얻은 모양이군.�
entries.translation: Traveling together ends once we find }Marc{. Seeing you here, you must have found a lead.�

entries.source: 그냥 그의 주 거래처가 여기라고 해서.. 무작정 기다리고 있는 것 뿐이예요.�
entries.translation: I just heard his main client was here... so I came blindly hoping to run into him.�

entries.source: 서신에 적혀있는 곳으로는 혼자 갈 수가 없어서..�
entries.translation: I could not go to the place mentioned in his letter alone...�
Where did the letter say to meet?�

entries.source: }베르날 서쪽{에 있는 }가시거미 동굴{로 오라고 적혀있었어요. 자신은 그곳에 은신해 있다고..�
entries.translation: It told me to come to the }Thorn Spider Cave{ }west of Vernal{. Said he was hiding out there...�
I had no idea how to go alone... Vernal Isle is dangerous too, right?�
I will go. You wait here.�

entries.source: 계승자들 중에는 위험한 자도 있어. 확인해 봐야 해.�
entries.translation: Some Successors are dangerous. I need to check first.�

entries.source: 역시 그때 렌을 공격했던 건.. 다른 계승자였던 건가요?�
entries.translation: So the one who attacked Ren back then... really was another Successor?�

entries.source: 그래. 그런 놈을 또 만났을 때 일행이 많으면 오히려 피곤해.�
entries.translation: Yeah. If we run into another guy like that, having dead weight will just make things worse.�

entries.source: 마르크를 만난 뒤, 말이 통하는 상대라면 데리고 오겠어.�
entries.translation: Once I meet Marc, if he can be reasoned with, I will bring him back.�
Then... I will do that. Please be careful.�
Huh...? You are not going together?�

entries.source: 괜찮아, 렌. 난 가봐야.. 방해만 될거야.�
entries.translation: It is fine, Ren. If I went... I would only get in the way.�

entries.source: .. 그런 눈으로 보지마. 마르크를 죽인 건 내가 아냐.�
entries.translation: ...Do not look at me like that. I am not the one who killed Marc.�
My spirit is agitated. My magic power grew stronger too...�

entries.source: 센트럴에서 마주쳤던 그 남자야. 그 남자는 계승자를 다 죽일 생각인 것 같더군.�
entries.translation: It was the man from Central. Seems he intends to kill all the Successors.�

entries.source: 뭐.. 마르크도 마찬가지 였던 것 같지만.�
entries.translation: Well... looks like Marc was planning to do the same.�
Marc... wanted to fight as well?�

entries.source: 아마도 계승자가 죽으면.. 정령의 힘은 남은 다른 계승자들에게 나눠지는 듯 해.�
entries.translation: When a Successor dies... their spirit power seems to split among the survivors.�

entries.source: 더 강한 힘을 원하는 자들은 다른 계승자들을 죽이려고 하겠지. 그런 구조야.�
entries.translation: Those who crave more power will hunt down other Successors. That is how it works.�

entries.source: 그건 알아내지 못했어. 다른 계승자들도 정령의 목적이나, 기원에 대해선 아무것도 모르는 듯 하더군.�
entries.translation: I could not find out. The other Successors do not seem to know anything about the spirits purpose or origin either.�

entries.source: 그저 받았을 뿐.. 그리고 그 상황에서 자신이 원하는 쪽으로 그 힘을 쓰고 있는거야.�
entries.translation: They just received it... and are using that power however they see fit.�

entries.source: 어째서.. 가장 원하는 것을 손에 넣었을 사람들이..�
entries.translation: Why... would people who got what they wanted most in life do that...?�

entries.source: 어쨌든.. 다행히 다른 정령을 찾아내는 능력은 렌에게 밖에 없는 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Regardless... fortunately, Ren seems to be the only one who can detect other spirits.�

entries.source: 보통은 계승자가 나타나면 기이한 일들이 벌어지니까, 그것을 통해 다른 계승자를 찾아나가겠지.�
entries.translation: Usually, strange events happen around a Successor, so they will track down others through that.�

entries.source: 그러니 죽은 듯이 숨어지내. 이미 9번가의 성녀에 대한 소문은 공화국 전체에 퍼져있으니.. 다른 계승자들의 표적이 될거야.�
entries.translation: So lay low like you are dead. Rumors of the Saintess of 9th Ave have already spread across the Republic... You will be a target.�

entries.source: 아니면 가장 원했던 것을 버리고, 스스로 계승권을 포기하는 방법도 있다더군.�
entries.translation: Or you can abandon what you desired most and forfeit your succession right yourself. That is another way.�

entries.source: 그건.. 듣지 않겠어요. 절대로 할 수 없을테니까.�
entries.translation: I will not... listen to that. Because I could never do that.�
That concludes my part of the request.�

entries.source: 계승자들끼리 모여서 즐거운 일이 일어난 기억이 있나?�
entries.translation: Do you recall anything pleasant ever happening when Successors gather?�

entries.source: 하지만 아일린 언니는 위험해 질거야! 아일린 언니는 싸우지도 못하잖아, 그 남자를 마주치기라도 하면..�
entries.translation: But Eileen will be in danger! She cannot even fight! If she runs into that man...�

entries.source: 함께 있다고 해서 그 놈을 이길 수 있는 것도 아니야.�
entries.translation: Sticking together will not help us beat him anyway.�

entries.source: 그냥, 무조건 숨어지내. 함부로 정령의 힘을 쓰지도 말고.. 다른 계승자들이 너를 추적할 단서가 될거야.�
entries.translation: Just stay hidden no matter what. Do not use your spirit power recklessly... It will become a clue for other successors to track you down.�

entries.source: 찾아야지. 이런 장난질을 하고 있는 게 누구인지.. 어떻게 하면 이 굴레에서 벗어날 수 있을지.�
entries.translation: I have to find out. Who is playing these twisted games... and how to break free from these shackles.�

entries.source: 그래.. 하나만 가르쳐 줘. 아일린, 당신은 언제부터 그 꿈을 꾸었지?�
entries.translation: Right... tell me one thing. Eileen, when did you first start having that dream?�

entries.source: 전 1년전에 그 꿈을 단 한 번 꾸었고.. 그 때 정령을 받아 들였어요.�
entries.translation: I had that dream just once a year ago... and that is when I accepted the spirit.�

entries.source: 역시 }1년{.. 이야. 마르크도 그랬겠지.. 루퍼스는, 뭔가 특별한건가..�
entries.translation: As expected, }1 year{... Marc was probably the same... Is Rufus something special, then...?�
Ren...? Are not you coming with him?�
Am I really... just a burden and a shackle to Schultz?�

entries.source: 그건.. 네가 아니라 계승자로써의 규칙을 말하는 걸 거야, 렌.�
entries.translation: That is... not about you, Ren. He is talking about the rules of being a successor.�

entries.source: 헤헤.. 나도 내가 어찌될 지 무서운데, 슈르츠님도 그렇겠지 뭐. 어쩔 수 없어.�
entries.translation: Hehe... I am terrified of what might happen to me too, so Schultz must feel the same. It cannot be helped.�

entries.source: 언니, 몸 조심해야 해? 나중에.. 내가 뭔가 알려줄 게 생기면 찾아갈게.�
entries.translation: Take care of yourself, okay? If... I find out anything later, I will come look for you.�
Dear God... What do you want from us...?�

entries.source: 일자리를 구하러 오신 거라면, 단순한 비정규직뿐이고 용병이 할 만한 일은 없어요.�
entries.translation: If you are here looking for work, there is only temporary labor. Nothing suitable for a mercenary.�

entries.source: 록빌 재개발로 일자리는 잔뜩 만들어졌지만 지금은 그것도 포화상태라서요.�
entries.translation: The Rockville redevelopment created a ton of jobs, but even those are fully saturated now.�
Hmm... Never heard that name before...�
No idea, honestly. Why do not you check the newspaper office upstairs?�

entries.source: 드나드는 사람이 많다보니 일일이 다 기억할 수가 없어요.�
entries.translation: With so many people coming and going, I cannot remember every single one.�
There is hardly any work for a mercenary.�

entries.source: 요즘 골치를 썩이고 있는 새들에게 현상금을 건다고 했는데...�
entries.translation: They put a bounty on the birds that have been causing trouble lately, though...�

entries.source: 그건 저 안쪽에 있는 빨간 옷을 입은 남자분에게 물어보시고요.�
entries.translation: You can ask the man in red over there in the back about that.�

entries.source: 웨이드 가에서 수배 중인 <언제나의 그 분{이 아직도 1위 하고 있네요.�
entries.translation: <The usual suspect{ wanted by House Wade is still ranked number one.�
My, the bounty went up again.�
Still, that is impossible for anyone, right?�
More promotional materials arrived from the council.�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬의 농업이 크게 발전해서, 이제 베르날 섬의 농지는 점차 줄여간다고 하네요.�
entries.translation: They say agriculture on Moytura Isle has developed so much that farmland on Vernal Isle will be gradually reduced.�

entries.source: 흠.. 이게 정말일까요? 모이투라 섬은 추운 지방이라 농업이 그렇게 안정적이지 못할텐데..�
entries.translation: Hmm... Is that really true? Moytura Isle is a cold region, so farming should not be that stable...�

entries.source: 후.. 이건 도대체, 어디서부터 설계를 고쳐야 할지 모르겠군.�
entries.translation: Phew... I do not even know where to begin redesigning this thing.�

entries.source: 록빌은 오래된 농업 도시야. 센트럴 처럼 되려면 몇 십년은 족히 걸릴 것 같다고.�
entries.translation: Rockville is an old agricultural town. It will take decades to become anything like Central.�

entries.source: 다른 일은 아직 없군. 뭔가 할 일이 있으면 또 부탁하지.�
entries.translation: No other jobs for now. If something comes up, I will call on you again.�

entries.source: 올해는 유난히 몬스터가 많은 것 같단 말이야. 다 어디서 기어나오는 건지 원.�
entries.translation: Seems like there are unusually many monsters this year. Wonder where they are all crawling out from.�
Judging by your gear, you must be a mercenary?�

entries.source: 원래 매년 수확기가 되면 새들이 말썽이라서 마을 사람들이 단체로 사냥을 했다고 하더군.�
entries.translation: Normally every harvest season, the birds cause trouble, so the villagers would hunt them in groups.�

entries.source: 그런데 올해는 유난히 극성인데다가 재개발도 겹처서 손이 모자라.�
entries.translation: But this year they are especially rampant, and on top of that, we are short-handed due to redevelopment.�

entries.source: 센트럴에 보상금을 걸고 용병을 고용해도 된다는 허가를 받아서, 오늘부터 시작인데.�
entries.translation: We got permission from Central to put up a bounty and hire mercenaries, starting today.�

entries.source: 뭐 알아서 하겠지만... 무리는 하지 말고.�
entries.translation: Well, suit yourself... Just do not overdo it.�

entries.source: 만만치 않은 녀석이 있거든. 돈 벌려다가 치료비로 다 날리지 말라고.�
entries.translation: There is a tough one out there. Do not end up spending all your earnings on medical bills.�

entries.source: 자재는 계속 들어오고, 뜯어고칠 것은 늘어만 가는군 그래.�
entries.translation: Materials keep pouring in, and the list of renovations just keeps growing.�

entries.source: 사람이 더 필요해, 사람이. 의회에서 산정해준 작업 인력으로는 택도 없어.�
entries.translation: We need more hands, more people. The workforce allocated by the council is nowhere near enough.�

entries.source: 생산 설비는 확실히 지원해 줄 것처럼 얘기하더니, 이게 뭐람.�
entries.translation: They talked as if they would fully back production facilities, but look at this mess.�

entries.source: 넌 잠시 들어가 있어. 카즈와는 둘이서 얘기할거니까.�
entries.translation: Step inside for a moment. I need to speak with Kaze privately.�

entries.source: 그냥 그렇게 해. 확실하지 않은 개인적인 일까지 일일이 보고하고 싶진 않아.�
entries.translation: Just leave it at that. I do not feel like reporting every uncertain personal matter.�

entries.source: 흠.. 날 숨기고 싶은 거구나. 알았어.�
entries.translation: Hmm... So you want to hide me. Fine.�

entries.source: 오, 슈르츠님. 돌아 오셨군요. 가주님께서 생각보다 늦으신다고 걱정이 많으십니다.�
entries.translation: Ah, Master Schultz. You have returned. The master was worried that you were taking longer than expected.�
Ran into some trouble. Is Kaze in?�
Master Schultz, you have arrived. Master Kastler is looking for you.�
New information, perhaps... I will head right in.�
Welcome, Master Schultz. Would you like to rest for a moment?�
Please feel free to come rest anytime, Master Schultz.�

entries.source: 에네스트 저택은 넓지만 그렇게 관리가 힘들지는 않습니다.�
entries.translation: Ernest Manor is large, but managing it is not particularly difficult.�

entries.source: 카스틀러님은 저희에게 무리한 일은 결코 요구하지 않으시니까요.�
entries.translation: Master Kastler never asks anything unreasonable of us.�

entries.source: 생각보다 양이 많아서 좀 나눠드리도록 하겠습니다.�
entries.translation: There was more than expected, so let me share some with you.�
|(...I knew you did not need 10 of them...){/literal�

entries.source: 북쪽 해안가에 있습니다. 북쪽이 어딘지는 알고 계신지요?�
entries.translation: They are on the northern coast. You do know where north is, do not you?�

entries.source: 카스틀러님에게 동부전갈집게발 구이를 만들어 드리고 싶습니다.�
entries.translation: I would like to cook grilled east scorpion claws for Master Kastler.�
They are on the northern coast, so please go fetch them.�
|(Go fetch them, not even a please...){/literal�

entries.source: 그렇군요... 슈르츠님은 어느새 돈이 안되는 일이라면 손도 까딱하지 않는 어른이 되어 버리셨군요...�
entries.translation: I see... You have grown into an adult who will not lift a finger unless money is involved...�

entries.source: 어쩔 수 없지요. 얼마면 되겠습니까? 얼마까지 알아보고 오셨나요?�
entries.translation: I suppose I have no choice. How much will it take? How much were you looking to get?�
|(So refusing was not an option from the start...){/literal�
Yes. I am not very good at cooking.�
Where does a maid get this kind of money?�

entries.source: 걱정해 주시는 겁니까? 제대로 경비로 처리하고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: Are you worried about me? I am expensing it properly.�

entries.source: 네, 슈르츠님이 집게발 10개를 가져와서 강매했다고 적을 생각입니다.�
entries.translation: Yes, I plan to write that Master Schultz brought 10 claws and forced me to buy them.�

entries.source: 예전의 슈르츠님은 좀 더 부려먹기 편한...�
entries.translation: The old Master Schultz was much easier to boss around...�

entries.source: 실례했습니다. 소녀의 말에 좀 더 귀기울여 주시는 친절한 분이셨습니다.�
entries.translation: Pardon me. You used to be kind enough to listen to a maiden request.�

entries.source: 고쳐도 이미 늦었거든? 예전에도 그런 적 없었거든!?�
entries.translation: It is too late to take it back! And I was never like that!�
It was not smooth sailing. In many ways.�
So, did you find anything useful?�
They were holding Ancients at Central Tower?�

entries.source: 역시.. 예상대로 그곳은 단순히 총기를 생산하고 기술 연구를 하는 곳이 아니었군..!�
entries.translation: Just as expected... It was not merely a place for producing firearms and researching tech!�

entries.source: 거기까지야. 그 붉은 머리의 도망자 때문에 비상이 걸린 뒤로는, 더 이상의 조사가 불가능했어.�
entries.translation: That is all I got. Once that red-haired fugitive triggered an alert, further investigation was impossible.�
What a shame. We spent so long preparing that infiltration into the tower...�

entries.source: 어쩔 수 없었어. 그 보안 카드도 더 이상 사용이 불가능했고.. 무엇보다 경계 수준이 엄청나게 올라갔거든.�
entries.translation: Nothing I could do. The keycard stopped working... and above all, their security was raised through the roof.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 그것보다는 오히려 그 }도망자{에 집중하면 괜찮은 성과였다고 봐.�
entries.translation: Still... If we focus on that }fugitive{, I would say it was quite a success.�

entries.source: 그 도망자가 타워를 빠져나오기 위해 했던 준비.. 그를 잡기 위해 타워에 내려진 비상, 그리고 탈출로에 등장한 괴수.�
entries.translation: The preparations he made to escape the tower, the emergency alert issued to catch him, and the monster sent after him.�

entries.source: 분명히.. 웨이드 가에 중요한 인물이었고, 그들과 적대하고 있다는 거야.�
entries.translation: Clearly... he is important to House Wade, and he opposes them.�

entries.source: 그 남자를 찾으면 웨이드 가에 대한 정보를 얻을 수 있어. 어쩌면 그 이상의 협조를 얻을 수 있을지도 몰라.�
entries.translation: If we find him, we can get intel on House Wade. We might even gain an ally.�

entries.source: 그렇군.. 다음 작전은 그 남자를 찾는 건가?�
entries.translation: I see... So our next move is finding that man?�

entries.source: 사람 찾는 건 너의 특기잖아. 각 섬의 항구에 있는 밀항업자들에게 붉은 머리의 남자에 대한 정보를 알아봐 줘.�
entries.translation: Finding people is your specialty. Ask the smugglers at each harbor about a red-haired man.�

entries.source: 후우. 그래, 일단 다음 단계를 위한 단서 정도는 잡은 거로군.�
entries.translation: Phew. Right, at least we have a lead for the next step.�
Have you ever heard of a }Listener{?�

entries.source: 그 남자가 언급했었어. 그리고 내 뒤를 쫓던 알프레드 역시 그 단어에 반응했고.�
entries.translation: He mentioned it. And Alfred, who was pursuing me, reacted to that word too.�

entries.source: 어쩌면 우리가 찾는 웨이드 가의 배후에 있는 이들을 일컫는 말일지도 몰라.�
entries.translation: Perhaps it refers to those pulling the strings behind House Wade.�

entries.source: 듣는 자.. 듣는 자.. 뭘 듣는다는 거지? 흐음..�
entries.translation: Listener... Listener... What do they listen to? Hmm...�

entries.source: 오케이. 다음은 붉은 머리 도망자의 추적, 듣는 자라는 것에 대한 조사. 그러면 되지?�
entries.translation: Alright. Next is tracking the red-haired fugitive and looking into this Listener. Sound good?�

entries.source: 일단 타워에서 얻은 성과로 다음 작업을 진행하려면 그 정도가 최선인 것 같군.�
entries.translation: For now, based on what we found at the tower, that seems to be our best bet.�

entries.source: 그래, 알겠어. 그건 나에게 맡겨. 사람을 좀 풀어보지.�
entries.translation: Got it. Leave that to me. I will put some people on it.�

entries.source: 넌 일단 좀 쉬어. 뭔가 단서가 나오면 다시 이야기하자.�
entries.translation: Get some rest for now. We will talk again once a lead turns up.�

entries.source: 아, 혹시 마르크라는 사람에 대해 아는 게 있나?�
entries.translation: Oh, do you happen to know anything about someone named Marc?�
I took on a personal request.�

entries.source: 요즘 }록빌 개발 공단{ 쪽에 엄청난 양의 귀금속을 팔러오는 사람이 있는데, 그런 이름이었던 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Lately, someone has been selling massive amounts of jewelry around the }Rockville Industrial Complex{. I think that was his name.�

entries.source: 뭐.. 귀금속 팔아서 번 돈만해도 상당히 많겠지만, 어디서 뭐하는 사람인지는 밝혀진게 없다더군.�
entries.translation: Well... He must have made a fortune selling jewelry, but no one knows who he is or where he came from.�

entries.source: 아마 콜크리크 섬에서 온 졸부가 아닐까 싶어.�
entries.translation: Probably just some nouveau riche from Cole Creek Isle.�
Want me to look into him too?�

entries.source: 아니.. 개인적으로 받은 의뢰니까. 내가 해결하도록 하지.�
entries.translation: No... It is a personal matter. I will handle it myself.�

entries.source: 힘든 일 하나 마쳤는데, 쉬엄쉬엄 하라구.�
entries.translation: You just finished a tough job, so take it easy.�

entries.source: 그리고.. 조심해. 흑의병들까지 쫓아왔다면 록빌도 위험할지 몰라.�
entries.translation: And... be careful. If the Black Guard is on your trail, Rockville might not be safe either.�

entries.source: 아직은 별 성과가 없어. 최근에 붉은 머리의 남자가 밀항했다는 정보도 없고.. 듣는 자는 어디서부터 시작해야 될지도 모르겠고.�
entries.translation: No results yet. No news of a red-haired man smuggling himself out... and I do not even know where to begin with the Listener.�
Did you have something to say?�

entries.source: 잠시 }콜크리크 섬{의 }킹스포트{로 본거지를 옮기려고 해. 아무래도 베르날 섬은 센트럴이 코앞이라 움직이기 힘드니까.�
entries.translation: I am moving our base to }Kingsport{ on }Cole Creek Isle{ for a bit. It is hard to operate on Vernal Isle with Central right on top of us.�
I suppose I should come along?�

entries.source: 음. 급한 일이 아니면, 난 잠시 모이투라 섬에 들렀다 가지.�
entries.translation: Hmm. If it is not urgent, I will stop by Moytura Plains first.�

entries.source: ... 그러고보니 꼴이 말이 아닌데.. 무슨 일을 하고 다니는 거야?�
entries.translation: ...Come to think of it, you look terrible... What kind of work are you doing?�

entries.source: 그냥, 개인적인 일이야. 금방 마무리 짓도록 하지.�
entries.translation: Just personal business. I will wrap it up quickly.�

entries.source: 개인적인 일이라.. 무슨 일인지 말해줄 순 없는건가.�
entries.translation: Personal business, huh... Guess you cannot tell me what it is.�
It will not interfere with our work.�

entries.source: 최대한.. 빨리 끝내고 콜크리크 섬으로 와. 언제 새로운 정보가 들어올 지 모르니까.�
entries.translation: Finish it as soon as you can and come to Cole Creek Isle. We might get new intel at any moment.�

entries.source: 네가 정말로 어떤 힘을 나에게 숨기고 있다면..�
entries.translation: If you really are hiding some power from me...�

entries.source: 듣는 자라는 건 도대체 어디서부터 조사를 해야할지 모르겠어.�
entries.translation: I have no idea where to even start investigating this Listener.�

entries.source: 정보꾼들이 흘려들은 거라도 있나 알아보고 있는 중이긴 한데...�
entries.translation: I am checking if the informants have picked up any rumors, but...�

entries.source: 오히려 그 붉은 머리 도망자 쪽이 낫겠어. 밀항 루트는 꿰고 있으니까, 좀 기다려 보자고.�
entries.translation: The red-haired fugitive seems more promising. I know the smuggling routes, so let us wait a bit.�

entries.source: 난 곧 }콜크리크 섬{으로 출발할거야. 볼 일이 끝나면 그곳으로 와.�
entries.translation: I will leave for }Cole Creek Isle{ soon. Come join me once you are done here.�

entries.source: 최대한 빨리 끝내고 오길 바라. 언제 새로운 정보가 들어올 지 모르니까.�
entries.translation: I hope you finish as soon as possible. We never know when new info might arrive.�

entries.source: 저 사람들, 여기까지 우릴 쫓아온 거야?�
entries.translation: Did they follow us all the way here?�

entries.source: 이봐.. 저 놈들, 웨이드 가의 흑의병 아냐?�
entries.translation: Hey... Are not they Black Guards from House Wade?�

entries.source: 이런 산골까지 무슨 일로 나타난 거지?�
entries.translation: What brought them all the way out to these mountains?�

entries.source: 이번에 모이투라로 들어온 여객선에 유명한 수배범이 타고 있었다고 하는군.�
entries.translation: I heard a notorious fugitive was aboard the ferry heading to Moytura.�

entries.source: }브리안{.. 이던가. 어쨌든 웨이드 가에서도 찾으려고 혈안이 되있다고 하니, 저 녀석들도 쫓아왔겠지.�
entries.translation: }Brian{... was it? House Wade is desperate to catch him, so their guards must be hunting him.�

entries.source: 우리때문에 온건 아닌 것 같지만.. 그래도 골치 아픈데..�
entries.translation: Does not seem like they are here for us... but still, this is troublesome...�
Could they be here... for Tyr?�

entries.source: 오빠 오빠 쉽게도 부르는군. 내 이름에 님은 뗄 생각도 안하면서.�
entries.translation: You call him oppa so easily. Yet you will not drop the honorific with me.�
Well, I just call people whatever feels natural...�

entries.source: 얼마나 더 있을지 몰라.. 함부로 마을에서 소란을 피우면 안되겠군.�
entries.translation: No telling how long they will stay... We should not cause a scene in town.�

entries.source: 북쪽 동굴로 가야하는데, 이거.. 일단 저놈들 눈을 피해 }마을을 벗어날 방법{부터 찾아야 겠어.�
entries.translation: We need to reach the northern cave. First, let us find }a way out of town{ unseen.�

entries.source: 공화국의 최북단이니까.. 오래 머무를 곳은 못되지.�
entries.translation: It is the northern tip of the Republic... Not a place to stay long.�

entries.source: 티르 오빠도.. 이 섬에 와있는 거겠지?�
entries.translation: Do you think Tyr... is on this island too?�

entries.source: 이 섬에 오지 못했다면 바다에 빠져 죽었겠지.�
entries.translation: If he did not make it here, he must have drowned at sea.�

entries.source: 농담이야. 그렇게 허술한 남자라면 웨이드 가에서 그렇게 찾아 헤매지도 않겠지.�
entries.translation: Just kidding. If he were that careless, House Wade would not still be hunting him.�

entries.source: .. 슈르츠님, 티르 오빠부터 찾아보면 안 돼?�
entries.translation: ...Schultz, cannot we look for Tyr first?�

entries.source: 왜애? 슈르츠님도 중요한 사람이라고 그랬잖아? 게다가 티르 오빠도, 계승자에 대해 알고 있었다구.�
entries.translation: Why? You said he is important too! And Tyr knew about the Successor.�

entries.source: 괜찮아. 그 남자.. 마지막에 다시 만날 거라고 했어. 그 쪽도 우리에게 흥미가 생겼다는 거지.�
entries.translation: Do not worry. He said we would meet again. That means he is interested in us too.�

entries.source: 웨이드 가에서 5년동안 잡지 못한 자야. 먼저 다가오길 기다리는 게 빠를거다.�
entries.translation: House Wade could not catch him for five years. It is faster to wait for him to approach us.�
Let us gather some info and find }Theodore{ first.�

entries.source: 언니, 고대종들 때문에 놀란거야? 아니면 멀미라도..�
entries.translation: Did the Ancients scare you? Or are you seasick...?�

entries.source: 응.. 좀 머리가 아파.. 쉬고 싶어.�
entries.translation: Yeah... My head aches a bit... I want to rest.�
A hindrance right from the start.�

entries.source: 여관에 가서 쉬고 있어. 어차피.. 움직이는 건 혼자 할 생각이었으니까.�
entries.translation: Go rest at the inn. I was planning to move alone anyway.�

entries.source: 몸도 안좋은 사람한테 꼭 그렇게 말해야 돼?�
entries.translation: Did you have to say it like that to someone who feels sick?�
I never asked her to follow me.�

entries.source: 정말.. 보통은 아일린 언니같은 여자들에게 친절하잖아? 남자들은.�
entries.translation: Seriously... Guys are usually nice to women like Eileen, are not they?�

entries.source: 아, 혹시 나이때문에 그래? 아일린 언니가 누나라서 별로인건가?�
entries.translation: Oh, is it because of her age? Because she is older than you?�

entries.source: 나이가 무슨 상관이야. 어른스러운 건 좋다고 생각해.�
entries.translation: Age does not matter. I think being mature is a good thing.�

entries.source: 그럼 좀 친절하게 대해줘.. 같은 계승자라는 것도 대단한 인연이잖아?�
entries.translation: Then treat her nicely... Being fellow Successors is a big deal, you know?�
Maybe... but I just do not see her as a woman.�

entries.source: 으음.. 아일린 언니가 좀 귀여운 느낌이 없긴 하지만..�
entries.translation: Hmm... Eileen might not seem that cute, but still...�

entries.source: 여자가 눈에 들어오겠냐? 지금 내가 노닥거릴 상황이라고 생각해?�
entries.translation: Do I look like I care about women? Do you think I am in a position to mess around?�

entries.source: 목숨이 왔다갔다 하는 상황이니까, 너도 긴장을 좀 더 하라고. 엄한 남자한테 첫눈에 반하지 말고.�
entries.translation: Our lives are on the line, so stay sharp. And stop falling for random guys at first sight.�
I-It was not love at first sight!�

entries.source: 흐흐. 수많은 사람들이 농업에 지쳐서 이렘을 떠나 센트럴로 갔지.�
entries.translation: Heh heh. Many grew sick of farming, left Irem, and went to Central.�

entries.source: 하지만 난 그러지 않을거야. 절대로 그 커다란 기계의 부속처럼 살지 않을 거라고.�
entries.translation: But not me. I will never live like a cog in that giant machine.�

entries.source: 아, 좋아좋아. 괴로움을 잊는데는 역시 이게 최고지.�
entries.translation: Ah, good, good. Nothing beats this for forgetting troubles.�

entries.source: 아, 그 지도는 선주종 말로 쓰여진 거니까, 누구 그 말 아는 사람을 찾아봐.�
entries.translation: Oh, that map is written in the native tongue, so find someone who reads it.�

entries.source: 그 때는 전쟁이 이렇게 끝날 줄 몰랐어. 선주종 땅을 다 점령하면 느긋하게 찾을 생각이었는데.�
entries.translation: Back then, I did not think the war would end like this. I planned to search at leisure once we took all native land.�
I was quite something back in the day.�

entries.source: 지금은 이렇게 술이 없으면 잠도 못자는 신세지만.�
entries.translation: Though now I cannot even sleep without a drink.�

entries.source: 이봐, 젊은 친구. 부탁 좀 하지.�
entries.translation: Hey, youngster. How about a favor?�

entries.source: 여기 마을 밖에 나가면 걸어다니는 포자들을 좀 잡아주지 않겠어?�
entries.translation: Could you go outside the village and slay those walking spores?�

entries.source: 그 놈들의 잎사귀를 가지고 끝내주는 술을 만들 수 있거든.�
entries.translation: Their leaves make an incredible brew, you see.�
Where would a beggar get money!�

entries.source: 쩝, 그래도 공짜로 해달라는 건 아냐. 이건 내가 옛날에 <성지전쟁{때 얻은 지도야.�
entries.translation: Tsk, I am not asking for free. This is a map I got back during the <Sanctuary War{.�

entries.source: 어느 선주종 놈이 가지고 있던 것을 뺏었지... 뭐 귀한 거라도 적혀 있나 보더군.�
entries.translation: I took it from some native... Looked like something precious was written on it.�

entries.source: 전에 센트럴에서 왔다던 학자 양반이 비싸게 팔라던 것도 사양한 거야.�
entries.translation: Some scholar from Central offered a fortune for it, but I refused.�
I will give it to you.�
What an unmotivated fellow. Forget it then.�
|(Demanding a favor with such an attitude...){�

entries.source: 여행객, 아니.. 용병이신가요? 저희 이렘에 오신걸 환영합니다.�
entries.translation: A traveler, or... a mercenary? Welcome to Irem.�

entries.source: 이렘은 공화국 최대의 농업 마을이자, 모든 학자들이 선망하는 거대 도서관이 있는 지성의 중심지랍니다.�
entries.translation: Irem is the Republic greatest farming village and an intellectual hub home to a grand library coveted by scholars.�

entries.source: 물론 저희 상점도 최고의 물품으로 여러분들을 모시고 있어요.�
entries.translation: Of course, our shop also welcomes you with the finest goods.�
Ohh, is it you? The Revolutionary Army new allies!�
You must be the one with purple hair...�

entries.source: }그라함{이라고 하네. 티르 대장의 명에 따라 자네들을 기다리고 있었지.�
entries.translation: Name is }Graham{. Commander Tyr ordered me to wait for you.�

entries.source: 패기 넘치는 모습이, 마치 젊은 날의 나를 보는 듯 하군 그래. 헛헛헛.�
entries.translation: Full of spirit, just like me in my younger days! Wahaha.�
Commander Tyr already boarded the }Neo Graham{.�

entries.source: 내가 군에서 마지막으로 빼돌린 최신예함이지! 인류의 미래를 위해 바다를 가르는.�
entries.translation: The latest warship I pinched from the military! Slicing the seas for humanity future!�

entries.source: 나의 풀개조까지 받은 네오 그라함 호가 오르비스 군도에서 가지 못하는 곳은 없다!�
entries.translation: Fully customized by me, there is nowhere in the Orbis Archipelago the Neo Graham cannot go!�

entries.source: 그럼 갈까? 성지로 간다고 들었는데.. 오랜만에 긴장감있는 항해가 되겠어!�
entries.translation: Shall we go? Heading to the Sanctuary, I hear... It has been a while since we had a thrilling voyage!�

entries.source: 모이투라 평야는 토양이 좋아서, 날씨가 추운데도 불구하고 수많은 종류의 곡물을 재배할 수 있지.�
entries.translation: The Moytura Plains have rich soil, so many crops grow despite the cold weather.�

entries.source: 하지만 요즘 위험한 것들이 많아져서 일하러 갈 땐 항상 무리를 지어서 이동해야 해.�
entries.translation: Dangerous beasts have increased lately, though, so we always travel in groups when working.�

entries.source: 테오도어가 나타난 건 1년전 즈음이야. 처음에는 그냥 샌님인 줄로만 알았지.�
entries.translation: Theodore appeared about a year ago. At first, I thought he was just a timid scholar.�

entries.source: 그 남자가 밝혀낸 선주종의 마법의 규칙들은, 모이투라의 생산력 증대에도 간접적으로 큰 영향을 주었어.�
entries.translation: The rules of native magic he unraveled indirectly boosted Moytura crop yields by a lot.�

entries.source: 4년전에 젊은 놈들이 혁명이니 뭐니 날뛰다가 마을이고 농지고 다 태워먹었을 땐 어쩌나 싶었는데..�
entries.translation: Four years ago, young folks ran wild shouting about revolution, burning farms and villages to ash...�

entries.source: 겨우 되살아난 마을이야. 쓸데없는 생각말고 모두가 웨이드 가를 잘 따라야 한다네.�
entries.translation: This village barely recovered. Stop dreaming foolish thoughts and follow House Wade properly.�

entries.source: 내가 말이야, 밀매업자이긴 해도 남에게 피해는 안주고 살아왔어.�
entries.translation: Look, I may be a smuggler, but I have lived without harming anyone.�

entries.source: 그러니까 이런 밝은 대낮에 너같은 용병을 보고도 암살당할 걱정이 없는 것 아니겠어?�
entries.translation: That is why I can see a mercenary like you in broad daylight without fearing assassination, right?�

entries.source: 어이.. 밀매업자면, 혹시 마을의 뒷길 같은 건 아는 게 없나?�
entries.translation: Hey... If you are a smuggler, do you know any back alleys around town?�

entries.source: 오호라.. 뭔가 캥기는 게 있는 놈이구만? 흑의병들 때문이지?�
entries.translation: Oho... You got something to hide, eh? Because of the Black Guard?�
Yeah. I would rather avoid causing a scene in town.�

entries.source: 뭐, 뒷길이랄 것도 없어. 샛길인데, 내가 가끔 교단에 토파즈 팔 때 이용하는 길이지.�
entries.translation: Well, it is hardly a back road. Just a side path I take when I sell topaz to the Order.�

entries.source: 다 알려진 길이니 비밀도 아니고.. 저 쪽이야.�
entries.translation: Everyone knows it, so it is no secret... Over that way.�
It is marked off as a danger zone, but it is nothing special.�

entries.source: 흑의병들 때문에 나도 영 찝찝하니까.. 마을이 이렇게 살벌한 건 싫거든.�
entries.translation: The Black Guard giving me the creeps anyway... Cannot stand the town feeling so grim.�

entries.source: 이렘은 최대의 농업마을인데다, 학자들까지 몰려와서.. 선박들의 유동량이 많은 편이야.�
entries.translation: Irem is our biggest farming town, plus scholars flock here... So ship traffic pretty heavy.�

entries.source: 선착장을 더 확장하고 인부도 더 늘려야 되는데, 웨이드 가는 이런 변방까지 신경써주지 못하나 보군.�
entries.translation: We need a bigger dock and more hands, but House Wade could not care less about these boonies.�

entries.source: 혁명군이 일어났을 때는 득달같이 달려오더니 말이야..�
entries.translation: Though they sure came running fast enough when the rebels rose up...�

entries.source: 꼭 이렇게 갈궈야 말을 듣는 애들이 있어서 사람을 피곤하게 한다니까. 수고했어.�
entries.translation: Always someone who will not listen unless you lean on them. Such a headache. Good work.�

entries.source: 자네 용병이지? 힘 쓰는 일이 좀 필요한데 도와주지 않겠나?�
entries.translation: You are a mercenary, right? Need some muscle for a job. Care to lend a hand?�

entries.source: 짐을 나르라는 건 아니니까 걱정 말고. 그런 건 잡부들한테 시키면 충분해.�
entries.translation: Not asking you to haul cargo, do not worry. Common laborers can handle that.�

entries.source: 마을 밖에 나가면 있는 농가에 알렉스라는 친구가 살고 있거든?�
entries.translation: There is a farm outside town where a fellow named Alex lives, you see.�

entries.source: 이번 달에 센트럴로 곡물을 보내야 하는데 그 친구가 아직 할당량을 못 채웠어.�
entries.translation: We have to ship grain to Central this month, but he has not met his quota yet.�

entries.source: 틀림없이 어디다가 꿍쳐놓고 있을테니 가서 적당히 구슬려서 뱉어내게 하면 되는데.�
entries.translation: I am sure he is stashing it somewhere. Just go over, talk some sense into him, and get it.�

entries.source: 이렘 주변의 농지는 원래 전부 국유지야. 원래 땅주인들은 반란 때 대부분 잡혀서 처형 당했거든.�
entries.translation: The farmland around Irem is state-owned. The original owners were mostly executed after the revolt.�

entries.source: 반란이 진압되고 주인이 없어진 땅을 국가에 귀속시켰다가 그걸 마을 사람들에게 다시 분양했어.�
entries.translation: Once it was put down, the unclaimed land went to the state, then got leased back to the townsfolk.�

entries.source: 물론 공짜는 아니고, 돈 대신 매년 수확량의 일부를 센트럴로 보낸다는 조건으로 말야.�
entries.translation: Not for free, mind you. In exchange for shipping a cut of their harvest to Central each year.�

entries.source: 여기와 록빌에서 생산되는 곡물이 거의 공화국 전체를 먹여 살리는 셈이니까...�
entries.translation: Grain from here and Rockville practically feeds the entire Republic, after all...�

entries.source: 간단히 말해서 10년 할부!랄까. 소작농이랑 뭐가 다르냐는 녀석도 있지만, 어쨌든 버티면 자기 땅이 되는 거잖아?�
entries.translation: Basically, a ten-year installment plan! Some whine it is just tenant farming, but stick it out and it is yours!�

entries.source: 나야 땅 부쳐먹고 사는 놈이 아니니까 잘 모르겠지만 괜찮은 조건 아냐?�
entries.translation: I am no farmer so what do I know, but sounds like a fair deal to me, does not it?�

entries.source: 근데 그 알렉스라는 놈처럼 꼭 끝까지 곡물 안내고 버티는 놈들이 있어서 골치야.�
entries.translation: Yet guys like Alex hold out on their grain till the bitter end. Real pain in the neck.�

entries.source: 거참. 그런 놈들은 다시 싸그리! 저기 콜크리크 같은 탄광에 보내서 무보수 노동을 시켜봐야 정신을 차리지.�
entries.translation: Sheesh. Ought to ship the lot of em to coal mines like Cole Creek for unpaid labor to teach em.�
Now that is what I like to hear! Counting on you.�

entries.source: 대신, 서둘러야 해. 선적이 늦으면 말짱 황이니까.�
entries.translation: Just hurry. If the shipment late, it is all for nothing.�
Anyway, so what will it be?�

entries.source: 이곳은 공화국 최대 규모의 도서관으로, 인류 지식의 보고입니다.�
entries.translation: This is the Republic largest library, a treasure trove of human knowledge.�

entries.source: 수많은 학자들이 이곳으로 지식을 축적하기 위해 방문하죠.. 저도 마찬가지고요.�
entries.translation: Countless scholars visit to gather knowledge here... Myself included.�

entries.source: 4년 전의 혁명에서 이곳이 불타버리지 않은건, 정말 신의 가호였습니다..�
entries.translation: It was truly divine providence that this place was not burned down during the revolution four years ago...�
When the Descendants return, a new world will unfold...�

entries.source: 신세계가 열리면 지금의 모든 인간의 과거는 부정되죠. 믿음만이 구원을 줍니다.�
entries.translation: In that new world, humanity entire past is voided. Only faith brings salvation.�
Huh? Excuse me, are you alright?�
Do not worry, everything will be fine.�
Hey, what are you meddling in now?�

entries.source: 하지만 이 사람.. 넋이 나간 것 같잖아. 하늘만 보고..�
entries.translation: But this person... seems totally out of it. Just staring at the sky...�

entries.source: 내거 아냐. 그렇게 남의 일 신경쓰지 마.�
entries.translation: None of our business. Stop poking your nose into other people affairs.�

entries.source: 당신들도 기도해야 할 거예요. 언젠가 찾아올 그 날을 위해..�
entries.translation: You too must pray. For that day which will inevitably come...�

entries.source: 미친 건 세상이죠. 웨이드 가가 펼치는 사업들은 자연을 파괴할 뿐- 인간의 힘으로는 더 이상 되돌릴 수 없어요.�
entries.translation: It is the world that is mad. House Wade enterprises only destroy nature- beyond human power to repair.�
Fascinating. So who is going to fix it then?�

entries.source: 곧 내려올 }강림자{들.. 그들이 }신세계{를 열어줄 거 예요.�
entries.translation: The }Descendants{, who shall soon descend... They will usher in a }new world{.�

entries.source: 부디 당신들도.. 우리들의 기도와 함께 하기를 바랍니다.�
entries.translation: I pray that you too... will join us in our prayers.�
More importantly... you look so thin. Should not you eat?�

entries.source: 모든 것은 변할 거예요. 당신들도 신세계를 그린다면.. 이것을 들고 기원의 관에서 가르침을 얻으세요.�
entries.translation: Everything will change. If you envision a new world too... take this and seek guidance at the Hall of Origin.�

entries.source: 지금 세상에서 구할 수 있는 모든 건 의미가 없어요. 그것을 깨달을 수 있으실 거예요.�
entries.translation: Everything you can obtain in this world is meaningless. You will come to realize that.�
A new world? Master Schultz... what is he talking about?�

entries.source: 하지만 웨이드 가의 정책에 반하는 종교단체라.. 조금 흥미가 동하는데.�
entries.translation: Still, a cult opposing House Wade policies... that piques my interest a bit.�
If we just clear this... will we be able to pass?�

entries.source: 이것도 그냥.. 경고용일 뿐인 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Seems this was just meant as a warning too.�
Welcome! We are at your service.�

entries.source: 쉬어가시겠어요? 200 GOLD로 모든 HP를 회복시켜 드립니다.�
entries.translation: Care for a rest? Fully restore all HP for 200 GOLD.�

entries.source: 미안해요, 몸이 안좋아서.. 저는 좀 쉬고 있을게요.�
entries.translation: I am sorry, I am not feeling well... I will rest for a bit.�

entries.source: 이렘이 최북단에 위치했으면서도 농사를 지을 수 있을 정도로 따뜻한 것은 근처를 지나는 난류와...�
entries.translation: Though Irem is in the far north, it is warm enough for farming due to warm ocean currents and...�

entries.source: 알 수 없는 지열이 원인이에요. 화산 지대라는 주장도 있고, 어쩌면 네베드...�
entries.translation: Mysterious geothermal heat. Some argue it is volcanic, or perhaps the Neved...�

entries.source: 여기서 더 북쪽으로 올라가면 <얼어붙은 바다{가 나올 뿐이거든요.�
entries.translation: Go any further north from here and you will only find the <Frozen Sea{.�

entries.source: 실례, 그 종족과 전쟁한 이후로 이 이름은 금기였죠. 선주종이 남긴 마법의 영향이라고도 해요.�
entries.translation: Pardon me. Ever since the war with that race, their name has been taboo. Some say it is magic left by the ancients.�

entries.source: 사실 마법도 꽤 설득력이 있는게, 이 섬이 인류 최초의 정착지거든요.�
entries.translation: The magic theory is quite plausible, since this island was humanity first settlement.�
Are you interested in tales like this?�

entries.source: 다들 그런 반응이에요. 당장 먹고 살기도 힘든데 무슨 상관이냐고.�
entries.translation: Everyone reacts like that. Asking what it matters when making a living is already hard enough.�

entries.source: 그래도 자신이 살고 있는 세계에는 조금 더 관심을 가지는 편이 좋지 않겠어요?�
entries.translation: Still, should not one care a bit more about the world they live in?�

entries.source: 인간들이 스스로 기록하기 시작한 역사는 여기서 시작해요. 그 이전의 역사는 네...�
entries.translation: Humanity written history begins right here. History prior to that comes only from the Ne...�

entries.source: ...선주종의 기록에 나오는 것 뿐이에요. <얼어붙은 바다를 건너 우리와 비슷하게 생긴 생물들이 나타났다{�
entries.translation: ...from the ancients records. <Across the Frozen Sea appeared creatures that resembled us.{�

entries.source: <그래서 우리는 모이투라 평원에 그들이 살 터를 마련해 주었다.{�
entries.translation: <So we provided land for them to live in the Moytura Plains.{�

entries.source: 모이투라, 이렘이라는 선주종의 언어가 지명에 남아 있는 것은 그 탓이에요.�
entries.translation: Names like Moytura and Irem persist in their ancient language because of that.�

entries.source: 예전에 교류가 있을 때는 베쓰무라 같은 곳에 가면 그들의 <수호자{에게 이런 전승을 들을 수 있었는데.�
entries.translation: Back when we interacted, you could hear these tales from their <Guardians{ in places like Bethmura.�

entries.source: 지금은 선주종이 인간에게 살 자리를 마련했다는 말 자체가 날조라고 가르친다니까요.�
entries.translation: Nowadays, people are taught that the idea of ancients giving humans land is a complete fabrication.�

entries.source: 여기 도서관에서도 그런 책들은 다 어디로 치워버렸어요.�
entries.translation: Even here in the library, all such books were removed.�

entries.source: 음? 무슨 일이에요? 제 이야기가 재미 있었나요? 더 듣고 싶어요?�
entries.translation: Hm? What is it? Did you find my story interesting? Want to hear more?�
How much of what I said earlier do you remember?�
Long enmity between humans and ancients�
That was not it... Long ago,�

entries.source: 공화국 성립... 그러니까 웨이드 가에 의한 무력 통일 이전에는 사이가 괜찮았어요.�
entries.translation: before the Republic founding... that is, before House Wade armed unification, relations were decent.�

entries.source: 솔직한 건 미덕이지만... 저도 나름대로 바쁘니까 귀찮게 하지 말아줘요.�
entries.translation: Honesty is a virtue, but... I am rather busy myself, so please do not bother me.�
Oh? You were actually listening, were not you?�

entries.source: 네베드의 기록 대로라면, 인간은 얼어붙은 바다를 건너서 온 거에요.�
entries.translation: According to Neved records, humans crossed the Frozen Sea to get here.�

entries.source: 그리고 실제로 인간들의 기록은 모이투라에서 시작하고요.�
entries.translation: And indeed, human records begin in Moytura.�
But what was it like beyond the Frozen Sea?�

entries.source: 기록된 네베드의 역사가 천년, 그에 비해 인간은 단 삼백년.�
entries.translation: Recorded Neved history spans a millennium, while humanity has barely three hundred years.�

entries.source: 대체 모이투라에 나타나기 전까지는 어디서 뭘 하고 있었을까요?�
entries.translation: Where were we, and what were we doing before we showed up in Moytura?�

entries.source: 저는 그게 궁금해서 일부러 여기까지 왔어요.�
entries.translation: I came all the way here out of curiosity about that.�

entries.source: 그런데 정작 귀중한 책들은 다 사라졌고, 얼어붙은 바다는 몬스터들로 난리라서 가지도 못하고.�
entries.translation: Yet all the precious books are gone, and the Frozen Sea is crawling with monsters, so I cannot even go there.�

entries.source: 아예 얼어붙은 바다에 조사를 가는 거 자체를 교묘하게 막고 있어요�
entries.translation: They are craftily blocking anyone from investigating the Frozen Sea altogether...�

entries.source: 처음에는 인간이 네베드의 도움을 받아서 정착했다는 역사를 조작하려는 건가, 하고 생각했는데...�
