entries.translation: At first, I thought they were trying to fabricate history to say humans settled here with Neved aid, but...�

entries.source: 이렇게까지 끈질기게 막는 것을 보면 뭔가 뒤가 구린 비밀이 숨겨져 있는게 분명해요.�
entries.translation: Given how stubbornly they obstruct this, there must be some shady secret hiding behind it.�

entries.source: 사소한 거라도 좋으니까 증거 하나만이라도 확보할 수 있으면!�
entries.translation: If only I could get my hands on even a scrap of proof, no matter how small!�
...And that is why I am holding out here.�

entries.source: 얼어붙은 바다에서 나오는 거라면 뭐든 모으고 있는데... 아직 성과는 없어요.�
entries.translation: I am collecting anything that comes from the Frozen Sea... though I have nothing to show for it yet.�
If you find anything, please bring it to me.�

entries.source: 현재 크게 인류의 거주지는 보리아 군도, 켈라이노 군도, 베릴 군도의 세 곳이에요.�
entries.translation: Currently, human territory consists mostly of three regions: the Voria, Celaeno, and Beryl Archipelagos.�

entries.source: 지금 당신이 있는 이렘은 보리아 군도에 속하는, 모이투라 섬에 있고 인류의 최북단으로 알려져 있어요.�
entries.translation: The Irem you stand in now is part of Moytura Island in the Voria Archipelago, known as humanity northernmost reach.�

entries.source: 어쩌면 이건 지금까지의 역사서를 모두 고쳐써야 할 정도의 대발견일지도 몰라요...�
entries.translation: Perhaps this could be a major discovery that rewrites every history book to date...�
Did you find this in the Frozen Sea?�

entries.source: 네베드의 것과는 확연히 다른! 어쩌면 이게 고대 인류의 흔적일지도 몰라요!�
entries.translation: It is distinctly different from anything Neved! Could this be a trace of ancient humanity?!�

entries.source: 저한테 주실거죠, 아니 주세요! 사례는 할게요!�
entries.translation: You will give this to me, right? No, please, let me have it! I will reward you!�

entries.source: 테오도어는, 또 북쪽 동굴에 보물 찾기 하러 간것 같구먼.�
entries.translation: Seems Theodore went treasure hunting in the northern cave again.�

entries.source: 요즘들어 독서나 연구에 너무 소홀한 것 같기도 헌데..�
entries.translation: Lately, he seems far too neglectful of his reading and studies...�

entries.source: 혹시, 테오도어라는 학자가 이곳에서 일을 하나?�
entries.translation: Does a scholar named Theodore work here?�
Theodore? Why do you ask about him?�

entries.source: 흠.. 용병들이 굳이 그 녀석과 볼일이 있을 게 없을텐데.�
entries.translation: Hmm... I cannot fathom what business mercenaries would have with him.�

entries.source: 이곳에서 일을 하긴 하지. 다만 자기 연구에 좀 빠져드는 스타일이라..�
entries.translation: He does work here, yes. But he tends to get completely lost in his own research...�
He does not seem to be here right now.�

entries.source: }선주종의 유적{을 찾는다고 자리를 비우는 일이 많다네.�
entries.translation: He is often away searching for }Precursor Ruins{.�

entries.source: 만나보고 싶으면 모이투라 평야 }북쪽의 동굴{로 가보시게. 요즘은 그 부근으로 자주 나간다고 하니까..�
entries.translation: If you wish to see him, check the }Northern Cave{ on Moytura Plains. He has been heading out that way often lately...�

entries.source: 그 녀석은 선주종의 마법이나 그 기원에 대해 연구하는 데 푹 빠져있거든.�
entries.translation: That lad is utterly obsessed with researching Precursor magic and its origins.�
I heard he suddenly appeared a year ago.�

entries.source: 뭐야, 테오도어에 대해 아는 것도 없는 게야?�
entries.translation: What, do you know nothing about Theodore?�
Only rumors. That he is a genius scholar.�

entries.source: 그래.. 그 녀석은 천재지. 학교도, 학원도 다닌 기록이 없는데 갑자기 나타나 웨이드 가에서도 놀랄만한 논문을 냈거든.�
entries.translation: Indeed... He is a prodigy. With no record of attending any academy, he suddenly showed up and published papers that stunned even House Wade.�

entries.source: 막상 만나보면 그냥 평범한 청년인데 말일세.. 허헛.�
entries.translation: Though when you meet him, he is just an ordinary young man... Heh.�

entries.source: 근대사에 대해 다룬 책들은 대부분 구석지에 숨겨져 있어.�
entries.translation: Most books concerning modern history are tucked away in dark corners.�

entries.source: 과거에 웨이드 가, 베인 가, 리드마이어 가, 에네스트 가 네개의 가문이 각 섬을 지배할 때에 대한 글들 말이야.�
entries.translation: Texts about the past when the four houses--Wade, Bane, Readmire, and Ernest--each ruled their own islands.�

entries.source: 아무래도 지금은, 웨이드 가에게 거슬리는 책들이겠지.�
entries.translation: I suppose nowadays, those books are an eyesore to House Wade.�

entries.source: 나는 이 도서관에서 일한지 7년째야. 그 4년전의 혁명이 일어날 때도 도서관을 지켰지.�
entries.translation: I have worked in this library for seven years. I guarded it even during the revolution four years ago.�

entries.source: 온 섬이 불타는 데도, 웨이드 가에서 이 도서관만큼은 지켜주었어. 감사한 일이지.�
entries.translation: Even as the entire island burned, House Wade spared this library. I am grateful for that.�

entries.source: 불과 십수년 전까지만 해도 인간 사회엔 노예제도가 있었어.�
entries.translation: Only a little over a decade ago, slavery still existed in human society.�

entries.source: 아직도 가슴에 }노예의 낙인{이 찍힌 채로 살아가는 사람들이 있지..�
entries.translation: There are still people living with the }Brand of Slavery{ burned into their chests...�

entries.source: 그런 것들도, 다 인간이 떠안고 가야할 역사인 게야.�
entries.translation: Even such things are part of the history humanity must bear.�
A mercenary, tsk tsk... You look so young, too.�

entries.source: 5년전의 성지전쟁은 인류 최악의 실수였어. 이렇게 많은 피해자들을 낳다니..�
entries.translation: The Sanctuary War five years ago was humanity gravest mistake. To leave behind so many victims...�

entries.source: 아직 어리니 늦지 않았어. 지금이라도 학자의 길을 걸어보는 건 어때?�
entries.translation: You are still young, it is not too late. Why not pursue the path of a scholar instead?�

entries.source: 항상 싸움만 한다고 해서 지식의 축적을 게을리 해선 안돼.�
entries.translation: Just because you fight all the time does not mean you can slack on your studies.�

entries.source: 용병들에게 있어서, 야생동물이나 각 지역의 특성 같은 것은 필수적인 지식이니까.�
entries.translation: For mercenaries, knowledge of wild beasts and regional traits is essential.�

entries.source: 오, 제대로 구해왔군. 직접 본 기분이 어때? 기분 나쁘지 않나?�
entries.translation: Oh, you brought them! How did it feel seeing them up close? Pretty creepy, huh?�

entries.source: 사실 몬스터 중에서 제일 알 수 없는 것은 언데드야.�
entries.translation: Undead really are the most mysterious of all monsters.�

entries.source: 대체 어떤 힘이 시체들을 움직이게 하는 건지 모르겠단 말이야.�
entries.translation: I just cannot fathom what power makes dead bodies move like that.�

entries.source: 선주종들이 사용하는 마법에도 그런 것은 없다고 알고 있거든.�
entries.translation: As far as I know, even the magic of the Ancients had nothing like that.�

entries.source: 요즘 <북의 동굴{에 움직이는 해골들이 나타났다는 소식을 듣고 있는데, 표본을 좀 구해오지 않겠나?�
entries.translation: I heard moving skeletons appeared in the <Northern Cave{ lately. Would you fetch some samples?�

entries.source: 책을 읽는데는 어디서 읽느냐보다 어떻게, 무엇을 읽느냐가 중요하지.�
entries.translation: When reading a book, how and what you read matters far more than where.�

entries.source: 도서관이 좀 복잡해서, 난 대체로 책을 빌려읽는 편이야.�
entries.translation: The library is rather crowded, so I usually borrow books to read.�

entries.source: 당신의 모험이 얼마나 많은 것을 보고 얻었는지, 확인해 보세요.�
entries.translation: Check out how much you have seen and earned on your adventures.�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬 최고의 상회, 이렘 상회에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 필요한 모든 것을 제공해 드릴게요.�
entries.translation: Welcome to the Irem Merchant Guild, the finest in Moytura! We have all you need.�

entries.source: 얼마나 강해졌는가? 강해지면 질수록, 더 강해지기 위해 더 많은 노력을 필요로 하지.�
entries.translation: How strong have you become? The stronger you get, the more effort it takes to grow further.�

entries.source: 후후, 오늘도 세 개나 깨먹었군. 하지만 괜찮아, 자네의 것은 튼실해 보이니까..�
entries.translation: Heh, broke three of them today. But it is fine, yours look quite sturdy...�

entries.source: 후우.. 좋아, 일단 빠져나온 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Whew... Good, looks like we made it out for now.�
Will outside the village... be okay?�

entries.source: 조심해야지. 저 놈들도 저렇게 허술하게 마을을 봉쇄할 수 있을거라곤 생각하지 않을테니.�
entries.translation: Stay alert. They will not expect to hold down the town with such a loose perimeter.�

entries.source: 밖에도 이미 놈들이 수색을 펼치고 있을지 몰라. 주의해서 }북쪽 동굴{로 가자.�
entries.translation: They might already be searching out here. Let us proceed carefully to the }Northern Cave{.�
What about Eileen? Are not we bringing her?�

entries.source: 좀 더 쉬게 둬. 몰려다녀서 좋을 것 없다.�
entries.translation: Let her rest. Moving in a crowd will only draw attention.�

entries.source: 준비는 충분히 해 왔지? 아니면 지금이라도 좀 더 장비를 챙기고.�
entries.translation: Prepared enough? If not, you can still grab some more gear now.�

entries.source: 세이브를 할 수 없는 지역으로 진행합니다.�
entries.translation: Proceeding to an area where you cannot save.�
Alright, time to pull out! See you in <Levan{!�
Not quite as tough as your reputation suggests, are you?�
Urgh... You brat... Your luck ends here...!�
T-Telepathy? It is not getting through?!�
Telepathy? What kind of trick is this?�

entries.source: 티르의 말만 듣고 널 신뢰할 순 없어.�
entries.translation: I cannot trust you based on Tyr words alone.�

entries.source: 어이.. 공격 당한 쪽 입장은 생각 안하는 거냐!�
entries.translation: Hey... Ever consider how the person being attacked feels?!�

entries.source: 미안, 하지만 알고 있잖아? 계승자라는 게 그렇게 만만한 자리가 아니라는 걸.�
entries.translation: Sorry, but you know, right? Being a Successor is no walk in the park.�

entries.source: 하지만 몇번이나 빈틈을 보여줬는데, 살기가 전혀 느껴지지 않았어. 여유일까나..?�
entries.translation: I showed openings several times, but felt zero bloodlust from you. Total confidence, maybe...?�
Are you... Theodore? Did not expect a woman.�

entries.source: 하하핫, 설마! 아냐, 아냐. 난 }에블린{이라고 해.�
entries.translation: Hahaha, no way! Not at all. I am }Evelyn{.�

entries.source: 아니.. 너는 분명히 정령의 힘을 썼어. 이제와서 숨길 생각은 말라고.�
entries.translation: No... You definitely used spirit power. Do not bother hiding it now.�

entries.source: 자기 생각에 확신이 있는 것도 좋지만, 남의 말을 좀 더 믿을 필요가 있겠네.�
entries.translation: It is fine to be sure of yourself, but you really should listen to others more.�

entries.source: 계승자가 한 명 더, 있을 거라는 생각은 안해본거지?�
entries.translation: Never crossed your mind that there might be another Successor, did it?�

entries.source: 테오도어도 곧 올거야. 그는 또 다른 한명을 데리러 갔거든.�
entries.translation: Theodore will be here soon. He went to get one more person.�

entries.source: 이 아이가 네 정령이야? 맙소사, 이럴 수도 있구나?�
entries.translation: Is this child your Spirit? Good grief, something like this is possible?�
What is her name? She is like a total doll!�
Uh... um... Schultz? What is going on?�
I am Schultz... and this is my Spirit, Ren.�

entries.source: 계승자와 정령이 커플이라니, 이런 건 상상도 못했어!�
entries.translation: A Successor and Spirit couple? I never imagined such a thing!�

entries.source: 어이.. 다짜고짜 덤벼들었으면 웃고 떠들기전에 뭔가 해명해야 되는 거 아냐?�
entries.translation: Hey... Before you start giggling and chatting after ambushing us, should not you explain yourselves?�

entries.source: 실체를 가진 정령이라.. 이것 또 연구 대상인걸.�
entries.translation: A Spirit with a physical form... This calls for research.�

entries.source: 아일린 언니, 몸이 안 좋아 보이는데..�
entries.translation: Eileen, you do not look well...�

entries.source: 괜.. 찮아, 렌.. 테오도어가 만들어준 약을 먹어서.. 한결 나아졌어..�
entries.translation: I am... fine, Ren... Theodore gave me some medicine... so I feel a bit better...�

entries.source: 그냥 안정제에 불과해. 일단은 안전한 곳에 가서 충분한 휴식을 취해야 할 것 같아.�
entries.translation: It is just a tranquilizer. First, we must take her somewhere safe so she can get plenty of rest.�
So, who is going to explain?�

entries.source: 티르에게서 계승자가 이렘으로 오고 있다는 걸 들었어.�
entries.translation: We heard from Tyr that a Successor was coming to Irem.�

entries.source: 그래서 어느정도 지켜본 뒤에.. 싸울 생각이 없다고 생각되면 접촉할 예정이었지.�
entries.translation: So we planned to watch for a bit... and make contact once we confirmed you had no intent to fight.�

entries.source: 이렇게 빨리 여기까지 도달할 줄은 몰랐어. 흑의병도 있고 해서, 좀 과격하게 시험했던 것은 이해해 줘.�
entries.translation: We did not expect you to get here this fast. With the Black Guard around, please understand why we tested you so roughly.�

entries.source: 미안하지만.. 예전에 루퍼스라는 미친 놈을 만났었거든.�
entries.translation: Sorry about that... but we ran into a madman named Rufus before.�

entries.source: 게다가 최근에는.. 계승자 한명의 죽음을 느끼기도 했고.�
entries.translation: Besides, recently... we felt the death of a Successor.�

entries.source: 그래. 그 미친 놈은 정령의 힘이 강해졌다고 좋아하더군.�
entries.translation: Yeah. That lunatic was thrilled that his Spirit power grew stronger.�

entries.source: 그럼 이해해주겠군. 다른 계승자를 조심할 수 밖에 없다는 걸.�
entries.translation: Then you will understand. We have no choice but to be wary of other Successors.�

entries.source: 내가 하려던 시험을 당하는 입장이 되니 짜증이 좀 날 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: It is just annoying to be put through the test I was planning to give.�
Heheh, such a cute complaint, is not it?�

entries.source: 그럼 일단.. 여기있는 네명의 계승자는 싸울 의지가 없는 것을 확인했으니..�
entries.translation: Now then... Since we have confirmed the four Successors here have no desire to fight...�

entries.source: 안전한 곳으로 가야겠지? 아일린의 상태가 악화되기 전에..�
entries.translation: Should not we head to a safe place? Before Eileen condition gets worse...�

entries.source: 잠깐, 안전한 곳이라니.. 우리에게 무작정 믿고 따라오라는 건가?�
entries.translation: Wait, a safe place... You expect us to just follow you blindly?�

entries.source: 너희의 시험은 끝났을 지 몰라도, 우린 아직 너희에 대해 아무것도 몰라.�
entries.translation: Your test may be over, but we still know nothing about you.�
Then allow me to make a formal introduction.�

entries.source: 나는 }테오도어{.. 너와 같은 계승자이자, 혁명군 }레반{의 일원이다.�
entries.translation: I am }Theodore{... A Successor like you, and a member of the rebel army, }Levan{.�

entries.source: 나는 }에블린{.. 너와 같은 계승자이자, 혁명군 }레반{의 일원이다.�
entries.translation: I am }Evelyn{... A Successor like you, and a member of the rebel army, }Levan{.�
Did not that sound just like him?�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬의 반란군은.. 4년전에 이미 전멸했다고 알고 있는데..�
entries.translation: I thought the rebels on Moytura Island were wiped out four years ago...�

entries.source: 사실 패잔병 수준이긴 해... 그 때 워낙 대실패 했거든.�
entries.translation: Honestly, we are just remnants... We suffered a total defeat back then.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 살아남은 사람들은 북쪽의 실버힐 섬에 은신하면서, 여전히 궐기할 때를 기다리고 있어.�
entries.translation: However... The survivors are hiding out on Silver Hill to the north, still waiting for the time to rise.�
Oho...? Ren, are you close with Tyr...?�

entries.source: 아.. 딱히 그런 건 아닌데.. 왠지 친숙해서..�
entries.translation: Ah... Not particularly, but... he just felt familiar...�

entries.source: 티르는 정식 멤버가 아니야. 하지만 여러모로 많은 도움을 받고 있다.�
entries.translation: Tyr is not an official member. But he has helped us in many ways.�

entries.source: 무엇보다.. 웨이드 가와 듣는 자들을 무너트린다는 공동의 목표가 있으니까.�
entries.translation: Above all... we share the common goal of bringing down House Wade and the Listeners.�
Is not that why you came looking for us as well?�

entries.source: 말만으로는 믿지 못하는 게 당연하지만, 지금은 함께 가 줘.�
entries.translation: It is only natural not to trust mere words, but please come with us for now.�
For starters, it is freezing here, and Irem is crawling with Black Guards.�

entries.source: 모이투라에는 기원의 관인가 하는 쓰레기 집단만 남은 줄 알았는데..�
entries.translation: I thought Moytura only had trash like the Hall of Dogma left...�

entries.source: 아직도 세력을 키워가고 있나보네. 도대체 거기에 넘어가는 사람들이 불쌍해..�
entries.translation: I see they are still expanding. I feel sorry for anyone who falls for that...�
Why feel sorry for fools who fall for it?�

entries.source: 하지만 뻔하잖아? 먹고 살기 힘든 사람들 등쳐먹는 집단이라구, 거기.�
entries.translation: It is obvious, is not it? They prey on desperate people struggling to survive.�

entries.source: 열심히 살 생각이 박힌 놈이면 넘어가지도 않아. 그냥 지금 사는 삶을 부정하고 싶은 놈들이나 넘어가는 거지.�
entries.translation: Anyone trying to live an honest life would not fall for it. It is just people looking for an easy escape from reality.�

entries.source: 제대로 살려면 자기 손으로 바꿀 수 있는 것부터 생각해야지, 기다리긴 뭘 기다려?�
entries.translation: If you want a better life, change what you can with your own hands. What are they waiting for?�
I really like what you just said!�

entries.source: 생각보다 훨씬 어른스럽고 멋있네, 좋은 계승자를 만나서 기쁘겠어!�
entries.translation: Far more mature and cool than I thought. You must be glad to have such a great Successor!�

entries.source: 아.. 하하하.. 그래도 내 계승자라고.. 칭찬받으니 기쁘긴 한데...�
entries.translation: Ah... Haha... Well, he is my Successor... It is nice to hear, but...�

entries.source: 서둘러서 움직이자. 아일린씨의 상태가 많이 안좋아.�
entries.translation: Let us move quickly. Eileen condition is looking bad.�

entries.source: 보통 병은 아닌 것 같아. 정령과도 관련이 있는 것 같은데, 조금 더 지켜봐야 해.�
entries.translation: It does not seem like an ordinary illness. Might be related to the Spirit, but we need to watch closely.�

entries.source: 우릴 쉽게 믿을 순 없겠지만.. 일단 레반에 가보면 생각이 바뀔거야.�
entries.translation: I know it is hard to trust us right away... but come to Levan, and you will see.�
Let us talk more once we are there.�

entries.source: 좋아.. 가주지. 보여줘 봐, 혁명군이라는 걸.�
entries.translation: Fine... I will come. Show me what this rebel army is all about.�

entries.source: 난 조금만 더 지켜보고 갈게. 아까 그 흑의병들이.. 아무래도 불안해.�
entries.translation: I will stay and watch a bit longer. Those Black Guard earlier... something feels off.�

entries.source: 반나절만 더 지켜보고 갈테니까, 그때까지 딱딱한 얘기들은 다 끝내놓아야 해?�
entries.translation: I will watch for half a day, so wrap up all the serious talk by then, okay?�

entries.source: 노력해볼게. 슈우 녀석이 깐깐해서 좀 힘들 것 같지만.�
entries.translation: I will try. Though Shu pretty stubborn, so it will not be easy.�
Creepy bastards... Not a single word between them.�
Further in... I sense a }Successor{ inside.�
But... what about those Black Guard?�

entries.source: 글쎄.. 잘 하면, 다른 계승자가 어떤 사람인지 확인해 볼 기회가 될 수도 있어.�
entries.translation: Well... if we play this right, it is a chance to see what this other Successor is made of.�

entries.source: 놈들이 계승자를 찾는 건지 티르를 찾는 건지는 모르겠지만.. 우리에겐 도움이 되겠군.�
entries.translation: Do not know if they are after the Successor or Tyr, but it works to our advantage.�
A dock...? Inside a cave like this?�
A dead end... Did we lose them?�

entries.source: 미안하지만 틀렸어. 우리가 운이 좋은 것 뿐이지.�
entries.translation: Sorry, but you are wrong. We just got lucky.�

entries.source: 티르가 반군에 합류하는 것을 막기 위해 왔는데, 놓쳤던 계승자와 다시 만나다니.�
entries.translation: We came to stop Tyr from joining the rebels, but running into the Successor who slipped away is a bonus.�

entries.source: 그 남자를 티르라고 부르는군. 게다가.. 반군이라는 게 있다고?�
entries.translation: So that man is named Tyr. And... there is a rebel army?�

entries.source: 미안하지만.. 그 재수없는 눈빛 교환 좀 그만하고, 말로 하지 그래?�
entries.translation: Sorry to interrupt, but could you stop that creepy eye contact and talk?�

entries.source: 내가 말이 너무 많았군. 계승자를 확보하겠다.�
entries.translation: I have talked too much. Securing the Successor.�

entries.source: 안 빠져나가. 두 놈 정도면.. 싸워볼만 할거야.�
entries.translation: We do not. Against just two... we stand a chance.�

entries.source: 티르라는 남자, 반군의 존재, 그리고 계승자를 쫓는 이유.. 전부 여기서 들어야 겠어.�
entries.translation: This man named Tyr, the rebels, and why you hunt Successors... You are telling me everything right now.�
Alfred let you go once, and now you think you are invincible.�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: 난 좀 더 이곳의 상황을 지켜보다가 갈게. 아까 그 흑의병들이 마음에 걸려.�
entries.translation: I will keep watch here a bit longer. Those Black Guard are bothering me.�

entries.source: 교단의 신자가 아니면, 교리의 관에 입장하실 수 없습니다.�
entries.translation: Only believers of the Order may enter the Hall of Dogma.�

entries.source: 교리의 관은 강림자의 교단, 그 중추입니다.�
entries.translation: The Hall of Dogma is the core of the Order of Descendants.�
Is this the Hall of Dogma? The ones waiting for the Descendant?�
Yes, that is right. Have you come seeking faith?�

entries.source: 믿음이라기 보다.. 듣고 싶어서. 애타게 기다리는 강림자라는 것이 뭔지.�
entries.translation: Not faith, really... I came to hear. What is this Descendant you are all waiting for?�
I am not too thrilled with this world right now either.�
Haha, I see. That is how most people start.�

entries.source: 하지만 강림자의 율법들을 듣고 나면, 새로운 세계에 대한 설레임으로 다시 삶이 기쁨으로 가득찰 겁니다.�
entries.translation: Once you hear the laws of the Descendant, anticipation of the new world will fill your life with joy again.�

entries.source: ... 밥도 안먹고 강림자란 걸 기다리는 게, 행복해진다는 건가?�
entries.translation: ...Starving yourself while waiting for some Descendant makes you happy?�
After all, this world is a }world to be discarded{.�

entries.source: 이 세계에서 내가 가진 모습, 당신이 가진 모습, 지금 느끼는 모든 감정은 부질없는 것이지요.�
entries.translation: How I look, how you look, every feeling we have in this world... it is all meaningless.�
Is this nonsense based on anything?�

entries.source: 말로는 설명드릴 수 없어요. 하지만 약속 드리죠.�
entries.translation: Words cannot explain it. But I can make you a promise.�

entries.source: 교리의 관에 들어오셔서 일주일만 함께 하시면, 강림자의 강림을 기다리시게 될 겁니다.�
entries.translation: Come to the Hall of Dogma for just one week, and you too will await the Descendant arrival.�

entries.source: 강림자라는 것이 오면, 이 세계의 모든 것이 버려지고 새 세계가 열린다구요?�
entries.translation: So when the Descendant comes, everything in this world will be thrown away, and a new one begins?�

entries.source: 그건.. 우리가 뭔가 다른 존재가 된다는 소리인가요?�
entries.translation: Does that mean... we will become something different?�

entries.source: 그렇죠. 이 세계는 인간의 힘으로 바꿀 수 있는 것이 아닙니다.�
entries.translation: Indeed. Human strength alone cannot change this world.�

entries.source: 인간 자체가 다른 존재가 되지 않으면..�
entries.translation: Unless humanity itself becomes something else...�

entries.source: 버려질 세계라고 하는 것 치곤, 건물을 꽤 호화롭게 지었군 그래.�
entries.translation: For a world meant to be discarded, you built quite a luxurious place here.�

entries.source: 강림자를 기다리는 우리들의 마음이죠. 아가씨는 관심이 있는 것 같습니다만?�
entries.translation: It reflects our devotion while awaiting the Descendant. It seems the young lady is interested?�

entries.source: 미안하지만 마음을 표현할 만큼의 돈이 없어, 그 녀석은. 나는 마음을 표현할 생각이 없고.�
entries.translation: Sorry, but she has no money to express devotion. And I have no intention of expressing any.�
Snow... but it is not cold...�

entries.source: 이건.. 말도 안돼. 얼어붙은 바다에 이런 기후가 있을리가..�
entries.translation: This... makes no sense. The Frozen Sea could never have a climate like this...�
And we have been heading straight north this whole time...�

entries.source: 뭔가 커다란 마법력에 의해 마을 전체가 보호되고 있는 것 같아.�
entries.translation: It feels like some immense magic power is shielding the entire village.�

entries.source: 아마 그.. 두 명의 계승자와 관계가 있는 게 아닐까?�
entries.translation: Could it have something to do with... the two Successors?�

entries.source: 테오도어.. 아니면 에블린이 가장 원했던 것이, 이것일지도 몰라.�
entries.translation: Maybe this was what Theodore... or Evelyn wanted most of all.�
Ah... a village that is not cold?�
Well... we will find out once we meet Theodore.�

entries.source: 이건 사람의 짓이 아니잖아.. 이 정도의 상처를 줄 수 있는 야수가 이 근처에 있나?�
entries.translation: This was not done by a human... Is there a beast around here that can inflict wounds like this?�

entries.source: 그런 건 몇 년동안 이곳에 살았지만 본 적이 없어..�
entries.translation: I have lived here for years, but I have never seen such a thing...�

entries.source: 나도.. 무슨 일인지 모르겠어. 어째서 이런 일이..�
entries.translation: I... do not know what happened either. Why would this...�

entries.source: 하지만 마을에서 아일린이 사라진 것만은 확실해.�
entries.translation: One thing is certain: Eileen has disappeared from the village.�

entries.source: 나에게는 마을을 지키라고 하고선.. 흔적을 따라 }동쪽{으로 갔어.. 혼자..�
entries.translation: He told me to protect the village... and followed the trail }east{... alone...�
I have a bad feeling about this. I need to go too!�

entries.source: 테오도어 말이 맞아. 당신은 마을을 지켜, 내가 갈테니.�
entries.translation: Theodore was right. You guard the village I will go.�

entries.source: 하지만 테오는 전투능력이 부족하단 말이야, 혼자서는..�
entries.translation: But Theo is not much of a fighter, not on his own...�

entries.source: 내 말 들어! 테오도어든 아일린이든, 다른 계승자를 찾는 거라면 내가 가장 빠르다!�
entries.translation: Listen to me! Whether it is Theodore or Eileen, I am the fastest at tracking another Successor!�

entries.source: 그리고 이놈이 뭘 노리는지 모르는 이상.. 돌아오는 것도 염두에 두어야해!�
entries.translation: Besides, without knowing what this thing wants... we must consider the chance it doubles back!�

entries.source: 동쪽으로.. 계승자 한 명이 멀어지고 있어.�
entries.translation: To the east... One Successor is moving away.�
We will catch up. Let us go.�

entries.source: 바깥 세상에는 훨씬 더 따뜻한 섬들이 있대. 나는 기억도 안나지만..�
entries.translation: They say there are much warmer islands out in the world. Though I do not even remember...�

entries.source: 난 이 정도로도 충분히 행복해. 이제 나와서 놀 수 있잖아?�
entries.translation: I am happy enough with this. I can finally come outside and play, right?�

entries.source: 테오는 괴물의 흔적을 따라 }동쪽{으로 갔어. 마을은 내가 지킬테니.. 어서 가봐.�
entries.translation: Theo headed }east{ following the monster tracks. I will protect the village... Hurry!�

entries.source: 도대체 아일린에게 무슨 일이 생긴건지.. 어쩌면 테오도 위험할 지 몰라.�
entries.translation: What on earth happened to Eileen... Theo might be in danger too.�
Yeah... The alarm system was frozen solid.�

entries.source: 역시! 내가 뭔가 기분이 이상했다니깐? 안가봤으면 큰일날 뻔 했지?�
entries.translation: I knew it! I had a bad feeling about it! Good thing someone went to check, right?�
So, did you replace the circuit?�

entries.source: 후후, 고마워. 가끔은 이렇게 도움을 받는 것도 괜찮네.�
entries.translation: Hehe, thanks. It feels nice getting some help once in a while.�

entries.source: 사례는 적당히, 이 정도면 만족하려나? 깐깐한 용병님.�
entries.translation: As for the reward, is this enough to satisfy you, Mr. Picky Mercenary?�
It is plenty. It was not hard work anyway.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 반군이라기엔 마을 분위기가 무척이나 쳐져있군.�
entries.translation: Still... for a rebel camp, the village atmosphere is awfully sluggish.�

entries.source: 음.. 뭐랄까 지난 1년간은, 사냥을 빼고는 싸울 일이 없었으니까.�
entries.translation: Well... for the past year, we have not had to fight, aside from hunting.�

entries.source: .. 당신이 계승자가 될 때, 저 작은 태양을 만든 거로군.�
entries.translation: ...When you became a Successor, you created that miniature sun.�

entries.source: 그래. 내가 원한건 평화로운 마을, 평범한 삶.. 뭐 그런 거였거든.�
entries.translation: Yeah. All I wanted was a peaceful village, a normal life... that kind of thing.�

entries.source: 다들 전투는 베테랑이니 걱정하지마. 다들 오랜만의 평화에 좀 취해있는 거야.�
entries.translation: Do not worry, everyone is a battle veteran. They are just a little drunk on peace.�

entries.source: 평화에 취하지 않은건.. 당신과 테오도어 뿐인가.�
entries.translation: And the only ones not drunk on it... are you and Theodore.�

entries.source: 평화를 즐기는 게 나쁜건 아니잖아? 나도, 이 힘만 없었다면, 홀랑 평화에 취해서 놀고 있을걸.�
entries.translation: Nothing wrong with enjoying peace, right? If not for this power, I would be slacking off too.�

entries.source: 모두들.. 오랫동안 싸워왔으니까, 지금은 쉬어도 좋다고 생각해.�
entries.translation: Everyone... fought for so long. I think they deserve a rest now.�

entries.source: 언젠가.. 다시 싸워야 될 때가 온다는 건.. 다들 알고 있을거야..�
entries.translation: I am sure they all know... the time will come when we have to fight again...�

entries.source: 슈우 덕분에, 오늘은 나도 좀 편하게 쉴 수 있겠어. 고마워.�
entries.translation: Thanks to you, Schu, I can finally get some rest today. Thank you.�
Evelyn... is such an amazing person.�
Where are you going in the middle of the night?�

entries.source: 아.. 슈우. 쉼터는 마을 북쪽이라니까, 방향치야?�
entries.translation: Ah... Schu. The shelter is north of the village. Are you directionally challenged?�

entries.source: 난 흑의병들이 코앞까지 와있으니 아무래도 불안해서, 얼음굴의 경비장치를 좀 점검해보려고.�
entries.translation: With the Black Guard right at our doorstep, I want to check the Ice Cavern alarms.�
Diligent... All to protect the village.�

entries.source: .. 이 마을의 평화가 내게는 가장 큰 소원이니까.�
entries.translation: ...Peace in this village is my greatest wish, after all.�

entries.source: 경계장치는 얼음굴의 선착장에 있어. 강화장치만 부착하면 돼.�
entries.translation: The alarm is at the dock in the Ice Cavern. Just attach the booster unit.�
Be careful, it gets much colder at night...�
It is for the village safety... It has to be done.�
What are you talking about? I am full of energy!�

entries.source: 아까 나와 싸울때.. 부상을 입지 않았나?�
entries.translation: Were not you injured... when you fought me earlier?�

entries.source: 후후, 그냥 긁힌 정도야. 그다지 어려운 일도 아닌데, 금방 끝내고 쉬지 뭐.�
entries.translation: Heh, just a scratch. It is not a tough job anyway, I will wrap it up and rest soon.�

entries.source: 난 용병이니까.. 생각을 정리하려면 부지런히 일을 하는 게 좋거든.�
entries.translation: I am a mercenary... Working hard helps clear my head.�
Wait... what? Do you want payment?�

entries.source: 부상입은 채로 나가는 것 보단 나을걸.�
entries.translation: Better than heading out there injured.�

entries.source: 언니.. 먼저 해주겠다는 말이 나온 것 부터가 말이 안되는 상황이예요..�
entries.translation: Evelyn... him offering to help first is absurd enough as it is...�
Never mind that, just hand it over.�

entries.source: 이런일은 종류별로 다 해봤으니 걱정하지마. 경계장치는 어디에 있지?�
entries.translation: I have done all kinds of jobs like this, so do not worry. Where is the alarm?�

entries.source: 경계장치는 }얼음굴의 선착장{에 있어. 제대로 동작을 안하면.. 회로만 교체해 줘.�
entries.translation: The alert device is at the }Ice Cavern Pier{. If it does not work... just replace the circuit.�

entries.source: 정말 기적이라고 밖에 할 수 없는 빛이에요. 네베드들의 기술인 걸까요?�
entries.translation: This light is nothing short of a miracle. Could it be Neved technology?�

entries.source: 뜨겁거나 한 것도 아니고, 순수하게 마법력으로만 마을 전체를 추위로부터 보호해주고 있답니다.�
entries.translation: It is not scorching hot it protects the whole village from the cold purely through magic power.�

entries.source: 이 }기적의 불꽃{이 없었다면, 몇년 안 가 우리는 모두 얼어죽었을지도 몰라요.�
entries.translation: Without this }Miracle Flame{, we all might have frozen to death within a few years.�

entries.source: 혁명에 실패해 힘든 삶을 살게 되었지만.. 우리는 올바른 선택을 했었다고 생각해.�
entries.translation: The revolution failed and life became hard... but I still think we made the right choice.�

entries.source: 의회는 아직도 선주종들의 땅을 포기하지 못했고, 결국은 전쟁을 부를테니까..�
entries.translation: The Council still has not given up on the natives land, which will inevitably lead to war...�

entries.source: 무슨 일일까, 기적의 빛이 온 뒤로 1년 간은 마을에서 사상자가 나온 적이 없는데..�
entries.translation: What could have happened? In the year since the miracle light appeared, there were no casualties in the village...�

entries.source: 테오에게 이야기 들었다. 요즘은 새로운 얼굴이 드물었는데..�
entries.translation: Theo told me about you. It has been a while since we have seen a new face...�
Levan is warm and safe. Make yourself at home and look around.�

entries.source: 이 상처는.. 인간의 무기로 인한 상처가 아니야.�
entries.translation: These wounds... were not caused by human weapons.�

entries.source: 이 정도면, 다른 섬의 평범한 겨울 날씨잖아?�
entries.translation: At this rate, it is just like a normal winter day on any other island, is not it?�

entries.source: 사실.. 지난 1년간은 우리가 도망자들이라는 것조차 잊고 살 정도였어.�
entries.translation: Honestly... for the past year, we almost forgot we were fugitives.�

entries.source: 뭔가가 마을을 습격했던 것 같아. 하지만 밤새 조용했었는데..�
entries.translation: It seems something attacked the village. But it was so quiet all night...�

entries.source: 나는 죽을때까지 이런 느긋함이 다시 찾아오지 않을 줄 알았어.�
entries.translation: I thought I would never experience such peace again until the day I died.�

entries.source: 살아남는 게 기적이라고 느껴질 정도로 힘겨운 몇 년이었다..�
entries.translation: It has been a rough few years, to the point where just surviving felt like a miracle...�

entries.source: 지난 1년간.. }기적의 불꽃{이 가져다준 평화를 다들 만끽하긴 했지만..�
entries.translation: Over the past year... everyone enjoyed the peace brought by the }Miracle Flame{, but...�

entries.source: 언젠가 다시 싸울 날이 오겠지. 다들 그것만큼은 알고 있어.�
entries.translation: The day will come when we have to fight again. Everyone knows at least that much.�

entries.source: 말도 안돼.. 어젯밤에 습격이라던가 하는 게 있었으면 내가 못들었을리가 없는데..�
entries.translation: No way... If there had been an attack last night, there is no way I would not have heard it...�
Is this really that bear? Incredible...�

entries.source: 가난한 마을이라서 뭐 달리 줄게 없네. 그건 내가 쓰던 장신구인데 너한테 빌려주마.�
entries.translation: It is a poor village, so I do not have much to give. Here is an accessory I used to wear. I will lend it to you.�

entries.source: 왠지 너한테 필요할 것 같다. 에블린이나 테오를 도와줘.�
entries.translation: Somehow I think you will need it. Please help Evelyn and Theo.�

entries.source: 왠지 모르지만 동물도 그렇고 몬스터들도 저 불꽃을 무서워 하더라고.�
entries.translation: I do not know why, but both beasts and monsters seem terrified of that flame.�

entries.source: 마을 근처에 오는 일은 한 번도 없거든.�
entries.translation: They never come anywhere near the village.�

entries.source: 가끔 무서울 때도 있긴 있어. 밤에 혼자서 저걸 쳐다보고 있으면 마치 나한테 말을 거는 것 같은 기분이 들어.�
entries.translation: Sometimes it does feel creepy, though. Staring at it alone at night makes me feel like it is talking to me.�
...Well, it is probably just my imagination, right?�

entries.source: 전에 마을 밖을 순찰 돌다가 커다란 흰 곰을 봤어.�
entries.translation: I saw a huge white bear while patrolling outside the village earlier.�

entries.source: 이 근방에서는 드문 일인데... 좀 긴장했는데 다행히 마을 근처까지는 안 오더라고.�
entries.translation: It is rare in these parts... I was nervous, but luckily it did not come near the village.�

entries.source: 바깥을 돌아다닐 일이 있으면 너도 조심하는게 좋을 거야.�
entries.translation: If you have business outside, you had better watch your back.�

entries.source: 그리고 혹시라도 곰을 잡거나, 죽은 곰을 보게 되면 나한테 이야기 해줘.�
entries.translation: And if you happen to kill it or find a dead bear, let me know.�

entries.source: 마을 사람들에게 안심하라고 다시 알려줘야 하니까.�
entries.translation: I need to reassure the villagers so they can rest easy.�

entries.source: ^네가 너의 의무를 다하지 않겠다면,;이제는 더 이상;네 안에 있을 필요가 없어..�
entries.translation: ^If you will not fulfill your duty, there is no longer any need to remain inside you...�

entries.source: ^넌 더 이상, 날 구속할 수 없어.�

entries.translation: Ah! So refreshing. Good morning, Schultz!�
As expected... Eileen is not here either...�

entries.source: 아일린이 없어졌어. 아무래도.. 문제가 생긴 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Eileen is missing. It seems... there is trouble.�

entries.source: 쉬었다 가겠니? 이 집은 마음껏 사용해도 좋아.�
entries.translation: Care to rest? Feel free to use this house as you like.�

entries.source: 에블린이 말한 손님들이로구나. 쉴 준비는 끝내놓았으니, 푹쉬어.�
entries.translation: Ah, the guests Evelyn mentioned. Everything ready for you to rest, so get some sleep.�
Has this kind of thing happened before?�

entries.source: 네.. 아니, 아니오.. 아무 일도 없었어요.. 아무 일도..�
entries.translation: Yes... No, no... Nothing happened... Nothing at all...�
...Is it really necessary to keep watching this?�
Ah... You are back sooner than I thought, Schu.�

entries.source: 렌.. 무서워.. 나는 내 정령이 너무 무서워..�
entries.translation: Ren... I am scared... I am so scared of my spirit...�
Her condition... seems to have gotten worse.�

entries.source: 아무래도.. 아일린씨의 정령이 뭔가 변화를 일으키고 있는 것 같아.�
entries.translation: It looks like... something inside Eileen spirit is changing.�
Does not look like a good change, either...�

entries.source: 제발, 제발 그만해! 누가.. 누가 이 목소리를 멈춰줘요!�
entries.translation: Please, please stop! Someone... make this voice stop!�
This will not do. Let us give her a sedative first.�

entries.source: 슈우, 안정제를 만들 재료를 좀 구해다 주겠어?�
entries.translation: Schu, could you get the ingredients for a sedative?�
Cannot it be healed... with magic?�

entries.source: 글쎄.. 좀 어려울 것 같은데. 저 변화의 원인 자체가 정령에게 있는 것 같아서..�
entries.translation: Well... that might be difficult. The cause of this change seems to come from the spirit itself...�
What ingredients do you need? Tell me.�
That is the spirit, Schu. A real man steps up.�
Schultz, you are going to help?�

entries.source: 결국은 네가 떼를 써서 가게 될테니까. 아일린이 저 모양이면 어차피 대화도 제대로 못할 것 같고..�
entries.translation: You would throw a fit until I agreed anyway. And with Eileen like this, we cannot talk to her properly regardless...�

entries.source: 구해와야 할 건 }살리실리아{야. 10개 정도만 구해주면 돼.�
entries.translation: What we need is }Salicilia{. About 10 of them will do.�

entries.source: 살리실리아.. 마약 성분이 있는 것 아닌가?�
entries.translation: Salicilia... Is not that a narcotic?�

entries.source: 조재를 잘 하면 돼. 지금은 흥분 상태를 가라앉히는 게 우선이니까..�
entries.translation: It is fine if prepared properly. Right now, calming her down comes first...�

entries.source: 얼어붙은 바다의 }얼음 정령{들에게서 구할 수 있어. 좀 춥겠지만, 수고해 줘.�
entries.translation: You can get it from }Ice Spirits{ in the Frozen Sea. It will be cold, but good luck.�

entries.source: 아일린 언니의 정령은.. 우리가.. 병기라고 했어요.�
entries.translation: Eileen spirit... said that we are... weapons.�

entries.source: 완성만을 갈구하는 포악한 병기.. 라고.. 이겨내지 못하면.. 결국..�
entries.translation: Fierce weapons that crave only completion... and if we cannot overcome it... in the end...�

entries.source: 우리들의 정령도.. 언젠가는 저렇게 튀어나와 우릴 괴물로 만들 거라는 거야?!�
entries.translation: Are you saying our spirits will burst out like that too and turn us into monsters?!�

entries.source: 아일린 언니는 예전으로 돌아가느니.. 죽는게 낫다고 그랬어.�
entries.translation: Eileen said... she would rather die than go back to how she was before.�

entries.source: 다들.. 그런거야? 그런 괴물이 된다고 해도, 정령을 포기할 수 없는 거야?�
entries.translation: Is everyone... like that? Even if you turn into a monster, you cannot give up your spirit?�

entries.source: 아무리 그래도, 가장 소중한 건 자신의 목숨이잖아!�
entries.translation: Even so, your own life is what matters most!�

entries.source: .. 나도, 예전의 그 숫자도 못 세던 바보로는 돌아가고 싶지 않으니까.�
entries.translation: ...I do not want to go back to being a fool who could not even count either.�

entries.source: 내가 얻은 것은 목숨이야. 나 역시.. 계승권을 버릴 수는 없다.�
entries.translation: What I gained was my life. I cannot throw away my succession either.�

entries.source: 하지만 그렇다고.. 그런 괴물이 되겠다는 것도 아니야.�
entries.translation: That does not mean I intend to become a monster, either.�
I agree. If we cannot overcome it... you say?�

entries.source: 이겨내면 돼. 방법을 찾고 말겠어, 내가 얻은 이 마법적인 지식들로..!�
entries.translation: Then we just have to overcome it. I will find a way, using this magical knowledge I have gained...!�

entries.source: 정령에 대해 좀 더 정확히 알 수 있는 방법이 있다.�
entries.translation: There is a way to learn more about the spirits.�

entries.source: 실체를 가진 정령이라고 했지? }네베드의 수호자{라면, 그 실체를 꿰뚫어 볼 수 있을거야.�
entries.translation: A spirit with physical form, right? A }Guardian of the Neved{ should be able to see through it.�

entries.source: 그렇.. 군. 고대신과 직접 마주하고 있는, 가장 강대한 네베드의 능력이라면..�
entries.translation: I see... If it is the power of the greatest Neved, who directly faces the Ancient Gods...�

entries.source: 저 아이는 다른 정령과 달리 인간의 내면에 숨어있지 않아. 가능할 거다.�
entries.translation: Unlike other spirits, that child is not hidden inside a human. It should be possible.�

entries.source: 적어도 정령이란 것이, 정말 고대신이 만들어 낸 건지 정도는..�
entries.translation: At least we could find out if spirits were truly made by the Ancient Gods...�

entries.source: 하지만 어떻게.. 그 네베드의 수호자에게 이 녀석을 보여준다는 거야?�
entries.translation: How do you expect us to show this one to a Neved Guardian?�

entries.source: 수호자는 지금 봉인을 떠날 수 없어. 우리가 }성지{로 가야한다.�
entries.translation: The Guardian cannot leave the seal right now. We must go to the }Sanctuary{.�

entries.source: 말도 안되는 소리를..! 이런 북쪽 끝까지 온 것도 모자라, 휴전중인 적국의 중심까지 들어가라는 건가?�
entries.translation: That is absurd! Coming all the way north was bad enough, and now you want us to march into the heart of an enemy nation during a truce?�
I feel like... I am going crazy right now...�

entries.source: 내가 그런 괴물이 되서 슈르츠님을 먹어버릴 지도 모른대잖아..!�
entries.translation: They said I might turn into a monster and devour you, Schultz...!�

entries.source: 테오도어씨나.. 에블린 언니나, 그 어린 아이까지 죽여버릴지도 몰라..�
entries.translation: I might end up killing Theodore... Evelyn, or even that child...�
You would not want that either, Schultz...�

entries.source: 내가 어떤 존재인지.. 알고 싶어.. 티르 오빠와 함께 가자, 슈르츠님..�
entries.translation: I want to know... what I really am... Let us go with Tyr, Schultz...�

entries.source: 성지로 가는 건 걱정하지마. 그곳은 제법 자주 들락거리니까..�
entries.translation: Do not worry about traveling to the Sanctuary. I head there quite often...�
It will not be dangerous. Just a bit of a long journey...�

entries.source: 그래, 슈우. 어떤 존재인지를 알아야.. 대책을 세울 수 있을거야.�
entries.translation: Yeah, Schultzy. We need to know what she is to find a countermeasure.�
Damn it. Your beloved Tyr says it is safe, after all.�

entries.source: 생각보다.. 시간을 많이 잡아먹게 되는군, 이거..�
entries.translation: This is taking up... far more time than expected.�

entries.source: 하지만 우리에게 시간제한이 걸린거라면.. 할 수 있는 건 최대한 빨리 해둬야 해, 슈우.�
entries.translation: If we are on a time limit, we should do what we can as soon as possible, Schultzy.�

entries.source: 그럼, 내가 먼저 콜크리크 섬에 가서 기다리겠어.�
entries.translation: Then I will head to Cole Creek Isle first and wait.�

entries.source: 성지에서 뭔가 답을 얻으면, 킹스포트에서 합류해서 함께 카즈를 만나자.�
entries.translation: Once you get answers at the Sanctuary, regroup at Kingsport and we will see Kaze together.�

entries.source: 잠깐, 테오.. 설마 혼자 가려는 건 아니겠지?�
entries.translation: Wait, Theo... You are not planning to go alone, are you?�
Evelyn, you need to stay and guard this place.�

entries.source: 웃기지마, 너의 정령은 전투용도 아니잖아? 혼자서 그 먼길을 가다가 루퍼스라도 만나면 어쩌려고?�
entries.translation: Do not be ridiculous. Your Spirit is not even built for combat! What if you run into Rufus on that long road?�

entries.source: 쓸데없는 걱정 하지마. 우리 둘 없다고 무슨 일이 생길만큼 레반이 약하진 않으니까.�
entries.translation: Stop worrying needlessly. Levan is not frail enough to collapse just because the two of us are gone.�

entries.source: 무엇보다 앞으로 우리의 움직임을 결정할지도 모르는 중요한 일이야. 나도 가겠어.�
entries.translation: Besides, this is critical information that could decide our next moves. I am coming too.�

entries.source: 킹스포트에, 에네스트 가문에서 운영하는 여관이 있어. 그곳에 가면 카즈가 있을거야.�
entries.translation: There is an inn run by House Ernest in Kingsport. Kaze will be there.�

entries.source: 먼저 만나는 건 상관없고.. 다만 계승자에 대해선 모르고 있으니 주의해.�
entries.translation: Feel free to meet him first, but be careful--he does not know about the Successors.�

entries.source: 걱정마. 비밀을 지키는 데는 익숙하니까. 레반의 사람들에게도 이건 비밀이거든.�
entries.translation: Do not worry. I am used to keeping secrets. Even the people of Levan do not know about this.�

entries.source: 슈우야말로 조심해서 다녀와. 티르가 함께 있다고 해도.. 거기는 전장이니까.�
entries.translation: Take care of yourself, Schultzy. Even with Tyr around, that place is a battlefield.�

entries.source: 그럼.. 먼저 }이렘{으로 가서 배를 준비해 둘테니 선착장으로 와.�
entries.translation: Then... I will head to }Irem{ first to ready a ship, so meet me at the dock.�
Look for a }clumsy girl with purple hair{.�
Well then... let us head out too.�

entries.source: 레반에서 평화를 즐겨. 이 정도는 추위도 아니잖아?�
entries.translation: Enjoy the peace here in Levan. This cold is nothing, right?�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬의 킹스포트로 간다고 했지? 이거 오랜만에, 제법 긴 여행이 되겠어.�
entries.translation: Did you say Kingsport on Cole Creek Isle? It has been a while since we had such a long trip.�

entries.source: 음, 충분해. 어린 나이에.. 고객들에게 사랑받는 용병이었겠는데?�
entries.translation: Yeah, plenty. At such a young age, you must have been quite popular with your clients as a mercenary.�
Hahaha, that bluntness is what makes you fun, Schultzy.�

entries.source: 그 슈우라고 부르는 것 좀 관둬. 님도 괴로워죽겠는데..�
entries.translation: Stop calling me Schultzy. Being called Lord is bad enough already...�

entries.source: 괜찮아 괜찮아, 쑥스러워 말라고. 계승자들은 신뢰와 의리로 뭉쳐야 되니까.�
entries.translation: Come on, do not be shy! Successors need to stick together through trust and loyalty.�

entries.source: 신기하네.. 슈르츠님이 완전히 말리잖아? 대단해, 테오도어씨도 에블린 언니도..�
entries.translation: Incredible... Schultz is completely overwhelmed. Theodore and Evelyn are amazing...�

entries.source: 음.. 내 호칭은 씨인가. 오빠가 좋은데.�
entries.translation: Hmm... So I am just Mr., huh? I would prefer Big Bro.�
That is never going to change, trust me...�

entries.source: 일단 잠들었어. 아무래도.. 같이 얘기하기는 무리일 것 같아.�
entries.translation: She finally fell asleep. Talking to her seems out of the question for now.�

entries.source: 정령의 목소리가 들린다고 해. 매우 가까운 곳에서..�
entries.translation: She said she could hear a Spirit voice. From very close by...�

entries.source: 예전에도 이런 일이 있었던 것 같은데, 도통 이야기를 해주지 않아.�
entries.translation: I think this happened before, but she never tells me anything about it.�

entries.source: 그녀가 위험한 계승자가 아니라는 건.. 확실하지? 테오.�
entries.translation: Are you sure... she is not a dangerous Successor, Theo?�

entries.source: 아일린 언니는 위험하지 않아요! 얼마나 착한데..�
entries.translation: Eileen is not dangerous! She is so sweet...�

entries.source: 하지만 정령이 저렇게 적극적으로 계승자를 괴롭히는 건 처음보니까..�
entries.translation: Still, I have never seen a Spirit torment its Successor like that...�

entries.source: 당신들도 정령에 대한 건 자세히 모르는 건가?�
entries.translation: So you do not know much about Spirits either?�

entries.source: 어쩔 수 없지 뭐, 정령은 자기 하고 싶은 말만 하는 걸.�
entries.translation: Cannot be helped. Spirits only say what they want to say.�
Wait, what do you mean by that?�

entries.source: 어차피 아일린은 함께 얘기할 수 없을 것 같으니.. 본론으로 들어가자고.�
entries.translation: Eileen will not be joining us anyway... Let us get down to business.�

entries.source: 누가 자기 하고 싶은 말만 한다는 건지..�
entries.translation: Look who is talking about only saying what they want...�
You two are quite a fun pair to watch.�

entries.source: 그래, 정령에 대한 건 우리도.. 추측만 하고 있을 뿐이지.�
entries.translation: Indeed. As for the Spirits... we are only guessing.�

entries.source: 오르비스 군도에서 인간의 지식을 벗어난 모든 힘은, }악몽의 주인{을 기반으로 하고 있다는 것을 근거로.�
entries.translation: In the Orbis Islands, all power beyond human understanding is tied to the }Lord of Nightmares{.�

entries.source: 네베드.. 선주종 말이로군. 그들의 신화에 나오는, 성지에 봉인된 고대신을 말하는 건가?�
entries.translation: Neved... the ancients. You mean the ancient god sealed in the Sanctuary from their myths?�

entries.source: 틀려. 그건 그들의 신화가 아니라, 그들의 }역사{다.�
entries.translation: Wrong. It is not their myth, but their }history{.�

entries.source: 실재로 네베드는 하늘에서 내려온 }강림자{의 힘을 빌어, 악몽의 주인을 }성지{에 봉인했다.�
entries.translation: The Neved truly borrowed the power of the }Descendant{ from the heavens to seal the Lord of Nightmares in the }Sanctuary{.�

entries.source: 그럼 우리가 가진 정령도.. 그 고대신이 만들었다고?�
entries.translation: Then our Spirits... were created by that ancient god?�

entries.source: 말했지만 정령에 대한 건 추측일 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: Like I said, the Spirits are just our theory.�

entries.source: 듣는 자들과 마찬가지로, 정령 역시 고대신이 자신의 }부활{을 위해 인간에게 준 힘이 아닐까.. 하는 추측.�
entries.translation: Just like the Listeners, we suspect Spirits were power granted to humans to aid the ancient god }resurrection{.�
What on earth are these }Listeners{ anyway?�

entries.source: 맙소사.. 정말 아무 것도 모르는 구나? 그래서 흑의병들을 죽이지 않은 거였어.�
entries.translation: Good grief... You really do not know anything? That is why you spared the Black Guard.�

entries.source: 그들에게서 정보를 얻을 수 있을까 해서다. 그게 뭐 잘못됐나?�
entries.translation: I thought I could get intel from them. Did I do something wrong?�

entries.source: 듣는 자들은 }고대신의 목소리{를 듣는 인간이야. 그들은 인간을 초월한 지식이나, 마법적인 능력을 전수받지.�
entries.translation: Listeners are humans who hear the }voice of the ancient god{. They are granted superhuman knowledge and magical powers.�
Humans who hear... the ancient god voice.�

entries.source: 그들은 서로 정신적인 대화가 가능해. 입도 열지 않고, 아무리 멀리 떨어져 있어도.�
entries.translation: They can communicate telepathically. Without speaking a word, no matter the distance.�

entries.source: 만약 그놈들이 전음으로 지원이라도 요청했으면, 우리의 위치가 모든 듣는 자들의 머릿속에 빵빵 광고되었을 걸?�
entries.translation: If they called for backup mentally, our location would have been broadcast across every Listener head!�

entries.source: 뭐.. 아직까지 조용한 걸 보니 다행히 그런 일은 막은 것 같지만..�
entries.translation: Well... seeing how quiet it is, looks like we dodged a bullet, but still...�

entries.source: 흑의병들은 모두 듣는 자인가? 웨이드 가의 인간들도?�
entries.translation: Is the Black Guard made entirely of Listeners? House Wade too?�

entries.source: 듣는 자는 어디에.. 얼마나 있는지 알 수 없어. 일단 흑의병은 전원 듣는 자로 구성되어 있다고 하더군.�
entries.translation: There is no telling where... or how many Listeners there are. But all Black Guards are Listeners.�

entries.source: 결국.. 모든 원흉은 선주종의 고대신이라는 건가..�
entries.translation: So in the end... the ancient god of the Neved is behind all of this...�

entries.source: 웨이드 가는 듣는 자들을 이용해 권력을 키워왔어, 듣는 자들이 고대신의 하수인이라는 걸 알면서도..�
entries.translation: House Wade grew its power using Listeners, knowing they serve the ancient god...�

entries.source: 그들은 결국 공화국을 파멸시킬 거야. 우리는 그걸 막기 위해.. 웨이드 가.. 그리고 듣는 자들과 싸웠던 거다.�
entries.translation: They will destroy the Republic. We fought House Wade... and the Listeners... to stop that.�

entries.source: 하지만 너희도 웨이드 가와 싸우려고 준비 중이라며?�
entries.translation: Still, are not you preparing to fight House Wade as well?�

entries.source: 우린 다른 곳에도 혁명군이 있는 줄 알고 너희들과 접촉한 건데.. 이런 건 전혀 몰랐던 거야?�
entries.translation: We contacted you hoping there were rebels elsewhere... Did you truly know none of this?�

entries.source: 이제 우리에게도, 너에 대해 말해주지 않겠어?�
entries.translation: Now, will not you tell us about yourself?�
...I am the last survivor of House Bane.�

entries.source: 나와 함께 행동하는 카즈는 에네스트 가문의 마지막 생존자지.�
entries.translation: And Kaze, who travels with me, is the last survivor of House Ernest.�

entries.source: 우리는.. 우리의 가문을 무너뜨린 웨이드 가의 배후가 어떤 존재인지 알고싶어서.. 센트럴 타워로의 잠입을 계획했어...�
entries.translation: We... planned to infiltrate Central Tower to find out who was backing House Wade when they destroyed our families...�
You guys have quite the history too...�

entries.source: 우리까지 치면 계승자를 6명이나 찾아낸 거군.. 대단해.�
entries.translation: Including us, you have found six Successors... Impressive.�

entries.source: 하지만 거기까지야.. 듣는 자의 정체도, 정령의 정체도 짐작조차 하지 못했다.�
entries.translation: That is as far as we got... We had no clue about the Listeners or the Spirits.�

entries.source: 당연해, 선주종의 고대신 따위 생각도 못했으니까..�
entries.translation: Naturally. Who would suspect an ancient god of the ancients...�

entries.source: 하지만.. 우리를 찾아온 건 웨이드 가와 싸우기 위해서가 아니라, 계승자를 찾아서였구나.�
entries.translation: So... you came to find Successors, not to join a war against House Wade.�

entries.source: 다른 혁명세력 같은 건 없었다는 거네.. 아쉬운데.�
entries.translation: No other rebel forces after all... That is disappointing.�

entries.source: 전혀 아쉬운 게 아니야, 에블린. 에네스트 가문의 경제력이 뒷받침 되면, 레반은 다시 무장할 수 있어.�
entries.translation: Not disappointing at all, Evelyn. With House Ernest wealth behind us, Levan can take up arms once more.�

entries.source: 이 두명뿐인 혁명군과의 연합은, 우리에게 다시 궐기할 수 있는 기회를 줄거야.�
entries.translation: An alliance with this two-person rebel force will give us a chance to rise again.�

entries.source: 그건 나도 동의하지만.. 그렇다면 정령은 어떻게 할거지?�
entries.translation: I agree with that, but... what do we do about the Spirits?�

entries.source: 이것 역시 고대신의 힘이라면, 없어져야 할 힘이 아닌가?�
entries.translation: If this is also the power of the ancient gods, should not it be destroyed?�

entries.source: 정령을 포기한다는 건, 계승자가 죽는 것.. 패배하는 것과 다를 바 없을 거야.�
entries.translation: Giving up the Spirits means the death of the Successors... It would be no different than defeat.�

entries.source: 계승자로서 우리가 할 수 있는 최선은, 서로 죽이지 않고, 아무도 죽지 않는 거라고 생각해.�
entries.translation: As Successors, I think the best we can do is refuse to kill each other, and make sure no one dies.�

entries.source: 그래. 누구도 최후의 승자가 되지 않는다면, 정령은 그 목적을 달성하지 못할 테니까..�
entries.translation: Right. If no one becomes the final victor, the Spirits will not achieve their purpose...�

entries.source: 듣는 자들과의 싸움이 끝날 때, 정령의 존재 이유도 알 수 있겠지. 그들은 우리들을 찾고 있으니까..�
entries.translation: When the fight against the Listeners ends, we will learn why the Spirits exist. They are seeking us, after all...�

entries.source: 내가.. 없어져야 할 존재일 수도 있는거야?�
entries.translation: Could I... be something that should be destroyed?�

entries.source: 테오도어는 저렇게 말하지만, 난 정령이.. 다른 신이 우리에게 내린 시련이라고 생각해.�
entries.translation: Theodore says that, but I think the Spirits... are a trial given to us by another god.�

entries.source: 이 힘이 있기에 레반은 따뜻한 안식처를 얻었고, 듣는 자와 맞설 힘을 가질 수 있었으니까.�
entries.translation: Because of this power, Levan found a warm haven, and the strength to stand against the Listeners.�

entries.source: 그 불꽃.. 역시 당신이 얻은 가장 원하던 것이로군.�
entries.translation: That flame... It truly was what you desired most.�

entries.source: 더 강한 힘을 얻으려는 욕망에만 휘둘리지 않으면.. 우리가 서로 사이좋게 지내면 만사 OK라고. 안 그래?�
entries.translation: As long as we do not get swayed by the desire for greater power... and get along, everything will be fine. Right?�

entries.source: 넌 없어져야 할 존재일 수도 있지만.. 인간을 위해 태어난 천사일 수도 있어.�
entries.translation: You might be something that should not exist... but you could also be an angel born for humanity.�

entries.source: 진실을 알기 전까진, 쓸데 없는 고민하지마. 알았지, 렌?�
entries.translation: Until we know the truth, do not worry about it. Got it, Ren?�
All right. I will join you.�

entries.source: 그러기 위해 나와 함께 킹스포트로 가주었으면 좋겠군.�
entries.translation: To that end, I would like you to come with me to Kingsport.�

entries.source: 함께 카즈를 만나.. 레반이 가진 모든 정보를 공유하고 앞으로의 계획을 세웠으면 하는데.�
entries.translation: We can meet Kaze, share everything Levan knows, and plan our next move together.�

entries.source: 좋아, 함께 가지. 당장 내일이라도 갈 수 있어.�
entries.translation: Sure, I will go with you. We can leave as early as tomorrow.�
I am glad to have found a good ally, Schultz.�

entries.source: 아.. 딱딱한 이야기가 엄청 길어졌네. 이제 좀 쉬자, 다들. 응?�
entries.translation: Ah... this serious talk went on for so long. Let us get some rest, everyone. Okay?�

entries.source: 그럼 슈우, 렌. 마을 북쪽에 있는 쉼터로 와. 신혼방 처럼 포근한 잠자리를 제공해줄테니.�
entries.translation: Then Schultz, Ren. Come to the shelter in the north of town. I will give you a bed cozy enough for newlyweds.�

entries.source: 글쎄, 워낙 신출귀몰하는 남자라서.. 사실 우리도 그에 대해선 잘 몰라.�
entries.translation: Well, he is so elusive... To be honest, we do not know much about him either.�

entries.source: 하지만 그는 듣는 자들을 증오하고 있고.. 강해. 4년전의 궐기때도 큰 도움이 되었지..�
entries.translation: But he hates the Listeners... and he is strong. He was a great help during the uprising four years ago...�

entries.source: 자주는 아니지만.. 한동안은 이 섬에 머물거라고 했으니 한번쯤 더 오지 않을까?�
entries.translation: Not often... but he said he would stay on this island for a while, so maybe he will drop by again.�

entries.source: 구해와야 할 건 살리실리아야. 10개 정도만 구해주면 돼.�
entries.translation: What you need to bring back is Salicilia. About 10 should be enough.�

entries.source: 얼어붙은 바다의 얼음정령들에게서 구할 수 있어. 좀 춥겠지만, 수고해 줘.�
entries.translation: You can get them from the ice spirits in the Frozen Sea. It will be a bit cold, but good luck.�

entries.source: 당신의 모험이 얼마나 많은 것을 보고 얻었는지, 확인해 보세요.�
entries.translation: Check out how much you have seen and earned on your adventures.�

entries.source: 거래가 활발할 정도로 사람이 많은 건 아니지만, 물건은 항상 구비해두고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: There are not many people around to trade, but our wares are always stocked.�

entries.source: 다들 조금은 나태해졌지만, 혁명의 그 때를 위해.. 수련을 게을리해선 안돼.�
entries.translation: Everyone gotten a bit complacent, but for the revolution... we must not neglect our training.�

entries.source: 우리 손으로 직접 벼린 무기들이라면, 센트럴의 공장에서 찍어내는 무기들 따위 무섭지 않다고!�
entries.translation: With weapons forged by our own hands, we do not fear the mass-produced junk from Central factories!�
Whoa! It is pretty... but freezing cold, is not it?�
Will not you lose track if you do not focus?�

entries.source: ... 이 추위에 땀을 흘리는 걸 보니 놓쳤구나.�
entries.translation: ...Seeing you sweat in this cold, you have definitely lost it.�
Well... it is just so huge out here...�
What about the direction? At least get a sense of direction.�

entries.source: 그나저나 이거 정말 끔찍한 추윈데.. 더 북쪽으로 올라가서 숨어살 수 있는 곳이 정말 있는건가?�
entries.translation: By the way, this cold is unbearable... Is there really a place further north where someone could live in hiding?�

entries.source: 일단 가자.. 가만히 서있는 것도 괴로워..�
entries.translation: Let us just keep moving... Standing still is torture...�
|(She could just make herself warmer clothes...)�

entries.source: .. 인사는 나중에 하지, 지금은 급한 일이 생긴 것 같군.�
entries.translation: ...Greetings can wait. It looks like we have an urgent situation.�
Tracks left by that monster... Did it go this way?�

entries.source: 여긴 네베드의 고대 유적이야. 네베드의 결계가 진입을 막고 있어.�
entries.translation: These are ancient Neved ruins. A Neved barrier is blocking the way.�

entries.source: 정확히 말하면.. 위치가 알려져있는 유일한 강림자의 유적이지만...�
entries.translation: To be exact... it is the only known Descendant ruins, but...�
Do monsters like that live in Neved ruins?�

entries.source: 아니, 이 괴물은 결계를 찢고 들어갔어. 적어도.. 안에서 밖으로 나온 건 아니라고 봐.�
entries.translation: No, that beast tore through the barrier to get in. It certainly did not come from inside.�

entries.source: 그럼 역시.. 아일린에게 문제가 생겼다고 봐야겠군.�
entries.translation: Then Eileen must really be in trouble.�

entries.source: 들어가서 확인해 보는 수 밖에 없어. 테오도어, 이 근처에서 영혼석이나 영혼가루를 구할 수 있나?�
entries.translation: We have no choice but to go in and check. Theodore, can we find Soulstones or Soul Dust nearby?�

entries.source: 아마.. 이 근방에 }설녀{가 있을거야. }영혼석{을 구할 수 있어.�
entries.translation: There should be a }Yuki-onna{ nearby. You can get a }Soulstone{ from it.�

entries.source: 영혼석.. 좋아, 하나만 있으면 되겠군. 내가 찾아 오겠다. 혹시 놈이 나올지도 모르니까 잘 지키고 있어!�
entries.translation: A Soulstone... Great, one should do. I will go find it. Watch the entrance in case that thing comes out!�

entries.source: 슈우, 너도 같이 가서 }영혼석{을 구해봐. }설녀{는 개체수가 적어서, 쉽게 찾을 수 없을거야.�
entries.translation: Shu, go help find a }Soulstone{. }Yuki-onnas{ are rare, so they will not be easy to find.�
Can we get inside with this?�

entries.source: 좋아.. 이걸로, 결계를 중화시킬 수 있을거야.�
entries.translation: Alright... This should neutralize the barrier.�
Ugh... This is not stabilizing easily...�

entries.source: 안돼.. 이 정도로는 한명밖에 들어갈 수 없어.. 시간이 좀 걸리겠는데..�
entries.translation: Damn it... This is only enough for one person to slip through. It will take some time...�
No, Shu! It is too dangerous alone!�

entries.source: 하지만 테오도어씨, 아일린 언니가 위험한 걸지도 몰라요.. 분명히 이 안에서 느껴지는 걸요.�
entries.translation: But Theodore, Eileen might be in danger... I can definitely sense her inside.�
Right. There is no time to wait around.�

entries.source: 금방 안정화시키고 따라갈테니까, 위험하면 무조건 도망쳐. 어제 에블린이 한 말 기억하지?�
entries.translation: I will stabilize it and follow shortly, so run if it gets dangerous. Remember what Evelyn said yesterday?�

entries.source: 누구도 죽이지 않을 거고, 누구도 죽어선 안돼!�
}설녀{를 사냥하면 봉인을 중화시킬 }영혼석{은 구할 수 있지만.. 개체수가 적어서 쉽게 찾을 수 없을거야.�
entries.translation: Hunting a }Yuki-onna{ will yield a }Soulstone{ to neutralize the seal... but they are rare and hard to find.�

entries.source: ^느껴진다.;넌 더 이상 날 구속할 수 없어.�
entries.translation: ^I feel it. You can no longer bind me.�
^The time to fight has finally come.�

entries.source: ^어째서 나를 숨기지?;어째서 나를 두려워 하지?;몇 번이고 너를 지켜준 나를..�
entries.translation: ^Why do you hide me? Why do you fear me? After all the times I protected you...�
^In your weakness, you will only be a sacrifice.�

entries.source: ^조각조각 갈라져;신의 톱니바퀴 한 조각이 될 뿐라고.�
entries.translation: ^Torn to pieces, nothing more than a cog for a god.�

entries.source: ^내 목소리를 무시하지 마.;넌 더 이상 날 구속할 수 없어.�
entries.translation: ^Do not ignore my voice. You can no longer bind me.�
Pull yourself together, Eileen. Are you alright?�

entries.source: 언니.. 괜찮아? 몸에는 이상이 없는 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Are you okay? You do not seem hurt, but...�
I will be fine... Do not worry...�
Does not seem like simple motion sickness.�

entries.source: 모이투라로 온 뒤로 계속 심해지고 있다는데.. 아무래도 정령이 말썽인 것 같아.�
entries.translation: It has been getting worse since we came to Moytura... Looks like her Spirit is acting up.�

entries.source: 렌, 너는 다른 계승자를 느낄 수 있다고 했지?�
entries.translation: Ren, did you say you can sense other Successors?�

entries.source: 에.. 응. 에블린 언니는 이제 느껴지지 않지만..�
entries.translation: Uh... yeah. Though I cannot sense Evelyn anymore...�

entries.source: 좋아, 그럼. 슈우, 나는 아일린씨를 데리고 먼저 갈게. 아무래도 길 안내까지 겸하기엔 상황이 급한 것 같으니.�
entries.translation: Alright then. Shu, I will go ahead with Eileen. The situation is too urgent for me to act as a guide.�
...So we should just follow on our own?�

entries.source: 한 명 정도는 내 능력으로 편안히 모실 수 있거든. 먼저 아일린씨를 편하게 해드리고 싶군.�
entries.translation: My power allows me to carry one person comfortably. I want to help Eileen rest as soon as possible.�

entries.source: 난 상관없어. 렌이 당신을 놓치지만 않는다면.�
entries.translation: Fine by me. As long as Ren does not lose track of you.�

entries.source: 호.. 왠지 나, 중요한 역할을 맡은 기분인데?�
entries.translation: Heh... feels like I have an important role now!�

entries.source: 동굴을 벗어나면 빙해야. 자칫 잘못하면 얼어죽을 수 있으니까, 서둘러서 따라와야 될거야.�
entries.translation: Past the cave is a glacier. You could freeze to death if you get lost, so follow quickly.�

entries.source: 반군의 은신처라면, 역시 표지판 같은 걸 세워두지 않았겠지?�
entries.translation: I assume the rebels would not leave road signs around, right?�
Of course not. Why, do not you trust Ren?�

entries.source: 걱정마, 나, 완전 집중할테니까. 절대 놓치지 않을게.�
entries.translation: Do not worry, I will focus completely. I will not lose them!�
Then I am counting on you, Ren. We are moving out.�

entries.source: 자, 자. 출발하자. 안내는 내게 맡겨.�
entries.translation: Alright, let us head out. Leave the guiding to me.�
I have a really bad feeling about this...�

entries.source: 나는 비상보급조이자 비상연락책이기도 해. 지금 혁명군에서 가장 중요한 남자지.�
entries.translation: I am both the emergency supply unit and liaison. Basically the most important man in the rebel army right now.�
...It is frozen solid. Good thing we came to check.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 완전 놀랐어. 슈르츠님이 먼저 남을 위해 일을 해주다니.�
entries.translation: Still... I am really surprised. You actually helping someone on your own, Schultz?�
I am definitely getting paid for this.�
You just wanted to help Evelyn, did not you?�

entries.source: 그 여자, 무리하고 있어. 억지로 밝은 척하는 것도 그렇고..�
entries.translation: She is pushing herself too hard. Even putting on that cheerful act...�

entries.source: 그냥 느낌이야. 부상입힌 것도 있고.. 무엇보다 일을 하고 있는게 나도 편하니까.�
entries.translation: Just a feeling. Besides, I did injure her... And honestly, keeping busy suits me better.�

entries.source: 항상 그렇게 남을 생각해주면 나도 마음이 편할텐데.�
entries.translation: If you cared about others like this all the time, my mind would be at ease.�

entries.source: 내 것도 아닌데.. 내가 생각해도 좀 별난 짓을 했군.�
entries.translation: It is not even my business... Guess it was weird of me even by my standards.�
Hurry, Ren. Can you sense the Successor?�

entries.source: 으.. 응! 안쪽, 깊숙한 곳이야. 멀어..�
entries.translation: Y-Yeah! Deep inside. It is far...�
Is Eileen going to be okay?�

entries.source: 아직 느껴지는 걸 보면 무사하겠지. 문제는.. 내가 그 흔적을 본적이 있다는 거야.�
entries.translation: Since you can still sense her, she is alive. The problem is... I have seen these traces before.�

entries.source: 경비병들의 상처.. 센트럴에서, 그 }늑대 괴물녀석{과 마주쳤을 때.�
entries.translation: The guards wounds... They match that }wolf monster{ back in Central.�

entries.source: 에에? 그거.. 웨이드 가의 비밀병기라던? 여기까지 쫓아온 거야?�
entries.translation: What? You mean House Wade secret weapon? It followed us all the way here?�
...No... It is just a guess. Let us hurry.�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�
|(There seems to be something in the ice.){�

entries.source: 그 상태에서 나를 찾아온 건.. 기적에 가깝군.�
entries.translation: Finding your way to me in that state... It is practically a miracle.�
But... it is already too late. I am sorry.�

entries.source: 당신은 이 악마를 조종할 수 있잖아! 그때처럼.. 나를 불러냈던 그때처럼..!�
entries.translation: You can control this demon! Just like back then... when you called me out...!�

entries.source: 정말 미안하다. 하지만 나는.. 거기서 빠져나와야 했어.�
entries.translation: I am truly sorry. But I... had to escape from there.�

entries.source: 그때 심은 작은 균열이.. 이렇게 겉잡을 수 없이 커질 줄은..�
entries.translation: I had no idea the small crack planted back then would grow so out of control...�

entries.source: 전 알아요.. 이번에는 다른 때와 틀려요..�
entries.translation: I know... It is different this time...�

entries.source: 돌아올 수 없을거야.. 난 정령에게 먹혀서..�
entries.translation: I will not be able to return... I will be devoured by the Spirit...�
No! I would rather die than do that!�
It is the only way. Renounce... your succession.�
Never... I am never going back to how it was!�
This time, it will not end like before!!�
^...Still, I am... lucky to become one with you.�
No... Do not say that, Eileen...�

entries.source: ^괜찮아 렌.;어차피 난 정령을 포기할 수도,;제어할 수도 없었으니까.�
entries.translation: ^It is alright, Ren. I could not give up the Spirit anyway, nor could I control it.�
Answer me! Eileen... is she dead!?�

entries.source: ^다시 예전처럼 침대위에서;시체처럼 누워 천장만 바라보느니..;죽는게 나으니까.�
entries.translation: ^Lying like a corpse in bed staring at the ceiling like before... Dying is much better than that.�
No way... As long as we are alive... if we just survive...�
^We are weapons, born only to fight...�
^If we cannot endure... in the end, all of us...�
What is... that? It is not an Ancient...?�

entries.source: 설마 방금 그게 정령의 실체.. 인건가..?�
entries.translation: Could that have been... a spirit true form...?�

entries.source: 날 죽였던 게.. 아일린이었다고..? 내가 죽인 게.. 아일린이라고?�
entries.translation: The one who killed me... was Eileen...? The one I killed was... Eileen?�
Schu, snap out of it! Schu!�

entries.source: 아일린의 3가지 정령 스킬중, 어떤 것을 전승하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: Which of Eileen 3 spirit skills will you inherit?�
Are we... not on Trident Isle?�

entries.source: 흔들린다.. 마치 배에 탄 것처럼.. 아니, 정말 배일지도 모르겠어.�
entries.translation: It is swaying... like being on a ship... Wait, this might really be one.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 이렇게 크고 넓은 배가 있을 수 있어?�
entries.translation: But... could a ship really be this vast?�

entries.source: 나도 몰라. 답을 들으려면.. 크래드를 찾아내는 수 밖에.�
entries.translation: I do not know. To find the answer... we will have to find Krad.�
^In the end... a world without gods falls to ruin.�
^That is precisely why you were needed.�
Who... is playing this sick joke?�
^O Bane,;;is the Master of Nightmares fully sealed?�
^O Ernest,;;is the new land fully cultivated?�
^O Reedmeyer,;;does the Ark await the hour of descent?�
^O Wade,;;are mankind fully prepared to receive us?�

entries.source: 그딴 거 알게 뭐야! 누구냐, 누가 우리에게 지시를 내린거냐고!�
entries.translation: Like I care! Who are you? Who gave us these orders?!�
I... do not hear anything... Telepathy...?�
No... What is this? This sound...�
It is coming from... within me. Almost like instinct...�
^Why do you seek to awaken Yggdrasil, O Guide?!�

entries.source: 다른 사람들은.. 아직 여기까지 못 온건가?�
entries.translation: Have the others... not made it here yet?�

entries.source: 네가 제일 빨랐다. 나머지는 유적에서 헤매다가 이제 막 방주에 진입했어.�
entries.translation: You were the fastest. The rest got lost in the ruins and just entered the Ark.�
The voice echoing through the Ark... was that your doing?�

entries.source: 방주에 세팅되어 있는 몇가지 프로그램이야. 그냥 귀찮은 절차지.�
entries.translation: Just a few programs set into the Ark. Merely a tedious formality.�

entries.source: 자신들의 계획을 제대로 진행시키기 위해 교육하고, 확인하고, 감시하는 거야.�
entries.translation: To properly carry out their plan, they teach, verify, and monitor.�

entries.source: 그 계획.. 이라는 것에는 정령도 포함되는 거겠군.�
entries.translation: And that... plan includes the Spirits as well, I take it.�

entries.source: 그래. 강림자들이 이 세계로 오는데에 가장 큰 걸림돌이 되는 것이, 네베드의 고대신이거든.�
entries.translation: Yes. The greatest obstacle to the Descendants coming to this world is the ancient god of the Neved.�

entries.source: 인간들이 자신들을 대신해서 그 고대신과 싸워주길 바라는 건가? 너희들이 만들어준 신을 이용해서?�
entries.translation: They want humans to fight that ancient god for them? Using the god you created?�

entries.source: 뭐.. 그것도 이유 중에 하나이긴 하지만.�
entries.translation: Well... that is one of the reasons.�

entries.source: 인간들이 원하기도 했어. 인간은 늘 새로운 힘을 갈망하니까.�
entries.translation: Humans wanted it too. They always hunger for new power.�
I never asked for anything like that.�

entries.source: 그러니까, 아직 때가 아니라고 하는 거겠지.. 강림자들은.�
entries.translation: That is why the Descendants say it is not time yet...�

entries.source: 그건 맞는 말이야. 아직 강림자들이 오기엔, 이 세계가 완벽하지 않아.�
entries.translation: That is true. This world is not yet ready for the Descendants to arrive.�

entries.source: 도대체 너희들은 뭐하는 놈들이지? 강림자는 단순한 네베드의 구원자가 아닌건가?�
entries.translation: Who on earth are you people? Are the Descendants not simply the saviors of the Neved?�

entries.source: 무엇을 위해 이 세계로 오려하고, 무슨 권리로 우리들을 고대신과 싸우는데 이용해 먹겠다는 거냐?�
entries.translation: Why do they seek to come here, and by what right do they use us to fight the ancient god?�
I told you. I am not a Descendant.�

entries.source: 그리고.. 보게 될거라고도 했지. 강림자가 어떤 존재인지..�
entries.translation: And... I told you that you would see. What kind of beings the Descendants truly are...�
^Guide. We told you it is too early.�

entries.source: 그래, 때가 이르지. 그런데.. 이쪽도 사정이라는 게 있어서.�
entries.translation: Yes, it is early. But... I had my own circumstances.�

entries.source: ^신을 만들기 위한 육체적 진화도,;;정신적 정보도 충분하지 못하다.�
entries.translation: ^Neither physical evolution;;nor mental data suffices to create a god.�

entries.source: ^고작 8개체의 정신을 기반으로;;세계를 지탱해야 할;;신을 만들고자 하는 것이냐?�
entries.translation: ^Do you intend to forge a god;;to sustain the world based;;on mere eight subjects minds?�

entries.source: ^너의 판단에;;강림자 전체의 존망이 달렸거늘,;;어째서 독단적인 공정을 진행하려 하느냐!�
entries.translation: ^The fate of all Descendants hinges;;on your judgment! Why do you forge ahead;;with this arbitrary process?!�
Are you... the one they call the }Guide{?�

entries.source: 여기선 너의 도움이 필요할 것 같군. }감시자{가 올거야.�
entries.translation: Looks like I will need your help here. A }Watcher{ is coming.�
*pant* *pant* Was that just now... a Descendant?�

entries.source: 강림자들은 아무래도 인간의 신을 만들어주려는 것이 마음에 안드는 모양이야.�
entries.translation: It seems the Descendants are displeased with creating a god for humanity.�

entries.source: 이제 와서 무슨 소리야! 인간의 신은 강림자들이 만들려고 한다고 했잖아!�
entries.translation: What are you talking about now?! You said the Descendants were trying to make a human god!�
Yes. But they also said it was too early, did not they?�

entries.source: 빙빙 돌려말하기에는 시간이 부족하군. 네가 알고싶어하는 걸 말해주지.�
entries.translation: We do not have time to beat around the bush. I will tell you what you want to know.�

entries.source: 너희들에게 정령을 심은 건 }듣는 자{들이야. 그들은 신이라는 이름의 }병기{를 원했다.�
entries.translation: The ones who implanted the Spirits in you were the }Listeners{. They wanted a }weapon{ in the name of a god.�

entries.source: 나는 그들에게 강림자의 기술을 제공했을 뿐이다.�
entries.translation: I merely provided them with the Descendants technology.�
The Listeners... implanted the Spirits in us?�

entries.source: 우린 정령의 힘으로 놈들에게서 도망쳐나왔는데.. 이 힘을 그 놈들이 준거라고?�
entries.translation: We escaped from them using the Spirit power... and they gave us this power?!�
They must have had their own plans.�

entries.source: 나도.. 원하는 게 있기 때문에 놈들에게 기술을 제공한거고.�
entries.translation: And I... wanted something too, which is why I gave them the technology.�
What is it? What did you want?�

entries.source: 걱정하지마. 그렇게 나쁜 건 아냐. 이미.. 내 목적은 달성되었어.�
entries.translation: Do not worry. It is nothing sinister. My goal has already... been achieved.�

entries.source: 다만 걱정되는 건 강림자들이 길길이 날뛰는 거지.�
entries.translation: The only concern now is that the Descendants will fly into a rage.�

entries.source: 말 돌리지 마라! 넌 무엇을 위해 정령을 만든거냐!�
entries.translation: Stop dodging the question! Why did you create the Spirits?!�

entries.source: 강림자들이 만들어 낸 존재라면서요. 인간들이 원하는 새로운 힘이라면서..�
entries.translation: You say it is a creation of the Descendants, a new power humans desired...�

entries.source: 무섭기만 해요. 애초에 당신들이.. 우리의 행복따위 신경이나 썼었나요?�
entries.translation: It is just terrifying. Did any of you ever care about our happiness in the first place?�

entries.source: 때가 이르다.. 하지만 당신은 만들 수 밖에 없었지?�
entries.translation: It was too early... but you had no choice, did you?�

entries.source: 크래드.. 당신은 인간이 아니라고 하기엔 너무 인간적이야.�
entries.translation: Krad... you are far too human for someone who claims not to be.�

entries.source: 천 년의 삶 속에서.. 가장 행복했던 순간이었다.�
entries.translation: In a thousand years of life... that was my happiest moment.�

entries.source: 그렇게 보내고 싶지 않았어. 이게.. 네가 말한 인간적인 감정이겠지?�
entries.translation: I did not want to let you go like that. Is this... the human emotion you spoke of?�

entries.source: 그래서 엘렌이 살아돌아왔나? 그저 듣는 자들에게 이용당한 것 뿐 아닌가?�
entries.translation: Is that why Ellen returned alive? Was she not merely used by the Listeners?�

entries.source: 그 녀석에게 또다시 가혹한 운명을 던져주고, 만족하고 있나!�
entries.translation: Forcing a cruel fate upon her once more, are you satisfied with that?!�

entries.source: 만족.. 하고 있어. 그 녀석을 다시 볼 수 있는 것 만으로..�
entries.translation: I am... satisfied. Just to be able to see her again...�

entries.source: 선택권은 너희에게 있다. 정령의 힘을.. 어떻게 사용할 것인지.�
entries.translation: The choice is yours. How you will use the power of the spirits...�
...After binding us with your pointless rules...!�

entries.source: 웨이드 가 놈들은.. 인간의 본성에 의해 신이 완성될 수 밖에 없을 거라고 했지만..�
entries.translation: The Wades said that human nature would inevitably give rise to godhood, but...�

entries.source: 난 인간을 믿어. 너희들은, 너희의 진정한 존재 이유를 스스로 찾아낼 거다.�
entries.translation: I believe in humans. You will find your own true reason for being.�
Just as Tyr did... and Lurain as well.�

entries.source: 나는 알렉스가 실패했을 때.. 방주를 컨트롤하려고 이곳에 왔어. 강림자들이 더 이상 날뛰지 않도록..�
entries.translation: I came here to control the Ark if Alex failed. So the Descendants would run amok no longer...�

entries.source: 때가 될 때까지, 우리들은 기다릴 것이다.�
entries.translation: Until the time comes, we shall wait.�

entries.source: 그러니까.. 너희는 너희에게 주어진 정령을 너희의 뜻대로 활용하면 돼.�
entries.translation: So... use the spirits granted to you as you see fit.�
That was what I wanted to tell you.�
We... we will stay in the Ark too!�

entries.source: 미안하지만 안돼. 이 시설은.. 너희가 원하는 안식처가 아니니까.�
entries.translation: I am sorry, but no. This facility... is not the sanctuary you seek.�

entries.source: 갈 곳 잃은 존재들이 이 세계를 향해 뚫어둔 지옥의 문이다..�
entries.translation: It is a gateway to hell, opened toward this world by those who lost their place...�
It is hell out there anyway!�

entries.source: 그 놈들이 올 수 없는 곳이라면, 우리 둘만 살 수 있는 곳이라면 그걸로 좋아!�
entries.translation: As long as they cannot reach us, as long as just the two of us can live, that is enough!�

entries.source: .. 전하고 싶은 말은 여기까지다. 그만.. 너희들의 지옥으로 돌아가.�
entries.translation: ...I have said all I needed to say. Now... return to your hell.�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: 듣는 자들과 싸우다보면.. 곧 다시 만나겠지.�
entries.translation: As we fight the Listeners... we will meet again soon.�
This time... I will definitely protect you.�

entries.source: 금방 또 만날테니까.. 벌써부터 그리워할 필요 없어.�
entries.translation: We will see them again soon... No need to miss them already.�

entries.source: 에네스트 가문이 운영하는 여관으로 간다. 테오도어와 에블린이 잘 도착했는지 모르겠군.�
entries.translation: Head to the inn run by House Ernest. I wonder if Theodore and Evelyn arrived safely.�
What are you two doing here?�
I thought it was Theodore or Evelyn...�
Do not need it! Let us go!�
Schultz, did you not say you would rip out their hair?�
What is the point of getting mad at kids?�

entries.source: 근데 저 아이들 숨어지낸다더니.. 여기까지 무슨 일이지?�
entries.translation: Still, I thought those kids were in hiding... What brings them all the way here?�

entries.source: 킹스포트는 산업화된지 좀 오래 됐죠. 리드마이어 가문 시절부터니까..�
entries.translation: Kingsport has been industrialized for quite a while. Ever since the Readmeyers...�

entries.source: 록빌도 산업화 된다는데, 우리도 재개발이나 한번 했으면 좋겠네요.�
entries.translation: Rockville is industrializing too. Wish we could get some redevelopment ourselves.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 중부.. 북서쪽의 폐쇄된 갱도.. 맞지? 티르 대장이 오면 바로 전해줄게.�
entries.translation: Central Cole Creek... the abandoned mine to the northwest... right? I will tell Captain Tyr as soon as he arrives.�

entries.source: 오오. 너희들 아직도 킹스포트에 있었군 그래.�
entries.translation: Oh! You guys are still in Kingsport, eh?�

entries.source: 그러는 너희도 아직 킹스포트를 안 떠난 건가?�
entries.translation: Have not you guys left Kingsport yet either?�

entries.source: 설마.. 네오 그라함 호의 기동성을 너무 과소평가하는군.�
entries.translation: No way... You underestimate the Neo Graham mobility.�

entries.source: 우린 벌써 강림자의 유적을 찾아 황혼섬을 뒤지고..�
entries.translation: We already searched Twilight Isle for Descendant relics and...�
Right, that is enough. Where is Tyr?�

entries.source: 네가 물어봤잖아.. 이 놈 은근히 대장을 닮았다니까..�
entries.translation: You are the one who asked... Man, he really acts like the Boss sometimes...�

entries.source: 티르 대장은 잠시 배 정비를 맡기고 각종 재료 수급중이야.�
entries.translation: Captain Tyr left the ship for maintenance and went to gather supplies.�

entries.source: 언제쯤 돌아올까? 티르 오빠도.. 함께 가는 게 좋을텐데.�
entries.translation: When will he be back? It would be nice if Tyr could come with us...�

entries.source: 글쎄.. 그건 잘 모르겠군. 근데 함께 가다니, 뭐라도 찾았나?�
entries.translation: Well... not sure about that. But come with you? Did you find something?�

entries.source: 콜크리크 중부 북서쪽 갱도에, 강림자의 유적.. 이라기는 뭐하지만 그들의 흔적을 찾았어.�
entries.translation: In the northwest mine shaft of Central Cole Creek, we found Descendant traces... well, not quite ruins, but traces.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬에? 의외로군.. 만약 있다면 트라이던트 섬일거라 생각했는데..�
entries.translation: On Cole Creek Isle? Surprising... If anywhere, I thought they would be on Trident Isle...�

entries.source: 자세히 설명해줄 시간은 없군. 지금.. 목숨이 왔다갔다 사람이 있어서.�
entries.translation: No time for full details. Right now... someone is life is hanging in the balance.�

entries.source: 도움이 필요할지도 몰라. 최대한 빨리 와주길 바란다고 전해줘.�
entries.translation: We might need help. Tell him to come as quickly as he can.�

entries.source: 음.. 알았어. 대장 오는 대로 전해줄게.�
entries.translation: Hmm... Got it. I will pass the message as soon as the Boss returns.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬의 타조들은 굉장히 포악해. 경비대가 가장 많이 신경쓰는 부분이지.�
entries.translation: The ostriches on Cole Creek Isle are ferocious. The guards spend most of their time watching out for them.�

entries.source: 게다가 간간히 강력한 데몬들도 출현하니.. 안전한 섬이라고는 못해.�
entries.translation: Plus, powerful demons appear occasionally... so it is hardly a safe island.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가문이 멸문당한 뒤로는, 이 썩어빠진 광산 협회가 다 해 쳐먹고 있어�
entries.translation: Ever since House Reedmeyer was wiped out, this rotten Mining Association has been hogging everything.�

entries.source: 다른 일거리만 있었어도 이따위 놈들을 지켜주는 일 따위 맡지 않았을텐데..�
entries.translation: If there were any other jobs, I would never bother guarding scum like them...�

entries.source: 킹스포트 사람들은, 생각보다 현재의 마을 상황에 불만이 많은 것 같아.�
entries.translation: People in Kingsport seem far more dissatisfied with the town state than you would expect.�

entries.source: 경제적으로는 부족함이 없는 것 같은데 이상하지?�
entries.translation: They lack nothing financially, so it is strange, is not it?�

entries.source: 록빌 재개발 때문에 자원 소비량이 많아져서 당장은 다들 좋아하고 있지만..�
entries.translation: Everyone happy for now because the Rockville redevelopment demands so many resources...�

entries.source: 북서쪽 갱도가 폐쇄된 뒤로, 동쪽 갱도의 채굴량이 너무 과다해졌어. 그게.. 제일 불안하군.�
entries.translation: Ever since the northwest shaft closed, the eastern shaft has been mined too aggressively. That is... what worries me most.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬은 공화국의 중앙에 위치해서.. 해상 교통의 요지로 발전시키면 좋을텐데 말이지.�
entries.translation: Cole Creek Isle sits right in the Republic center... It would make a great hub for maritime traffic.�

entries.source: 현실은 화물선, 화물선, 화물선 뿐이야. 아무리 봐도 위에서 뭔가 수를 쓰고 있는 거라고.�
entries.translation: Instead, it is just cargo ship after cargo ship. Someone up top is definitely pulling strings.�

entries.source: 이것 참.. 별다른 사건도 없는데 마을 분위기가 흉흉하니 내가 다 찝찝하군.�
entries.translation: Man... Nothing even happened, yet the gloomy mood around town is giving me the creeps.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가문이 건재할 때는 안 이랬는데.. 사람들이 너무 비관적이 됐다니까.�
entries.translation: It was not like this when House Reedmeyer was around... People have become far too cynical.�

entries.source: 저희는 콜크리크 섬의 주요 갱도들을 관리하며, 외부로 나가는 광물들을 분류하고 검증하는 일을 주로 담당하고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: We manage Cole Creek Isle main shafts, sorting and inspecting minerals slated for export.�

entries.source: 저기, 아까 놓고 가신 것이 있는데.�
entries.translation: Excuse me, you left this behind earlier.�

entries.source: 광산조합에서 고용한 용병들이 광부조합 결성을 위한 서명서를 제출한 광부를 어디론가 잡아 갔어요.�
entries.translation: Mercenaries hired by the Mining Association took away a miner who submitted a petition to form a union.�

entries.source: 요즘 광산 근처에서 <웜{을 봤다는 목격담이 있습니다.�
entries.translation: Lately, there have been sightings of <Wyrms{ near the mines.�

entries.source: 웜은 땅을 파헤치며 다녀서 지반을 약화시키는데다가 숫자도 금방 불어나니까,�
entries.translation: Wyrms burrow through the ground, weakening the bedrock, and their numbers multiply fast.�

entries.source: 보게 되면 바로 가드에게 신고해 주세요.�
entries.translation: If you spot one, please report it to the guards immediately.�

entries.source: 광산조합에서는 웜에 대한 현상금도 걸고 있으니, 능력이 되시면 직접 잡아 보는 것도 좋겠죠.�
entries.translation: The Mining Association offers a bounty on Wyrms, so feel free to hunt them yourself if you are capable.�

entries.source: 단, 현상금을 받으려면 <웜의 머리{를 가져오셔야 합니다.�
entries.translation: However, you must bring a <Wyrm Head{ to claim the reward.�
Oh my... You actually hunted one?�
Did you really slay it all by yourself?...�

entries.source: 포상금 지급 한도가 있어서 이 이상은 드릴 수 없어요.�
entries.translation: There is a payout cap on bounties, so I cannot give you any more than this.�

entries.source: 에잉.. 이거 원, 동부 갱도 말고 다른 루트는 개발 못하는 건가?�
entries.translation: Sigh... Cannot we develop any route other than the eastern shaft?�

entries.source: 광물 심의 비용을 좀 더 늘려야 돼. 이런 식이면 인건비도 제대로 안나온다고.�
