entries.translation: We must raise the mineral appraisal fees. At this rate, we will not even cover labor costs.�

entries.source: 이거 무게에 비해 순도가 너무 떨어지는데. 요즘 점점 질이 나빠져.�
entries.translation: The purity is way too low for its weight. The quality keeps worsening lately.�

entries.source: 이게 다 우리가 공인해준 장비를 사용하지 않아서 이런 거라니까. 왜 말들을 안 듣는지.�
entries.translation: It is all because they will not use our certified equipment. Why will not anyone listen?�

entries.source: 아하암.. 뭐.. 광물들이 다 거기서 거기긴 하지..�
entries.translation: *Yawn*... Well, minerals are pretty much all the same anyway...�

entries.source: 그래도 이래저래 제약을 좀 걸어줘야, 일꾼들도 우리를 쉽게 못 본다고.�
entries.translation: Still, we need some rules like this so the workers will not take us lightly.�

entries.source: 뒤에 쌓여있는 거 보이지? 이게 다 장부야.�
entries.translation: See those piles behind me? Those are all ledgers.�

entries.source: 내가 저걸 정리할 때마다 느끼는 건데.. 광산 협회는 진짜 도둑놈들이라고.�
entries.translation: Every time I balance these books, I realize the Mining Guild is a bunch of crooks.�

entries.source: 너희야말로.. 네베드의 땅은 좀 살만 했어?�
entries.translation: And you guys? Was the land of Neved bearable?�
More or less. Where is Theodore?�

entries.source: 마침 카즈와 대화중이야. 너와는 완전 딴판으로 귀공자 스타일이던데?�
entries.translation: Talking with Kaze. Unlike you, he is quite the refined gentleman.�

entries.source: 뭔가 자꾸 우리를 떠보는 듯한 기분이 들어서 좀 마음에 안들지만..�
entries.translation: Though I did not like how he kept sounding us out...�
I see. I will head right in.�
How was it, Ren? Did you find any answers?�
Heh... A little. I got a lot of good advice.�
Glad to hear it. I am looking forward to seeing it.�

entries.source: 움.. 크리스 쟤, 멀미 어지간히 심하게 했나봐..�
entries.translation: Mm... Chris must have had some terrible seasickness...�

entries.source: .. 우리와 같은 여관에 묵기 싫다는 걸 보니 제 정신이고.. 제 정신인걸 보니 정령이 미친 건 아닌 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Refusing to stay in the same inn means he is sane. And if he is sane, his spirit has not gone mad.�
I really wish they would trust us...�

entries.source: 사람을 믿는다는 걸 너무 가볍게 생각하지 마.�
entries.translation: Do not take trusting people so lightly.�
Huh? Thought you were gonna rest, but here you are again.�

entries.source: 이봐.. 우리가 먼저 여기서 묵고 있었다고. 따라오기는..�
entries.translation: Hey... We were staying here first. Who followed who?�

entries.source: 그냥 가게 두는 게 좋을걸, 파뿌리 애송이... 우욱.�
entries.translation: Better let us go, scallion-haired brat... Ugh.�
Ah... damn it... I am so dizzy...�

entries.source: 티아나가 곤란해 하잖아. 그 꼴을 하고 어딜 또 가겠다는 거야?�
entries.translation: You are troubling Tiana. Where do you think you can go in that state?�

entries.source: 쉬었다 가라. 이 여관, 내 친구가 하는데라고. 돈도 없잖아 너희.�
entries.translation: Just rest here. A friend of mine runs this inn. Besides, you do not even have any money.�

entries.source: 티아나, 이쪽으로 와.. 얼른. 네가 오면 크리스도 올거야.�
entries.translation: Tiana, come here... quickly. If you stay, Chris will stay too.�
You do not want Chris to suffer, right?�

entries.source: 수배서를 보면 그들이 이번에 오는 이유는 명백해. 나 뿐만이 아니라..�
entries.translation: Judging by the bounties, their goal is clear. Not just me...�

entries.source: 크리스, 알렉스, 루퍼스가 수배자 목록에 포함되어 있다.�
entries.translation: Chris, Alex, and Rufus are all on the wanted list.�

entries.source: 명백히.. 계승자를 노리고 오는 거야. 게다가.. 루퍼스까지 콜크리크 섬에 있을지도 모른다는 얘기지.�
entries.translation: They are clearly hunting Successors. Which also means... Rufus might be here on Cole Creek Isle.�

entries.source: 그럼.. 어서 이 섬을 떠나야 겠네?�
entries.translation: Then... we need to leave this island at once?�

entries.source: 그래, 떠날거야. 하지만.. }알렉스{에게 경고해 둬야 돼.�
entries.translation: Yes, we will leave. But... I have to warn }Alex{ first.�

entries.source: 미련하게 그곳을 지키고 서있다간.. 죽게된다. 루퍼스던 흑의병이던, 발견되고 말거야!�
entries.translation: If he stubbornly stays there, he will die. Whether it is Rufus or the Black Guard, he will be found!�

entries.source: 슈르츠 왔구나. 카스틀러님이 널 위한 방을 준비해두라고 하셨으니 쉬고 싶을 때 사용하렴.�
entries.translation: Welcome, Schultz. Kastler told me to prepare a room for you. Use it whenever you need to rest.�
Schu, you made it back safely.�

entries.source: 이런 엄청난 일을 나한테 던져놓고 이제야 오냐..�
entries.translation: Dumping all this huge work on me and only showing up now...�

entries.source: 그래. 혁명군 레반이 아직도 남아있다니, 믿을 수가 없어. 도대체 어떻게 찾아낸 거야?�
entries.translation: Good. I cannot believe the Levan resistance is still around. How on earth did you find them?�

entries.source: 게다가 천재 학자 테오도어씨가 그 일원일 줄이야.�
entries.translation: And to think the brilliant Theodore was one of them.�

entries.source: 고맙습니다, 테오도어씨. 덕분에.. 웨이드 가에 가지고 있던 여러가지 의문이 풀렸어요.�
entries.translation: Thank you, Theodore. Thanks to you, many of my doubts about House Wade are clear.�
I am glad I could be of help.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 혁명에 부정적이라는 건 조금 의외인걸.�
entries.translation: Still... I am a bit surprised you are opposed to the revolution.�

entries.source: 듣는 자가 무엇인지를 알고나니 더욱 확신이 들어.�
entries.translation: Now that I know what Listeners are, I am even more certain.�

entries.source: 그들과 맞서기 위해선, 우리가 지금 가진 힘만으로는 부족하다는 것이..�
entries.translation: To stand against them, our current strength alone simply is not enough...�

entries.source: 여기서 우리가 경제적으로 지원한다고 해도, 결과는 4년전과 달라질게 없을거야. 그렇지 않아?�
entries.translation: Even if we fund them financially, nothing will change from four years ago. Am I wrong?�

entries.source: 레반은 그때와 달라. 얼어붙은 바다에서, 우리들은 더더욱 강해졌으니까.�
entries.translation: Levan is different now. We grew far stronger in the Frozen Sea.�

entries.source: 기회가 다시 주어진다면, 싸움은 해봐야 아는 게 아닐까?�
entries.translation: If given another chance, will not we only know if we actually fight?�

entries.source: 해봐야 아는 싸움.. 으로는 안 됩니다.�
entries.translation: A fight where we only know by trying... is not good enough.�

entries.source: 지금 궐기한다고 반드시 성공한다는 보장이 없다는 것에는 동의해.�
entries.translation: I agree there is no guarantee of success if we rise up right now.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 우리가 하려는 일은 인간의 힘이 아닌 무언가로 인간을 지배하는 자들과 싸우는 것이 아닌가?�
entries.translation: Still... are not we trying to fight those who rule humanity with inhuman power?�

entries.source: 그들을 무너뜨리기 위해, 우리도 그런 힘을 구해야 한다는 건가?�
entries.translation: Are you saying we must obtain that kind of power just to defeat them?�

entries.source: 그것이 아니라면.. 더 힘을 모아야 겠죠. 4년전 레반 이상의...�
entries.translation: If not that... then we must gather more strength. Far more than Levan four years ago...�

entries.source: 혁명은 성공의 확신이 들 때 해야만 합니다. 아직 우리는 힘이 부족해요.�
entries.translation: A revolution must only begin when success is certain. We lack the power right now.�
It feels strange hearing you be so cautious.�
We only have one chance, Schultz.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬에도, 반 웨이드 가의 움직임이 있을 수 있습니다.�
entries.translation: Cole Creek Isle might harbor anti-Wade sentiments as well.�

entries.source: 그럴리가 없어. 콜크리크 섬의 광산 협회는, 웨이드 가의 전폭적인 지원을 받고 있다.�
entries.translation: Impossible. The Cole Creek Isle Mining Guild is fully backed by House Wade.�

entries.source: 광부들은 달라요. 그들은 과거 }리드마이어 가문{이 콜크리크 섬을 지배하던 때를 그리워하고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: The miners differ. They miss when }House Reedmeier{ ruled Cole Creek Isle.�

entries.source: 그리고.. }몇 개월 전{부터, 리드마이어 가의 생존자가 나타났다는 소문이 그들 사이에 돌고 있죠.�
entries.translation: And... rumor says a Reedmeier survivor appeared }a few months ago{.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가문은, 웨이드 가에 멸문당한 것 아니었나?�
entries.translation: Was not House Reedmeier wiped out by House Wade?�

entries.source: 에네스트 가와 베인 가 역시 멸문 당했지만 저와 슈르츠가 있지 않습니까.�
entries.translation: House Ernest and House Bane fell too, yet Schultz and I still draw breath.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가의 생존자가 정말로 있다면, 콜크리크 섬의 힘도 혁명에 보탤 수 있을 거예요.�
entries.translation: If a Reedmeier survivor truly exists, Cole Creek Isle could aid the revolution.�
What is with that look? Are you busy?�

entries.source: 아니, 아니야. 좀 안좋은 소식이 있어서..�
entries.translation: No, not that. I just have some bad news...�

entries.source: 흑의병들이 이번에 콜크리크 섬으로 올 모양이야. 수배자들을 찾아서..�
entries.translation: The Black Guard are coming to Cole Creek Isle. Hunting wanted men...�
Wait... am I on the wanted list?�

entries.source: 그 설마야. 이번에 등록된 이 수배자 목록을 봐봐.�
entries.translation: Indeed. Look at this latest bounty list.�

entries.source: 잠시 피신하는 게 좋을 것 같아.�
entries.translation: You should go into hiding for a while.�

entries.source: 이 놈들, 어떻게 알았는지 모르겠지만 네가 콜크리크 섬에 있는 걸 알고 있어.�
entries.translation: I do not know how they found out, but they know you are on Cole Creek Isle.�
What are you going to do?�
I have to leave Cole Creek Isle...�

entries.source: 좋아, 그래. 네가 그렇게 말할 줄 알았어. 배를 준비해 둘게.�
entries.translation: Right, of course. I knew you would say that. I will ready a ship.�
Wait. Before that... there is something I must finish.�

entries.source: 금방.. 돌아올게. 돌아오는 데로 떠날 수 있게 준비해줘.�
entries.translation: I will be right back. Have it ready so we can sail the moment I return.�
You still... trusted him a little, did not you?�
...It seems... he intends to hide it from me until the very end...�

entries.source: 말씀드렸지 않습니까, 카스틀러님.. 그는 고대신과 싸우고자 하는 의지가 없어요.�
entries.translation: I told you, Lord Kastler... He has no will to fight the Ancient Gods.�

entries.source: }알테나{를 완성시키기 위해선.. 우리가 움직이는 수 밖에 없습니다.�
entries.translation: To complete }Althena{... we must take matters into our own hands.�

entries.source: 레반과의 협력은 반가운 일이지만.. 아직은 때가 아니야.�
entries.translation: Cooperating with Levan is welcome news... but now is not the time.�

entries.source: 슈르츠, 우리에겐 더 강한 힘이 필요한 때라고.�
entries.translation: Schultz, right now, we need greater power.�
Are you heading back to Levan?�

entries.source: 뭐.. 아직 때가 아니라니까. 좀 더 기다려 봐야지?�
entries.translation: Well... He said it is not time yet. We just have to wait.�

entries.source: 그리고.. 나는 강림자에 대해서 조사를 좀 해봐야 겠어.�
entries.translation: And... I should do some research on the Descendants.�

entries.source: 지금까지는 고대신과 네베드 위주로만 연구를 해서 답이 안나왔는데...�
entries.translation: Until now, I only studied the ancient gods and the Neved, so I hit a dead end...�

entries.source: 너희들이 말한데로 강림자가 정령의 창조자라면 다른 쪽으로 연구를 해봐야 할 것 같아.�
entries.translation: If Descendants truly created the spirits like you said, I should approach it differently.�

entries.source: 뭔가 방법을 찾을 수 있을까? 괴물이 되지 않기 위한..�
entries.translation: Can we find a way? A way not to become monsters...�
We will. Theo is a genius.�

entries.source: 우리는 신 따위 만들자고 서로 죽이지 않을거고, 정령에게 먹혀 괴물이 되지도 않을거야.�
entries.translation: We will not kill each other to make some god, and we will not be devoured by spirits into monsters.�

entries.source: 그러니까 걱정하지 말고, 마음 굳게 먹고 기다려, 렌.�
entries.translation: So do not worry, stay strong, and wait, Ren.�
Okay, I will believe in you and wait.�

entries.source: 그보다 슈우. 아까 그 리드마이어 가문의 생존자 이야기말인데..�
entries.translation: By the way, Schu. About that survivor from the Riedmayr family...�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가의 멸문은 20년도 더 전이야. 생존자가 갑자기 나타났다는 건 말이 안 돼.�
entries.translation: The Riedmayr family fell over twenty years ago. A survivor suddenly appearing makes no sense.�

entries.source: 음. 몇 달 전.. 이라는 것도 마음에 걸리지?�
entries.translation: Yeah. The part about a few months ago bothers you too, right?�

entries.source: 그래.. 오히려 계승자의 출현 징후에 가깝다고 봐.�
entries.translation: Yeah... It sounds much more like a sign of a Successor appearance.�

entries.source: 나도 그렇게 생각했어. 그 조사는 나에게 맡겨.�
entries.translation: I thought so too. Leave that investigation to me.�
Kaze will probably want that as well.�

entries.source: 광부들 사이에서 도는 소문이라면.. 콜크리크 섬 중부의 }동쪽 갱도{에서 정보를 얻을 수 있을거야.�
entries.translation: If rumors are spreading among miners... you can find info in the }East Shaft{ of central Cole Creek Isle.�

entries.source: 계승자란 건 도대체 몇 명이나 되는 건지.�
entries.translation: Just how many Successors are there out there?�

entries.source: 그럼 슈우, 뭔가 변화가 생기면 찾아와. 기다리고 있을게.�
entries.translation: Then Schu, come see me if anything changes. I will be waiting.�

entries.source: 그리고 슈르츠.. 카즈를 너무 믿지 않는 것이 좋겠어.�
entries.translation: And Schultz... you should not trust Kaze too much.�

entries.source: 복수에 집착하는 것도 그렇고... 고대신이나 듣는 자에 대한 것도, 마치 알고 있다는 듯한 반응이었어.�
entries.translation: Besides his obsession with revenge... his reaction to the ancient gods and the Listeners seemed like he already knew.�
It is just a feeling... but be careful.�
Chris, you really should get some sleep...�

entries.source: 신경 꺼.. 내가 너희를 옆에 두고 마음 놓고 쉴 수 있을 것 같아?�
entries.translation: Mind your own business... You think I can rest easy with you two around?�

entries.source: 인정할게.. 넌 슈르츠님보다 두배는 더 삐딱해..�
entries.translation: I have to admit... you are twice as cranky as Lord Schultz...�

entries.source: 이걸 모아야 된다고? 어디로 가야되냐는 거지?�
entries.translation: You need to gather this? Asking where you need to go?�
Oh... Lord Schultz, you managed to communicate with her!�
This is... medicine ingredients. What kind of medicine?�

entries.source: .. 그게 없으면 티아나는 잠을 못 자. .. }악몽{을 꾸거든.�
entries.translation: ... Without it, Tiana cannot sleep. ... She has }nightmares{.�

entries.source: 슈르츠 형, 그럼..;그 악몽은 정말 꿈일 뿐인거지?;실재론 없는거지?�
entries.translation: Schultz, then... those nightmares are just dreams, right? They are not real, are they?�

entries.source: 정말.. 아직까지도;그런 걸 무서워 하면 어떡해?�
entries.translation: Really... Are you still scared of things like that?�

entries.source: 자꾸 친한 척 우리에 대해 물어보지 마! 너희에게 우리에 대해 말해줄 의무는 없다!�
entries.translation: Stop acting friendly and asking about us! We have no obligation to tell you anything!�

entries.source: }아미노페나{.. 이건 보통 어린 애들이 구할 수 있는 게 아냐. 콜크리크 섬의 }타조{들은 난폭하다.�
entries.translation: }Aminofena{... This is not something kids can gather. The }Ostriches{ on Cole Creek Isle are fierce.�

entries.source: 내가 구해주지. 잠들기 전까지 돌아올테니.. 기다리고 있어.�
entries.translation: I will get it. I will be back before you fall asleep... so wait here.�
I said we do not need your help!�

entries.source: 지켜주고 싶다더니.. 정말 신경써주는 거야? 언제는 머리털을 다 뽑아버리겠다고..�
entries.translation: You said you would protect her, but are you really caring for her? Earlier you said you would rip all my hair out...�

entries.source: .. 몸만 좀 괜찮아지면 바로 나을거야. 이걸로 생색낼 생각은 하지마.�
entries.translation: ... Once she feels a bit better, she will recover soon. Do not think you can hold this over us.�
Hand it over. The medicine... I will make it myself.�
If you really cannot trust me, suit yourself...�

entries.source: 우리.. 록빌 이전에 어디선가 만난 적이 있었던가..?�
entries.translation: Have we... met somewhere before Rockville...?�

entries.source: 그럴리가 없지. 우린.. 세상에 나온지 1년도 채 안 됐어.�
entries.translation: That is impossible. It has been... less than a year since we came into the world.�

entries.source: 응? 설마.. 너희 둘 다 나처럼 정령..?�
entries.translation: Huh? Could both of you be spirits like me...?�
Do not talk nonsense. How could that be?�
... Ah, I really want to hit him...�

entries.source: 갇혀있었을 뿐이야. 동물원의 동물들처럼.. 빌어먹을 어른들에게..�
entries.translation: We were just locked up. Like zoo animals... by those damn adults...�

entries.source: .. 티아나, 너도 날 어디선가 본것 같나?�
entries.translation: ...Tiana, do you feel like you have seen me somewhere too?�

entries.source: 그건.. 더 바보같은 소리야. 티아나는.. 1년전에 모든 기억을 잃었거든.�
entries.translation: That is... even more foolish. Tiana... lost all her memories a year ago.�

entries.source: 이 녀석에겐 나와 함께.. 도망다닌 기억뿐이야. 우릴 괴롭히던 인간들로부터 탈출한 뒤로..�
entries.translation: All she remembers is running away with me. Ever since we escaped those humans who tormented us...�
Because the memories were that painful!�

entries.source: 만약 그전에 우리가 만난 적이 있다면.. 그 놈들과 한 패거리라면, 난 너를 벌써 죽여버렸을 거다!�
entries.translation: If we met before... and you are with them, I would have killed you already!�
Looks like you have got your energy back.�
...I am all better now. We are leaving.�
Where are you planning to go?�

entries.source: 가 봐. 저 놈 소리지르기 전에.�
entries.translation: Go on. Before he starts yelling.�

entries.source: 갇혀지내다니.. 도대체 누가 그런 짓을 한 걸까? 기억을 잃을 정도로 괴로운..�
entries.translation: Locked up... Who on earth would do such a thing? Painful enough to lose her memories...�

entries.source: 엘바니움 광석이 유통 제한에 걸렸다는군. 협회에서 승인이 안났데, 별 쓸데없는 이유로.�
entries.translation: Elbanium ore got hit with trade restrictions. The guild did not approve it, over some pointless excuse.�

entries.source: 아니 대체, 광석이 어디 쓰이는지도 제대로 모르는 놈들이 뭘 승인하겠다는 건지..�
entries.translation: I mean, what are they approving when they do not even know what the ore is used for...?�
Welcome! Please assist the Arcane Society with inspecting magic wares!�

entries.source: 최고의 재료로 만든 최고의 아이템만을 제공합니다. 보고 가세요.�
entries.translation: We only offer the finest items made from the best materials. Take a look!�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬의 공화국에서 가장 위험한 지역 중에 하나지. 수련을 게을리해선 안돼.�
entries.translation: Cole Creek Isle is one of the most dangerous places in the Republic. Do not neglect your training.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬의 대장장이들에게 광물은 평생의 동반자와도 같아.�
entries.translation: To the blacksmiths of Cole Creek Isle, minerals are lifelong companions.�

entries.source: 세이브를 할 수 없는 곳으로 진행합니다.�
entries.translation: Advancing to an area where saving is disabled.�

entries.source: 후우.. 정말 있는걸까, }트라이던트 섬{으로 가는 육로가?�
entries.translation: Phew... Is there really an overland route to }Trident Isle{?�

entries.source: 언제 또 다른 계승자가 습격해 올지 몰라. 한시라도 빨리.. 트라이던트섬의 }방주{로 가야 해.�
entries.translation: Another Successor could attack at any time. We must get to the }Ark{ on Trident Isle as soon as possible.�
Because they will run away again if they see us...�

entries.source: 그나저나 저 녀석은.. 도대체 뭐라고 말하는 거야?�
entries.translation: By the way, what on earth is that girl saying?�

entries.source: 무슨 병이라도 있는 건가? 말하는 것 자체가 익숙하지 못한 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Is she sick? It looks like she is not even used to speaking...�

entries.source: 손대면 부러질 것 같아, 저 아이는.. 그래서 크리스가 저렇게 아끼는 걸까나..�
entries.translation: She looks like she would break if you touched her... Is that why Chris cares for her so much?�
How about you, Schultz? Do you like quiet girls like that?�

entries.source: 왜? 귀찮게 굴지도 않고.. 조용히 따라만 다닐텐데. 그런 걸 원하지 않았어?�
entries.translation: Why? She would not bother you... She would just follow quietly. Is not that what you wanted?�

entries.source: 그래도 함께 다닐거라면.. 좀 활기차고 덜 심심한게 좋아.�
entries.translation: Still, if we are traveling together... I prefer someone lively and less boring.�

entries.source: 몇 번 해봤는데.. 얌전한 부잣집 따님 호위하는 게 엄청 고역이라고.�
entries.translation: I have done it a few times... Escorting quiet highborn ladies is absolute torture.�

entries.source: 그럼 앞으론 좀 더 떠들어도 되겠다.�
entries.translation: Then I guess I can talk a bit more from now on.�
It makes you want to protect her, does not it?�
I knew it, right? Will not be a bother, either...�
I like that it is quiet, but...�

entries.source: 그것보단 저 아무것도 모르는 듯한 눈빛이.. 신경 쓰여.�
entries.translation: More than that, those blank, innocent eyes... bother me.�
Heh? You were actually paying attention?�

entries.source: 알았어.. 그렇게 할게. 일단 마을에서 .. 몸이 좀 낫기를 기다려보자.�
entries.translation: Fine... I will do that. Let us wait in town until you are feeling better.�

entries.source: 이곳은 인간이 들어 갈 수 없는 영역.. 리드마이어 가문이 수 백년간 수호해온 영역이다.�
entries.translation: This domain is forbidden to mortals... Protected by House Riedmeier for centuries.�
You deliver warnings like you are reading from a book.�

entries.source: 공격에는 살기가 하나도 없고 말이야.. 겁주기 용인가?�
entries.translation: Not a shred of bloodlust in your attacks, either... Just trying to scare me?�

entries.source: 정말로 싸우길 바란다면 그렇게 해 줄 수도 있다.�
entries.translation: If you truly wish to fight, I can grant that.�

entries.source: 절대. 그런 건 바라지 않아. 당신이 수호하고 있는 것에도 관심이 없고..�
entries.translation: Not at all. I do not want that. And I do not care what you are guarding...�

entries.source: 내가 관심이 있는 건 당신이야. 리드마이어 가의 생존자이자... 계승자인 당신.�
entries.translation: The one I care about is you. The last survivor of House Riedmeier... and a Successor.�

entries.source: ... 계승자에 대해 알고 있나. 그렇다는 말은..�

entries.translation: Means I am one too. The name Schultz.�

entries.source: 싸우려고 온 것이 아니야. 경계하지 않았으면 좋겠군.�
entries.translation: I did not come to fight. Lower your guard.�
Guardian of Trident Isle... I am }Alex van Riedmeier{.�
What brings you here, fellow Successor?�
To tell you to get out of this place.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬의 사람들은, 당신이 웨이드 가로부터 자신들을 구해줄 것을 기다리고 있다.�
entries.translation: The people of Cole Creek Isle are waiting for you to save them from House Wade.�

entries.source: 우리와 함께.. 웨이드 가와 싸우지 않겠나?�
entries.translation: Will you join us... and fight House Wade?�

entries.source: 정말로 화산 활동이 당신 덕분에 멈춘다고 생각하는 건 아니겠지?�
entries.translation: You do not honestly believe the volcanic activity stopped because of you, do you?�

entries.source: 그건 우연일 뿐이야. 이곳에 집착하는 건 가문의 망령일 뿐이라고.�
entries.translation: It is just a coincidence. Clinging to this place is nothing but a family ghost.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가문이 지키던 게 무엇이든, 그것은 20년전에 웨이드 가에게 깨지지 않았나?�
entries.translation: Whatever House Riedmeier guarded, was not it shattered 20 years ago by House Wade?�

entries.source: 그것이 내가 가장 원했던 것이니까.. 계승자라면, 알고 있겠지.�
entries.translation: Because that was what I desired most... As a Successor, you should know.�

entries.source: 나는 우리 가문이 20년전 지키지 못했던 사명을 다시 부활시켰다.�
entries.translation: I revived the duty our family failed to protect 20 years ago.�

entries.source: 그러니까 난.. 이곳을 벗어날 수 없어.�
entries.translation: So I... cannot leave this place.�

entries.source: 잠깐, 가장 원한 것이 가문의 사명이었다고?�
entries.translation: Wait, your family duty was what you desired most?�

entries.source: 혼자서 이런 갱도에 틀어박혀 침입자를 내쫓는 것을.. 가장 원했다고? 진심이냐?�
entries.translation: Locked alone in a mine shaft driving out intruders... was your greatest desire? Seriously?�

entries.source: 그때의 나는 이곳을 지키지 못한 가문의 한을 푸는 것만을 갈구했다.�
entries.translation: Back then, all I craved was to avenge the grief of failing to protect this place.�

entries.source: 선택의 여지는 없었다. 그건 너도 마찬가지였을 터.�
entries.translation: There was no choice. It must have been the same for you.�

entries.source: 이미 지쳐버린 거라고. 당신이 지금 원하는 건..�
entries.translation: You are already exhausted. What you really want now is...�

entries.source: 네가 우리 가문의 한에 대해 무엇을 알고 있나!�
entries.translation: What do you know of my family sorrow?!�
Turn back. I will... protect this place...�
...Phew... At least it did not come to blows...�

entries.source: 하지만 우리에게 힘을 빌려주지는 .. 않을 것 같은데?�
entries.translation: Still, I do not think he is gonna lend us a hand... right?�
No... He can definitely be swayed.�

entries.source: }카즈{와 함께 방법을 좀 더 생각해 보는 게 좋겠군.�
entries.translation: Let us consult }Kaze{ and think of another way.�

entries.source: 젠장, 무슨 일이 벌써 벌어진 건가? 알렉스는 어디로 갔지?�
entries.translation: Damn it, what happened already? Where did Alex go?�

entries.source: 아무래도.. 이게 알렉스가 지키던 것 같은데.�
entries.translation: Seems... this is what Alex was guarding.�
I... I have seen this before.�

entries.source: 아일린 언니가 죽은 곳.. 거기에도 같은 마법진이 있었어..�
entries.translation: Where Eileen died... there was a magic circle just like this...�

entries.source: 게다가 그때와는 달리.. 이 마법진은 아직 활동하고 있어..�
entries.translation: And unlike back then... this circle is still active...�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가의 사명이.. 강림자의 유적을 지키는 것이었다고? 이건 무슨 의미지..?�
entries.translation: House Riedmayr mission... was guarding Descendant ruins? What does this mean...?�

entries.source: 슈르츠님. 이 마법진, 다른 공간과 연결되어 있어.�
entries.translation: Schultz. This circle connects to another space.�

entries.source: 어쩌면.. 아직 활동중인 강림자의 유적을 찾을 수 있을지도 몰라.�
entries.translation: Maybe... we can find an active Descendant ruin.�

entries.source: 이거, 이제 제법 도움이 되는데, 너도?�
entries.translation: You are actually pretty helpful now, are not you?�

entries.source: 어쨌든 서두르자. 분명히 무슨 일이 생기긴 생긴거야!�
entries.translation: Anyway, let us hurry. Something definitely happened!�

entries.source: 돌아가라. 나에겐 가문의 사명이 무엇보다 우선이다.�
entries.translation: Turn back. For me, my family mission comes before all else.�

entries.source: 이거 보이지? 여긴 못 지나간다고. 직접 봐야 믿어지나?�
entries.translation: See this? Cannot get through here. Need to see it for yourself to believe it?�

entries.source: 내가 안전하게 길을 뚫어줄테니, 무황껍질이나 모아다 줘.�
entries.translation: I will blast a safe path through, so just bring me some Brimstone Carapaces.�

entries.source: 오호, 좋아, 좋아. 이 정도면 충분해.�
entries.translation: Oho, nice, nice! This should be plenty.�

entries.source: .. 그런데 당신은 왜 이 갱도에 들어가려는 거지?�
entries.translation: ...Why are you trying to enter this mine shaft, anyway?�

entries.source: 흐.. 이 갱도는 사고로 무너진 거야. 안에 뭐가 있을지 모른다고.�
entries.translation: Heh... This shaft caved in from an accident. No telling what is inside.�

entries.source: 안에 있는 장비들만 가져다 팔아도 큰돈이 될거야. 보물 찾기지.�
entries.translation: Selling off the gear left inside will fetch a fortune. It is treasure hunting!�
How is that? The work of an expert.�

entries.source: 그럼 이제부터는 각자, 알아서, 자신의 이득을 챙겨보자고.�
entries.translation: From here on, let us look out for our own interests, individually.�
The Successor... I feel a faint presence.�

entries.source: 응. 아직은 좀 멀지만.. 분명히 있어.�
entries.translation: Yeah. Still a bit far, but... definitely there.�

entries.source: 뜬금없이 루퍼스나 크리스일 가능성도 있으니.. 긴장해.�
entries.translation: Could suddenly be Rufus or Chris, so... stay on guard.�

entries.source: 응. 언제든지 숨을 준비 하고 있을게.�
entries.translation: Okay. I will be ready to hide at any moment.�

entries.source: 갱도에서 일하는 광부들을 보호해주는 게 우리의 주된 일이지.�
entries.translation: Protecting the miners working in the shafts is our main job.�

entries.source: 이것도 광산 협회가 중간에서 수수료 엄청 떼어가. 넌 이런 일 맡지 말아라.�
entries.translation: Even for this, the Mining Guild skims a huge cut. Do not take jobs like this.�

entries.source: 갱도 깊은 곳일수록 위험도가 높아져. 보수는 쎄지지만, 이 이상은 힘들 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Deeper shafts mean greater danger. Pay goes up, but pushing further seems tough.�

entries.source: 아무래도 조만간, 동부 갱도도 폐쇄되지 않을까 싶은데..�
entries.translation: I suspect the Eastern Shaft might get shut down soon too, though...�

entries.source: 뭐야. 갱도에는 광부들만 들어오란 법 있나?�
entries.translation: What? Is there a rule saying only miners can enter the shafts?�

entries.source: 나처럼 돈 냄새를 잘맡는 사람들에게 이런 빈틈많은 동굴은 소중한 보물창고라고.�
entries.translation: To folks with a nose for coin like me, loose caves like this are goldmines!�

entries.source: 이봐 너희.. 아까부터 리드마이어 가문에 대한 걸 캐묻고 다니던데..�
entries.translation: Hey, you two... heard you snooping around about House Riedmayr earlier...�
...Who are you? Do you know something?�

entries.source: 흐흐.. 남들 아는 만큼은 알지. 어디까지 들었나?�
entries.translation: Heh heh... As much as anyone else. How much have you heard?�

entries.source: 섬의 화산으로부터 콜크리크 섬을 지켜왔다는 것.. 과 }북서쪽의 갱도{까지.�
entries.translation: That they protected Cole Creek Isle from volcanoes... and about the }Northwest Shaft{.�
So, heading out to check that rumor?�
Get to the point. Otherwise, I am leaving.�
Whoa, hold on. Do not be in such a rush.�

entries.source: 북서쪽의 갱도는 폐쇄된 지 오래야. 지진으로 입구가 무너져서 위험하거든.�
entries.translation: The Northwest Shaft closed long ago. Entrance collapsed in an earthquake. Dangerous.�

entries.source: 하지만, 사람이 살고 있다고 하지 않았나?�
entries.translation: Did not they say someone is living there, though?�

entries.source: 그러니까 소문이지. 조사를 하려면, 입구 정도는 폭파시키고 들어가야 될거야.�
entries.translation: Hence the rumor. If you want to check, you will need to blast open the entrance.�
Leave it to a pro! A real pro.�

entries.source: 난 전부터 그 갱도에 들어가고 싶었거든. 하지만 광산 협회에서 허가를 안내준단 말이지.�
entries.translation: I have wanted in there for a while, but the Mining Guild will not grant a permit.�

entries.source: 용병으로 보이는데, 자네가 폭약의 재료만 모아다 준다면 내가 갱도의 입구를 열어주겠어.�
entries.translation: You look like a merc. Gather explosive materials, and I will clear the entrance.�

entries.source: }무황껍질{.. 이라는 거야. 중부의 }데몬{들에게서 구할 수 있는데, 이게 꽤 강하단 말이지.�
entries.translation: }Brimstone Carapace{... from the }Demons{ in the central area. Tough bastards, though.�

entries.source: 가보면 알거야. 그 일을 하지 않으면 폐쇄된 갱도로는 못들어가.�
entries.translation: Go see for yourself. Without this, you will not get into that closed shaft.�

entries.source: 흐흐, 너무 빼지 마. 정식으로 의뢰하는 거니까. 보수도 줄게.�
entries.translation: Heh, do not play hard to get. This is an official request, and I will pay you.�

entries.source: 그럼 수락하는 걸로 알고, 먼저 폐쇄된 갱도로 가있도록 하지. 잘 부탁해.�
entries.translation: Then I will take that as a yes. I will head to the abandoned shaft first. Good luck.�
Phew, it was nice when I was young...�

entries.source: 아, 저 쪽 구석에 있는 친구가 틈만 나면 이야기 하던 거군. 난 찬성이야.�
entries.translation: Ah, that guy in the corner talks about that all the time. I am all for it.�

entries.source: 생각만큼 잘 될지는 몰라도 시도해보는 건 나쁘지 않겠지.�
entries.translation: Do not know if it will work out, but it cannot hurt to try.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가문은.. 오래전부터 콜크리크 섬을 지켜왔지. 저 }트라이던트 섬{의 }화산{으로부터 말이야.�
entries.translation: House Riedmayer guarded Cole Creek Isle for ages... against that }volcano{ on }Trident Isle{.�

entries.source: 그들이 웨이드 가에게 멸문 당한 뒤로.. 지진이 끊임없이 찾아왔어. 1년에 서너번씩 꼬박꼬박..�
entries.translation: Ever since House Wade wiped them out... earthquakes hit constantly. Three or four times a year, like clockwork...�

entries.source: 난 리드마이어의 생존자가 있다는 게 사실이었으면 좋겠어. 그들만이 저 화산의 분노를 달랠 수 있을테니까.�
entries.translation: I hope the rumor about a Riedmayer survivor is true. Only they can appease that volcano wrath.�

entries.source: 후우. 지금은 그저 부지런히 일할 때야.�
entries.translation: Phew. Right now, all we can do is work hard.�

entries.source: 예전보다 어려워 졌다곤 하지만 우리에겐 이 일밖에 없으니까.�
entries.translation: Things are tougher than before, but this is the only job we have got.�
A union? I do not even have to ask whose idea that was.�

entries.source: 광부들이 모여봤자 뭐 할 수 있는 일은 없다고.�
entries.translation: What can a bunch of miners achieve by gathering together?�

entries.source: 광산조합과 협상한다고 해도 무슨 수로 우리 말을 듣게 할거야?�
entries.translation: Even if we negotiate with the mining association, how do we make them listen?�

entries.source: 관둬, 관둬. 광산조합의 용병은 몬스터만 잡으라고 고용된게 아냐.�
entries.translation: Forget it, just forget it. The mining association mercs are not hired just to hunt monsters.�

entries.source: 아무리 광부라고 해도 칼질 하는 애들은 못 당해.�
entries.translation: Miners cannot stand a chance against trained blades.�

entries.source: 하긴... 다 같이 일을 안하면 조합에서도 좀 긴장하려나.�
entries.translation: True... if everyone stops working, the association might get nervous.�
Especially during peak season like now...�

entries.source: 그런데 정말 그래도 되는 건가? 난 잘 모르겠군.�
entries.translation: Will that really work, though? I am not so sure.�
Well, either way, I can at least give you my signature.�

entries.source: 나도 처음엔 안믿었지만.. }북서쪽{에 지진으로 무너진 갱도가 있는데, 거기에 몇 개월 전부터 누군가 살고 있데.�
entries.translation: I did not believe it at first either, but someone is been living in the collapsed shaft to the }northwest{ for months.�

entries.source: 그가 목격되기 시작한 뒤로 화산의 분노는 가라앉았어. 그거면 얘기 끝난거지!�
entries.translation: Ever since they were spotted, the volcano calmed down. That proves it!�
The survivor of House Riedmayer is real.�

entries.source: 광산 협회란 놈들은 지금 현장이 어떤 상황인지 전혀 모르고 있어.�
entries.translation: Those bastards in the mining association have no clue what is happening on site.�

entries.source: 그나마 최근에는 지진이 없어서 좀 줄었지만, 갱도 안의 생물들은 점점 더 위험해지고 있다고.�
entries.translation: Earthquakes stopped recently so it calmed down a bit, but the beasts in the shaft are getting more dangerous.�

entries.source: 노조? 그런 이야기를 주워 섬기는 친구가 있었지.�
entries.translation: A union? Yeah, some guy was babbling about that.�

entries.source: 이렘에서 왔다고 하는 것 같던데. 그쪽 동네 사람들은 혁명가 기질이 너무 넘친다니까.�
entries.translation: Said he is from Irem. Folks from over there are way too full of revolutionary nonsense.�

entries.source: 그걸 만들면 뭐가 좋은데? 밥이 나와? 떡이 나와?�
entries.translation: What good does making that do? Will it feed us or put food on the table?�
What is the point of doing that?�

entries.source: 젊은 친구, 좋은 걸 하나 알려줄까?�
entries.translation: Young man, want a piece of advice?�

entries.source: 자기 노하우는 아무한테도 알려주지 마. 그래야 내가 남들보다 잘하고, 그래야 안 짤려.�
entries.translation: Never share your know-how with anyone. That is how you stay better than the rest and keep your job.�

entries.source: 흠... 가능할까? 가능하다면야 서명 정도야 해주지.�
entries.translation: Hmm... is that even possible? If it is, I guess I could sign it.�

entries.source: 아무도 이해해 주지 않아도 나는 끝까지 싸울거야.�
entries.translation: Even if no one understands, I will fight to the bitter end.�
That makes four of us, including me.�

entries.source: 소소한 출발이지만... 작은 것부터라도 바꿔 보겠어.�
entries.translation: It is a humble start, but... we will begin by changing the small things.�

entries.source: 남에게 기대지 않고 우리 스스로의 힘으로 말이야.�
entries.translation: Through our own strength, without relying on others.�

entries.source: 일이 잘 풀리면 뭐라도 한 턱 내지.�
entries.translation: If things go well, I will treat you to something nice.�

entries.source: 광산조합에는 쓰레기 같은 놈들 뿐이야. 어떻게든 우리들을 쥐어짜서 지들 이익 낼 생각 뿐이지.�
entries.translation: The mining association is full of trash. They only care about squeezing us dry for their own profit.�

entries.source: ...뭐 카운터의 아가씨는 빼고. 자주 이야기 하는데 내 생각에 관심이 많은 것 같아.�
entries.translation: ...Well, except the lady at the counter. We chat often, and she seems interested in my ideas.�
|(I do not think that is quite it...){�

entries.source: 옷차림을 보니 외지인인가 보군. 용병인가? 광산조합에서 고용한?�
entries.translation: Looking at your outfit, you are an outsider. A merc hired by the mining association?�

entries.source: 진짜라면 부탁하고 싶은 일이 하나 있는데.�
entries.translation: If that is true, I have a favor to ask.�

entries.source: 아까부터 이것저것 캐묻고 다니는 것 같던데, 그렇다면 광산조합의 횡포에 대해서도 좀 들었겠지.�
entries.translation: You seem to have been asking around. Then you must have heard about the Mining Union tyranny.�

entries.source: 나는 그 상황을 바꾸고 싶어. 리드마이어의 생존자 같은 불확실한 것이 아니라, 나의, 우리의 힘으로.�
entries.translation: I want to change this. Not by clinging to rumors of Radmayer survivors, but by our own strength.�

entries.source: 구체적으로는 광부들의 길드... 광산이 아니라 광부의 조합 같은 걸 만들려고 해.�
entries.translation: Specifically, a miners guild... a union for the miners, not the mine owners.�

entries.source: 광부들이 단체로 행동할 수 있으면 임금이나, 휴식이나, 근무 환경 개선 같은 것을 주장할 수 있을거야.�
entries.translation: If the miners act together, we can demand better wages, rest, and working conditions.�

entries.source: 하지만 조합에서도 이런 걸 눈치채고 용병을 붙여서 날 감시하고 있단 말이야.�
entries.translation: But the syndicate caught on and hired mercenaries to keep watch on me.�

entries.source: 흥, 그렇다면 들려줄 이야기는 없다. 갱도에 있는 몬스터나 잘 처리하시지?�
entries.translation: Hmph, then I have got nothing to tell you. Why do not you go deal with the monsters in the shaft?�

entries.source: 그래서... 외지인인데다가, 나이도 어려보이고, 용병인 자네라면 저쪽에서도 그다지 의심을 하지 않을거야.�
entries.translation: So... as an outsider, young-looking, and a mercenary, they will not suspect you much.�

entries.source: 나 대신 다른 광부들을 만나서 설득해 주지 않겠나?�
entries.translation: Could you meet with the other miners and persuade them for me?�
All you need is to get their signatures to form a labor union.�

entries.source: 귀찮은 짐을 떠넘기는 것 같아서 미안하군.�
entries.translation: I am sorry to burden you with such a troublesome task.�
We need at least three people.�

entries.source: 지금부터는 설득에 필요한 말이니까 잘 들어둬.�
entries.translation: Listen carefully, as this is what you will need to persuade them.�

entries.source: 왜 조합이 필요한지 이해하지 못하는 사람도 많을 거야.�
entries.translation: Many will not understand why a union is necessary.�

entries.source: 고용주라는 입장을 이용해서 일방적으로 착취하는 광산조합에 대등한 입장을 가지는 것이 첫 목적이야.�
entries.translation: Our primary goal is to stand on equal footing against the syndicate exploiting us.�

entries.source: 조합을 만들어서 단체로 행동하게 되면 우리가 광산조합에게 압력을 가할 수 있어.�
entries.translation: By organizing and acting collectively, we can put pressure on the Mining Union.�

entries.source: 우리 처지를 개선하려는 거야. <임금 인상{이나 <근무 여건을 개선{하려고 해.�
entries.translation: It is to improve our lot: <higher wages{ and <better working conditions{.�

entries.source: 말한다고 들어주겠냐... 싶겠지. 하지만 단체가 되면 힘이 생겨.�
entries.translation: They might wonder if anyone will listen... but there is strength in numbers.�

entries.source: 우리가 <단체로 파업을 하겠다거나{ 하면 광산조합에서도 무시하지는 못할거야.�
entries.translation: If we threaten to <go on strike together{, the syndicate will not be able to ignore us.�

entries.source: 지금의 공화국은 우리를 챙겨주지 않는다고. 스스로 살아야 해.�
entries.translation: The Republic will not look after us now. We must fend for ourselves.�
...does not look like ruins, does it?�

entries.source: 목소리가 울리는 정도를 보니.. 엄청나게 깊은 동굴이야.�
entries.translation: Judging by the echo... this is an incredibly deep cavern.�

entries.source: 둘.. 계승자가 둘이야..! 그리고.. 싸우고 있어!�
entries.translation: Two... there are two Successors...! And... they are fighting!�
No time for sightseeing. Let us move!�

entries.source: 슈르츠님, 그쪽이 아니야! 점점 멀어지고 있어, 계승자의 느낌으로부터..�
entries.translation: Schultz, not that way! You are moving away from the Successor presence...!�
I am sorry, but... this is the end.�

entries.source: 그걸 막는 것이 나의 사명이다. 그리고.. 이미 승부는 난 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Stopping that is my mission. And... this fight is already decided.�

entries.source: 돌아가라. 난.. 너희를 죽이고 싶지 않아.�
entries.translation: Turn back. I... do not want to kill you.�

entries.source: 아직이야.. 나는.. 아직 지지 않았어..! }최후의 수단{이 남아있다..�
entries.translation: Not yet... I have not... lost yet! I still have a }last resort{...!�

entries.source: 제발 돌아가..!! 난 너희를 지켜주고 싶은 거다!�
entries.translation: Please, turn back!! I want to protect you!�

entries.source: 사명을 위해서는 그런 어린 아이들까지 때려 눕혀야 하나?�
entries.translation: Must you beat down mere children for the sake of your mission?�

entries.source: 내가 원한것이 아니야.. 단지 내 사명을 위해선..�
entries.translation: I never wanted this... It is only for my mission...�

entries.source: 웨이드 가문이.. 듣는 자들이 돌아올거다. 너 혼자서는 그 사명을 다할 수 없어.�
entries.translation: House Wade... The Listeners will return. You cannot fulfill that duty alone.�

entries.source: 그렇다면.. 그걸로 좋다. 마지막까지 이곳을 지키다가 죽는다면.. 적어도 가문의 명예는 지킬 수 있겠지.�
entries.translation: Then... so be it. If I die defending this place to the end... I will at least preserve my family honor.�

entries.source: 어차피 내가 지켜야 할 진정한 무언가를 되찾지 못한다면, 그것도 좋아..�
entries.translation: If I cannot reclaim what truly matters to me anyway, then so be it...�

entries.source: 헛소리 하지 말아, 그건 그냥 망령이다! 이미 없어져 버린, 가문의 망령!�
entries.translation: Stop talking nonsense! That is just a ghost! A ghost of a house that is already gone!�

entries.source: 그렇다면 내가 부숴주지, 그 쓸데없는 의무감 따위!�
entries.translation: Then I will shatter it for you-that pointless sense of duty!�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: 와.. 여기, 덥잖아? 북쪽으로 온 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Whoa... it is hot here, is not it? I thought we headed north...�

entries.source: 아냐. 여기가 더운 건.. 이 섬이 화산섬이기 때문이야.�
entries.translation: No. It is hot here... because this is a volcanic island.�

entries.source: 아무래도 아까 그 동굴은.. 바다를 건너는 해저 동굴인 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Seems like that cave earlier... was a subsea cavern crossing the ocean.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 강림자의 유적이 왜 이곳으로 이어져 있는거지?�
entries.translation: Still... why would the Descendant Ruins lead here?�

entries.source: 이 섬은 .. 버려진 섬이야. 아니, 인간이 아직 뭘 해보지 못한 섬이라고 해야 하나.�
entries.translation: This is an abandoned isle... Or rather, one untouched by mankind.�

entries.source: 뭔가가 있다고 해도 이상할건 없지만.. 설마 콜크리크 섬과 해저 동굴로 이어져있다니..�
entries.translation: Finding something here is not surprising, but... connected to Cole Creek Isle via subsea cavern...?�
Two successors... They are not far.�
They could not have gotten far yet.�

entries.source: 두 계승자도 서로 멀리 떨어져 있어.. 루퍼스도 아직 크리스를 찾지는 못한 것 같아.�
entries.translation: The two successors are far apart, too... Seems Rufus has not found Chris yet either.�

entries.source: 아무래도 그 남자의 안내가 필요할 것 같군. 루퍼스보다 먼저 그들을 찾아내야 하는데..�
entries.translation: Looks like we need that guy to guide us. We must find them before Rufus does...�

entries.source: 화산섬이니까, 지진이나 화산 활동이 있는 건 당연해..�
entries.translation: It is a volcanic isle, so tremors and volcanic activity are expected...�

entries.source: 설마.. 정말 알렉스가 계승권을 버린 것과 관련 있는 건 아니겠지..?�
entries.translation: Do not tell me... this really has something to do with Alex giving up succession...?�
Either way, let us look for them. Alex and Chris, the siblings...�

entries.source: }티르{ 오빠에게도.. 알려야 되지 않을까? 강림자의 유적을 찾았다고..�
entries.translation: Should not we let }Tyr{ know too? That we found the Descendant Ruins...�

entries.source: 지금 그 남자가 어디에 있을지 모르잖아. 콜크리크 섬에 있다면 좋겠지만..�
entries.translation: We do not even know where he is right now. It would be great if he is still on Cole Creek Isle, but...�

entries.source: }티르 오빠{에게, 그 사람을 만나게 해 줘야 해.�
entries.translation: We have to let }Tyr{ meet that person.�

entries.source: 그러면 좋겠지만.. 그라함이 전달하는 게 늦은건지, 오지 않는군.�
entries.translation: That would be nice, but... either Graham was late delivering the word, or he is not coming.�

entries.source: 기다리자.. 기다리면 꼭 올거야, 티르 오빠는.�
entries.translation: Let us wait... If we wait, Tyr will surely come.�

entries.source: 너.. 티르나 크래드에게 느끼는 감정이 다른 사람에게 느끼는 것과 그렇게 다른 거냐?�
entries.translation: Tell me... are your feelings for Tyr and Krad really that different from how you feel about others?�

entries.source: 그라함에게 듣고 바로 따라왔는데도.. 좀 늦은 것 같군.�
entries.translation: I rushed here as soon as Graham told me... looks like I am still a bit late.�

entries.source: 트라이던트 섬으로 이어지는 육로가 있을 줄이야.. 나는 배로 들어올 만한 곳만 찾았었는데.�
entries.translation: To think an overland path led to Trident Isle... I only searched for spots accessible by boat.�

entries.source: 대충 알아낸 바로는.. 여기가 리드마이어 가문이 지키던 방주라는군.�
entries.translation: From what I have gathered... this is the Ark guarded by House Riedmayr.�

entries.source: 최초의 인간들이 오르비스 군도로 들어올 때 타고왔다고 해.�
entries.translation: They say the first humans came across the Orbis archipelago aboard it.�

entries.source: 인간이? 그런 곳이.. 어째서 강림자의 마법진으로..?�
entries.translation: Humans? Then why... would such a place have a Descendant magic circle...?�
We need to find that out now. Above all...�
The man you are looking for, }Krad{, is in here.�

entries.source: 아니.. 환영만 보였어. 자신은 }방주의 중심{에 있다고..�
entries.translation: No... only an illusion. He said he was at the }center of the Ark{...�
I will not let him get away again.�
You cannot just walk in. Take this with you.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가문의 보안 체계인 것 같아. 네베드의 결계와 비슷하지만.. 이게 있으면 들어갈 수 있다.�
entries.translation: It seems to be House Riedmayr security system. Similar to a Neved barrier... but this lets you through.�

entries.source: 난 다시 찾으면 돼. 어디서 구해야 할지 알고 있으니까 금방 따라 갈 수 있다.�
entries.translation: I can get another. I know where to find one, so I will catch up shortly.�

entries.source: 얼른 또 }고위사도{를 하나 잡아서 }광휘의 열쇠{를 구해야 겠군. 나만 못들어갈 순 없으니까.�
entries.translation: Better go take down another }High Apostle{ and get a }Key of Radiance{. Cannot be left behind.�
We have to enter the ruins.�
Let us wait here... Tyr might come.�
Well then... I am going in.�
Looks like the kids... are safe too.�
You really love dogging my heels, do not you...�

entries.source: 난 네가 여기서 알렉스와 싸우고 있었던 게 더 이해가 안 가는데.�
entries.translation: What I find harder to understand is why you were fighting Alex here.�

entries.source: 숨어지낸다더니, 도대체 뭘 찾아 여기까지 온거냐?�
entries.translation: You said you went into hiding, so what on earth did you come all this way for?�

entries.source: 이 아이들.. }방주{로 가기 위해 온거다. 도대체 어떻게 알았는지 모르겠지만..�
entries.translation: These children... came to reach the }Ark{. I do not know how they found out, but...�
What on earth is this Ark?�

entries.source: 세상에서.. 가장 안전한 장소라고 해야 할까.�
entries.translation: The safest place in the world... you could say.�

entries.source: 가문에 내려오는 말대로라면.. }최초의 인간들{이 오르비스 군도로 올 때 타고왔던 배라고 한다.�
entries.translation: According to our family lore... it is the ship the }first humans{ arrived on in the Orbis Archipelago.�

entries.source: 그래. 네베드들만 살던 이 오르비스 군도에, 인간들이 어디선가 방주를 타고 나타난 거지.�
entries.translation: Yes. In this Orbis Archipelago where only Neveds lived, humans appeared from somewhere aboard the Ark.�

entries.source: 인간들이 모두 내린 후.. 방주는 스스로 봉인되었고, 그 누구의 출입도 허용하지 않았다.�
entries.translation: After all the humans disembarked... the Ark sealed itself and permitted no one to enter.�

entries.source: .. 그 방주가 실제로 이곳에 있다는 건가?�
entries.translation: ...Are you saying that Ark is really here?�

entries.source: 어째서 최초의 인간들이 타고온 방주가.. 강림자의 마법진으로 봉인되어 있었던 거지?�
entries.translation: Why was the ship ridden by the first humans... sealed with a Descendant magic circle?�

entries.source: 역시, 들어가봐야 정답이 보일 것 같군.�
entries.translation: As expected, we will have to go inside to find the answer.�
Has not the seal already been broken?�

entries.source: 이 꼬마들은 그 방주란 곳에서 숨어살기를 원해.�
entries.translation: These kids want to hide out in that Ark.�

entries.source: 나는 그 방주란 것이 강림자들과 어떤 관계가 있는지 알고 싶어.�
entries.translation: And I want to know how that Ark is connected to the Descendants.�

entries.source: 그리고 루퍼스는 이 섬 어딘가에서 눈에 불을 켜고 우릴 찾고 있겠지.�
entries.translation: Besides, Rufus must be searching this island frantically for us.�

entries.source: 마지막으로, 당신은 그 방주란 곳으로 우릴 안내해 줄 수 있는 유일한 사람이야.�
entries.translation: Finally, you are the only one who can guide us to that Ark.�

entries.source: 방주의 입구에 쳐진 결계는 방주의 봉인과는 별개로 우리 가문에서 만든 것이다.�
entries.translation: The barrier at the Ark entrance was erected by my family, separate from the Ark own seal.�

entries.source: 트라이던트 섬에 있는 }고위사도{들이 가지고 있고.. 들어가려는 사람은 모두 그것을 가지고 있어야 한다.�
entries.translation: The }High Apostles{ on Trident Isle carry them... and everyone entering must hold one.�
You made quite a hassle for yourselves...�

entries.source: 그럼 나와, 당신.. 크리스와 티아나 것 까지 4개를 구해오면 되나?�
entries.translation: So I just need to get four: for me, you... Chris, and Tiana?�
Why... are you trying to help us?�

entries.source: 난 계승자가 죽는 걸 원하지 않는 것 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: I just do not want the successor to die.�

entries.source: 버려놓고 가고 싶지만.. 이 섬에는 루퍼스가 있으니까. 지금의 너라면 분명히 죽는다.�
entries.translation: I want to leave you behind, but... Rufus is on this island. As you are now, you will surely die.�
I will go get them. Wait here.�

entries.source: 다행히, 루퍼스는 아직 여길 찾아내지 못하고 헤매고 있는 모양이다.�
entries.translation: Fortunately, it seems Rufus is still wandering about without finding this place.�
He is still... on this island, though...�
Let us hurry. Can we enter?�
Well... first, take one of these each...�

entries.source: 좋아, 결계가 중화된다.. 들어갈 수 있어.�
entries.translation: Good, the barrier is neutralizing... We can go in.�
...Do you intend to enter the Ark?�

entries.source: 뭔가 있을거라고는 생각했지만, 이런 곳에 있다니..!�
entries.translation: I thought there might be something, but to think it was in a place like this...!�

entries.source: 슈르츠님.. 저 사람 본 적 있어? 환영인 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Schultz... Have you seen that person before? Looks like an illusion...�

entries.source: 그래.. 본 적 있지. 그리고 저 자가 여기에 있는 걸 설명하려면, 답은 하나밖에 없어.�
entries.translation: Yeah... I have. And to explain his presence here, there is only one answer.�

entries.source: 당신이 티르가 찾는 사람.. 아니, }강림자{라는 거지.�
entries.translation: You are the one Tyr was looking for... no, a }Descendant{.�

entries.source: 티르가 아직도 날 찾고 있나? 포기할 때도 되었는데.�
entries.translation: Is Tyr still looking for me? It is about time he gave up.�
The only remaining Descendant... His name was }Krad{.�
Krad is Krad, but I would not call that the right answer.�
Then... you mean you are not a Descendant?�
Since you have made it here, I assume you intend to come inside.�

entries.source: 그다지 초대하고 싶지 않은 장소지만.. 들어오면 곧 보게 될거야.�
entries.translation: It is not a place I care to welcome guests, but... once inside, you will see soon enough.�
Just what kind of beings... the Descendants really are.�

entries.source: 슈르츠, 지금 무슨 대화를 하고 있는건가?�
entries.translation: Schultz, who are you talking to right now?�

entries.source: 들어와봤자 너희에게 주어지는 관람시간은 길지 않겠지만.�
entries.translation: Though even if you enter, your visiting time will not be very long.�

entries.source: 방주는 곧 기동하고.. 기동해버린 방주로는 그 누구도 들어올 수 없게 되니까.�
entries.translation: The Ark will activate soon... and once it does, no one will be able to enter.�
Sch... Schultz! This is no time to...!�

entries.source: 당신이 강림자가 아니라면 어째서 강림자의 유적에서 나타나는 거냐.. 방주는 강림자의 유적일텐데.�
entries.translation: If you are not a Descendant, why appear in their ruins? The Ark is a Descendant ruin.�

entries.source: 내가 있어야할 곳에 있는 것 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: I am simply where I belong.�

entries.source: 너희도 너희가 있어야 할 곳에 있는 거지.�
entries.translation: Just as you are where you belong.�
Everything... like that... meshed like cogs.�

entries.source: }방주의 중심{에 있어. 돌아가라고 해도 듣지 않을테니 오는 걸 말리지는 않겠다만..�
entries.translation: In }the heart of the Ark{. I know you will not turn back, so I will not stop you from coming, but...�
...I have a lot to ask you...�
Was that person just now... }Brother Krad{?�

entries.source: 굉장히.. 그리운 기분이 들어. 그 눈빛.. 그 이름..�
entries.translation: I feel such nostalgia... That look in his eyes... That name...�
Now is not the time to get sentimental.�

entries.source: 지금은 그 루퍼스라는 놈들로부터 이 아이들을 지키는 게 우선이니까..�
entries.translation: Right now, protecting these children from Rufus men comes first...�

entries.source: 광휘의 열쇠가 4개 필요하다. 주변에 있는 고위사도가 가지고 있을 거다.�
entries.translation: We need 4 Keys of Radiance. The High Apostles nearby should have them.�

entries.source: 고맙다는 인사를.. 기대하진 마. 부상만 아니었으면..�
entries.translation: Do not expect... a thank you. If it were not for this injury...�

entries.source: EVENT_일반대사. 크래드가 나올지도 모르므로 지키고 있는다.�
entries.translation: EVENT_Standard dialogue. Standing guard in case Krad comes out.�

entries.source: 이런 곳에 자판기라니.. 리드마이어 가에서 설치한 건가?�
entries.translation: A vending machine here...? Did House Riedmayr install it?�

entries.source: 왠지 음침해.. 다른 사람들은 어디로 갔을까?�
entries.translation: It feels so gloomy... Where did the others go?�
They probably headed to the center first. But...�

entries.source: 가장 안전한 장소라고? 꼬마들이 기대한 숨을 장소로는 적합하지 않은 것 같은데.�
entries.translation: The safest place? Does not look like the kind of hiding spot those kids hoped for.�
Anyway, let us head to the center too.�

entries.source: 이나마도 겨우 찾아낸 안전지대야. 매도우힐은 공화국에서 포기한 뒤로 아주 위험한 땅이 되었거든.�
entries.translation: Even this was hard to find as a safe zone. Meadow Hill became dangerous after the Republic abandoned it.�

entries.source: 한때는 제법 큰 도시가 있었다고 들었는데...�
entries.translation: I heard there used to be a fairly large city here...�

entries.source: 그래봤자 네베드의 도시를 점거한 것 뿐이었지. 그나마도 지금은 고대종들에게 빼앗긴 상태고.�
entries.translation: It was merely occupying a Neved city. And even that was taken over by ancients.�
Did you happen to live in Meadow Hill when you were young?�
No. First time here in my life.�
By any chance, did you practice swordplay with a }Gladius{ when you were young...?�
What is with the foolish question all of a sudden?�
I did when I was a kid. Never mind, forget it.�

entries.source: 뭐.. 비밀기지치곤 초라하지? 쌓여있는 것들도 거의 티르 대장의 잡동사니들이고..�
entries.translation: Well... pretty humble for a secret base, huh? Most of the clutter belongs to Commander Tyr...�

entries.source: 음, 가끔 }책상 서랍{의 사진들을 보며 추억에 잠기시곤 해. 나름.. 추억이 있는 곳인가봐.�
entries.translation: Well, he sometimes gets lost in thought looking at photos in the }desk drawer{. Must hold memories for him.�

entries.source: 성지에서 볼 일이 끝나면 돌아와. 우리의 날개, 네오 그라함호는 언제나 최상의 상태를 유지하고 있을테니!�
entries.translation: Come back when you are done at the Sanctuary. Our wings, the Neo Graham, will always be in top shape!�

entries.source: 떠돌이 상인이지만 물건은 최상급이라고 자부하고 있어. 골라보라고.�
entries.translation: I may be a traveling merchant, but I pride myself on top-tier goods. Take your pick!�

entries.source: 티르의 조력자들은 소수정예야. 너도 뜻을 함께 하려면 더 강해져야 한다.�
entries.translation: Tyr allies are an elite few. If you share our cause, you will need to grow stronger too.�

entries.source: 항상 수준에 맞는 장비를 유지하지 않으면, 점점 더 강해지는 적들과 대적할 수 없지.�
entries.translation: Unless you keep your gear up to par, you will not survive against the stronger foes ahead.�
Let us head out. Should we go to Cole Creek Isle?�

entries.source: 강림자의 유적을 찾아다녀야지. 그 놈을 잡으려면.�
entries.translation: I need to search the Descendant Ruins. To catch that bastard.�

entries.source: 강림자의 유적은 북쪽 땅에 있다.. 그 정도면 충분해.�
entries.translation: The Descendant Ruins are in the north... That is enough.�

entries.source: 북쪽의 모든 섬을 뒤져서라도.. 그 남자를 찾아낼 거다.�
entries.translation: Even if I have to search every island in the north... I will find him.�
Huh? Master Schultz, what are you looking at?�

entries.source: 티르 오빠는.. 여기서 꽤 자주 머무나봐. 나름대로 살 수 있게 되있네.�
entries.translation: Tyr must stay here pretty often... It is actually quite livable.�
It is certainly far better than sleeping outside.�
|(Still, they look so alike... Who is she?)�

entries.source: 성지로 가려면.. 일단 }네베드의 결계{를 해제해야 해.�
entries.translation: To reach the Sanctuary... we must first dispel the }Neved Barrier{.�

entries.source: 네베드의 결계란 건.. 얼어붙은 바다에 있던 것과 같은 건가?�
entries.translation: The Neved Barrier... Is it like the one at the Frozen Sea?�

entries.source: 그래. 좀 더 넓은 범위에 쳐져있긴 하지만..�
entries.translation: Yes. Though it covers a much wider area...�
Then we will need a Soulstone.�

entries.source: 이 근처에서는 영혼석을 구할 수 없어. 대신 악령들로부터 }영혼가루{를 구할 수 있지.�
entries.translation: Soulstones cannot be found nearby. But you can get }Soul Powder{ from evil spirits.�

entries.source: 영혼석 만큼의 힘을 내려면, 좀 많이 필요할 거야. 모아서 }남동쪽 선착장{으로 와.�
entries.translation: To match a Soulstone power, you will need a lot. Gather it and head to the }southeast pier{.�

entries.source: 그곳에, 결계를 해제할 수 있는 포인트가 있다.�
entries.translation: That is where the point to dispel the barrier is.�

entries.source: 자주 왔다갔다 했다면서, 좀 모아둔 것도 없나?�
entries.translation: You come here often, have not you saved any up?�

entries.source: 난 이미 이 결계에 면역이니까. 다른 사람과 함께 가는 건 처음이다. 귀찮아도 어쩔 수 없어.�
entries.translation: I am already immune to this barrier. It is my first time taking anyone along. Bear with it.�
Then I will have Graham ready the boat.�

entries.source: 묘하군. 서로를 믿고 의지하는 인간과 네베드라..�
entries.translation: How strange. A human and a Neved relying on and trusting each other...�
Seems like a bond that was never meant to be.�

entries.source: 어째서..? 종족이 다르면.. 사랑할 수 없다고 생각해?�
entries.translation: Why...? Do you think... different races cannot love each other?�

entries.source: 아니, 그런건 아니야.. 그런 건, 상관없다고 생각해.�
entries.translation: No, that is not it... I do not think that matters.�

entries.source: 인연의 깊이가 깊다면.. 종족 따위가 마음을 막을 수는 없겠지.�
entries.translation: If a bond runs deep enough... difference in race cannot stand in its way.�
Do you... really have feelings for that man...?�

entries.source: 아냐, 난 그냥.. 티르 오빠가 행복해졌으면.. 해서. 그리고..�
entries.translation: No, I just... want Tyr to be happy... That is all. And...�

entries.source: 사랑할 수 없어. 종족이란 건 그리 낮은 장벽이 아니거든.�
entries.translation: They cannot. Race is not an easy barrier to cross.�

entries.source: 겉모습이 비슷하다해도, 서로 다른 존재라는 건 변함이 없는 거야.�
entries.translation: Even if appearances are similar, the fact remains they are different beings.�
So you... might want to give up on Tyr right about now...�

entries.source: 무.. 무슨 뜻이야? 그런 거 아니라니깐!�
entries.translation: Wh-What do you mean? It is really not like that!�

entries.source: |(마법 결계 때문에.. 배를 띄울 수 없다.)�
entries.translation: |(Because of the magic barrier... we cannot launch the boat.)�

entries.source: 수호자의 결계를 통과하려면 악령들로부터 }영혼가루{를 모아와야 해.�
entries.translation: To pass the Guardian barrier, gather }Soul Powder{ from the evil spirits.�

entries.source: 영혼석 만큼의 힘을 내려면, 좀 많이 필요할 거야.�
entries.translation: To match the power of a Soulstone, we will need quite a lot.�
|(Should I ask about that... girl photo...?)�
She looks... like me...? Who... is she?�

entries.source: 남의 사생활이나 뒤지고 있을 시간이 있나? 급하다고 한 것은 너다.�
entries.translation: Do you have time to snoop through other people privacy? You said you were in a hurry.�
She just looks like her. That is all.�

entries.source: 내가 지켜주지 못해 죽었고.. 이 정도면 되나?�
entries.translation: I failed to protect her, and she died... Is that enough?�

entries.source: 지금은 자신의 일이나 신경써. 거듭 말하지만.. 난 그 당시의 기억을 다시 생각하고 싶지 않아.�
entries.translation: Focus on your own affairs for now. I repeat... I have no wish to relive those memories.�
She looks... like me? Who is... this person?�

entries.source: }엘렌{이라고 써있어.. 닮은 정도가 아니라 머리색만 빼면..�
entries.translation: It says }Ellen{... She does not just look like me, aside from hair color...�
A friend little sister. She died during the Sanctuary War...�

entries.source: 내가 지켜주지 못한 소중한 사람들 중 한명이지. 이 정도면 되나?�
entries.translation: One of the precious people I failed to protect. Is that enough?�

entries.source: 좋아.. 이제 특별한 일이 없는 한 너도 이 포인트를 통해 성지로 갈 수 있을거야.�
entries.translation: Good... Barring unusual circumstances, you should now be able to reach the Sanctuary through this point.�

entries.source: 선주종의 성지 따위에 다시 올 일이 있을지는 모르겠지만.�
entries.translation: Not sure why I would ever need to return to some progenitor sanctuary, though.�
Master Schultz, you should call them Neved.�

entries.source: 네가 진심으로 웨이드 가와 맞서려면, 네베드를 존중해야 할거야.�
entries.translation: If you truly intend to oppose House Wade, you must respect the Neved.�
I will keep that in mind.�

entries.source: |(아, 그래.. 렌이 없을 때.. 그 소녀의 사진에 대해 물어볼까..?)�
entries.translation: |(While Ren is away, should I ask about that photo of the girl?)�
Wait... I have something to ask.�

entries.source: 렌이 있을 땐 못 물어봤지만.. 이런 사진을 찾았는데.�
entries.translation: I could not ask while Ren was around... but I found this photo.�

entries.source: 혹시 이게.. 녀석이 당신을 오빠라고 부르는 것과 관계가 있나?�
entries.translation: Does this have anything to do with why she calls you brother?�
This girl is... }Ellen{. The younger sister of someone I knew.�
And...? Why does she look so much like Ren?�

entries.source: 하지만 이미 죽었어. 성지전쟁 때.. 나도, }크래드{도 그녀를 지켜주지 못했다.�
entries.translation: She is already dead, though. During the Sanctuary War... neither I nor }Krad{ could protect her.�

entries.source: 솔직히 말하면, 렌이 날 부를 때마다 놀라곤 해.�
entries.translation: To be honest, it startles me every time Ren calls me that.�

entries.source: 머리 색을 빼고는.. 완전히 똑같거든. 그 당시의 엘렌과..�
entries.translation: Aside from hair color... she is identical. Identical to Ellen back then...�

entries.source: 렌이.. 엘렌이라는 소녀의 환생이라도 된다고 생각하나?�
entries.translation: Do you think Ren... is Ellen reincarnation?�

entries.source: 설마. 죽은 자를 살릴 수 있는 기술은 고대신에게도, 강림자에게도 없어.�
entries.translation: Hardly. Neither Ancient Gods nor Descendants possessed the power to raise the dead.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 왠지 그녀를 만든 것이 엘렌을 아는 자일 것 같다는 예감은 든다.�
entries.translation: Still... I suspect whoever created her must have known Ellen.�
Ah... What is wrong with my body...?�
You never get motion sickness. What is wrong?�
I do not know... I am shivering all over... and losing strength...�
...So spirits truly do contain }cells of the Ancient Gods{.�

entries.source: 수호자 }루레인{의 힘이야. 그녀의 영향권 내에선, 듣는 자들도 힘을 못쓰지.�
entries.translation: It is the power of the Guardian }Lurain{. Within her domain, even Hearers lose their strength.�
Then does that mean I am...�

entries.source: 일단 숨어. 이대로는.. 걷지도 못할 것 같은데.�
entries.translation: Hide for now. At this rate... you will not even be able to walk.�

entries.source: 아니야. 꼭 고대신의 것이 아니더라도.. 마법적인 힘은 이곳에서 대체로 제한받게 되니까..�
entries.translation: No. Even if it is not of the Ancient Gods... magical powers are largely suppressed here...�

entries.source: .. 하지만 이곳.. 성지라고 하기엔 좀 난잡하군.�
entries.translation: ...Still, calling this place a Sanctuary feels like a stretch. It is quite chaotic.�

entries.source: 아니, 이상하게 고대종의 개체수가 많은 거야.�
entries.translation: No, there are simply an unusually high number of ancient species here.�

entries.source: 배를 타고 들어올 때 조용하더니, 성지로 총공격 중인 것 같군..�
entries.translation: It was quiet when we sailed in, but it seems they are launching a full assault on the Sanctuary...�

entries.source: 아무래도 급박한 상황인 것 같다. 먼저 갈테니, 섬의 중심에 있는 }수호자의 거점{에서 만나도록 하지.�
entries.translation: Things look urgent. I will go ahead, so meet me at the }Guardian Base{ in the center of the island.�

entries.source: 수호자의 거점에 들어가려면 }4개의 수호석{을 활성화시켜서 너를 인식시켜야 돼. 어려운 과정은 아니니까 혼자 올 수 있을거다.�
entries.translation: To enter the Guardian Base, you must activate the }4 Wardstones{ to register yourself. It is not difficult, so you can make it alone.�

entries.source: 이 정도 숫자면 거점도 위험할 지 몰라. 루레인을 도와줘야 해.�
entries.translation: With numbers like this, the base might be in danger too. I need to help Lurain.�
Understood. I will catch up shortly.�
Wait... You should go with Tyr.�
You two... seem to care a great deal for each other.�

entries.source: 소중한 친구다. 최악의 시간을 함께 이겨냈던..�
entries.translation: She is a precious friend. We endured the worst of times together...�
A human and a Neved... What a curious pair.�

entries.source: 어린애 같은 생각이군. 감상적인 생각이나 하고 있을 때가 아니야.�
entries.translation: Childish thinking. Now is hardly the time for sentimentality.�

entries.source: 그 악몽의 주인과, 그를 이용하려는 미친 인간들을 박멸하기 전까지.. 내 개인적인 감정은 되살아나지 않을거다.�
entries.translation: Until that nightmare master and the mad humans trying to use it are eradicated... my personal feelings will not return.�

entries.source: 나는 공화국에서.. 그녀는 성지에서 할 수 있는 것을 할 뿐..�
entries.translation: I do what I can in the Republic... and she does what she can in the Sanctuary...�
Phew... What was that, like being drawn to something...�

entries.source: 끝도 없네.. 이 정도의 싸움은 오랜만인걸..!�
entries.translation: They are endless... It has been a while since a fight like this...!�

entries.source: 무슨 일이지? 이 정도의 습격을 해오다니..�
entries.translation: What is going on? To launch an attack of this scale...�

entries.source: 악몽의 주인이.. 뭔가가 자신을 위협한다고 판단했어요.�
entries.translation: The master of the nightmare... determined that something was threatening it.�
Yet there were no unusual signs before...�
Could it be... because of the Successor...?�
Lurain, put up a barrier around that boy!�
...If we were not, we would have died long ago.�
Yes. I wanted you... to examine him.�

entries.source: .. 모험을 하셨군요. 덕분에 고생했으니, 도와준 것에 대한 감사는 하지 않겠어요.�
entries.translation: ...You took a gamble. Since it caused so much trouble, I will not thank you for helping.�
Yeah. Do not worry about it.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 무엇을 확인할 수 있죠? 이 소년은.. 그냥 인간일 뿐이잖아요.�
entries.translation: But... what can I confirm? This boy... is just a human.�
This Successor... is a bit different.�

entries.source: 부르지 않으면 여기까지 온 의미가 없잖아.�
entries.translation: If you do not call her, there was no point coming all this way.�

entries.source: 루레인, 이 아이가 결계의 영향을 안받도록 부탁해.�
entries.translation: Lurain, please make sure the barrier does not affect her.�

entries.source: 정령이야. 다른 계승자들의 정령과 달리, 강력한 실체화 에너지를 가지고 있어.�
entries.translation: She is a Spirit. Unlike the others, she possesses powerful materialization energy.�

entries.source: 그 힘의 기원을.. 알아낼 수 있겠나?�
entries.translation: Can you determine... the origin of that power?�

entries.source: 당신의 추측대로에요. 정령은.. 고대신의 세포를 기반으로 하고 있습니다..�
entries.translation: It is as you suspected. The Spirit... is based on the cells of the Ancient God...�

entries.source: 그럼.. 역시 저는 고대신이 }부활의 열쇠{로 만든 존재인가요?�
entries.translation: Then... was I really created as a }key to revival{ for the Ancient God?�

entries.source: 하지만.. 그렇다면 어째서 놈이 이들을 적으로 간주한거지?�
entries.translation: But... if so, why did that thing see them as enemies?�

entries.source: 이들을 숨겼더니 고대종들의 습격이 멈췄어. 놈이 정령을 위협으로 느낀건 틀림 없잖아?�
entries.translation: Hiding them stopped the assault of the ancient beasts. Surely it perceived the Spirit as a threat?�

entries.source: 먼 길 온 보람이 없는 대답이군.�
entries.translation: Not much of an answer after such a long journey.�
However, you can ask it directly.�

entries.source: 이들을 그것과 직접 접촉시키면.. 악몽의 주인도 뭔가 반응하겠죠. 저는 그 목소리를 들을 수 있어요.�
entries.translation: If they make direct contact with it... the Lord of Nightmares will react. And I can hear that voice.�
You want to send them to the }center of the seal{?�

entries.source: 제가 어느정도는 보호해 줄 수 있어요. 결계 내에서는.. 악몽의 주인도 서툰 짓을 할 수는 없으니까.�
entries.translation: I can protect them to an extent. Inside the barrier... even the Lord of Nightmares cannot act recklessly.�

entries.source: 이해가 가게 말을 해줘. 설마 우리를, 신과 대면시켜주겠다는 건 아니겠지?�
entries.translation: Make sense. You are not saying you will put us face-to-face with a god, are you?�

entries.source: 비슷해요. 악몽의 주인이 봉인된 바로 그곳으로 가는 거니까.�
entries.translation: Close to it. You will be going right where the Lord of Nightmares is sealed.�
Hey, was this part of the plan?�

entries.source: 지금 정령이.. 어떤 존재인지 명확히 알 수 있는 존재는, 악몽의 주인 뿐입니다.�
entries.translation: Right now... only the Lord of Nightmares truly knows what the Spirit really is.�
All we have ever done is guess...�

entries.source: 명확한 답을 얻기 위한 최후의 방법이다.. 그건 알고 있어.�
entries.translation: It is the last resort to get a clear answer... I know that.�

entries.source: 안돼요, 티르. 인원이 많아지면 결계의 효율만 낮아질 뿐이니까요.�
entries.translation: No, Tyr. More people will only weaken the barrier efficiency.�

entries.source: 그리고.. 그들이 봉인의 중심지에 들어서면 아까 같은 습격이 또 있을지 몰라요.�
entries.translation: And... once they enter the center of the seal, another attack like before might happen.�

entries.source: 역시.. 이건 너무 위험해. 저들은 악몽의 주인과 만나기엔 아직..�
entries.translation: It is still too dangerous. They are not ready to face the Lord of Nightmares...�

entries.source: 티르 오빠, 우리 걱정은 하지 마.�
entries.translation: Tyr, do not worry about us.�

entries.source: 진실을 알 수 있는 유일한 방법이라면.. 전 할거예요.�
entries.translation: If it is the only way to know the truth... I will do it.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 나도 동감이야. 세계를 뒤돌며 찾아헤매던 답이 바로 앞에 있는데 위험하다고 피해갈 생각은 없어.�
entries.translation: Still... I agree. The answer we searched the whole world for is right in front of us. I will not run away just because it is dangerous.�
Besides, the Guardian says it is fine, right?�
You are... a truly strong woman, Lurain.�
Did it take you this long to realize?�

entries.source: 제가 여기서 최대한 봉인을 컨트롤 해볼테니까.. 다녀오세요. 입구는 북쪽에 있어요.�
entries.translation: I will control the seal from here as much as I can... Go on. The entrance is to the north.�

entries.source: 안에는 성지전쟁 때의 마물들이 좀 남아있을 거예요.�
entries.translation: There may still be monsters left inside from the Sanctuary War.�

entries.source: 고대신은 간섭할 수 없겠지만.. 혹시나 위험한 낌새가 느껴지면 바로 돌아오도록 해요.�
entries.translation: The Ancient God cannot interfere, but... if you sense any danger, return immediately.�

entries.source: 이제 렌은 .. 괜찮은 건가? 이 안에서도.�
entries.translation: Is Ren... really all right now? Even inside there?�

entries.source: 네. 면역체를 심어두었으니, 평소와 다를 것 없을 거예요.�
entries.translation: Yes. I implanted the immunity, so it will be no different than usual.�

entries.source: ... 진짜.. 듣고 싶은 대답은 따로 있죠?�
entries.translation: ...There is another answer you really want to hear, is not there?�

entries.source: 케프네스가 아니라, 엘렌의 세포에서 배양된 존재예요. 저 아이..�
entries.translation: That child... was cultured from Ellen cells, not Cefnes.�

entries.source: 마음을 굳게 먹으세요. 강대한 힘은 언제나 그에 상응하는 의지를 필요로 합니다.�
entries.translation: Steel your resolve. Great power always demands equal will.�
It worked... That is why Lurain is...�

entries.source: 하아.. 하아.. 크.. 흑.. 괘.. 괜찮아요..�
entries.translation: Haa... haa... ugh... I-I am fine...�
I told you it was too dangerous... You idiot...�

entries.source: 어떻게 된거지? 위험한 건.. 우리가 아니었나?�
entries.translation: What happened? Were not we the ones in danger?�
Come to think of it, that voice belonged to Lady Lurain...�

entries.source: .. 잠시.. 악몽의 주인과 동화되었던 거야. 너희들이 접촉하는 순간, 놈의 의지를 읽기 위해..�
entries.translation: ...I briefly... attuned with the Lord of Nightmares. The moment you touched it, to read its will...�

entries.source: 신과 동화되다니, 수호자는 그런 것도 가능한가?�
entries.translation: Attuning with a god? Can a Guardian really do that?�
No... It is because... I am an avatar of the Ancient God, too...�

entries.source: 그런 소리 하지마. 지금은 훌륭한 수호자잖아.�
entries.translation: Do not say that. You are a wonderful Guardian now.�
Take a deep breath. You were not corrupted, were you?�

entries.source: .. 묘한 분위기인데 그래, 저 두 사람.�
entries.translation: ...There is definitely something between those two.�
Ren, you heard it too, right?�

entries.source: 네, 하지만.. 무슨 소리인지 잘 정리가 안되요.�
entries.translation: Yes, but... I cannot really make sense of what it meant.�
You are really no help at all...�
She said the ones who created the Spirits were the }Soltian{.�

entries.source: 육신은 고대신의 세포를 기반으로 하지만, 인간의 정신을 얹었다고 했어요. 솔티안의 기술이겠죠.�
entries.translation: She said the physical body is based on the cells of an Ancient God, but imbued with a human spirit. Soltian technology, most likely.�

entries.source: 그 솔티안이라는 건.. 당신들의 역사에 나오는 그건가?�
entries.translation: Those Soltians... are they the ones from your history?�

entries.source: 그래. 고대신을 봉인할 때 하늘에서 내려와 네베드를 도와주었다는 그.. }강림자{다.�
entries.translation: Yes. The ones who came down from the heavens to aid the Neved when sealing the Ancient God... the }Descendants{.�

entries.source: 그럼.. 에블린 언니의 말처럼, 나는 고대신 말고 다른 신이 만들어준...?�
entries.translation: Then... just like Sister Evelyn said, was I made by another god, not an Ancient God...?�
I do not know if this makes any sense, but...�

entries.source: 신이 정령을 만든 것이 아니라.. 정령이 신이 되기 위해 태어난 거예요.�
entries.translation: A god did not create the Spirits... Spirits were born to become gods.�

entries.source: 솔티안은, 고대신에 맞서기 위한 인간의 }신{을 만들고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: The Soltians are creating a human }god{ to stand against the Ancient God.�
Then this must be that bastard doing after all.�

entries.source: .. 지금, 이 땅에 있는 강림자라면, }크래드{ 뿐이죠.�
entries.translation: ...The only Descendant on this land right now is }Krad{.�

entries.source: 기필코 그 놈을 찾아내.. 사지를 절단해 주겠어.�
entries.translation: I will find that bastard no matter what... and tear him limb from limb.�

entries.source: .. 혼자 있게 두세요. 티르의 그 남자에 대한 마음은.. 조금 복잡하니까요.�
entries.translation: ...Leave him be. Tyr feelings toward that man are... rather complicated.�

entries.source: 루레인 언니, 그럼 저는.. 완성되는 게 좋은 걸까요?�
entries.translation: Sister Lurain, then would it... be a good thing if I am completed?�

entries.source: 고대신은 사악한 신이라고 들었어요. 그럼 제가 완성되는 것이..�
entries.translation: I heard the Ancient God was evil. So if I am completed...�
Do not dwell on that too much, Ren.�

entries.source: 자신이 무엇때문에 태어났던지, 자신에게 어떠한 속박이 걸려있던지...�
entries.translation: No matter what you were born for, no matter what shackles bind you...�

entries.source: 그런 것들이 절대로 자신을 지배하지 못하게 하세요.�
entries.translation: Never let such things control who you are.�

entries.source: 말씀 드렸죠? 전 고대신의 분신중에 하나였어요.�
entries.translation: I told you before, did not I? I was once an avatar of the Ancient God.�

entries.source: 처음 알았을 땐 죽고싶었죠. 내 손으로 세계를 파멸시킬지도 모른다는 두려움에 떨기도 했어요.�
entries.translation: When I first found out, I wanted to die. I trembled in fear that my own hands might bring ruin to the world.�

entries.source: 하지만 지금은 고대신의 가장 가까운 곳에서 그를 봉인하고 있죠.�
entries.translation: Yet now, I keep him sealed from the place closest to him.�

entries.source: 태어난 이상.. 당신이 태어난 이유는 당신이 만드는 겁니다.�
entries.translation: Now that you are born... the reason for your existence is yours to forge.�

entries.source: 당신들은.. 대체 얼마나 많은 고난을 넘어온 거지?�
entries.translation: Just how many hardships... did you people have to overcome?�

entries.source: 저희가 넘었다면.. 당신들도 넘을 수 있을 거예요.�
entries.translation: If we overcame them... then you will be able to as well.�

entries.source: 솔티안이 만들고자 한 것은 }인간의 신{.. 결국 모든 것은 인간에게 달렸습니다.�
entries.translation: What the Soltians sought to make was a }god of humanity{... In the end, everything rests upon humanity.�

entries.source: 완성할 것인지, 말 것인지, 완성한다면 어떻게 사용할 것인지..�
entries.translation: Whether to complete it or not, and how to use it once completed...�

entries.source: 모두, 당신들- 계승자들의 선택이 될 겁니다.�
entries.translation: All of it will be your choice-the choice of the Successors.�
Be prepared for... the resolve it demands.�

entries.source: 티르 이외의 인간은 오랜만이군.. 티르 일당들에겐 여러가지로 도움을 받고 있어.�
entries.translation: It has been a while since I have seen a human other than Tyr... We owe Tyr group quite a lot.�

entries.source: 그들을 보고 있으면.. 옛날처럼 네베드와 인간이 화합하는 것도 가능할 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Looking at them... it feels like harmony between Neved and humans might truly be possible, just like in the old days...�

entries.source: 티르님의 친구라면 환영이에요. 뭐 필요한 거라도? 인간쪽 화폐도 괜찮아요.�
entries.translation: Any friend of Lord Tyr is welcome here. Need anything? Human currency is fine too.�

entries.source: 티르가 데려온 손님이라고 들었는데.. 성지의 마물들을 제법 잘 처리해줬더군.�
entries.translation: I heard you were guests brought by Tyr... You handled the monsters in the Sanctuary quite well.�

entries.source: 간단한 회복 정도는 해줄 수 있어.�
entries.translation: I can provide some basic healing for you.�
Well... seems like it has done.�

entries.source: 번쩍이는 불빛이나 마법진이라도 나올 줄 알았어?�
entries.translation: Did you think there would be flashing lights or magic circles?�

entries.source: 그런 건 다 눈속임이라고. 원래 일류 제작자는 제자리에서 뚝딱 만들어.�
entries.translation: That is all cheap trickery. A true master craftsman whips it up on the spot.�
|(I have my doubts, but let us take his word for it...){�

entries.source: |(그러고 보니, 선주종의 언어로 된 지도를 한 장 가지고 있다...){�
entries.translation: |(Come to think of it, I have a map written in the ancient language...){�

entries.source: 우리 말로 쓰여진 문서? 한 번 보지.�
entries.translation: A document written in our tongue? Let me see.�
This... looks more like research notes than a map.�

entries.source: 우리가 원래 사용하던 소환수는 원래 영체로 구성되어 있어서 거기에 물질적인 장비를 입히는 것은 불가능해.�
entries.translation: The summons we once used were astral bodies, so equipping physical gear to them was impossible.�

entries.source: 하지만 이 문서에는 비슷한 영체로 구성된 장비에 마력을 부여하면 그걸 소환수에게 장비시켜서 능력을 강화할 수 있을지도 모른다는...�
entries.translation: Yet according to this text, imbuing mana into gear made of similar astral matter might let a summon equip it and grow stronger...�

entries.source: 그러고보니 들어본 적이 있긴 하군. 이걸 왜 네가 가지고 있지? 전쟁 중에 빼앗긴 물건 중 하나인가...�
entries.translation: Now that I think about it, I have heard of this. Why do you have it? Was it looted during the war...?�

entries.source: 뭐, 상관 없지. 이 문서 자체가 미완성이기도 하고. 어차피 우리들은 대전 중에 소환수를 다루는 능력을 대부분 상실했어.�
entries.translation: Well, no matter. The document itself is unfinished anyway. Besides, most of us lost the ability to command summons during the Great War.�

entries.source: 아니... 너무 위험해서 포기했다고 하는 쪽이 옳으려나.�
entries.translation: Or rather... it might be more accurate to say we abandoned it because it was too dangerous.�

entries.source: |(영체에 장비 가능한 것이라면 <렌에게도 장비시킬 수 있을 것 같다.){�
entries.translation: |(If it can be equipped to an astral body, <maybe Ren can wear it too.){�
Sounds like too much trouble, so forget it.�

entries.source: 만들어 보려고? 인간에게는 쓸모 없는 물건일텐데?�
entries.translation: You want to craft it? It should be useless to humans.�

entries.source: 왜 이런 데 관심을 가지는지는 모르겠지만... 보자. 굳이 해보겠다면...�
entries.translation: I have no idea why you are interested in this, but... let us see. If you insist on trying...�

entries.source: 이 물건들을 구해오면 일단 시험해 보지.�
entries.translation: Bring me these materials, and I will at least test it.�

entries.source: 이곳은 악몽의 주인을 봉인하고 있는 곳이자.. 네베드의 마법력, 그 근원이지.�
entries.translation: This place seals the Master of Nightmares... and serves as the very source of Neved magic.�

entries.source: 루레인님의 가호가 없으면 아무도 들어갈 수 없는 곳이야.�
entries.translation: No one can enter without Lady Lurain blessing.�

entries.source: 봉인의 중심에는 잡스러운 것들 뿐이니 별 일 없을거야. 대신 악몽의 주인에게는 절대 긴장감을 늦추지 마라.�
entries.translation: There are only lesser fiends around the seal center, so you will be fine. But never let your guard down against the Master of Nightmares.�

entries.source: 사실.. 정말 위험한 건 너희가 아니지만..�
entries.translation: Though in truth... the ones truly in danger are not you...�

entries.source: 티르랑 그라함을 빼고는 다른 사람은 오랜만에 보는데...�
entries.translation: Aside from Tyr and Graham, it has been a long time since I saw another person...�
Is there something I can help you with?�
Monstrous... Is this the Master of Nightmares...?!�
That is... nothing more than discarded flesh of an ancient god...�

entries.source: 저 강대한 존재가.. 우리가 싸워야 할 적..�
entries.translation: Such a colossal entity... is the enemy we must fight...�

entries.source: 나는.. 저 존재에 맞설 또다른 신으로 완성되기 위해 만들어진..�
entries.translation: I was... created to become another god to face that existence...�

entries.source: 뭔가.. 들은 거야? 고대신의 목소리를 들었어?�
entries.translation: Did you... hear something? Did you hear the ancient god voice?�

entries.source: 인간이.. 자신의 분신을 버리고 우리를 선택했다고 했어.�
entries.translation: It said humanity... discarded their own avatar and chose us.�
That the }Soltian{ placed humans atop their own remnants...�
What is that supposed to mean...?�
I-I cannot make sense of it either, but anyway...�

entries.source: }솔티안{들이 우리를 만들었대. 자신과 맞서기 위한 새로운 인간의 신으로...�
entries.translation: The }Soltian{ made us. As a new god for humanity, meant to stand against them...�

entries.source: 좋아, 정리는 나가서 하자. 아무래도 조짐이 이상해..!�
entries.translation: Alright, let us figure it out outside. Something feels off here...!�

entries.source: 후우.. 이곳이, 오르비스 군도 최악의 존재가 봉인된 곳인가..�
entries.translation: Phew... So this is where the worst evil in the Orbis Archipelago is sealed...�

entries.source: 이상할 건 없지. 어쩌면 네 창조자가 있을지도 모르는 곳이니.�
entries.translation: Not surprising. Your creator might very well be here.�

entries.source: 이곳에서 무서운 일을 겪은 것 같은 기분이 들어..�
entries.translation: I feel like something terrible happened to me here...�

entries.source: 정신차려. 티르에게 자신 있게 말하고 들어온 거잖아.�
entries.translation: Pull yourself together. You were so confident when you told Tyr before coming in.�

entries.source: 더 이상 이유도 목적도 없이 헤맬 순 없다고. 여기서 해답을 못찾으면 평생 못 찾는다는 각오로 움직여야 해.�
entries.translation: We cannot wander without reason or purpose anymore. If we cannot find answers here, we never will. Steel yourself.�

entries.source: 무엇보다.. 신을 만나러 가는 거니까. 마음 단단히 먹어.�
entries.translation: Above all... we are going to meet a god. Stay sharp.�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: 혹시.. 저 섬에 대해 뭔가 떠오른 것이 있나?�
entries.translation: Did you... remember anything about that island?�

entries.source: 처음 와봤다고 했잖아. 이런 걸 속일 이유가 있나?�
entries.translation: I told you this is my first time here. What reason would I have to lie?�

entries.source: 아무것도 모른다면.. 그대로 살아가도 변하는 건 없다..�
entries.translation: If you know nothing... continuing on changes nothing...�

entries.source: 난.. 고대신과 그 종복들에게 내가 살아왔던 모든 삶을 부정당한 적이 있어.�
entries.translation: I... had my entire life denied by an ancient god and its servants.�

entries.source: 그 놈들의 방법은 항상 그런 식이야.. 계획대로 진행시키기 위해서, 다른 모든 걸 망가뜨리지.�
entries.translation: That is always how they operate... They ruin everything else just to keep their plans on track.�
I truly hope... that you two do not end up broken.�

entries.source: 모든 삶을.. 부정당했다고..? 기억조작이라도 당했다는 소린가..?�
entries.translation: His whole life... was denied...? Does that mean his memories were altered...?�

entries.source: 고대신이다 마법이다 매일같이 듣다보니 쓸데없는 상상력만 늘어가는군.�
entries.translation: Listening to talk of ancient gods and magic every day is giving me wild thoughts.�
Tyr... is that a friend name?�

entries.source: 많은 일을 겪은 모양이군, 성지 전쟁에서.�
entries.translation: Looks like you went through a lot during the Sanctuary War.�

entries.source: 그래. 많은 사람을 잃었어. 소중한 사람들을.�
entries.translation: Yeah. I lost many people. People who were dear to me.�

entries.source: 네베드를 이해할 수 있게 되고, 수호자도 알게되고..�
entries.translation: You came to understand the Neved, met the Guardian...�

entries.source: 분명히 얻은 것도 있을 거야. 티르 오빠는 올바른 일을 한 거니까.�
entries.translation: You must have gained something. Because you did the right thing, Tyr.�
Are you... used to calling me that?�
Does... does that make you un... uncomfortable?�

entries.source: 이 녀석이 이름뒤에 붙이는 호칭은 신경쓰지마. 그냥 편한대로 내뱉은 다음에 절대 안바꾸거든.�
entries.translation: Do not mind how she addresses people. She just says whatever feels natural and never changes it.�
If it bothers you... I will stop...�

entries.source: 어이, 내 이름에 님은 죽어도 안빼면서..�
entries.translation: Hey, but you stubbornly refuse to drop the honorific with me...�
It is fine. Call me whatever you like.�

entries.source: 이거.. 고대종들이 조용하니 또 심심한데. 이야기나 좀 해볼까?�
entries.translation: Man... now that the ancients are quiet, it is boring. Want to chat?�

entries.source: 그때 }고대신{이 부활했다면, 분명 지금 아무도 살아있을 수 없겠지..�
entries.translation: If the }Ancient God{ had revived back then, no one would be alive today...�

entries.source: 아무도 알아주지 않았어. 나도 처음에는 티르 대장을.. 그저 배신자라고만 생각했으니까.�
entries.translation: No one recognized it. Even I thought Captain Tyr was just a traitor at first.�

entries.source: 하지만 난 직접 보았지. 필사적으로 사람들을 지키기 위해 싸우는 그의 모습을..�
