entries.translation: But I saw it with my own eyes. How desperately he fought to protect everyone...�

entries.source: 언젠가는 세상이 티르 대장을 영웅이라 부를 날이 올거야. 모두가 진실을 알게되는 그 날이.�
entries.translation: One day, the world will call Captain Tyr a hero. When everyone learns the truth.�

entries.source: 가장 놀라운 건.. 당시 총사령관 }케프네스{가 사실 }고대신의 사도{였다는 거야.�
entries.translation: The most shocking thing was that Supreme Commander }Kefnes{ was an }Apostle of the Ancient God{.�

entries.source: 모든 듣는 자들은 그가 만들어냈다고 하지.. 네베드를 공격하기 위해.�
entries.translation: They say he created all the Listeners... just to attack the Neved.�

entries.source: 결국은 티르 대장이 쓰러트렸지만 말이야. 5년전 그 성지에서의 사투는, 내 평생 잊지 못할거야.�
entries.translation: Captain Tyr struck him down in the end. That desperate battle 5 years ago... I will never forget it.�

entries.source: 그런데도 의회는 그 자를 전쟁중에 행방불명된 영웅으로 포장하고 있으니.. 섬짓하지 않아?�
entries.translation: Yet the Council still paints him as a war hero who went MIA... Creepy, is not it?�
That is... something I still do not understand either.�

entries.source: 분명히 군에 있을땐 }브리안{이었거든? 근데 어느 순간부터 }티르{라고 부르래.�
entries.translation: Back in the military, he was clearly }Brian{. But at some point, he told us to call him }Tyr{.�

entries.source: 아마 군인 시절에 절친한 친구였던 티르를 자신의 손으로 죽이고.. 그를 기리는 것이 아닐까 하지만..�
entries.translation: Maybe he killed his close friend Tyr with his own hands... and honors him that way...�

entries.source: 브리안 대장이라고 부르면 좀 너무하다 싶을 정도로 혼나는 건 좀 이상해.�
entries.translation: Though he scolds you way too harshly if you call him Captain Brian. It is strange.�

entries.source: 알잖아? }고대종{들이 갑자기 출현하기 시작했어. 성지를 중심으로..�
entries.translation: You know, right? The }Ancients{ suddenly started appearing. Centered around the Sanctuary...�

entries.source: 티르 대장이 말하기로는.. 고대신의 봉인이 약해져서 그렇게 된거라고 하더군.�
entries.translation: Captain Tyr said it happened because the Ancient God seal weakened.�

entries.source: 고대신이 완전히 부활했다면 전쟁이 끝나는 정도로 끝나지 않았을걸?�
entries.translation: If the Ancient God had fully revived, it would not have ended with just a war.�

entries.source: 후.. 사실 진정한 전쟁은, 아직도 진행중이긴 하지만.�
entries.translation: Sigh... To be honest, the real war is still going on.�

entries.source: 매도우힐은 고대종들에게 점령당해.. 인간은 남아있지 않아. 좋은 은신처지.�
entries.translation: Meadow Hill is overrun with ancients... No humans left. Makes for a good hideout.�

entries.source: 티르에게 도움을 받았거나, 그의 뜻에 동조하는 몇몇 이들이 그곳에서 싸움을 준비하고 있어.�
entries.translation: Those saved by Tyr, or who share his cause, are preparing for battle there.�

entries.source: 싫어하는 걸 알면서도 대장이라고 부르는 건 그라함 그 멍청이 뿐이지만..�
entries.translation: Even knowing I hate it, that fool Graham is the only one who still calls me Captain...�

entries.source: 난 티르를 경제적으로 지원하고 있어. 비록 떠돌이 상인에 불과하지만..�
entries.translation: I provide Tyr with financial backing. Though I am nothing more than a traveling merchant...�

entries.source: 뭐 사고 싶은 거 있으면 매도우힐에 가서 말하라고. 미안하지만 아무에게나 공짜는 아니거든.�
entries.translation: If you want to buy anything, say so when we reach Meadow Hill. Sorry, but I do not hand out freebies to strangers.�
The Sanctuary, huh... How do you plan on getting there?�

entries.source: 성지로는 배로 바로 갈 수 없어. }수호자의 결계{ 때문에..�
entries.translation: We cannot sail straight to the Sanctuary. Because of the }Guardian barrier{...�

entries.source: 먼저 매도우힐에 입항해서, 그곳에서 결계를 해제한 뒤 진입해야 해.�
entries.translation: We must first dock at Meadow Hill, dispel the barrier from there, and then head inside.�
You seem to know quite a lot about them.�
I drop by fairly often. Over there, that is...�

entries.source: 선주종들과 목숨 걸고 전쟁을 벌이던 군인 출신이면서.. 묘하군.�
entries.translation: Strange, coming from a former soldier who fought tooth and nail against the Proto-races...�
Let me make this clear: they are }Neved{, not }Proto-races{.�

entries.source: 그건 인간 위주의 사고 방식이 지어낸 말이니까, 그들에겐 실례가 될거야.�
entries.translation: That word came from human arrogance. It is an insult to them.�

entries.source: }성지전쟁{은.. 겉으로는 인간과 네베드의 전쟁이었지만, 그 속은 전혀 다른 싸움이었다.�
entries.translation: The }Sanctuary War{... On the surface, it was human against Neved, but deep down, it was something entirely different.�
It was a war against the }resurrecting Ancient God{... waged by those trying to stop it.�

entries.source: 그 과정에서 선.. 네베드들과 손을 잡은 건가?�
entries.translation: And in the process, you joined hands with the Pro... Neved?�
Yeah. And what I came to realize was...�

entries.source: 그들도 인간과 그리 다를 바 없다는 거다. 웃기도 하고, 화도 내고.. 괴로워 하기도 하지.�
entries.translation: They are really no different from humans. They laugh, get angry... and suffer just like us.�
What kind of person is this... }Guardian{?�

entries.source: 강한 여자야. 한 종족의 운명을 등에 엎고도 싸울 수 있을 만큼.�
entries.translation: A strong woman. Strong enough to fight carrying the fate of an entire race on her back.�

entries.source: 그녀가 없었다면, 난 벌써 죽었을 거야. 아니.. 인간과 네베드 모두 사라졌을지도 모르지.�
entries.translation: Without her, I would have died long ago. In fact... both mankind and Neved might have perished.�
Was the Ancient God really such a perilous threat?�
It is still a grave threat even now.�

entries.source: 5년전의 싸움으로 }봉인{은 쇠약해졌어. 그래서 고대종들이 출몰하기 시작한거고.�
entries.translation: The battle five years ago weakened the }seal{. That is why ancient beasts have begun appearing.�

entries.source: 고대종들이 고대신의 똘마니라면.. 신의 가호로 전쟁이 끝났다는 것도 헛소리만은 아니군.�
entries.translation: If ancient beasts are its minions... maybe the talk of the war ending through divine grace was not entirely hollow.�
...No such benevolent god exists in this world.�

entries.source: 깨어나면 우릴 전부 죽이고도 남을 미치광이 신이 하나 있을 뿐이지.�
entries.translation: Only a mad god who would slaughter every last one of us if it ever awakened.�
Could I... have been created by such a creature...?�

entries.source: 피곤하군. 별로.. 떠올리고 싶지 않은 기억들을 이야기 하다보니.�
entries.translation: I am exhausted. Talking about memories I would rather not recall...�

entries.source: 매도우 힐에 도착할 때까지.. 좀 쉬도록 해.�
entries.translation: Get some rest... until we reach Meadow Hill.�

entries.source: |(이 위는... 처음 타워에 갔을 때 탈출했던 환기구...){�
entries.translation: |(Up there... is the vent I used to escape Central Tower the first time...){�
|(I wonder if it is still open?){�
|(It is locked. I need to find another way...){�

entries.source: 정말 엄청 크다! 엄청! 난 꼭 커서 저기서 일할거야!�
entries.translation: It is so huge! Massive! When I grow up, I am definitely working there!�

entries.source: 저 건물 안에서는 무엇을 연구하고 있는걸까?�
entries.translation: What kind of research are they doing inside that building?�

entries.source: 웨이드 가문이 의회를 장악한 뒤로 공화국은 확실히 살기 좋아지고 있어.�
entries.translation: Ever since House Wade took control of the Council, life in the Republic has definitely gotten better.�
Daily life is convenient, security is strict...�

entries.source: 다른 섬들에서는 반의회파도 있는 것 같지만, 센트럴에서 한번 살아보면 생각이 바뀔걸?�
entries.translation: Other islands seem to have anti-Council factions, but live in Central once and you will change your mind.�

entries.source: 이제 센트럴은 공화국의 수도로 한치의 부족함도 없을 정도로 발전했어.�
entries.translation: Central has developed so much that it is now truly worthy of being the Republic capital.�

entries.source: 의회는 앞으로 공화국 전체의 산업화를 진행할 생각이라는군.�
entries.translation: They say parliament plans to push industrialization across the entire Republic.�

entries.source: 센트럴에서 웨이드 가에 거슬리면 붙잡혀서 센트럴 타워로 간다면서?�
entries.translation: If you cross House Wade in Central, they drag you off to Central Tower, right?�

entries.source: 지하의 비밀층에서 코로 설렁탕을 먹게 된다는데 진짜야?�
entries.translation: Is it true they waterboard you in some secret underground floor?�

entries.source: 인류가 현재 사용하고 있는 모든 기술은 저 센트럴 타워에서 나왔다고 해도 과언이 아니야.�
entries.translation: It is no exaggeration that all tech humanity currently uses came from Central Tower.�
I really wish they would shut down that underground sewer.�

entries.source: 시체가 나오다니... 덕분에 이 주변 땅값이 폭락했다고.�
entries.translation: Finding a corpse down there... Property values around here plummeted thanks to that!�
I am glad my child is enjoying it.�

entries.source: 공화국에서 가장 크고 높은 건물이라는 센트럴 타워를 아이에게 꼭 보여주고 싶었어요.�
entries.translation: I really wanted to show my child Central Tower, the largest and tallest building in the Republic.�

entries.source: 타워 지하층에서 대형 사족보행 전차를 개발하고 있다는 소문이 있어.�
entries.translation: There is a rumor they are developing a massive four-legged tank in the Tower basement.�

entries.source: 난 이족보행 병기가 더 좋다고 생각하는데...�
entries.translation: Personally, I think bipedal mechs are much cooler...�

entries.source: |(}흑의병|이 사라졌다... 타워 경비를 빼낼 정도로 사람이 부족해진건가?)�
entries.translation: |(The }Black Guard| is gone... Did they need even the Tower guards?)�

entries.source: 다행이다. 그 날 다들 안 돌아와서 걱정하고 있었는데.�
entries.translation: Thank goodness. When no one came back that day, I was so worried.�
The others in the sewers... Have you heard?�
|(Cannot really say I saw it myself...){�

entries.source: 그래도 너는 같이 발견이 안된데다가 나중에 왠 보라머리 여자가 와서 물어보길래 혹시나 했지.�
entries.translation: Still, you were not found with them, and later some purple-haired woman came asking, so I held out hope.�

entries.source: 그 동안 어디서 뭘 하고 다닌거야?�
entries.translation: Where have you been, and what were you doing all this time?�

entries.source: 살아 있었으면 진작에 얼굴 좀 내밀지 그랬어?�
entries.translation: If you were alive, you could have shown your face a lot sooner!�
I heard the guild was disbanded.�

entries.source: 원래도 작은 길드였잖아? 하루 아침에 길드원이 다 사라졌으니 자연히 공중분해된거야.�
entries.translation: It was a small guild to begin with. With everyone gone overnight, it just fell apart.�

entries.source: 사람을 다시 모으기도 힘들고... 그리고 난 원래 용병 길드 그다지 하고 싶지 않았거든.�
entries.translation: Finding new people is tough... Besides, I never really wanted to run a mercenary guild anyway.�

entries.source: 아, 슈르츠는 나중에 와서 몰랐던가? 이 길드 원래는 그 대장 아저씨랑 나랑 시작한 거였어.�
entries.translation: Oh, you joined later, so maybe you did not know? The boss and I actually started this place together.�
I own this building. As for him...�

entries.source: 성지전쟁 끝나고 일자리가 없어서 밥을 굶다가 건물 앞에 쓰러져 있던 걸 주워온 거였어.�
entries.translation: After the Sanctuary War, he could not find work and collapsed starving outside. I just took him in.�

entries.source: 그 다음에 뭐든 일 시켜달라고 해서 어찌어찌 하다보니 다른 사람도 모이고 해서 길드가 된거지만.�
entries.translation: He begged me for any kind of work, and one thing led to another until more people joined and it became a guild.�
All that feels like ancient history now...�

entries.source: 여전히 차갑네. 그 말투도 하나도 안 변했구나.�
entries.translation: Cold as ever. That tone of yours has not changed a bit.�

entries.source: 그래도 뭐... 잘 왔어. 이제 용병 길드는 없어져서 의뢰 같은 거 줄 일도 없긴 하지만 말야.�
entries.translation: Still... it is good to see you. Though with the guild gone, I do not have any contracts for you.�

entries.source: 길드가 없어졌으니 이제 의뢰 같은 것도 없어.�
entries.translation: The guild is gone, so there are no more contracts.�
The kids made it here safely. Thank you.�

entries.source: 어릴 적부터 버려진 고양이나 개 같은 걸 주워오는 애였거든, 난.�
entries.translation: Ever since I was little, I have always brought home stray cats and dogs. That is just who I am.�

entries.source: 무슨 일이야? 이제 길드가 없으니까 의뢰할 일도 없는데...�
entries.translation: What is up? With the guild gone, there are not any jobs...�
Right, you too. Drop by whenever you are bored.�

entries.source: 넌 성격만 빼면 성실하고 실력도 있는 편이었으니까 어디가도 잘 살거 같아.�
entries.translation: Aside from your attitude, you are diligent and skilled. You will do fine wherever you go.�

entries.source: 그래도, 아직 나이가 어리니까 다른 일을 찾아봤으면 좋겠네.�
entries.translation: Still, you are young. I hope you look into other lines of work.�
What are you going to do now?�
Heh, are you actually worried about me?�

entries.source: 집도 있고 길드 운영비도 꽤 남았고, 먹고 살 걱정은 없지 싶은데?�
entries.translation: I have the building and plenty of guild funds left. I am not worried about making ends meet.�

entries.source: 음, 사실은 애들이나 좀 돌볼까 싶어. 길드 같은 거 말고.�
entries.translation: Well, to be honest, I am thinking of looking after kids instead of running a guild.�

entries.source: 저 구석에 있는 애 봤어? 고아라고 하더라고. 근처에 쓰러져 있길래 또 주워왔지만.�
entries.translation: See that kid in the corner? Said he is an orphan. Found him collapsed nearby, so I took him in.�

entries.source: 못말리겠다 싶어? 내가 원래 좀 그런 성격인가 봐.�
entries.translation: Think I am hopeless? Guess that is just the way I was built.�

entries.source: 음, 그래서 슈르츠한테는... 의뢰는 없지만 개인적인 부탁이 있는데.�
entries.translation: So, Schultz... I do not have a job for you, but I do have a personal favor.�
Someone came by saying you sent them.�

entries.source: 무슨 소리야, 일도 잘하고 얼마나 착한데.�
entries.translation: What are you saying? They are hardworking and so kind!�
Well, anyway, it has gotten pretty lively around here.�

entries.source: 무슨 일을 하고 다니는 건지는 모르겠지만...�
entries.translation: I do not know what kind of work you are involved in, but...�

entries.source: 나중에 정 갈 곳이 없으면 슈르츠도 여기로 와.�
entries.translation: If you ever run out of places to go, you can always come back here, Schultz.�

entries.source: 물론 네가 어디 정착해서 돌아갈 곳이 있으면 그게 제일 좋겠지만.�
entries.translation: Though of course, it would be best if you settled down somewhere and found a real place to return to.�

entries.source: 사람이 더 늘어나면 나 혼자서는 일손이 부족할지도 모르겠네...�
entries.translation: If more people show up, I might not be able to handle it all alone...�

entries.source: 도와줄 만한 사람을 알고 있으면 이쪽으로 또 보내줄래?�
entries.translation: If you know anyone who can help out, could you send them my way?�

entries.source: 성지전쟁 이후로 저런 애들이 꽤 늘었다고 들었거든.�
entries.translation: I heard there have been a lot more kids like that since the Sanctuary War.�
They say the Council is not doing anything for them.�

entries.source: 그러고보니 너도 고아원 출신이었던가... 나보다 잘 알겠네.�
entries.translation: Come to think of it, you grew up in an orphanage too... You would know better than me.�

entries.source: 갈 곳 없는 애들이 있으면 내가 좀 돌봐주고 싶은데, 내가 여길 비우고 돌아다니기도 그렇고.�
entries.translation: I want to look after kids with nowhere else to go, but I cannot just leave this place unattended.�

entries.source: 돌아다니다가 갈 곳 없는 애들이나, 혹시 이런 일에 관심 있는 사람을 보게 되면 이리로 보내줘.�
entries.translation: If you find any homeless kids or anyone interested in helping out, send them my way.�
I do not have time for that.�
I see. You have your own business to attend to.�
Alright, thank you! I am counting on you.�

entries.source: 뭐... 길바닥에서 상자 깔고 자는 것 보다는 낫죠...�
entries.translation: Well... it is better than sleeping on cardboard in the streets...�

entries.source: 아직 낯설어서 무섭기는 하지만, 저 언니는 좋은 분 같아요.�
entries.translation: It is still scary being in an unfamiliar place, but she seems nice.�
Well... it seems fine so far.�

entries.source: 괜찮을 거에요. 무슨 일이 있어도. 적어도 동생은 제가 지킬 거니까.�
entries.translation: It will be okay. No matter what happens, I will protect my sibling.�

entries.source: 보수도 나쁘지 않고, 애들 돌보는 것도 익숙합니다만...�
entries.translation: The pay is not bad, and I am used to looking after kids, but...�

entries.source: 주인 아주머니는 그다지 마음에 들지 않네요.�
entries.translation: I do not really like the landlady.�

entries.source: 왜 밤이 되어도 별이 안보이는 걸까요?�
entries.translation: Why cannot we see the stars even at night?�
Sometimes I want to go to the forest or the sea.�

entries.source: 하지만 엄마 아빠가 바쁘시니까.. 아마 안되겠죠..�
entries.translation: Mom and Dad are too busy, though... Probably not gonna happen...�

entries.source: 흠.. 책들은 그다지 참고할만한 것들이 없군.�
entries.translation: Hmm... Not many books worth referencing here.�

entries.source: 난 솔직히 공산품은 별로 안 좋아해. 물론 싸고 품질이 일정한 것은 좋지.�
entries.translation: Honestly, I do not care much for factory goods. Sure, they are cheap and consistent.�

entries.source: 그렇지만 싸게 만들기 위해서 희생되는 부분들이 있단말야.�
entries.translation: But sacrifices are made to keep them cheap.�

entries.source: 그냥저냥한 재료를 쓴다던가, 마감이 좀 허술하다던가.�
entries.translation: Like using mediocre materials, or sloppy finishing.�
...And it is not even that cheap, is it?�

entries.source: 솔직히 말해서 이곳에서 파는 장비는 별로야.�
entries.translation: To be honest, the gear sold here is junk.�
That is factory-made stuff for you, though.�

entries.source: 예전에 센트럴에는 엄청난 실력을 가진 무기제작자 가문이 있었어.�
entries.translation: There used to be a family of master weaponsmiths in Central.�

entries.source: 4년 전이었으면 저런 어설픈 무기를 만드는 대장장이는 센트럴에서 명함도 못 내밀었을걸.�
entries.translation: Four years ago, a smith making shoddy weapons like these would not dare show his face here.�
If only that had not happened...�

entries.source: 칼 좀 만지는 것 같은데 무기에 관심이 없다니.�
entries.translation: You wield a blade, yet you do not care about weapons?�

entries.source: 요즘 애들은 무기가 소모품인 줄 안다니까.�
entries.translation: Kids these days treat weapons like disposables.�
That is why factory goods run rampant.�

entries.source: 용병이라 좋은 무기에는 관심이 가나 보지?�
entries.translation: You are a mercenary, so fine weapons caught your ear, huh?�
They opposed the Southern Expedition... the Sanctuary War, and got executed for it.�

entries.source: 거기서 만든 무기는 몇 개 안남았는데 이제 구할 수도 없지...�
entries.translation: Few of their weapons remain, and you cannot buy them anywhere now...�

entries.source: 매도우 힐에서 장사하던 방계 가문도 있었는데, 지금 꼴을 보면 아마 그 쪽도 다 죽었겠지.�
entries.translation: They had a branch family in Meadow Hill, but looking at things now, they are probably dead too.�

entries.source: 제일 젊은 애는 살았다는 소문도 있긴 하던데...�
entries.translation: Rumor has it the youngest one survived, though...�
His name was... Alex, I think.�
Were those weaponsmiths the Riedmayr family?�

entries.source: 뭐, 살아 있다는 소문이 사실이라도 센트럴에서 다시 볼 수는 없을 거야.�
entries.translation: Well, even if that rumor is true, he will not be seen in Central again.�

entries.source: 가문 일도 가문 일이고, 그 친구는 특히 매도우 힐 점령 때 선주종들 도주를 도왔다고 하더군.�
entries.translation: Besides his family fate, they say he helped the natives escape during Meadow Hill fall.�
That makes him an undeniable traitor.�

entries.source: 그래도 어딘가에서 살아 있었으면 좋겠어. 그 기술이 끊기는 건 아깝거든.�
entries.translation: Still, I hope he is alive somewhere. Losing such craftsmanship is a tragic waste.�

entries.source: 혹시 특별한 무기를 얻으면 잘 살펴봐. 거기서 만든 무기에는 항상 L이라는 이니셜이 새겨져 있어. 진품이라는 증거지.�
entries.translation: If you find an extraordinary weapon, inspect it closely. Their works bear the initial L. That is proof of an authentic piece.�

entries.source: 거참 이래서 어린 애들이랑은 말이 안통한다니까.�
entries.translation: Good grief, you really cannot get through to kids these days.�

entries.source: 마침 센트럴을 떠나 있어서 살아 있던 애가 한 명 있다고 하던데.�
entries.translation: I heard one survived because he was not in Central at the time.�

entries.source: 이렘의 무슨 사이비 종교 집단 같은데 숨어 있다고 하던가...�
entries.translation: Said he was hiding in some cult in Irem or something...�

entries.source: 뭐, 거짓말일거야. 그 이후로 그런 무기는 못 봤거든.�
entries.translation: Well, probably a lie. I have not seen a single weapon like that since.�

entries.source: 어서오세요, 센트럴에서 생산된 물품들은 최고의 성능을 보장합니다.�
entries.translation: Welcome! Central-made goods guarantee peak performance.�

entries.source: 스킬은 스킬북만 산다고 익혀지는 게 아니다. 그에 걸맞는 육체의 강인함이 기본임을 잊지말도록.�
entries.translation: Skills are not mastered just by buying books. Never forget the body must match them.�
Central Tower is already lost, Patriarch.�

entries.source: 프로젝트 알테나는 실패입니다. 인간은 알테나의 제어권을 가지지 못했어요.�
entries.translation: Project Altena is a failure. Humans could not control Altena.�
It seems this is the end. Now we...�
..It was fun, was not it? Until now.�
..All of it... It was all your twisted game... was not it?�

entries.source: 당신은.. 알테나를 제어할 그릇이 되지 못했어요.�
entries.translation: You were not... a vessel capable of controlling Altena.�

entries.source: 너희는 아무것도 몰라. 하지만 알테나는 알고 있다.�
entries.translation: You know nothing. But Altena knows.�

entries.source: 너희들의 독재는 여기까지야.. 인류는 새로운 사회를 구축할 것이다.�
entries.translation: Your tyranny ends here... Humanity will forge a new society.�

entries.source: 당신은 이미 알테나에게 구속되었어요.. 고대신과 다를 바 없습니다.�
entries.translation: You are already bound to Altena... No different from an ancient god.�

entries.source: 신을 만들때는.. 우러러 모실 마음의 준비 정도는 해뒀어야지..�
entries.translation: When you create a god... you should be prepared to worship it..�

entries.source: 전부 네놈들의 업보다. 이제 인류는 신을 얻었고.. 더 이상 인간끼리의 하찮은 지배체제는 필요없어.�
entries.translation: This is all your retribution. Humanity has a god now... We no longer need petty human rule.�
Listen only to my voice. That is all you need.�

entries.source: |(아직 열려 있을 줄은... 좋아, 일단 들어오는데는 성공했는데...){�
entries.translation: |(I cannot believe it was still unlocked... Good, I got inside, but...) {�
|(No researchers around... only security devices active.) {�
|(Anyway, let us look for a way up.) {�
Please disable the lock at the lobby control panel.�
Please enter the destination floor code.�

entries.source: 조만간 저는 이 섬을 떠나야 합니다. 아마도 전방으로 차출될 것 같아요.�
entries.translation: I will have to leave this island soon. Probably getting sent to the front lines.�

entries.source: 뭐 요즘은.. 고대종들도 공격해오지 않는다니까 위험하진 않겠지만..�
entries.translation: Well, they say the ancient species have not attacked lately, so it might not be dangerous...�

entries.source: 역시 고향을 떠나는 건 슬픈 일이죠.�
entries.translation: Still, leaving home is always heartbreaking.�

entries.source: 여전히 전방에서는 간간히 고대종들이 우리의 영역을 공격해온다고 해요.�
entries.translation: They say ancient species still strike our borders from time to time out on the front.�

entries.source: 말이 안통하는 괴물들과 싸우는 곳에 이 사람을 보내야 하다니.. 너무 걱정되네요.�
entries.translation: Sending him off to fight senseless monsters... I am so worried.�

entries.source: 어른들은 참 굉장해요! 도시 밖에는 위험한 짐승들이 우글거리는데 어떻게 이런 도시를 만들었을까요?�
entries.translation: Grown-ups are amazing! Dangerous beasts roam outside, yet they built a city like this!�

entries.source: 전쟁 때 나타난 고대종들도 우리들의 섬에는 감히 쳐들어오지 못한데요!�
entries.translation: They say even the ancient species from the war do not dare attack our island!�

entries.source: 9번가는 선착장이 있는 걸 빼면 그다지 특이할 것 없는 보통의 거리야.�
entries.translation: 9th is just an ordinary street, aside from having the docks.�

entries.source: 하지만 요 앞집에 사는 성녀님 덕분에 제법 많은 사람들이 찾아오지.�
entries.translation: Though quite a few people visit thanks to the Saintess living across the way.�

entries.source: 성녀님이 내리는 치유의 기적은, 겪어보지 않으면 믿을 수 없을 정도라고.�
entries.translation: The healing miracles she performs... you would not believe it unless you saw it.�

entries.source: 난 의회가 하는 일을 항상 지지하고 있어.�
entries.translation: I always support whatever the council does.�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬에서 몇년 전에 반란이 있었다는 건 알고 있지?�
entries.translation: You know there was a rebellion on Moytura Island a few years back, right?�

entries.source: 그 놈들은 무엇이 인간을 위한 건지도 모르고 있는거야. 혼란만 부추기고..�
entries.translation: Those rebels do not even know what is good for mankind. Just stirring up chaos...�

entries.source: 미안하지만 우리 길드는 현재 다른 용병들을 받아들이지 않고 있어.�
entries.translation: Sorry, but our guild is not accepting outside mercenaries right now.�

entries.source: 요즘 센트럴의 다른 길드들에서 스파이들이 난리라고들 해서 말이야..�
entries.translation: Word is, spies from other Central guilds have been running wild lately...�
If you need work, look somewhere else.�
My order still has not arrived yet.�

entries.source: 오늘 저녁에는 오랜만에 황혼 수프를 먹고 싶구만..�
entries.translation: I would love to have some Twilight Soup tonight for the first time in a while...�

entries.source: 내가 젊었을 때는 말이지, 거침없이 나가서 황혼 수프의 재료들을 모아오곤 했지.�
entries.translation: Back in my day, I would boldly head out to gather the ingredients for Twilight Soup myself.�

entries.source: 사먹는 것과는 그 맛의 차원이 달랐는데 말이야.. 허허..�
entries.translation: Tasted completely different from the store-bought stuff... Heh heh...�

entries.source: 의회에서 갑자기 통과시킨 고대종 방어 정책 때문에, 여객선은 운행 안해.�
entries.translation: Because of that Ancient defense policy the Council suddenly passed, passenger ships are not running.�

entries.source: 있는 건 수송선 뿐이니 혹시 탈 생각 있으면 }상점{에 가서 일거리를 건져 봐.�
entries.translation: Only cargo ships are left. If you want a ride, try finding work at the }Shop{.�

entries.source: 여행을 하다보면 정규군들은 괜찮아요. 친절하달까, 순박하달까..�
entries.translation: When traveling, the regular army folks are fine. Kind, maybe even gentle...�

entries.source: 하지만 웨이드 가의 직속부대인 흑의병들은 굉장히 살벌하죠.�
entries.translation: But the Black Guard, House Wade direct unit, are utterly ruthless.�

entries.source: 몰려다니거나 거점이 있는 것도 아니고.. 그들은 무엇을 위한 부대일까요?�
entries.translation: They do not move in packs or have a base... What kind of unit are they, anyway?�

entries.source: 선주종들과 사이가 좋을 때는, 이런 선주종식 패션도 유행했었어요.�
entries.translation: When relations with the ancients were good, native fashion like this was popular.�

entries.source: 좀 춥긴하죠.. 아무래도 선주종들은 따뜻한 남쪽섬에 살고 있으니까.�
entries.translation: It is a bit chilly... The natives live on the warm southern islands, after all.�

entries.source: 우리 인간도 따뜻한 섬에서 살려면, 역시 선주종들과의 전쟁밖에 답이 없는 걸까요?�
entries.translation: If we humans want to live on warm islands, is war with the natives really the only answer?�

entries.source: 제대로 된 황혼 수프 식당을 만드려면, 사오는 재료로는 부족하죠.�
entries.translation: To make proper Twilight Soup for a diner, store-bought ingredients just will not do.�

entries.source: 식당을 여는 것도 문제지만 재료도 직접 구해와야 할텐데..�
entries.translation: Opening a diner is one thing, but we also have to gather ingredients ourselves...�
Honestly, I just cannot trust that man.�
Central is actually overflowing with people.�

entries.source: 정확히 말하면 제대로 된 일자리가 부족하달까.. 내가 능력이 없어서 이러는 게 아니라고.�
entries.translation: To be precise, decent jobs are lacking... It is not because I lack talent.�

entries.source: 여편네가 요리실력이 좋으니 식당이라도 하나 내볼까 생각 중인데..�
entries.translation: My wife is a great cook, so I am thinking of opening a diner...�

entries.source: 다양한 장비를 사용해보는 것은 굉장히 소중한 경험이죠. 얼마나 많은 경험을 해보셨나요?�
entries.translation: Trying various equipment is a valuable experience. How much have you tried?�

entries.source: 오르비스 군도 말고 다른 땅은 없을까?�
entries.translation: Is there no other land beyond the Orbis Archipelago?�

entries.source: 인간과 선주종은 이 몇 개 안되는 섬을 서로 차지하겠다고 싸워야만 했을까?�
entries.translation: Did humans and natives really have to fight just to claim these few islands?�

entries.source: 사거나 팔 물건이 있나? 매물은 1/5 가격에 받고, 흥정은 없네.�
entries.translation: Looking to buy or sell? I buy at 1/5 price, no bargaining.�

entries.source: 스킬을 익힌데에 만족하지 말게. 스킬의 위력을 배가시켜주는 }강화 특성{을 개발하는 것도 중요하니까.�
entries.translation: Do not just be content with learning skills. Developing }Enhance Traits{ is key.�
..Rockville... has not changed much at all.�

entries.source: 아니. 듣는 자들이 에네스트 가의 여관을 타겟으로 했다면.. 카즈도 위험하지 않을까 싶었거든.�
entries.translation: No. If the Listeners targeted House Ernest inn... I thought Kaze might be in danger too.�
Seeing how peaceful it is, though...�

entries.source: 흠.. 얼굴도 못본 사람이라서 그런지, 영 실감이 안나네.�
entries.translation: Hmm... I never met him, so it does not feel real to me.�

entries.source: 어떻게 된거야? 흑의병들이 갑자기 전부 움직이기 시작했어.�
entries.translation: What is going on? The Black Guard suddenly mobilized!�

entries.source: 카즈 녀석이 멍청하게 듣는 자들에게 속았어..!�
entries.translation: That fool Kaze was tricked by the Listeners...!�

entries.source: 놈들, 전부 배를 타고 어디론가 이동하던데..�
entries.translation: They were all boarding ships somewhere...�
It is }Cole Creek Isle{. They are going after }Chris{ and the others.�
I will ready a ship! Let us move right away!�

entries.source: 재개발이 되면, 이런 비위생적인 시장에 매일 들락거릴 일도 없어질거야.�
entries.translation: Once redevelopment happens, we will not have to visit this unsanitary market every day.�

entries.source: 센트럴에서는 그냥 집 안에서 모든 걸 바로 구할 수 있다는데, 우리도 그렇게 되겠지?�
entries.translation: I heard in Central you can get everything right at home. Will it be like that for us too?�
Just a few years ago, we used to hang out there all the time...�

entries.source: 난 여기만 지키면 돼. 개발 공단에 기여한 바를 인정 받아야, 나중에도 좋은 자리 차지할 수 있을테니까.�
entries.translation: I just need to guard this spot. If they recognize my service to the Development Complex, I will secure a good post later.�

entries.source: 재개발이 된다는 건 단순하게 마을이 자동화 되는 것만이 아니야.�
entries.translation: Redevelopment is not just about automating the town.�

entries.source: 분명 센트럴처럼 앉아서 편하게 일할 수 있는 일거리들이 들어오겠지?�
entries.translation: Surely comfortable desk jobs like the ones in Central will become available, right?�

entries.source: 지긋 지긋한 농삿일에서 벗어날 수 있어.. 헛헛!�
entries.translation: I can finally escape this dreadful farming... Heheh!�

entries.source: 이거야 원, 마을이 하루종일 쿵땅거리니 정신이 없구먼 그래.�
entries.translation: Good grief, this town is clattering and banging all day long. Gives me a headache.�

entries.source: 젊은 것들은 재개발이 되면 좋아라 하겠지만..�
entries.translation: The young folks might rejoice over redevelopment, but...�

entries.source: 에네스트 가문은 무슨 대형사고가 터진 뒤로, 엄청 어린 가주가 물려받았다던데..�
entries.translation: I heard after some disaster hit the Ernest family, a young kid took over as head...�

entries.source: 의외로 베르날에서의 평판도 좋고.. 집도 휘황찬란 하군 그래.�
entries.translation: Surprisingly, their reputation in Vernal is good... and the mansion is magnificent.�

entries.source: 어려서부터 큰 돈을 만지면 보통 제정신이 아니기 쉬운데 말이야..�
entries.translation: Usually, handling that much money at a young age goes straight to your head...�

entries.source: 나는.. 의회의 이 무분별한 재개발이 위험하다고 생각해.�
entries.translation: I think... this reckless redevelopment by the Council is dangerous.�

entries.source: 안그래도 공화국에는 추운 섬이 많고 농사 지을 땅이 부족한데...�
entries.translation: The Republic already has so many cold islands and so little farmland...�

entries.source: 늘어나는 인구에 대한 대책은 세우고 있는 걸까?�
entries.translation: Are they even planning for the growing population?�

entries.source: 베르날의 시장은 작지만, 정이 넘치고 유쾌하답니다.�
entries.translation: The market in Vernal is small, but it is warm and lively.�
Welcome! Care to take a look at my wares?�

entries.source: 강해지는 데에는 왕도가 없지! 수련, 수련, 수련 뿐이다!�
entries.translation: There is no royal road to strength! Train, train, and train!�

entries.source: 어떤가, 용병 친구. 나에게 자네 장비의 운명을 맡겨보는 것은?�
entries.translation: How about it, mercenary? Care to trust your gear to my hands?�
Have you seen Lord Castler? He is so handsome!�

entries.source: 자상하고, 친절하고.. 전 나중에 카스틀러님께 시집갈 거예요!�
entries.translation: He is kind, caring... I am going to marry him one day!�

entries.source: 에네스트 가문은 옛날부터 록빌을 지켜주던 훌륭한 가문이었지..�
entries.translation: The Ernest family has protected Rockville since the old days...�

entries.source: 농사가 풍년이든 흉년이든 에네스트 가문의 지원이 있어 버텨낼 수 있었어요.�
entries.translation: Whether harvest was good or bad, the Ernests support got us through.�

entries.source: 이제 재개발이 되면 농삿일은 많이 줄어들겠지만..�
entries.translation: Farming will decrease once redevelopment starts, but...�

entries.source: 허허, 신문을 만든다는 건 민심을 조율하는 일이지.�
entries.translation: Haha, running a newspaper is all about tuning the public mood.�

entries.source: 재개발이 계속되면서 록빌의 시민들은 때로는 설레이고, 때로는 불안해 하네.�
entries.translation: With ongoing redevelopment, Rockville citizens oscillate between excitement and anxiety.�

entries.source: 그들을 지속적으로 희망차게 만드는 것이 우리의 일이지.�
entries.translation: Keeping them constantly hopeful is our job.�

entries.source: 가끔 의회에서는 말도 안되는 홍보물들이 내려와.�
entries.translation: Sometimes the council sends down ridiculous promotional material.�

entries.source: 사람들이 이걸 믿을까.. 싶기도 한데, 어쨌든 기사화가 되면 믿게 되더라고.�
entries.translation: I wonder if anyone will believe it... but once it is published, people usually do.�

entries.source: 재개발이 된다고, 과연 다들 먹고 살기 편해지기만 할지는 나도 잘 모르겠어.�
entries.translation: Whether redevelopment will truly make life easier for everyone, I am not so sure.�

entries.source: 휴, 휴, 쓸데없는 고민 따위 할 시간도 없다고?�
entries.translation: Whew, no time to waste on pointless worries!�

entries.source: 하루하루 새로운 정보가 밀려오는데, 받아들이기만 해도 벅차다고?�
entries.translation: New information floods in every day. Just keeping up is overwhelming enough!�

entries.source: 오래된 정보들을 어서 버리고, 새로운 세상을 받아들여야지 않겠어?�
entries.translation: Should not we discard outdated news quickly and embrace the new world?�

entries.source: 의회에서는 재개발이 완료되면 우리에게 더 큰 역할을 준다고 하더군.�
entries.translation: The council promised us a bigger role once redevelopment finishes.�

entries.source: 하지만 나는 그저 승진하기 위해 이 일을 하고 있는 건 아냐.�
entries.translation: Still, I am not doing this job just to climb the ladder.�

entries.source: 의회에서 주는 일 따위 보다, 사람들에게 유용한 정보를 주는 것이 더 보람차거든.�
entries.translation: Providing useful information to the people is far more rewarding than council tasks.�

entries.source: 일자리를 구하러 오신 거라면, 단순한 비정규직뿐이고 용병이 할 만한 일은 없어요.�
entries.translation: If you are here looking for work, there is only temporary labor. Nothing suitable for a mercenary.�

entries.source: 록빌 재개발로 일자리는 잔뜩 만들어졌지만 지금은 그것도 포화상태라서요.�
entries.translation: The Rockville redevelopment created a ton of jobs, but even those are fully saturated now.�

entries.source: 저 같은 일개 메이지가 뭘 알겠어요?�
entries.translation: What would a mere mage like me know?�

entries.source: 넓은 저택을 깨끗하게 만드는 건 마법과도 같은 일이랍니다.�
entries.translation: Keeping such a huge mansion clean is practically like magic.�

entries.source: 슈르츠님... 또 어디서 그런 상스러운 말투를...�
entries.translation: Master Schultz... Where did you pick up such vulgar language again?�

entries.source: 너랑 이야기 하고 있으면 왠지 피곤해져...�
entries.translation: Talking to you somehow wears me out...�
Do not worry. I am enjoying it, after all.�

entries.source: 저택의 일이라면, 카즈가 일개 고용인에게 다 말할리가 없지 않습니까.�
entries.translation: Besides, why would Kaze share mansion secrets with a mere servant?�

entries.source: 이제 일을 그만두었으니 존칭은 생략해도 되지 않을까 해서.�
entries.translation: Since I quit, I figured honorifics were no longer necessary.�

entries.source: 진지하게 말씀드리자면, 그냥 우연히 엿들었을 뿐이에요.�
entries.translation: To be frank, I merely happened to overhear things.�

entries.source: 무슨 이야기인지는 잘 모르겠지만, 어쩌면 슈르츠님이 위험해지실 수도 있을 것 같아서.�
entries.translation: I did not fully understand it, but it seemed you might be in danger, Master Schultz.�

entries.source: 제 딴에는 최대한 경고를 하려고 노력했습니다만.�
entries.translation: I tried my best to warn you in my own way.�

entries.source: 일을 그만둔다는 말 가지고 어떻게 알아듣냐.�
entries.translation: How was I supposed to get that from you just saying you quit?�

entries.source: 하지만 또 슈르츠님이 카즈님을 계속 돕기로 하신다면, 섣불리 설명했다가는 제 출세길이 위험해질 수도 있었기에.�
entries.translation: Well, if you chose to stay by Lord Kaze side, explaining carelessly could have ruined my career.�
Regardless... I am glad you are safe.�

entries.source: 언젠가 드린 집게발 구이는 잘 드셨나요?�
entries.translation: By the way, did you enjoy the roasted claw I gave you?�
It restored my health when I ate it...�
Of course. I drizzled Hi-Potion on it before roasting.�

entries.source: 재미없네요. 남자들은 이런 소리를 들으면 깜짝 놀라야 정상 아닌가요?�
entries.translation: How dull. Should not a man be startled when hearing words like that?�

entries.source: 역시 슈르츠님은 훌륭한 마법사가 되실 수 있을 것 같습니다.�
entries.translation: As expected, you will make a splendid wizard someday, Master Schultz.�
I said, what are you talking about?�

entries.source: 앉아서 퇴직금만 까먹고 있는 것도 꽤나 심심하네요.�
entries.translation: Sitting around living off severance pay gets terribly boring.�

entries.source: 맥락없이 화제를 돌리지 마. 그리고 일해.�
entries.translation: Do not change the subject randomly. Go get a job.�

entries.source: 제가 실업자가 된 것도 따지고 보면 슈르츠님 책임이지 않습니까.�
entries.translation: If you think about it, my unemployment is technically your fault.�
It has absolutely nothing to do with me!�

entries.source: 돈을 줄지는 모르겠지만, 아는 사람이 일손을 구하고 있기는 한데.�
entries.translation: I do not know about pay, but an acquaintance was looking for an extra hand.�
You actually know someone, Master Schultz?�
In Central 17th, at what used to be a mercenary guild...�

entries.source: 길드가 망하고 나서 갑자기 건물주인 아줌마가 고아나, 갈 곳 없는 사람이나, 아니면 자기를 도울 사람이 있으면.�
entries.translation: After it went under, the landlady told me if I found orphans, drifters, or anyone to help her...�
Does that mean you will be dropping by often, Master Schultz?�
I have to collect my pay, after all.�
Understood. I will go check it out.�
More promotional materials arrived from the council.�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬의 농업이 크게 발전해서, 이제 베르날 섬의 농지는 점차 줄여간다고 하네요.�
entries.translation: They say agriculture on Moytura Isle has developed so much that farmland on Vernal Isle will be gradually reduced.�

entries.source: 흠.. 이게 정말일까요? 모이투라 섬은 추운 지방이라 농업이 그렇게 안정적이지 못할텐데..�
entries.translation: Hmm... Is that really true? Moytura Isle is a cold region, so farming should not be that stable...�

entries.source: 후.. 이건 도대체, 어디서부터 설계를 고쳐야 할지 모르겠군.�
entries.translation: Phew... I do not even know where to begin redesigning this thing.�

entries.source: 록빌은 오래된 농업 도시야. 센트럴 처럼 되려면 몇 십년은 족히 걸릴 것 같다고.�
entries.translation: Rockville is an old agricultural town. It will take decades to become anything like Central.�

entries.source: 자재는 계속 들어오고, 뜯어고칠 것은 늘어만 가는군 그래.�
entries.translation: Materials keep pouring in, and the list of renovations just keeps growing.�

entries.source: 사람이 더 필요해, 사람이. 의회에서 산정해준 작업 인력으로는 택도 없어.�
entries.translation: We need more hands, more people. The workforce allocated by the council is nowhere near enough.�

entries.source: 생산 설비는 확실히 지원해 줄 것처럼 얘기하더니, 이게 뭐람.�
entries.translation: They talked as if they would fully back production facilities, but look at this mess.�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�
Ah... Master Schultz... You are here...�

entries.source: 전 오늘로 인간...이 아니라, 이곳을 그만둡니다.�
entries.translation: As of today, I am quitting being human... I mean, quitting this place.�

entries.source: 나중에 또, 꼭 만나뵐 수 있기를 희망합니다.�
entries.translation: I truly hope we can meet again someday.�
Please take good care of yourself until then.�

entries.source: 뭐 다시 만날 일이 있을지는 모르겠지만... 어디로 가는데? 센트럴?�
entries.translation: Not sure we will, but... where are you heading? Central?�
I will be staying at the local office for the time being.�

entries.source: |(그러면 어디 먼 곳으로 떠나는 것 같은 인사는 하지 말라고...){�
entries.translation: |(Then do not say goodbye like you are leaving for the ends of the earth...){�

entries.source: .. 아.. 아냐, 무사히 돌아왔구나, 슈르츠. 다행이야.�
entries.translation: ... N-No, you returned safely, Schultz. What a relief.�

entries.source: 먼저.. 나를 속인 건 너야, 슈르츠.�
entries.translation: You were the one... who deceived me first, Schultz.�

entries.source: 숨기지 않아도 돼. 난 이미 알고 있어, 너의 정령에 대해..�
entries.translation: No need to hide it. I already know about your Spirit...�

entries.source: 왜 그 힘을 나에게 숨겼지? 그 힘이 있으면 고대신을 영원히 봉인할 수 있다는 것도 알고 있으면서!�
entries.translation: Why did you hide that power from me? You knew it could seal the ancient gods forever!�
So, is that why you tried to hand me over to the Black Guard?�

entries.source: 그 놈들은, 듣는 자잖아! 네가 그렇게 증오하던... 웨이드 가의 배후라고!�
entries.translation: They are Listeners! The ones you hated so much... the ones behind House Wade!�
The Listeners are... victims as well.�

entries.source: ... 고대신에게 이용당할 뿐이었어. 듣는 자들은 그걸 깨닫고, 고대신을 배신했지.�
entries.translation: ...They were merely used by the ancient gods. Once they realized, they betrayed the gods.�

entries.source: 무슨 소릴 하는거야.. 너 누구에게 무슨 소릴 들은거냐?�
entries.translation: What are you talking about? Who told you such nonsense?�

entries.source: 속은 거야. 놈들은 고대신의 충실한 수족에 불과하다.�
entries.translation: You have been duped. They are nothing more than faithful puppets of the ancient gods.�

entries.source: 그렇다면 어째서 성지전쟁 때 고대종이 인간을 공격한 거라고 생각해?�
entries.translation: Then why do you think the ancients attacked humans during the Sanctuary War?�

entries.source: 우리의 적은 }고대신{이야, 슈르츠. 웨이드 가와 듣는 자들은 이용당하고 있음을 깨닫고 지금은 }고대신을 봉인{하려 하고 있다.�
entries.translation: Our enemy is the }ancient gods{, Schultz. House Wade and the Listeners realized they were being used, and now seek to }seal the ancient gods{.�

entries.source: 난.. 네가 최후의 승자가 되어주길 바래, 슈르츠.�
entries.translation: I... want you to be the ultimate victor, Schultz.�

entries.source: 공화국을 망치고, 우리들의 가문을 몰락시킨 것도 결국은 고대신의 농간이었어, 이제 너도 알잖아?�
entries.translation: Ruining the Republic, destroying our families... it was all the gods doing. Surely you know that now!�

entries.source: 그래서 나더러 다른 계승자들을 죽여 정령을 완성시키고, 고대신을 봉인하라고?�
entries.translation: So you want me to slaughter the other successors, complete the Spirit, and seal the ancient gods?�

entries.source: 그 어떤 대가를 치루더라도.. 고대신을 막지 않으면 인간에게 미래란 없으니까.�
entries.translation: No matter the cost... if we do not stop the ancient gods, humanity has no future.�

entries.source: 언제부터 네가 그렇게 듣는 자들을 믿게 된거지? 어떻게 그렇게 완벽하게 세뇌된거냐?�
entries.translation: Since when did you trust the Listeners so blindly? How could you be so utterly brainwashed?�

entries.source: 고대신을 막기 위해 고대신의 종복인 듣는 자에게 붙는다니, 그런 머저리가 어딨어!�
entries.translation: Siding with the Listeners, servants of the ancient gods, to stop those very gods? Who could be so foolish!�

entries.source: 듣는 자들이 고대신을 배신했다고? 그걸 어떻게 그렇게 쉽게 믿지?�
entries.translation: The Listeners betrayed the ancient gods? How could you believe that so easily?�

entries.source: 그들이 말해줬거든.. 내가 가장.. 알고 싶던 것을.�
entries.translation: Because they told me... the one thing I wanted to know most.�
Why my father... devoured my mother...�

entries.source: 듣는 자들은 서로를 흡수할 수 있다더군. 더 강한 능력을 가지게 된다고 해.�
entries.translation: Listeners can absorb one another. They gain greater power that way.�

entries.source: 하지만 보통.. 인간인 이상 그런 짓까진 하지 않겠지..�
entries.translation: Normally, though... no human would ever do such a thing...�

entries.source: 그걸 우리 아버지는 저질러 버렸어. 그 이유가 뭔지 알아?�
entries.translation: Yet my father did it. Do you know why?�

entries.source: 고대신의 의식이 아버지의 의식을 완전히 지배했기 때문이래. 그래, 그렇지 않으면 아버지가 그럴리가 없지..!�
entries.translation: The will of an ancient god completely overrode his mind. Yes, otherwise he never would have done it...!�

entries.source: 웨이드 가에서 와서 아버지를 처단하고, 사건은 마무리 됐어. 가문에는 나만 남았지.�
entries.translation: House Wade stepped in, executed my father, and ended it. Leaving only me in our family.�

entries.source: 그게.. 우리 가족에게 일어난 일의 진실이었던 거야..�
entries.translation: That... was the truth of what happened to my family...�

entries.source: 아버지와 어머니는.. 둘 다 듣는 자였고.. 언젠가는 고대신에게 지배당할 운명이었던..�
entries.translation: Both my father and mother... were Listeners... destined to be possessed by the ancient gods...�

entries.source: 듣는 자들도 필사적이야. 자신들이 고대신에게 지배당하면 공화국이 어떻게 될지 아니까.�
entries.translation: The Listeners are desperate too. They know what will happen to the Republic if the ancient gods take over.�
That is why... I will help them...�
If you will not change your mind...�
Kaze... are you out of your mind?!�

entries.source: 난 널 계속 추적하고 있었어. 그 }계승자 소년{이 지금 }콜크리크 섬{에 있다는 것도 알고 있지.�
entries.translation: I have been tracking you. I know that }successor boy{ is currently on }Cole Creek Isle{.�

entries.source: 네가 못하겠다면 내가, 모든 계승자들을 죽이고 정령을 완성시키겠다.�
entries.translation: If you cannot do it, then I will kill all the successors and complete the Spirit myself.�

entries.source: 흐흐. 수많은 사람들이 농업에 지쳐서 이렘을 떠나 센트럴로 갔지.�
entries.translation: Heh heh. Many grew sick of farming, left Irem, and went to Central.�

entries.source: 하지만 난 그러지 않을거야. 절대로 그 커다란 기계의 부속처럼 살지 않을 거라고.�
entries.translation: But not me. I will never live like a cog in that giant machine.�

entries.source: 여행객, 아니.. 용병이신가요? 저희 이렘에 오신걸 환영합니다.�
entries.translation: A traveler, or... a mercenary? Welcome to Irem.�

entries.source: 이렘은 공화국 최대의 농업 마을이자, 모든 학자들이 선망하는 거대 도서관이 있는 지성의 중심지랍니다.�
entries.translation: Irem is the Republic greatest farming village and an intellectual hub home to a grand library coveted by scholars.�

entries.source: 물론 저희 상점도 최고의 물품으로 여러분들을 모시고 있어요.�
entries.translation: Of course, our shop also welcomes you with the finest goods.�

entries.source: 모이투라 평야는 토양이 좋아서, 날씨가 추운데도 불구하고 수많은 종류의 곡물을 재배할 수 있지.�
entries.translation: The Moytura Plains have rich soil, so many crops grow despite the cold weather.�

entries.source: 하지만 요즘 위험한 것들이 많아져서 일하러 갈 땐 항상 무리를 지어서 이동해야 해.�
entries.translation: Dangerous beasts have increased lately, though, so we always travel in groups when working.�

entries.source: 테오도어가 나타난 건 1년전 즈음이야. 처음에는 그냥 샌님인 줄로만 알았지.�
entries.translation: Theodore appeared about a year ago. At first, I thought he was just a timid scholar.�

entries.source: 그 남자가 밝혀낸 마법의 규칙들은, 모이투라의 생산력 증대에도 간접적으로 큰 영향을 주었어.�
entries.translation: The magical laws he uncovered indirectly aided Moytura productivity immensely.�

entries.source: 4년전에 젊은 놈들이 혁명이니 뭐니 날뛰다가 마을이고 농지고 다 태워먹었을 땐 어쩌나 싶었는데..�
entries.translation: Four years ago, young folks ran wild shouting about revolution, burning farms and villages to ash...�

entries.source: 겨우 되살아난 마을이야. 쓸데없는 생각말고 모두가 웨이드 가를 잘 따라야 한다네.�
entries.translation: This village barely recovered. Stop dreaming foolish thoughts and follow House Wade properly.�

entries.source: 내가 말이야, 밀매업자이긴 해도 남에게 피해는 안주고 살아왔어.�
entries.translation: Look, I may be a smuggler, but I have lived without harming anyone.�

entries.source: 그러니까 이런 밝은 대낮에 너같은 용병을 보고도 암살당할 걱정이 없는 것 아니겠어?�
entries.translation: That is why I can see a mercenary like you in broad daylight without fearing assassination, right?�

entries.source: 이렘은 최대의 농업마을인데다, 학자들까지 몰려와서.. 선박들의 유동량이 많은 편이야.�
entries.translation: Irem is our biggest farming town, plus scholars flock here... So ship traffic pretty heavy.�

entries.source: 선착장을 더 확장하고 인부도 더 늘려야 되는데, 웨이드 가는 이런 변방까지 신경써주지 못하나 보군.�
entries.translation: We need a bigger dock and more hands, but House Wade could not care less about these boonies.�

entries.source: 혁명군이 일어났을 때는 득달같이 달려오더니 말이야..�
entries.translation: Though they sure came running fast enough when the rebels rose up...�

entries.source: 이곳은 공화국 최대 규모의 도서관으로, 인류 지식의 보고입니다.�
entries.translation: This is the Republic largest library, a treasure trove of human knowledge.�

entries.source: 수많은 학자들이 이곳으로 지식을 축적하기 위해 방문하죠.. 저도 마찬가지고요.�
entries.translation: Countless scholars visit to gather knowledge here... Myself included.�

entries.source: 4년 전의 혁명에서 이곳이 불타버리지 않은건, 정말 신의 가호였습니다..�
entries.translation: It was truly divine providence that this place was not burned down during the revolution four years ago...�
When the Descendants return, a new world will unfold...�

entries.source: 신세계가 열리면 지금의 모든 인간의 과거는 부정되죠. 믿음만이 구원을 줍니다.�
entries.translation: In that new world, humanity entire past is voided. Only faith brings salvation.�

entries.source: 이것도 그냥.. 경고용일 뿐인 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Seems this was just meant as a warning too.�
Welcome! We are at your service.�

entries.source: 쉬어가시겠어요? 200 GOLD로 모든 HP를 회복시켜 드립니다.�
entries.translation: Care for a rest? Fully restore all HP for 200 GOLD.�

entries.source: 네베드들은 좋겠어요. 그 쪽은 자신들의 기원을 명확하게 알고 있거든요.�
entries.translation: Must be nice for the Neveds. They clearly know their own origins.�

entries.source: 창세 신화가 있어요, 그쪽은. 이 세계를 창조한 신이 네베드도 창조했다고 해요.�
entries.translation: They have a creation myth. They say the god who made this world created the Neved too.�

entries.source: 그런데 그 신, 성격은 안 좋았는지 나중에 피조물들이랑 싸우다가 결국 봉인당했다고 하더라고요.�
entries.translation: Apparently that god had quite a temper, ending up fighting its creations before being sealed away.�

entries.source: 그 신이 묻혀 있는 곳이 그들이 말하는 성지에요.�
entries.translation: Where that god lies buried is what they call the Sanctuary.�
You mean the relic you brought me?�

entries.source: 아쉽지만 인류의 흔적은 아닌 것 같아요.�
entries.translation: Unfortunately, it does not seem to be of human origin.�

entries.source: 새겨진 문자도 너무 이질적이고... 재질도 그래요. 지금 기술로도 만들 수 있을까 말까 할 정도라서.�
entries.translation: The inscriptions are too alien... and the material, too. Even today technology could barely replicate it.�

entries.source: 네베드의 유물로 보기도 좀 그렇단 말이에요. 지금으로서는 완전히 정체 불명이에요.�
entries.translation: It hardly looks like a Neved relic either. For now, its identity is a complete mystery.�
Do you need it back? What are you going to use it for?�

entries.source: 조금 짚이는 곳이 있어서 확인해 봤으면 하는데...�
entries.translation: I have an idea of where it might belong, so I want to check it out...�

entries.source: 어디 다른 곳에 비싸게 팔아먹으려는 건 아니겠죠...�
entries.translation: You are not trying to sell it off somewhere for a fortune, are you...?�

entries.source: 뭐 좋아요, 발견한 사람은 당신이니까. 대신 뭔가 알아내면 저한테도 말해주세요.�
entries.translation: Well, fine. You found it after all. Just make sure to tell me if you discover anything.�

entries.source: 요즘 들어 테오도어가 안보인단 말야. 무슨 일이 있나?�
entries.translation: I have not seen Theodore around lately. Did something happen?�

entries.source: 진실을 담고 있는 책이란 귀중한거야. 언제나 지배자들한테는 눈에 가시 같지만.�
entries.translation: Books that tell the truth are precious. Though they are always a thorn in the side of rulers.�

entries.source: 아무리 금서 조치를 취하고, 책을 불태워도 끝까지 살아 남거든.�
entries.translation: No matter how many bans they place or books they burn, truth survives in the end.�

entries.source: 나는 이 도서관에서 일한지 7년째야. 그 4년전의 혁명이 일어날 때도 도서관을 지켰지.�
entries.translation: I have worked in this library for seven years. I guarded it even during the revolution four years ago.�

entries.source: 온 섬이 불타는 데도, 웨이드 가에서 이 도서관만큼은 지켜주었어. 감사한 일이지.�
entries.translation: Even as the entire island burned, House Wade spared this library. I am grateful for that.�

entries.source: 공화국, 공화국 하지만 공화국의 역사는 30년도 안되었어.�
entries.translation: People talk about the Republic, but its history is not even 30 years old.�

entries.source: 베인, 리드마이어, 웨이드, 에네스트 4개의 귀족 가문이 각자 세력을 넓히려고 호시탐탐 눈치만 보던게...�
entries.translation: Bane, Riedmeyr, Wade, Ernest... The four noble houses were just biding their time to expand their power...�

entries.source: 멸문당한 가문의 생존자나, 거기에 충성하던 사람들이 남아서 난동을 부리기는 아직 충분한 시간이야.�
entries.translation: It is still plenty of time for survivors of ruined houses or their loyalists to cause chaos.�

entries.source: |(이 사람이라면, 로건의 책을 잘 보관해 줄지도 모르겠다...){�
entries.translation: |(This person might take good care of Logan book...){�

entries.source: 안되겠는걸. 여기는 출판된 서적만 보관하거든. 이건 책이라기 보다는 원고잖아.�
entries.translation: Afraid not. We only archive published books here. This is a manuscript, not a book.�
The contents are a mess, too... Did you write this yourself?�

entries.source: 하긴 별로 책을 읽거나 글을 써볼 것처럼 생긴 인상은 아니군.�
entries.translation: Figures. You do not strike me as someone who reads or writes much anyway.�
If it will not work, nothing to be done. Give it back.�

entries.source: 이건 내가 좀 편집을 한 후에 제대로 출판해서 도서관에 한 부 들여놓도록 하겠어.�
entries.translation: I will edit this a bit, get it properly published, and then place a copy in the library.�

entries.source: 전쟁이 끝나자 감축된 군인원들이 용병이 되었지.�
entries.translation: When the war ended, demobilized soldiers turned into mercenaries.�

entries.source: 아직은 몬스터들이 많으니 용병들도 먹고 살만 하겠지만, 몬스터도 줄어들면 어쩔 생각인가?�
entries.translation: There are plenty of monsters now, so mercenaries make a living, but what when monsters dwindle?�
You are still young. Why not study while you can?�

entries.source: 용병에게 생존 지식은 무척 중요해. 언제 고립될지 모르니까.�
entries.translation: Survival skills are crucial for mercenaries. You never know when you will be stranded.�

entries.source: 보급이 달리게 되면 정규군에게 우선적으로 가는 경향이 있어...�
entries.translation: When supplies run low, regular troops tend to get priority...�

entries.source: 먹을 수 있는 것과 없는 것 정도는 구별할 수 있게 미리 익혀 두는게 좋아.�
entries.translation: You should learn early on to tell what is edible from what is not.�

entries.source: 예를 들면 매도우 힐의 늑대는 훌륭한 단백질 공급원이지.�
entries.translation: For instance, wolves on Meadow Hill are an excellent source of protein.�

entries.source: 책을 읽는데는 어디서 읽느냐보다 어떻게, 무엇을 읽느냐가 중요하지.�
entries.translation: When reading a book, how and what you read matters far more than where.�

entries.source: 도서관이 좀 복잡해서, 난 대체로 책을 빌려읽는 편이야.�
entries.translation: The library is rather crowded, so I usually borrow books to read.�

entries.source: 당신의 모험이 얼마나 많은 것을 보고 얻었는지, 확인해 보세요.�
entries.translation: Check out how much you have seen and earned on your adventures.�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬 최고의 상회, 이렘 상회에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 필요한 모든 것을 제공해 드릴게요.�
entries.translation: Welcome to the Irem Merchant Guild, the finest in Moytura! We have all you need.�

entries.source: 얼마나 강해졌는가? 강해지면 질수록, 더 강해지기 위해 더 많은 노력을 필요로 하지.�
entries.translation: How strong have you become? The stronger you get, the more effort it takes to grow further.�

entries.source: 후후, 오늘도 세 개나 깨먹었군. 하지만 괜찮아, 자네의 것은 튼실해 보이니까..�
entries.translation: Heh, broke three of them today. But it is fine, yours look quite sturdy...�

entries.source: 그럼, 테오를 돕는 일은 슈우에게 맡기고 난 여길 지킬게.�
entries.translation: Alright, I will leave helping Theo to you, Schu, and stay behind to guard this place.�

entries.source: 뭐.. 의회쪽에서는 우리를 전혀 눈치 못채고 있는 것 같지만, 그래도 조심하는 게 좋으니까.�
entries.translation: Well... the Council does not seem to notice us at all, but it pays to be careful.�

entries.source: 전언을 보냈는데 너무 안와서.. 그냥 내가 테오를 도와주러 갈까 생각하던 참이었다구.�
entries.translation: I sent word but you took so long... I was just thinking of going to help Theo myself.�

entries.source: 뭐.. 그냥, 여전해. 웨이드 가도 듣는 자들도, 얼어붙은 바다 쪽은 신경도 안쓰는 것 같다니까.�
entries.translation: Well... same as usual. House Wade and the Listeners do not seem to care about the Frozen Sea at all.�

entries.source: 너희들은 어때? 몇 번인가.. 전승이 있었잖아?�
entries.translation: How about you guys? Were not there... a few transmissions?�

entries.source: 후우.. 그랬구나. 남은 건 넷 뿐이구나.�
entries.translation: Phew... I see. Only four of us left, then.�

entries.source: 히.. 힘내야지? 그래도. 루퍼스 빼고도 아직 셋이나 남았어.�
entries.translation: Ch-Cheer up, okay? Even without Rufus, there are still three left.�

entries.source: 루퍼스를 어떻게든 처리하고, 테오가 정령의 폭주만 제어할 수 있게 되면.. 준비 완료잖아?�
entries.translation: Once we deal with Rufus and Theo can control the Spirit rampage... we will be all set, right?�

entries.source: 좀 가난한 혁명이 되겠지만, 배신자 끼고 혁명을 일으키는 것보단 나을테고.�
entries.translation: It will be a rather meager revolution, but better than having traitors involved.�
Even looking at it in the best light, that is where we stand.�
Otherwise, we would never be able to endure it.�

entries.source: 그래도.. 에블린 언니의 목소리는.. 신비한 힘이 있는 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Still... Evelyn voice seems to hold a mysterious power.�

entries.source: 조금은, 할 수 있을 것 같다는 생각이 들거든.�
entries.translation: It makes me feel like we just might be able to do this.�
Just might? That is not enough!�

entries.source: 기왕이면 할 수 있을 것 같은 게 아니라, 할 수 있다로 가자구.�
entries.translation: Instead of thinking we might, let us believe we can!�
So, what is it you need us to do?�
Alright... let us get down to business.�

entries.source: 테오가, 연구에 진척이 없는 것 같아. }강림자의 교단{에서 뭔가 자료를 빼오고 싶은 것 같은데..�
entries.translation: Theo seems stuck in his research. He wants to extract some records from the }Order of Descendants{...�

entries.source: 아무래도, 네베드의 강림자와 아무 연관이 없는 건 아닌 것 같아. 그 수상한 집단.�
entries.translation: That suspicious group does not seem entirely unrelated to the Neved Descendants.�

entries.source: 그래도 수상한 집단이라 뭔가 위험할 것 같긴한데.. 테오는 싸움질에 약하잖아?�
entries.translation: It sounds dangerous since they are so suspicious... and Theo no fighter, right?�

entries.source: 하지만 난 요즘같은 때에 여길 비우기가 좀 그래서 망설이고 있었어.�
entries.translation: I hesitated because I really cannot leave this place right now.�

entries.source: 슈우 네가 간다면, 분명 도와줄 일이 있을거야. 한번 가봐.�
entries.translation: If you go, Schu, I am sure you can help him out. Go check on him.�

entries.source: 결국은 당신이 테오도어가 걱정되서, 우릴 부른 거로군?�
entries.translation: So basically, you called us because you are worried about Theodore?�

entries.source: 중요한 연구잖아, 너에게도 나에게도. 그런 섭섭한 소리 말라구.�
entries.translation: It is crucial research, for both of us! Do not make it sound so cold.�

entries.source: 교단의 본거지는 }모이투라 평야 동쪽{에 있는 }기원의 관{이야. 아마 테오도 아직 거기에 있을거야.�
entries.translation: Their base is the }Hall of Prayer{ in }East Moytura Plains{. Theo should still be there.�

entries.source: 잠깐.. 기원의 관은 }증명된 신자{가 아니면 들어갈 수 없습니다.�
entries.translation: Hold on... Only }proven believers{ may enter the Hall of Prayer.�

entries.source: .. 증명된 신자? 너희.. 종교 단체면 신자 모으기에 열중해야 하는 것 아닌가?�
entries.translation: ...Proven believers? Should not a religious cult be eager to gather followers?�

entries.source: 저희는 단순한 종교 단체가 아닙니다. 진정 구원을 구하는 자만이 저희와 함께 할 수 있습니다.�
entries.translation: We are no mere cult. Only those who truly seek salvation may join us.�

entries.source: 당연히 구원을 구하지. 구원을 구하는 데 무슨, 증거라도 필요해?�
entries.translation: Of course we seek salvation. Do we need proof just to seek it?�

entries.source: 음.. 여기 내 친구들인데, 어떻게 안 될까요?�
entries.translation: Um... these are my friends, could you let them through?�

entries.source: 테오도어님, 무슨 소리십니까. 지금 저희는 강림을 위한 중요한 제사를 앞두고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: Master Theodore, what are you saying? We are preparing an important ritual for the Descent.�
Ah, of course, I understand that, but...�

entries.source: 모든 신자는 같은 가치의 증거를 보여야 합니다. 그건..�
entries.translation: All believers must offer proof of equal worth. That is...�

entries.source: 네에, 네에, 그렇죠. 저도 잘 알고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: Yes, yes, I know. I understand completely.�
Do they actually have any connection to the Descendants?�

entries.source: 음.. 일단 표면적으로는 사람들이 지어낸 얘기가 대부분이지만..�
entries.translation: Well... on the surface, most of it is just fabricated stories, but...�

entries.source: 이들이 법전으로 보는 문건들은 상당히 흥미로워. 네베드 쪽의 역사도 상당히 개입되어 있고..�
entries.translation: The texts they treat as canon are quite fascinating. Neved history is heavily entwined...�

entries.source: 무엇보다 지하에서 수상한 일이 벌어지고 있는 것 같은데...�
entries.translation: Above all, something very suspicious seems to be happening underground...�

entries.source: 어쩌면 강림자의 유적일지도 몰라. 유적에서 나온 것들을 기반으로 신앙이 형성된 거지.�
entries.translation: It could be a Descendant ruin. Their faith was likely built around relics found there.�

entries.source: 확실히 북쪽의 섬들에는 숨겨진 강림자의 유적들이 많은 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Indeed, the northern isles seem full of hidden Descendant ruins.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 일단 들어가야 뭘 할 것 아냐.�
entries.translation: Still... we cannot do anything unless we get inside first.�

entries.source: 어쩔 수 없이 너도, 신앙의 증거가 필요할 것 같다.�
entries.translation: Looks like you have no choice but to provide proof of faith as well.�
What on earth is this proof of faith, anyway?�

entries.source: 강림의 제사에는 }토파즈{라는 보석이 대량으로 필요하다고 해.�
entries.translation: They say the Descent ritual requires a large amount of }Topaz{.�

entries.source: }황혼섬 동부{에서 구할 수 있는데.. 나도 제법 고생했다고, 그거 모으느라고.�
entries.translation: You can find it in }East Twilight Isle{... It took me quite an effort to gather enough, too.�
What... so it is all about money in the end.�

entries.source: 요구하는 수량도 만만치 않아. 자그마치 }20개{... 욕심많은 놈들이지.�
entries.translation: The amount they demand is ridiculous, too. A whole }20 units{... Greedy bastards.�

entries.source: .. 상관없어, 용병질 할 때부터 수집하는 데는 익숙하니까.�
entries.translation: ...Does not matter. I am used to collecting things from my mercenary days.�

entries.source: 후.. 좀 귀찮지만 지금 너도 소란 안피우고 안에 들어오려면 그 방법 뿐인 것 같다.�
entries.translation: Phew... It is a hassle, but that is the only way to get in without causing a scene.�

entries.source: 의회에서도, 우리 교단의 모임은 인정해주고 있어.�
entries.translation: Even the Council recognizes our gatherings.�

entries.source: 당연하지.. 우린 그냥 기다릴 뿐인걸. 어떠한 힘도, 사람의 기다림은 막을 수 없지.�
entries.translation: Naturally... We are merely waiting. No power can stop people from waiting.�
Have you tasted the elixir brewed from Aminofena?�

entries.source: 강림자들의 성문에도 나오는 그 영약은, 강림자를 좀 더 가까이 느끼게 해주죠.�
entries.translation: Mentioned in the Descendants scriptures, it brings one closer to the Descendants.�

entries.source: 저는 느껴본 적이 있어요. 제 몸의 주인이, 마치 제가 아닌.. 강림자인 것만 같은 느낌.�
entries.translation: I have felt it before. A feeling that the master of my body is not me... but a Descendant.�

entries.source: 봉인된 교리의 관 2층에는 지식인들이 계십니다. 교단의 설립자 들이죠.�
entries.translation: Scholars reside on the sealed 2nd floor of the Hall of Dogma. The Order founders.�

entries.source: 어차피 부질없어질 세상에 대한 미련을 완전히 끊으셨다고 해요.�
entries.translation: They say they have completely severed all ties to this doomed, futile world.�

entries.source: 모이투라 섬 최고의 학자들이시니, 분명히 더 큰 명예를 얻으실 수도 있었을 텐데..�
entries.translation: They were the greatest scholars of Moytura Isle, and could have gained great fame...�

entries.source: 교리의 관에는 신앙을 증명한 진실한 신도만이 들어갈 수 있습니다.�
entries.translation: Only true believers who have proven their faith may enter the Hall of Dogma.�

entries.source: 강림자의 재림을 기원하는 제사가 얼마남지 않았습니다. 더 많은 정성으로 구원을 기다립시다.�
entries.translation: The ritual praying for the Descendant return is near. Let us await salvation with devotion.�

entries.source: 교단이 단순히 믿음만으로 이루어진 종교라고 생각하지 말게나.�
entries.translation: Do not assume this Order is simply a religion built on mere blind faith.�

entries.source: 강림자의 교단은 모이투라 섬의 가장 진보된, 젊은 지식인들이 만든 학문에 가까워.�
entries.translation: The Order of the Descendant is closer to an academic discipline built by Moytura young elite.�

entries.source: 이제 막 3년째일 뿐이지만, 그들은 강림자의 존재를 우리에게 증명해 주었지.�
entries.translation: It is only been three years, but they have proven the existence of the Descendant to us.�

entries.source: 그래도 말이야.. 의회가 이 교단에 의외로 관대한 건 놀랍단 말이지.�
entries.translation: Still... it is surprising how unexpectedly lenient the Council is toward this Order.�

entries.source: 뭐 신도들 사이에서 떠도는 말에 따르면, 교단의 지도자가 웨이드 가와 깊은 관계라는 소리도 있고..�
entries.translation: Well, rumor among believers has it that the Order leader is close with House Wade...�

entries.source: 어쩌면 의회에서도 강림자의 존재를 믿고 있는 게 아닐까?�
entries.translation: Maybe even the Council believes in the existence of the Descendant?�

entries.source: 뭐, 나는 그 덕을 보고 있는 셈이지만.�
entries.translation: Well, I am certainly reaping the benefits of it, though.�

entries.source: 무기 수리는 해줄 수 있지만, 그 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: I can repair your weapons, but that is about it.�

entries.source: 반역자로 목이 매달릴 뻔 했는데 여기 숨어 있으니까 안 쫓아 오더라고.�
entries.translation: I was almost hanged as a traitor, but hiding here, they have not chased after me.�

entries.source: 덕분에 이 건물에서 한발자국도 못 나가는 신세가 되었지만, 뭐 죽는 것 보다는 낫지.�
entries.translation: Thanks to that, I cannot take a single step out of this building, but it beats dying.�

entries.source: 센트럴에서 론베르크라는 명공 가문 이야기를 들었는데... 혹시 당신이?�
entries.translation: I heard in Central of a master smith family called Ronberg... Could you be?�

entries.source: 그렇게 불릴 때도 있었지만 다 옛날 일이야. 지금은 이름도 성도 없는 지나가는 아저씨 A지.�
entries.translation: People called me that once, but it is ancient history. Now I am just a nameless nobody.�
You do not forge weapons anymore?�

entries.source: 뭐야, 자네도 검을 만들어 달라고 날 찾은 건가?�
entries.translation: What, did you come looking for me to forge you a sword too?�

entries.source: 여태까지 그런 소리를 하며 찾아 온 놈들이 열 명도 넘어.�
entries.translation: Over a dozen bastards have come asking for the exact same thing so far.�

entries.source: 하지만 무리야, 무리. 우리 가문에 내려오는 비전의 도구가 없으면 평범한 무기 밖에 못 만들어.�
entries.translation: It is impossible. Without my family heirloom tools, I can only make ordinary junk.�
Whenever I tell them that, they just curse me out and leave.�

entries.source: 뭘 멋대로 잔뜩 기대하고 와서 멋대로 실망했다고 화를 내는건지, 참 어처구니 없다니까.�
entries.translation: Getting their hopes up and then getting pissed when they are disappointed... ridiculous.�
|(Showed the broken magic device and blueprint.){�
To think I would see this again...�

entries.source: 그런데 역시, 부숴버렸군. 멍청한 놈들 같으니.�
entries.translation: Figures they broke it, though. Incompetent fools.�

entries.source: 일단 이거부터 고쳐야겠는데... 좀 특별한 광석이 필요해.�
entries.translation: I need to fix this first... but I will need a special ore.�

entries.source: 나는 밖에 나가기만 하면 목이 달아날 판이니 또 자네가 구해와야 하는데, 할 수 있겠나?�
entries.translation: My head rolls the moment I step outside, so you will have to get it. Can you do it?�

entries.source: 여기까지 와서 포기라니... 근성없는 놈 같으니.�
entries.translation: Giving up after coming this far? What a spineless coward.�

entries.source: 일단 <이터니움{이 필요해. 콜크리크에서 나는 특수한 금속인데.�
entries.translation: First, I need <Eternium{. It is a special metal found only on Cole Creek.�

entries.source: 우리 가문 밖에 구매처가 없었으니, 아마 지금은 채광하지 않을거야. 직접 캐야지 뭐.�
entries.translation: My family was the only buyer, so they probably do not mine it now. You will have to dig it up.�
Oh, you are back? What for?�

entries.source: 음? 자네 뭘 가지고 있는 건가?�
entries.translation: Hmm? What do you have there?�
|(Showed the broken weapon engraved with initials.){�

entries.source: 이건 우리 아버지가 만들었던... 맙소사... 대체 여기다가 무슨 짓을 한거야?�
entries.translation: This was made by my father... Good grief... What on earth did you do to it?�
Damn it... To break it like this.�

entries.source: 이런 무기는 수리도 마음대로 못해. 도구가 제대로 갖춰져 있기만 해도...�
entries.translation: I cannot just repair a weapon like this easily. If only I had the right tools...�

entries.source: 전에도 그런 이야기를 했었지. 어디 있는데?�
entries.translation: You mentioned that before. Where are they?�

entries.source: 웨이드 가 놈들이 가져가 버렸어. 아마 센트럴 타워에서 야만스럽게 분해를 하느니 하고 있겠지.�
entries.translation: Those House Wade dogs took them. Probably barbarically dismantling them in Central Tower.�

entries.source: 조합할 수 있는 목록을 보여줄 테니 필요한 재료를 구해서 오라고.�
entries.translation: I will show you the combine list, so bring back the materials needed.�

entries.source: 기왕하는거, 더 나은 무기를 만들어 주지.�
entries.translation: Since we are doing this, I will craft you an even better weapon.�

entries.source: 토파즈는 교단의 제사에 아주 중요한 제물 중에 하나예요.�
entries.translation: Topaz is one of the most crucial offerings for the Order ritual.�

entries.source: 강림자께서 우리에게 남겨준 문서들을 보면, 토파즈는 거대한 힘을 다스릴 매개체라고 하거든요.�
entries.translation: According to the documents left by the Descendants, topaz serves as a medium to control immense power.�

entries.source: 절대로 교단에서 돈을 위해 모으거나 하는 게 아니랍니다.�
entries.translation: The order is definitely not gathering it for money or anything like that.�

entries.source: 엄마가, 이 모임이 공화국에서 가장 똑똑한 사람들이 만든 거랬어.�
entries.translation: Mom said this group was founded by the smartest people in the Republic.�

entries.source: 근데 정말 나는 공부안해도 되는 걸까?�
entries.translation: Does that mean I really do not have to study anymore?�

entries.source: 강림자들에게 8이라는 숫자는 대단히 큰 의미를 가진다고 해요.�
entries.translation: They say the number 8 holds great significance to the Descendants.�

entries.source: 완성된 숫자.. 끝이 없는 숫자.. 그렇게 생각하고 보면, 굉장히 아름다워보이지 않나요?�
entries.translation: A complete number... an infinite number... When you see it that way, is not it truly beautiful?�

entries.source: 좀 먼 길이지만.. }황혼섬 동부{에서 }토파즈{를 좀 모아와야 해.�
entries.translation: It is a bit of a trek, but... we need to collect }Topaz{ from }East Twilight Isle{.�

entries.source: 난 그 사이에 좀 더 이 수상한 건물을 조사하고 있을게.�
entries.translation: Meanwhile, I will keep investigating this suspicious building.�

entries.source: 어떻게든 심층부까지 들어가 봐야 해. 난 위에서 놈들이 지내는 제사라는 걸 조사해 볼게.�
entries.translation: We must reach the deepest level somehow. I will check out the ritual they are holding upstairs.�

entries.source: 입구는 여기야.. 지어진지 얼마 안된 건물이라 찾는데 애 좀 먹었지.�
entries.translation: Here is the entrance... It is newly built, so it took some effort to find.�

entries.source: .. 모임의 근간이 되는 지하시설로의 입구인데.. 너무 허술한 거 아닌가?�
entries.translation: ...The entrance to the underground facility holding this group together... Is not security too lax?�

entries.source: 나도 그런줄 알았는데.. 아까도 말했지만 아래는 경계 장치들이 엄청난 수준이야.�
entries.translation: I thought so too... but like I said, the security devices down there are serious business.�

entries.source: 어쩌면 그 경계장치들도 방주의 영향으로 진화한 걸지도...�
entries.translation: Perhaps those security devices evolved under the Ark influence as well...�

entries.source: 모르겠어. 강림자의 기술은 이 세상의 것이 아니니까.. 가능성이 없진 않지.�
entries.translation: I am not sure. Descendant tech is otherworldly... so it is not entirely out of the question.�

entries.source: 게다가 뭔가 마법적인 트랩도 있는 것 같으니.. 쉽지는 않을거야.�
entries.translation: Besides, there seem to be magical traps too... It will not be easy.�
Sounds annoying just hearing about it.�

entries.source: 어떻게든 심층부까지 들어가 봐야 해. 할 수 있을까?�
entries.translation: We have to reach the deepest area no matter what. Can you pull it off?�

entries.source: 가봐야 알겠지. 일단 다녀올테니.. 망이나 잘 봐줘.�
entries.translation: I will know once I get there. I am heading in, so keep a sharp lookout.�

entries.source: 오, 좋아. 이 정도면 충분해. 넌 정말 돈 잘 벌것 같다, 이렇게 빠르다니..�
entries.translation: Oh, nice. This is plenty. You would make a fortune at this rate, being so fast...�
I did this endlessly back in my mercenary days.�

entries.source: 뭐.. 요즘은 이 녀석 덕분에 좀 더 수월해진 것도 있지. 이대로 용병질만 하면 떼돈 벌지도.�
entries.translation: Well... lately this one has made things a lot easier too. Keep this up and we might strike it rich.�
Ehehe, did you just compliment me?�

entries.source: 어쨌든.. 그 사이에 나도 좀 진전이 있었어.�
entries.translation: Anyway... I made some progress while you were gone.�

entries.source: 지하에 수상한 미궁이 있어. 굉장히 오래돼 보이는..�
entries.translation: There is a suspicious labyrinth below. It looks ancient...�

entries.source: 일단 들어가는 입구는 찾았는데.. 아무래도 좀 위험한 것 같아서 널 기다리고 있었지.�
entries.translation: I found the way in, but it seemed too dangerous, so I was waiting for you.�

entries.source: 테오도어씨 그거.. 위험에 밀어넣겠다는 소리로 들리는데..�
entries.translation: Theodore... that sounds an awful lot like you are throwing him into danger...�
That is why I buttered him up first, did not I?�
Does not matter. That is what I came here for anyway.�

entries.source: 헛고생이 되지만 않는다면 좋겠는데.. 조사할 가치는 확실한 거겠지?�
entries.translation: I just hope it is not a wild goose chase... It is worth looking into, right?�

entries.source: 사실 나도 안 들어가본 건 아닌데.. 경비장치가 좀 삼엄해. 돈을 많이 벌긴 했는지..�
entries.translation: To be honest, I peeked inside... Security is tight. They must have made a killing...�

entries.source: 게다가, 뭔가 마법적인 장치도 되어있는 것 같고..�
entries.translation: Plus, it looks like there are magical devices set up as well...�

entries.source: 개인적인 견해로는 확실해. }강림자의 유적{이, 이 지하에 있는 거야.�
entries.translation: In my opinion, there is no doubt. The }Descendant Ruins{ are down below.�

entries.source: 거기서 찾아낸 유물들이 이 교단의 근간이 된거고.�
entries.translation: And the relics recovered from them formed the foundation of this order.�

entries.source: 좋아. 너희도 등록해 줄테니까.. 들어와서 뒷쪽 창고 쪽으로 와.�
entries.translation: All right. I will get you registered, so come in and head toward the back storage room.�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�

entries.source: 바깥 세상에는 훨씬 더 따뜻한 섬들이 있대. 나는 기억도 안나지만..�
entries.translation: They say there are much warmer islands out in the world. Though I do not even remember...�

entries.source: 난 이 정도로도 충분히 행복해. 이제 나와서 놀 수 있잖아?�
entries.translation: I am happy enough with this. I can finally come outside and play, right?�
You are here. Did you hear the news?�

entries.source: 아아. 테오도어는.. 비명길의 유물을 연구하고 있겠지?�
entries.translation: Yeah. Theodore is... researching the relic from Screaming Path, right?�

entries.source: 응. 이게 루퍼스를 사냥할 수 있는 유일한 방법이라고..�
entries.translation: Yes. He said this is the only way to hunt Rufus down...�

entries.source: 응? 테오도어씨.. 여기 있는 거 아니야?�
응. 잠깐 들렀다가 바로 비명길로 갔어.�
entries.translation: No. He stopped by briefly and headed straight for Screaming Path.�

entries.source: 마을에 계승자가 두 명 느껴져서 당연히 테오도어씨인 줄 알았..�
entries.translation: I sensed two Successors in town, so I naturally assumed one was Theodore...�

entries.source: 있어.. 이안에, 에블린 언니 말고 또 한명의 계승자가!�
entries.translation: There is another... Successor in here besides Evelyn!�

entries.source: 들켜버렸네.. 세 명이 전부 모이길 기다리고 있었는데..�
entries.translation: Busted... And here I was waiting for all three to gather...�

entries.source: 크크크크.. 좀 지루했지만.. 이번엔 확실하게 하려고..�
entries.translation: Heheheh.. It got a bit boring.. but I had to make sure this time..�

entries.source: 어떻게 여기까지 이렇게 빨리 찾아온거지? 여기는..�
entries.translation: How did you track us down so fast? This place is..�

entries.source: 난 듣는 자라고. 듣는 자들이 알고 있는 건 나도 알고 있어.�
entries.translation: I am a Hearer. What the Hearers know, I know.�

entries.source: 설마 순진하게, 듣는 자들이 정말 여길 모를 거라고 생각했던 거냐?�
entries.translation: Did you honestly think the Hearers did not know about this place?�

entries.source: 하지만.. 셋을 한번에 상대하려고 하다니, 우릴 너무 쉽게 보는군..!�
entries.translation: Taking on all three of us at once? You take us too lightly..!�

entries.source: 크크크크.. 쉽게 보다니, 무슨 그런 섭섭한 소리를..�
entries.translation: Heheheh.. Take you lightly? How hurtful..�

entries.source: 어떡하지, 테오가 준비를 마쳤을까? 너무 빠른데..!�
entries.translation: What now? Is Theo ready yet? He came too fast..!�

entries.source: 방법이 없어.. 정면으로 대적할 수 있는 상대가 아니다..!�
entries.translation: There is no way.. We cannot take him head-on..!�

entries.source: 슈우, 먼저 빠져나가서 비명길에서 테오와 함께 기다리고 있어.�
entries.translation: Schultz, get out first and wait with Theo at Screaming Path.�

entries.source: 조금이라도 시간을 끌어야 해.. 최대한 버텨볼게.�
entries.translation: We need to buy time.. I will hold him off as long as I can.�

entries.source: 적당히 저 놈을 놀려주다가 따라갈게. 그리고 전장을 비명길로 옮기자.�
entries.translation: I will toy with him a bit and follow. Let us move the fight to Screaming Path.�

entries.source: 괜찮겠어? 루퍼스는 예전에 당신이 만났을 때보다 훨씬 강할거야..�
entries.translation: Are you sure? Rufus is far stronger than when you last fought him..�
Do not underestimate me. I am the ace of the Revolutionary Army.�
Evelyn, do not push yourself too hard!�
No, you do not know Rufus.�

entries.source: 나도 만나봤어. 저 남자가 강하다는 건 알아.�
entries.translation: I faced him too. I know how strong he is.�
That is not enough. You go first.�

entries.source: 슈우, 여긴 내가 지켜온 땅이야.. 마지막까지..�
entries.translation: Schultz, this is the land I protected.. Until the very end..�

entries.source: 내 말 들어! 시간 끌다가 희생하려는 생각따위 하지말고 어서 가!�
entries.translation: Listen to me! Do not even think about stalling to sacrifice yourself. Go, now!�

entries.source: 놈에게 미끼가 되는 거, 난 벌써 몇 번이나 해봤어. 난 반드시 살아서 간다.�
entries.translation: Being bait for him? I have done it plenty of times. I will make it back alive, guaranteed.�

entries.source: 크크 뭐야.. 또 네가 미끼냐? 계속 실패하면서 질리지도 않나 보구나.�
entries.translation: Heheh, what.. you are bait again? You fail every time, do not you get tired of it?�
Yeah, well, I am used to it.�

entries.source: 크크크, 몇 번을 반복하면서 아직도 모르다니..�
entries.translation: Heheheh, after so many times, you still have not figured it out..�

entries.source: 나는 너를 마지막에 잡을 거야.. 싸우는 보람이 있기도 하고, 정령의 변화를 눈으로 볼 수 있는 소중한 샘플이거든.�
entries.translation: I am saving you for last.. Fighting you is fun, and you are a precious specimen showing Spirit evolution firsthand.�

entries.source: 그리고 가능하면.. 그 정령 아가씨도 산 채로 얻고 싶고 말이야.. 크크..�
entries.translation: And if possible.. I would love to take that Spirit girl alive too.. Heheh..�

entries.source: 그러니까.. 난 이번에도 널 무시할거야.. 크크크..�
entries.translation: So.. I am going to ignore you this time too.. Heheheh..�
Of course I will. Because I can.�

entries.source: 오늘 나는 가장 강대한 힘을 손에 넣는다.�
entries.translation: Today, the greatest power will be mine.�
Damn it..!! You will not get away!�

entries.source: 예전에는 이걸 보고 있으면 마음이 편해졌는데...�
entries.translation: Looking at this used to bring me peace of mind...�
Now, it somehow only brings more anxiety.�

entries.source: 난 아직도 지금 선택을 후회하지 않아.�
entries.translation: I still do not regret my choice.�

entries.source: 에블린과 테오를 믿어도 되는 걸까. 요즘 왠지... 좀.�
entries.translation: Can we really trust Evelyn and Theo? Lately, something feels... off.�

entries.source: 사람들이 너무 풀어졌어. 이제 저 불꽃을 당연하게 여기고 더 좋은 걸 내놓으라고...�
entries.translation: People have grown too complacent. They take the flame for granted and demand more...�

entries.source: 테오나 에블린한테 그러는 것 같단 말야. 쯧쯧.�
entries.translation: Demanding it from Theo and Evelyn. Tsk tsk.�

entries.source: 여기서 동쪽으로 가면 동굴이 하나 있잖아?�
entries.translation: You know the cave east of here, right?�

entries.source: 원래는 무슨 결계 같은 게 있었는데 갑자기 없어졌더라고.�
entries.translation: There used to be some barrier there, but it suddenly vanished.�

entries.source: 몬스터들이 갑자기 흉폭해졌어. 곰도 더 나타나고 말야.�
entries.translation: The monsters suddenly grew ferocious. More bears have shown up too.�

entries.source: 네가 그 때 그 백곰을 잡지 않았으면 그 놈도 더 흉폭해졌겠지?�
entries.translation: If you had not slain that white bear back then, it probably would have gone berserk too, right?�

entries.source: 큰 일이 생기기 전에 막아서 다행이야.�
entries.translation: Glad we stopped it before disaster struck.�

entries.source: 쉬었다 가겠니? 이 집은 마음껏 사용해도 좋아.�
entries.translation: Care to rest? Feel free to use this house as you like.�

entries.source: ... 웨이드 가와 듣는 자들의 움직임은 확연히 죽었어. 특히.. 듣는 자들은 완전히 침묵하고 있다.�
entries.translation: ...House Wade and the Listeners have gone quiet. Especially the Listeners... not a sound.�

entries.source: 어쩌면 웨이드 가와 결별했거나.. 고대신에게 완전히 지배당했을 수도 있어.�
entries.translation: Maybe they split from House Wade... or were consumed entirely by the ancient gods.�
Hmm. How are things with the Neved, Tyr?�

entries.source: 고대신의 균열이 다시 벌어지기 시작해서, 전력을 돌리기 힘든 상태야.�
entries.translation: The ancient god rift is widening again, so it is hard to spare forces.�

entries.source: 일단은 정예 마도사 1개 부대만 대기 중이다. 베르날에서 합류할 수 있을거야.�
entries.translation: For now, only one elite mage unit is on standby. They can join us in Vernal.�

entries.source: 좋아, 그럼 오늘은 푹쉴까? 내일은 출정의 아침이니까.�
entries.translation: All right, then shall we rest tonight? Tomorrow morning we march.�

entries.source: 난 먼저 베르날로 가서 네베드들과 합류하겠어. 너희들은 예정대로 내일 출발해.�
entries.translation: I will head to Vernal first to join the Neved. You two depart tomorrow as planned.�
Oho? Giving us some space, are you?�
Just do not get too relaxed.�
Phew... Is it finally time for the decisive battle?�
...It has been a long road, has not it...?�
And from here on... it will only get longer.�

entries.source: 끝은 보이지 않지만, 영원하진 않을 거야. 난 그렇게 믿어.�
entries.translation: We cannot see the end, but it will not last forever. I truly believe that.�

entries.source: 그리고 그때가 되면.. 정말로 난.. 나의 꿈을 위해 살거야.�
entries.translation: And when that day comes... I will truly... live for my own dream.�

entries.source: 평범한 마을에서.. 평범한 사랑을 하며.. 평범한 여자로 말이지?�
entries.translation: In an ordinary village... with an ordinary love... as an ordinary woman, right?�

entries.source: 우리는 적어도;인간 그대로의 모습으로;인간을 위해 싸우고 있다.�
entries.translation: At least we fight as humans, for humanity.�
House Wade... The Listeners... And the master of nightmares.�

entries.source: 예전같았으면 이런 싸움에;더 이상 몸을 담고 있지도;않을 것이다.�
entries.translation: In the past, I never would have stayed in a fight like this.�

entries.source: 오래전.. 카즈와 함께;복수라는 명목으로 ;움직일 때와 달리..�
entries.translation: Unlike long ago, when I moved alongside Kaze in the name of vengeance...�

entries.source: 나에게도..;이 싸움이 끝난 뒤에;이루고 싶은 꿈이 생겼다.�
entries.translation: Even I... have found a dream for after this fight ends.�
In an ordinary village... with an ordinary love... as an ordinary man...�

entries.source: 당신의 모험이 얼마나 많은 것을 보고 얻었는지, 확인해 보세요.�
entries.translation: Check out how much you have seen and earned on your adventures.�

entries.source: 거래가 활발할 정도로 사람이 많은 건 아니지만, 물건은 항상 구비해두고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: There are not many people around to trade, but our wares are always stocked.�

entries.source: 다들 조금은 나태해졌지만, 혁명의 그 때를 위해.. 수련을 게을리해선 안돼.�
entries.translation: Everyone gotten a bit complacent, but for the revolution... we must not neglect our training.�

entries.source: 우리 손으로 직접 벼린 무기들이라면, 센트럴의 공장에서 찍어내는 무기들 따위 무섭지 않다고!�
entries.translation: With weapons forged by our own hands, we do not fear the mass-produced junk from Central factories!�

entries.source: 뭐하는거야.. 1초라도 빨리 }비명길{에 있는 강림자의 유적으로 가야지!�
entries.translation: What are you doing? We need to reach the Descendant Ruins on the }Screaming Path{ this second!�
It is fine. Just enough to keep the cold away.�

entries.source: 그럴땐 그냥 아니라고 하는 거야, 바보야.�
entries.translation: That is when you are supposed to say no, you dummy.�

entries.source: 고맙다는 마음이 싹 사라지네. 정말, 붙임성 없기는..�
entries.translation: And there goes my gratitude. Honestly, so unapproachable...�

entries.source: 괜찮아. 그래도.. 슈우는 믿을 수 있으니까.. 사실은 따뜻한 남자고.�
entries.translation: It is fine. Still... I can rely on you, Schu... You really are warm at heart.�

entries.source: 너무 쉽게 사람을 믿지 마. 테오도어 녀석에게 배신당한 게 방금 전이잖아.�
entries.translation: Do not trust people so easily. Theodore just betrayed you moments ago.�

entries.source: 네가 없었다면.. 테오가 그렇게 날 버렸을 때 견뎌낼 수 없었을 거야.�
entries.translation: If not for you... I would not have endured Theo abandoning me like that.�

entries.source: 동굴 안쪽에서 무슨 소리가 난 것 같은데...?�
entries.translation: Did you hear something deeper inside the cave...?�

entries.source: 별일 없나? 혹시 테오도어가 수상한 짓을..�
entries.translation: Is everything all right? Did Theodore try anything suspicious...?�
It is all over. The god is complete.�

entries.source: 크크크.. 웃기지도 않는군. 이따위 것이 신이라고.. 겨우 이따위 걸 만들기 위해..�
entries.translation: Heh, heh... Ridiculous. This thing is a god...? All of this, just to create this trash...?�

entries.source: 이건 그냥 병기야. 아주 강대한 파괴병기지. 지금도 내안에서 속삭이고 있어, 당장이라도 폭발할 것 처럼..�
entries.translation: This is just a weapon. A monstrous weapon of destruction. It is whispering inside me right now, like it could blow at any second...!�

entries.source: 듣지 마라, 슈르츠..! 네가 그걸 제어하지 않으면..�
entries.translation: Do not listen, Schultz...! If you cannot control it...!�
