entries.source: 내가 어떻게? 이건 신이야, 전능하다! 내가 이걸 어떻게 제어하라는 거지?�
entries.translation: How could I? This is a god, omnipotent! How the hell am I supposed to control this?!�

entries.source: 안돼, 슈르츠! 병기에 잡아먹히지 마라, 그러면 누구도 이 세계의 폭주를 막을 수 없게돼!�
entries.translation: No, Schultz! Do not let the weapon consume you! If it does, nothing can stop this world destruction!�

entries.source: 내거 아냐.. 버려도 돼..! 지금의 나는 한 가지만을 갈?맨構?있다..!�
entries.translation: It is not mine... Throw it away! There is only one thing I want now...�
^I am the god of humanity, the law of the new world...�
^Host... For the sake of mankind, what is needed now?�

entries.source: 신은 완성되었어.. 그리고 내안에서 속삭이고 있다.�
entries.translation: God is complete... And whispering inside me.�

entries.source: 나를 해방하라.. 나는 인간을 지키기 위해 태어났다..�
entries.translation: Release me... I was born to protect humans...�

entries.source: 슈르츠, 마음 굳게 먹어라. 신이란 건 허울일 뿐.. 그건 결국 병기에 불과해.�
entries.translation: Schultz, stay strong. A god is just a title... In the end, it is nothing more than a weapon.�

entries.source: 알고 있어..! 나는 .. 절대로 이 따위 것에게 먹히지 않는다..�
entries.translation: I know...! I... will never be consumed by something like this...!�

entries.source: 나는 지켜야 할 사람이 있고, 지켜야 할 약속이 있어.. 이건.. 이건 그 과정일 뿐이다..!�
entries.translation: I have someone to protect, a promise to keep... This... this is just a step along the way...!�

entries.source: 폭발할 것 같은 힘이다..! 하지만.. 절대 지지 않아..!�
entries.translation: Such explosive power...! But... I will not lose...!�

entries.source: 알테나가 완성되면.. 부디 무언가를 파괴하는 데에는 사용하지 말아줘.�
entries.translation: When Altena is complete... please do not use it to destroy things.�

entries.source: 나는.. 그 악몽의 주인같은 파괴신이 되고 싶지 않으니까..�
entries.translation: Because... I do not want to become a god of destruction like the master of nightmares...�
Yes, even if those nightmares return...�

entries.source: 날 믿어.. 내가 반드시 널 그 악몽으로부터 해방시켜 주겠어..!�
entries.translation: Trust me... I swear I will free you from that nightmare...!�
I have a promise to keep.�
If you are truly humanity god...!!�

entries.source: 이렇게 내 자신이 혐오스러웠던 적이 없었어..�
entries.translation: I have never loathed myself this much before...�

entries.source: 그 녀석이 알테나에게 먹혀버리는 걸 보면서도.. 나는..�
entries.translation: Even as I watched him get consumed by Altena... I...�
I was... just waiting for you to come...�

entries.source: 나는.. 또 그 녀석을 지켜주지 못한.. 건가..�
entries.translation: Did I... fail to protect him again...?�

entries.source: 당신 덕에 겨우 목숨을 건진 주제에..�
entries.translation: Even though I barely survived thanks to you...�

entries.source: 다시 같은 상황이 오면.. 그땐 반드시 내가 그 녀석을 지켜주겠다고..�
entries.translation: Telling myself if that ever happened again... I would definitely protect him next time...�

entries.source: 그런 주제에 또.. 그런 주제에 또..! 중요한 순간에는 당신이 와줄거라고..!�
entries.translation: And yet again... yet again...! At the critical moment, I expected you to come...!�
Why was I so foolish... so complacent...!�

entries.source: 멀뚱하게 마지막 인사나 듣고 있는 내 자신이 죽여버리고 싶을 정도로 구역질이 나서..!�
entries.translation: Standing there blankly listening to his final words made me sick enough to kill myself...!�

entries.source: 이 따위 것을.. 겨우 이 따위 것을 만들기 위해 그 녀석은..!�
entries.translation: For something like this... Just to make something like this, he...!!�

entries.source: 슈르츠, 아직이다.. 네가 먹혀버리면 모든 게 끝이야!�
entries.translation: Schultz, not yet... If you are consumed, everything is over!�

entries.source: 그 놈의 안에 렌이 있어, 너는 그것을 찾을 수 있다!�
entries.translation: Ren is inside that thing, you can find him!�
Are you still... still in there?�

entries.source: 나를 집어삼키고 싶다고 속삭이는 네 놈의 뱃속에..�
entries.translation: Inside the belly of you, who whispers that you want to devour me...�
^Accept me now, as the new god of humanity...�

entries.source: 지금 네 놈이 집어삼킨 그게.. 내 모든 것이었어..!�
entries.translation: What you just swallowed... was my everything...!�
No... I do not need your answer anymore...�
I will hear it directly... from him...�

entries.source: 이번에야 말로..;내가.. 널 구할 수 있도록!!�
entries.translation: This time for sure... So I can... save you!!�
Everything... is just the Hearers trickery...�
A Successor memories are all nothing but fabricated illusions...�

entries.source: 계승자의 조건을 갖추기 위해;만들어진 허상에 불과하다고..�
entries.translation: Nothing but illusions created to meet the conditions of a Successor...�
In the abyss of Lord Schultz memories, everyone is there...�

entries.source: 알렉스씨..;아일린 언니.. 에블린 언니..;마르크.. 크리스.. 티아나..�
entries.translation: Alex... Eileen... Evelyn... Marc... Chris... Tiana...�
Just to create me, Lord Schultz had to... lose all of them...�
When I am nothing more than a spare part for a weapon...�
For all the things Lord Schultz lost because of me...�

entries.source: 나는 어떻게 해야..;보상해 줄 수 있을까..�
entries.translation: What could I ever do... to atone for it...?�

entries.source: 어쩌면..;이렇게 된 것이 잘된 걸지도 몰라..�
entries.translation: Maybe... it is better this way...�
L-Lord Schultz, how did you get here...?�

entries.source: 깊은게 아니라 여긴.. 끝이 없는 심연인데.. 어떻게..�
entries.translation: Not just deep, this is... a bottomless abyss... How could you...?�

entries.source: 어차피 내 안에 있는 심연이야. 내가 열 수 있어.�
entries.translation: It is an abyss inside me anyway. I can open it.�

entries.source: 알테나는 내 제어하에 있으니까, 나가자고! 내가, 길을 열겠다!�
entries.translation: Althena is under my control, so let us get out! I will pave the way!�
Did my voice... really reach her...?�

entries.source: 그딴 생각 다신 하지마.. 어떻게 해야 보상할 수 있냐고?�
entries.translation: Do not ever think like that again... How could you atone?�

entries.source: 너는 내가 지금 믿을 수 있는 유일한 기억이고, 가족이야.. 그걸로 됐어.�
entries.translation: You are my only trusted memory right now, and my family... That is enough.�

entries.source: 슈, 슈르츠님, 하지만 난 이미 알테나의 일부인데..�
entries.translation: L-Lord Schultz, but I am already part of Althena...�

entries.source: 내 거다.. 절대 안 버려. 알테나 따위가 가져가게 두지 않을거라고!�
entries.translation: You are mine... I will never abandon you. I will not let Althena take you away!�
So... do not hide either... Ever again...�

entries.source: 네가 내 옆에 있다면.. 알테나 따위.. 영원히 잠만 자게 해줄테니까..�
entries.translation: As long as you are by my side... Althena will sleep forever...�

entries.source: 사냥을 위한 덫,;그것의 발동 기회는;한 번 뿐일지도 모른다.�
entries.translation: A hunting trap might only give you a single chance to spring it.�

entries.source: 나와 에블린이 유인해온 루퍼스가;강림자의 유물에 묶여;정령의 힘을 잃었을 때..�
entries.translation: When Rufus, lured by Evelyn and me, was bound by the Descendant relic and stripped of his Spirit power...�

entries.source: 그래, 바로 지금이;루퍼스를 막을 수 있는;마지막 기회다..!�
entries.translation: Yes, right now is our final chance to stop Rufus...!�

entries.source: 후우.. 후우.. 이제 곧.. 너의 정령을 완전히 무력화 시켜주마..�
entries.translation: *Pant*... *pant*... Soon... I will completely neutralize your Spirit...�
Descendant tech, huh? Impressive that you revived it...�

entries.source: 하지만.. 내겐 정령의 힘만이 있는 것이 아니야. 나는 듣는 자를 벌써 50명도 넘게 먹어치웠다..!�
entries.translation: However... Spirit power is not all I have. I have already devoured over 50 Hearers...!�

entries.source: 너희들 쯤이야, 정령없이도 밟아 줄 수 있어..!!�
entries.translation: Crushing you two without a Spirit will be a breeze...!!�

entries.source: 말도 안돼.. 저 상태에서 움직일 수 있을리가..!�
entries.translation: No way... How can he move in that state...?!�

entries.source: 테오도어, 정령을 완전히 제어하는 게 가능한가?�
entries.translation: Theodore, is it possible to control the Spirit completely?�
Not yet... I still need more time!�
Either way... he is not at 100% right now, is he?�
Even so, it is enough... I can crush you with one hand...!�

entries.source: 미안하지만, 그렇게 까지 쉽지는 않을 거야!!�
entries.translation: Sorry, but it will not be that easy!!�
I am strong! I will not lose to anyone!!�
Spirit controlled... The Successor restraint is complete.�

entries.source: 끝이다 루퍼스. 계승권을 포기하고.. 우리를 그냥 내버려 둬.�
entries.translation: It is over, Rufus. Renounce your Succession... and leave us alone.�

entries.source: 진심이냐? 너희들은 진심으로 정령에 만족하겠다는 거냐?�
entries.translation: Are you serious? You are truly satisfied with just the Spirit?�

entries.source: 테오도어.. 정말로 나를 잡는 것으로 만족하겠나?�
entries.translation: Theodore... Will you truly be satisfied just by capturing me?�

entries.source: 전혀 가치없는 말들이다. 모든 것은 널 잡기 위해 준비된 거니까.�
entries.translation: Worthless words. Everything was prepared just to capture you.�

entries.source: 웃기지 마라.. 힘을 원하지 않는 자는 계승자의 자격이 없어! 안 그러냐?!�
entries.translation: Do not make me laugh... Those who do not desire power do not deserve Succession! Am I wrong?!�

entries.source: 계승권을 포기해라. 그렇지 않으면.. 이 자리에서 죽여주지.�
entries.translation: Renounce the Succession. If not... I will kill you right here.�
I cannot... do that! I am strong...�

entries.source: 정령도.. 계승자의 힘도 모두 완벽히 제압했다.�
entries.translation: The Spirit... and the Successor power are both completely subdued.�

entries.source: 그리고 듣는 자의 힘까지... 너는 할 수 있는 게 없어.�
entries.translation: Even the Hearer power... There is nothing you can do.�
^Unfortunately, it was not a fair match, but...�

entries.source: 살인마에게 제대로 된 승부를 해 줄 필요는 없다고 생각해.�
entries.translation: I do not think a murderer deserves a fair match anyway.�
^He was a Successor closest to the Spirit true nature...�
^Or perhaps... he simply did not hide his human nature.�
^To a former slave... power was the ultimate truth.�

entries.source: ^고대신의 세포를 이식당하고;듣는 자가 된 뒤에는;더욱 확신하게 되었지.�
entries.translation: ^After being implanted with ancient god cells and becoming a Hearer, he grew even more certain.�

entries.source: ^진정한 자유를 얻기 위해서는..;가장 위에 올라서야 한다는 걸.�
entries.translation: ^That to attain true freedom... one must stand at the very top.�

entries.source: 루퍼스는.. 방법도 목적도 모두 틀렸었던 거야.�
entries.translation: Rufus was wrong... in both his means and his ends.�
^That is why he was closest to us.�

entries.source: ^우리는 병기잖아?;병기라는 건 원래;방법도 목적도 모두 틀린거거든.�
entries.translation: ^We are weapons, are not we? Weapons are inherently flawed in both means and ends.�

entries.source: ^하지만 결국 세계를 지배하는 건;가장 강한 병기를 지닌 자야.�
entries.translation: ^Yet, in the end, whoever wields the strongest weapon rules the world.�

entries.source: 놈은.. 죽은 게 아니야. 이건 분명히 계승권을 포기한건데..�
entries.translation: He did not... die. He definitely renounced the Succession, but...�
The Descendant relic... will not stop. Why?�

entries.source: 루퍼스 놈이 무슨 최후의 발악이라도 한 건가?!�
entries.translation: Did that Rufus pull some kind of final desperate trick?!�

entries.source: 본 적이 있어.. 방주로 갈 때 사용했던..�
entries.translation: I have seen it... The one used to reach the Ark...�
Did Rufus use that to escape?�

entries.source: 내 불찰이로군. 강림자의 유물을 살린 것이.. 방주의 봉인마저 풀어버리게 된건가..�
entries.translation: My oversight. Activating the Descendant relic... also unsealed the Ark...�

entries.source: 무슨 소리야, 테오. 방주가 뭔지는 모르겠지만.. 우린 방금 가장 큰 벽을 넘은거야.�
entries.translation: What are you saying, Theo? I do not know what the Ark is, but... we just overcame the biggest hurdle.�

entries.source: 루퍼스는 듣는 자야. 그놈이 아무 생각 없이 방주로 도망치진 않았겠지.�
entries.translation: Rufus is a Hearer. He would not flee to the Ark without a plan.�

entries.source: 아무래도 놈을 완전히 처리하기 전에는 마음을 놓을 수 없을 것 같아.�
entries.translation: I will not be at ease until we finish him off for good.�

entries.source: 루퍼스의 3가지 정령 스킬중, 어떤 것을 전승하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: Which of Rufus 3 Spirit Skills will you inherit?�

entries.source: 이제 끝났다고 생각했는데.. 마지막까지 쉽지가 않네, 그 남자는..�
entries.translation: I thought it was over... That man never makes it easy, even to the end...�

entries.source: 난 여기서 강림자의 유적을 다시 멈출 방법을 연구해볼게.�
entries.translation: I will stay here and research how to stop the Descendant Ruins.�

entries.source: 루퍼스는 힘을 대부분 잃었겠지만.. 그래도 조심해. 놈은 듣는 자다.�
entries.translation: Rufus must have lost most of his power... but stay alert. He is a Hearer.�
The Ark... feels different than before.�
Yeah. It feels much more... alive than before.�

entries.source: 크래드 오빠가.. 봉인했었는데. 우리들의 실수로 되살아나다니..�
entries.translation: Krad sealed it... To think our mistake brought it back to life...�

entries.source: 괜찮아. 강림자들은 아직 때가 아니라고 했으니까.�
entries.translation: It is fine. The Descendants said the time has not come yet.�

entries.source: 무슨 짓을 할지 모르는 루퍼스만 처리하면... 별 일 없을거야.�
entries.translation: Once we deal with Rufus, who knows what he might do... everything will be fine.�
^The Guide foolishness will not ruin us.�
^Until the time comes, we shall wait...�

entries.source: ^빛을 바라보고 싶다.;널 만지고 싶다.;하지만 참아야 한다.�
entries.translation: ^I want to see the light. I want to touch you. Yet I must endure.�

entries.source: ^세계가 완벽해지면,;비로소 우리는 이 땅에 설 것이다.�
entries.translation: ^When the world is made whole, only then shall we stand on this land.�
^Last souls of Soltia, do not yield to the thirst...!�
^A new vessel has reached the core.�
^You must not yield to the thirst.�
^An incomplete bond will only make us hideous beasts...�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�
You are strong, after all... Schu...�

entries.source: 친한 척 부르지 마. 구역질이 난다..!�
entries.translation: Do not call me so familiarly. It makes me sick...!�

entries.source: 크.. 크.. 이제.. 완성되겠군. 내 할 일은 끝났어..�
entries.translation: Heh... heh... Now... it will be complete. My task is finished...�

entries.source: 이봐, 슈우.. 어떻게 할거지? 신의 힘을 가지게 되면..�
entries.translation: Hey, Schu... What will you do? Once you possess the power of a god...�
I do not... need such a thing.�

entries.source: 넌 필요 없을지 몰라도.. 인간에겐.. 필요해. 너에겐 선택권이 .. 없다..�
entries.translation: You might not, but... mankind does... You have no choice...�

entries.source: 내 것이 아니라도 좋아.. 그리고 너라면.. 알테나를 올바르게 사용해 주겠지..�
entries.translation: Even if it is not mine, it is fine... If it is you... you will use Altena rightly...�

entries.source: 어이.. 끝났다니.. 테오도어 놈.. 정말 죽어버린거야?�
entries.translation: Hey... Over? Did Theodore... really die?�

entries.source: 넌.. 어떻게 되는 거야? 너도 그 신이라는 것이 되는 건가?�
entries.translation: What... happens to you? Do you become that god too?�

entries.source: 아니야. 이제 나 역시 그 신의 일부가 되는 거야.�
entries.translation: No. Now, I too shall become a part of that god.�
I came to say my final goodbye.�
My body... will not move forward...!�

entries.source: 웃기다, 겨우 이런 걸 신이라고 했던 거라니..�
entries.translation: How ridiculous, that this was what they called a god...�

entries.source: 이건 그냥 모든 지식과.. 감정과.. 파괴력을 담은 거대한 병기일 뿐이야..�
entries.translation: This is just a massive weapon containing all knowledge... emotions... and destruction...�

entries.source: 잠깐.. 너는 병기따윈 되기 싫다고 했잖아?�
entries.translation: Wait... You said you never wanted to be a weapon!�

entries.source: 게다가 네가 없어지면 나는..? 내가 얻은 것은 생명인데...�
entries.translation: Besides, what about me if you are gone...? What I gained was life...�

entries.source: 슈르츠님이 계승자가 되면서 얻은 건, 생명이 아니야.�
entries.translation: What Schultz gained by becoming the Successor was not life.�

entries.source: 그러니까 살게 될거야. 신의 첫번째 숙주로서..�
entries.translation: So you will live. As the god first host...�

entries.source: 무슨 말이야, 숙주라니! 이런 건 들은 적이 없다고!�
entries.translation: What are you saying, a host?! I never heard about this!�
There is no more time now.�
Will you let me... say goodbye?�
Schultz, they said your wish was... a family.�

entries.source: 하지만 죽은 사람을 살리는 힘은 강림자에게도, 고대신에게도 없었어.�
entries.translation: Neither Descendants nor ancient gods could raise the dead.�

entries.source: 아마 그래서 내가.. 다른 정령과 다르게 오랫동안 슈르츠님의 곁에 있을 수 있었나 봐.�
entries.translation: Maybe that is why I stayed by your side longer than other spirits.�

entries.source: 나도 이제야 안건데 말이야, 사실 좀 믿을 수가 없어.�
entries.translation: I only just realized it myself, but it is hard to believe.�
I annoyed you so much, did I not?�
Did I make you... feel a little less lonely?�
Heh, at the very end... you call my name.�
Thank you. I will take that as a yes.�

entries.source: 이제 곧 신의 주인이 될텐데.. 마지막 부탁 하나만 해도 돼?�
entries.translation: You will soon be master of a god... Can I ask one last favor?�

entries.source: 알테나가 완성되면.. 부디 무언가를 파괴하는 데에는 사용하지 말아줘.�
entries.translation: When Altena is complete... please do not use it to destroy things.�

entries.source: 나는.. 그 악몽의 주인같은 파괴신이 되고 싶지 않으니까..�
entries.translation: Because... I do not want to become a god of destruction like the master of nightmares...�
^I am sorry. But... there was no other way.�

entries.source: ^곧.. 인간의 힘으로는 어찌할 수 없는 파도가 밀려올테니까.�
entries.translation: ^Soon... a wave no human can stop will sweep over us.�

entries.source: ^고대신이 부활하고.. 강림자들이 내려오면, 세계는 그들의 전쟁으로 파괴될거야.�
entries.translation: ^When the ancient gods revive... and Descendants fall, war will destroy all.�

entries.source: ^언젠가는 완성될 수 밖에 없어.;너는 인류를 위한;최종 병기가 되어야 한다.�
entries.translation: ^Someday it must be completed. You must become humanity ultimate weapon.�

entries.source: ^인간의 정신으로는;정령의 완성되고자 하는 의지를;이겨낼 수 없어.�
entries.translation: ^A human mind cannot overcome the spirit will to become complete.�
^In the end, by your own hands, you will have to kill Schu and Evelyn.�
Now... it is just the two of us...�

entries.source: 글쎄... 그건 왜 그랬을까. 난.. 누구보다 테오도어를 믿고있다고 생각했는데..�
entries.translation: I wonder... why I did that. I thought I trusted Theodore more than anyone...�
Yet at that moment... I could not trust him at all.�

entries.source: 하지만 마지막에 남는게.. 우리들일 줄은 몰랐어..�
entries.translation: I never imagined... we would be the last ones left...�
To think Theodore... was a Listener...�

entries.source: 그가.. 정령을 완성하기 위해 우리들을 전부 이용했었다니..�
entries.translation: To think he used all of us... just to complete the spirit...�

entries.source: 방주의 진동이.. 멈추지 않아. 이건 무슨 의미일까?�
entries.translation: The Ark will not stop shaking... What does this mean?�
Once the Descendants return... everything will end.�

entries.source: 테오도어씨의 목소리가 내 안에 있어.. 강림자들은 신의 완성과 함께 돌아와, 새로운 이 땅의 주민이 될거라고..�
entries.translation: Theodore voice is inside me... Descendants will return with the god...�

entries.source: 그때가 오면, 인간들의 모든 과거는 부정되고.. 더 이상 이 땅위에 남아있지 않을거라고.�
entries.translation: When that time comes, mankind past will be erased from this land.�

entries.source: .. 걱정하지마, 렌. 우리는.. 신 따위 완성하지 않을테니까. 그렇지, 슈우?�
entries.translation: Do not worry, Ren. We will not complete any god. Right, Schu?�
Of course. ...This is truly the end.�

entries.source: 서로를 믿지 않으면.. 헤쳐나갈 수 없어.�
entries.translation: Unless we trust each other... we cannot make it through.�

entries.source: 슈르츠님, 하지만 언젠가는.. 언젠가는 완성될 수 밖에 없어.�
entries.translation: Schultz, but someday... someday it will be completed anyway.�
I will... stay here and seal the Ark.�
Wh-what are you talking about? You...�

entries.source: 어이, 그건 구속의 마법진이잖아! 무슨 짓을..!�
entries.translation: Hey, that is a binding circle! What are you doing...?!�
Ren, get out of there now!�

entries.source: 응.. 괜찮아. 나는.. 그들이 원하는 병기따위 되지 않을거야.�
entries.translation: Yes... I am fine. I will not become their weapon.�

entries.source: 슈르츠님. 에블린 언니.. 나는 여기서.. 나의 싸움을 계속할게.�
entries.translation: Master Schultz. Evelyn... I will continue my battle here.�

entries.source: 두 사람도.. 절대 지지마. 웨이드 가와.. 듣는 자들에게..�
entries.translation: You two must never lose either. To House Wade... and the Listeners...�
Krad... What are you planning to do?�

entries.source: 방주와.. 마지막 남은 정령을 영원히 봉인할 것이다.�
entries.translation: I will seal the Ark... and the last remaining Spirit forever.�

entries.source: 렌의 힘은 이 결계안에 묶일거고.. 그 힘이 있다면, 이제 다시는 되살아 날 수 없도록 봉인할 수 있을거야.�
entries.translation: Ren power will be bound in this barrier... With it, we can seal it so it never awakens again.�

entries.source: 그렇게 되면.. 에블린에게 남은 정령도 완성될 수 없다. 계승자의 역할은 끝나.�
entries.translation: If so... the Spirit inside Evelyn cannot be completed. The Successor role will end.�

entries.source: 당신들은? 당신들은 영원히 이곳을 지키겠다는 건가?�
entries.translation: And you two? Do you plan to guard this place forever?�
I... As long as I have Ren, I am fine.�

entries.source: 응. 이름없는 작은 섬에서.. 둘이서 지내던 그때처럼.�
entries.translation: Yes. Just like when the two of us lived on that nameless island.�
Master Schultz. It is time to say goodbye.�
Is there really no other way, Ren...?�

entries.source: 나만이 할 수 있는 일이고.. 나는 이일을 하지 않으면 내가 가장 하고 싶지 않은 일을 하게 될 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Only I can do this... If I do not, I fear I will end up doing what I despise most.�
Are you truly sure about this?�

entries.source: 응. 난, 신이나 병기 따위가 되느니 이곳에서 크래드 오빠와 영원을 살거야.�
entries.translation: Yes. Rather than become a god or a weapon, I will live eternity here with Brother Krad.�

entries.source: 에블린 언니, 슈르츠님을 부탁해. 외로움.. 많이 타는 사람이니까.�
entries.translation: Evelyn, please take care of Schultz. He gets... terribly lonely.�

entries.source: 고맙다.. 네가 준 삶.. 절대로 헛되이 하지 않을게.�
entries.translation: Thank you... I will never waste the life you gave me.�

entries.source: 지켜봐. 에블린과.. 티르와 함께, 반드시 악몽의 주인을 이겨낼테니..!�
entries.translation: Watch me. Together with Evelyn and Tyr, I will defeat the Lord of Nightmares...!�
Right. The battle is not over yet.�

entries.source: 강림자의 위협은 사라졌지만,;듣는 자와 악몽의 주인은;여전히 건재하니까.�
entries.translation: The Descendant threat is gone, but the Listeners and the Lord of Nightmares still remain.�
What...? What is he trying to do?�

entries.source: 싫다.. 이런 건.. 내가 원한 힘이 아니야..�
entries.translation: No... Not this... This is not the power I wanted...�
I have a bad feeling about this...�

entries.source: 히이익! 난.. 난 너희를 부르지 않았어!!�
entries.translation: Eek! I... I did not summon you!!�
^We have been buried in the void for far too long...!�

entries.source: ^대지를 밟을 수 있다면,;내 이 손으로 널 만질 수 있다면..�
entries.translation: ^If only I could walk the earth, if only these hands could touch you...�
^Even an incomplete flesh does not matter to me...!�
Can we... put the Ark back to sleep?�

entries.source: 글쎄.. 테오도어가 할 수 있다면 좋은데..�
entries.translation: Who knows... It would be great if Theodore could do it...�

entries.source: 하지만 강림자라는 건 도대체 뭐지? 듣는 자들은 알고 있었던 건가?�
entries.translation: What on earth are Descendants, anyway? Did the Listeners know all along?�

entries.source: 마지막에 루퍼스는.. 뭔가 두려워 하고 있었는데...�
entries.translation: In the end, Rufus... looked terrified of something...�

entries.source: 평범한 인간인 그에게 강림자를 거역할 힘따위는 없었으니까.�
entries.translation: As an ordinary human, he had no power to defy the Descendants.�

entries.source: 설마 루퍼스에게 오염시킨 강림자까지 쓰러트릴 줄이야.. 함정을 겹겹이 파두길 잘했군.�
entries.translation: To think you would defeat even Rufus corrupted Descendant... Good thing I layered multiple traps.�

entries.source: 계승권을 포기해, 슈우. 너도 알다시피.. 이 결계에서는 계승자와 정령이 완전히 구속된다.�
entries.translation: Relinquish your succession right, Schu. As you know, this barrier completely binds Successor and Spirit.�

entries.source: 무슨 생각이야..! 당신 설마 정령을 완성하려는 건가?�
entries.translation: What are you thinking?! Do not tell me you intend to complete the Spirit?!�

entries.source: 정식 명칭은 }알테나{. 우리들이 강림자의 기술을 빌려 만들려고 하는 인류의 최종병기지.�
entries.translation: Its formal name is }Althena{. The ultimate weapon of humanity, made using the Descendants technology.�

entries.source: 이해해 줘, 슈우. 인류에겐.. 고대신이나 강림자들과 대적할 만한 힘이 없어.�
entries.translation: Try to understand, Schu. Humanity has no power to contend against the Ancient Gods or Descendants.�

entries.source: 루퍼스를 처리하기 위해서는.. 다른 계승자들의 힘이 절대적으로 필요했으니까.�
entries.translation: To deal with Rufus, the power of other Successors was absolutely necessary.�
You used us? Me and Evelyn?�

entries.source: 정확히 말하면 인간 계승자 6명 전부를.. 알테나의 완성을 위해.�
entries.translation: To be precise, all six human Successors... to complete Althena.�

entries.source: 도대체 너희들은 .. 너희들도 인간이 아니냐! 어떻게 그리 쉽게 다른 인간들을 이용할 수 있지?�
entries.translation: What are you people... Are not you human too?! How can you use other humans so easily?!�

entries.source: 처음에는 듣는 자들이 계승자가 되려 했다. 우리가 희생하려 했었지.�
entries.translation: At first, the Hearers tried to become Successors. We intended to sacrifice ourselves.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 두번째 계승자인 루퍼스가 폭주해버리는 바람에, 더 이상 듣는 자들을 계승자로 만들 수 없었다.�
entries.translation: However, when Rufus, the second Successor, ran rampant, we could not make any more Hearers into Successors.�

entries.source: 그는 너무 강해졌고, 듣는 자들은 그를 제어할 수 없었어.�
entries.translation: He grew too powerful, and the Hearers could no longer control him.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 우린 우리 나름대로 가장 작은 희생이라고 생각했다.�
entries.translation: Still, we believed it was the smallest sacrifice possible.�

entries.source: 어차피 너희들에겐 아무 것도 없었고.. 적어도 우린 너희에게 삶의 목표를 주었으니까.�
entries.translation: You had nothing anyway... At least we gave you a purpose in life.�

entries.source: 프로비던스의 고아원에서 썩어가는 것 보단, 훨씬 가치있는 삶을 살 수 있게..�
entries.translation: A far more meaningful life than rotting away in Providence Orphanage...�
Theodore... stop... it hurts so much...!�
Shh... Quiet for just a moment.�

entries.source: 어떻게 된거야? 왜 슈우를 붙잡고 있어?�
entries.translation: What happened? Why are you holding Schu down?�
It is... too late for Schu.�

entries.source: 렌이.. 강림자의 목소리를 이겨내지 못했어. 정령이 폭주했다.�
entries.translation: Ren could not resist the Descendant voice. His Spirit went berserk.�
|(Ugh... My voice... will not come out...)�
Do not you hear that strange voice?�
I-I hear it. My Spirit is reacting too.�

entries.source: 잘 제어해야 해. 막지 못하면.. 우리도 저렇게 될거야.�
entries.translation: You must control it. If we cannot stop it, we will end up like that too.�
Then now... is it just the two of us?�
...We have just returned... to the beginning, Evelyn.�

entries.source: 괜찮아 에블린.. 우린 이겨낼 수 있어.�
entries.translation: It is all right, Evelyn... We can overcome this.�

entries.source: 지난 3년간, 네 덕분에.. 행복할 수 있었다. 하지만..�
entries.translation: These past three years, thanks to you... I was happy. But...�

entries.source: 그래. 어차피.. 전부 거짓말이야. 너희가 기억하는 모든 것들이..�
entries.translation: Yes. In the end... it is all a lie. Everything that you remember...�

entries.source: 모두, 그냥 이 순간을 위해 만들어진 거야. 그러니까.. 받아들여줘.�
entries.translation: All of it was made just for this moment. So... accept it.�
I did too... I am sorry...�

entries.source: 에블린.. 언니? 에블린 언니, 죽으면 안돼!�

entries.translation: ^No use. I am going to die.�
^For now... I merely gave up, but...�
^Ah... Levan must have... grown cold again.�

entries.source: ^애초부터..;이런 힘을 가지고 평범하게;살고자 하는 바람 자체가..;무리였던 걸까?�
entries.translation: ^From the start... Was wishing to live normally with power like this... too much to ask?�
^The tragic heroine, stabbed to death by the one she loved... I really hate this...�

entries.source: ^복수해 줘.;적어도 저런 인간에게;신의 힘을 쥐어줄 수는 없잖아?�
entries.translation: ^Avenge me. At least we cannot let a man like that hold divine power.�
^Evelyn is a strong woman. Until the very end...�
^Did I not say? For now, I only gave up...�
... Schu, he would never do that.�
Schu is not that weak. Let him go.�

entries.source: 안돼, 에블린! 지금은 봉인하고 있지만.. 그렇게 되면 슈우를 죽여야 할지도 몰라!�
entries.translation: No, Evelyn! We have him sealed now, but... if we do that, we might have to kill Schu!�
Then... do you have another way?�

entries.source: 이대로.. 봉인해 둬야지. 스스로.. 계승권을 포기할 때까지..�
entries.translation: Keep him... sealed like this. Until he relinquishes... his succession on his own...�

entries.source: 미쳤어? 그런 걸 어떻게 방법이라고 그래?�
entries.translation: Are you crazy? How can you call that a solution?�

entries.source: 난 반대야. 믿을 수 없어, 렌이 폭주하다니.�
entries.translation: I object. I cannot believe it... Ren going berserk.�
Evelyn, are you saying you cannot trust me?�

entries.source: 그게 아니야, 테오.. 그게 아니라, 슈우를.. 좀 더 믿어보자는 거지.�
entries.translation: That is not it, Theo... Not that, I just want to... believe in Schu a bit more.�

entries.source: 나도 버틸 수 있는데.. 슈우나 렌이 버텨내지 못할리가 없어.�
entries.translation: Even I can endure it... There is no way Schu or Ren could not.�

entries.source: 마지막까지 확인하고, 실패한다면 그땐.. 내 손으로..�
entries.translation: I will see it through to the end, and if it fails... then by my own hands...�

entries.source: 아아.. 가능하면.. 너희들과는 싸우지 않고 끝내고 싶었는데, 슈우.�
entries.translation: Ah... If possible... I wanted to end this without fighting you, Schu.�

entries.source: 죽은 게 아니라.. 포기한 거였구나.. 에블린..!�
entries.translation: She did not die... she just gave it up... Evelyn...!�
She became a normal human to save Schultz...!�
What are you saying! Bleeding like this...�
I know... That is why you should not worry...�

entries.source: 테오가 나를 찔렀으니까.. 차라리 여기가 끝인 게 나아..�
entries.translation: Theo stabbed me... It is better that it ends here...�
Please, Schu... Stop Theo... Stop him...�

entries.source: 내가 하늘에서.. 테오를 보고.. 후회하지 않도록..�
entries.translation: So looking down from above... I will not regret...�
I have done so many bad things...�
I wonder if I can... even go to heaven...�

entries.source: 아아.. 가능하면.. 너희와는 싸우지 않고 끝내고 싶었는데..�
entries.translation: Ah... If possible... I did not want to fight you...�
I will make you pay for this...�

entries.source: 이제 물러설 곳이 없어. 너도, 나도.�
entries.translation: There is no turning back now. For neither of us.�

entries.source: 에블린의 3가지 정령 스킬중, 어떤 것을 전승하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: Which of Evelyn 3 spirit skills will you inherit?�

entries.source: 테오도어의 3가지 정령 스킬중, 어떤 것을 전승하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: Which of Theodore 3 spirit skills will you inherit?�

entries.source: 뭔가.. 예전보다 훨씬 힘들어진 것 같지 않아?�
entries.translation: Does not it feel... much tougher than before?�

entries.source: .. 알렉스가 그랬잖아. 마물들이 포악해진 것 같다고..�
entries.translation: ...Alex said so too. The monsters seem more ferocious...�

entries.source: 갱도에서 잠시 쉬는 사이에.. 이렇게 비정상 적으로 동물들이 포악해지다니..�
entries.translation: While we rested in the mine... for animals to turn this savage...�

entries.source: 역시.. 방주가 기동했다, 는 것과 무슨 관련이 있는걸까?�
entries.translation: Could it be connected to... the Ark activating?�

entries.source: 글쎄.. 어찌됐든 이런 현상이 전세계적으로 일어났다면, 앞으로는 더 힘들어질 것 같군.�
entries.translation: Who knows... But if this is happening everywhere, things will get harder.�

entries.source: 위험하면 뒤도 돌아보지 말고 오라고. 빛의 속도로 도망칠 수 있으니.�
entries.translation: If it is dangerous, run straight back. I can flee at light speed.�

entries.source: 완성시키지는 않더라도 정령의 힘을 빌리지 않을 수는 없어.. 그 연구의 성과는 혁명에 큰 영향을 줄거야.�
entries.translation: Even if unfinished, we need spirit power... That research will fuel the revolution.�

entries.source: 폭주를 막는 방법을.. 찾을 수 있을까?�
entries.translation: Can we find a way... to stop the rampage?�

entries.source: 아마도, 그걸 위해 도움을 요청한 거겠지.�
entries.translation: That is probably why they asked for help.�
At any rate, we should go meet them.�

entries.source: 에블린은 연구가 진행되는 동안 }모이투라 섬{의 }북의 동굴{을 지키고 있는다고 했어.�
entries.translation: Evelyn said she would guard the }Northern Cave{ on }Moytura Plains{ during the research.�

entries.source: 별 일이 없다면 거기서 만날 수 있을 거다.�
entries.translation: Barring anything unexpected, you will find her there.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 지금은 나도 따로 조사해야 할 것이 있어.�
entries.translation: However... I have something else I must investigate first.�

entries.source: 자네 설마 레이디의 부탁을 거절하는 건가?�
entries.translation: Are you really turning down a lady request?�
There is a more urgent matter right now.�

entries.source: 고대신의 현재 상태.. 그리고 봉인할 수 있는 방법..�
entries.translation: The current state of the ancient god... and a way to seal it...�
Hey... if such a thing existed, someone would have...�

entries.source: 정령의 힘이라면, 분명히 그녀에게 힘을 보탤 수 있을 거야.�
entries.translation: With the spirits power, I can definitely lend her strength.�

entries.source: }네베드의 수호자{에게 가서, 좀 더 정확한 방법을 알아보겠어.�
entries.translation: I will go to the }Guardian of the Neved{ to find a proper method.�
...So you are heading back to the Sanctuary?�

entries.source: 뭐.. 알겠지만 성지로 바로 가는 건 불가능해. 일단 }매도우 힐{에서 내려주도록 하지.�
entries.translation: Well... you cannot go straight there. I will drop you off at }Meadow Hill{ first.�
You are back. Did things... go well?�

entries.source: .. 이봐, 일이 잘 풀리지 않았어도.. 항상 내일을 봐야지.�
entries.translation: ...Hey, even if things went badly, you have to look ahead.�

entries.source: 인간의 인생에서 파도란건 한두번 오는 게 아니라고. 그런 표정으로는 버틸 수 없을거다.�
entries.translation: Life throws more than a couple rough waves at you. You will not survive with that face.�
I... like the sound of that.�

entries.source: 그래. 좀 큰 희생을 치뤘지만.. 싸움은 아직 끝나지 않았으니까.�
entries.translation: Right. The sacrifice was heavy... but the fight is not over yet.�

entries.source: 그런 마음가짐이다. 앞으로도 해야할 일은 산더미니까!�
entries.translation: That is the spirit! There is still a mountain of work ahead!�
Actually, there is a message from Evelyn.�

entries.source: 혁명군의 전령이 킹스포트까지 날라왔더군. 일단은 내가 접수했지.�
entries.translation: A revolutionary messenger flew all the way to Kingsport. I received it.�
No, they said it was a personal request.�

entries.source: 테오도어가 연구를 하는데 문제가 좀 있어서.. 여유가 되면 좀 도와달라고.�
entries.translation: Theodore hit a snag in his research... Help him if you have time.�

entries.source: 무슨 연구냐고 물었더니 자네는 알거라고 하던데?�
entries.translation: I asked what kind of research, and he said you would know.�

entries.source: 테오도어씨는.. 정령과 강림자에 대해 연구한다고 했었지?�
entries.translation: Theodore said he was researching Spirits and Descendants, right?�

entries.source: 그래. 계승자를 먹는다거나, 힘이 폭주한다거나 하는 일이 생기면 곤란하니까.�
entries.translation: Yeah. It would be trouble if it devoured a Successor or its power went wild.�

entries.source: 전해주고 난 뒤에는, 내 눈에 띄지 않는게 좋을거야. 너도..�
entries.translation: Once you deliver it, you had better stay out of my sight. You too...�

entries.source: 이제 너는 내게, 그저 웨이드 가의 앞잡이로 보일 뿐이니까.�
entries.translation: Because now, all I see in you is a lackey of House Wade.�

entries.source: 그렇다면 나도.. 너에 대한 미련을 접겠다.�
entries.translation: Then I too... will let go of any lingering attachment to you.�
I will gladly accept that offer.�
Have you... made up your mind?�

entries.source: 닥쳐. 네 얼굴만 봐도 구역질이 나지만 분명히 말해두기 위해 왔다.�
entries.translation: Shut up. Looking at your face makes me sick, but I came to make things clear.�
Sealing the Ancient God comes first.�

entries.source: 고대신의 봉인이 우선이다. 그건 나도 마찬가지야.�
entries.translation: Sealing the Ancient God comes first. I feel the same about that.�

entries.source: 하지만 너나 듣는 자들과 함께는 아니야. 절대로, 그 방법은 틀렸다.�
entries.translation: But not with you or the Listeners. Absolutely not. Your method is wrong.�

entries.source: 그러면 또 듣는 자들은 날 죽이러 오겠지?�
entries.translation: So the Listeners will come to kill me again, will not they?�

entries.source: 전부 다 살려면 몇 명 죽어야 하니까. 그건 숭고한 희생이니까?�
entries.translation: A few must die so everyone else lives? Because that is a noble sacrifice?�
We have no choice. The Ancient God is...�
The Ancient God is our enemy. I agree with that.�

entries.source: 하지만 여전히, 웨이드 가와 듣는 자들 역시 나의 적이다. 그들과 손을 잡을 생각은 없어.�
entries.translation: But even so, House Wade and the Listeners are still my enemies. I will not join hands with them.�

entries.source: 고대신과 싸우려면.. 그들이 가진 힘과 지식이 필요해.�
entries.translation: To fight the Ancient God... we need their power and knowledge.�

entries.source: 인간의 힘만으로는, 네베드의 힘만으로는 놈을 이겨낼 수 없다는 걸 왜 모르지?�
entries.translation: Why do not you see that human strength alone, Neved strength alone, cannot defeat it?�

entries.source: 나는.. }티르{와 }네베드{들을 도울거야. 그들의 방법이 너희들보다 훨씬 인간적이니까.�
entries.translation: I am going to... help }Tyr{ and the }Neved{. Their way is far more human than yours.�

entries.source: 정령만은.. 절대로 완성시키지 않는다. 우리의 방식대로 고대신과 싸울 거야.�
entries.translation: I will never... let you complete the Spirit. We will fight the Ancient God our own way.�

entries.source: 그러니까 그들에게 똑똑히 전해. 다음은, 너희라고.�
entries.translation: So tell them clearly. You guys are next.�

entries.source: 듣는 자와의 싸움이 우선이다. 내 적은 변하지 않아.�
entries.translation: Fighting the Listeners comes first. My enemy has not changed.�
But Schultz... the Ancient God is...!�

entries.source: 그래, 고대신의 부활은 임박했겠지. 그래서 듣는 자들이 난리치는 거겠지?�
entries.translation: Right, its resurrection must be imminent. That is why the Listeners are in a panic, is not it?�

entries.source: 하지만 그 모든 걸 숨기고 공화국 전체를 이용해서 싸우려는 자들을 믿을 순 없어.�
entries.translation: But I cannot trust people who hide everything and use the entire Republic to fight.�

entries.source: 그들은 공화국을 발전시키고 혼란을 막아주고 있어.�
entries.translation: They are developing the Republic and preventing chaos.�

entries.source: 그리고 권세를 누리지. 고대신이 봉인된다 해도 그건 변하지 않는다.�
entries.translation: And enjoying power. Even if the Ancient God is sealed, that will not change.�

entries.source: 난 }혁명군{으로 돌아가... 다른 계승자들과 함께 듣는 자들과 싸울거야.�
entries.translation: I am going back to the }Resistance{... to fight the Listeners alongside the other Successors.�

entries.source: 반대야. 그 놈들이 사라져야 고대신과도 싸울 수 있다.�
entries.translation: It is the opposite. Only when they are gone can we fight the Ancient God.�

entries.source: 그러니까 그들에게 똑똑히 전해. 우리를 이용할 생각은 일찌감치 접으라고.�
entries.translation: So tell them clearly. Give up on using us right now.�

entries.source: 킹스포트는 산업화된지 좀 오래 됐죠. 리드마이어 가문 시절부터니까..�
entries.translation: Kingsport has been industrialized for quite a while. Ever since the Readmeyers...�

entries.source: 록빌도 산업화 된다는데, 우리도 재개발이나 한번 했으면 좋겠네요.�
entries.translation: Rockville is industrializing too. Wish we could get some redevelopment ourselves.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬의 타조들은 굉장히 포악해. 경비대가 가장 많이 신경쓰는 부분이지.�
entries.translation: The ostriches on Cole Creek Isle are ferocious. The guards spend most of their time watching out for them.�

entries.source: 게다가 간간히 강력한 데몬들도 출현하니.. 안전한 섬이라고는 못해.�
entries.translation: Plus, powerful demons appear occasionally... so it is hardly a safe island.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가문이 멸문당한 뒤로는, 이 썩어빠진 광산 협회가 다 해 쳐먹고 있어�
entries.translation: Ever since House Reedmeyer was wiped out, this rotten Mining Association has been hogging everything.�

entries.source: 다른 일거리만 있었어도 이따위 놈들을 지켜주는 일 따위 맡지 않았을텐데..�
entries.translation: If there were any other jobs, I would never bother guarding scum like them...�

entries.source: 킹스포트 사람들은, 생각보다 현재의 마을 상황에 불만이 많은 것 같아.�
entries.translation: People in Kingsport seem far more dissatisfied with the town state than you would expect.�

entries.source: 경제적으로는 부족함이 없는 것 같은데 이상하지?�
entries.translation: They lack nothing financially, so it is strange, is not it?�

entries.source: 록빌 재개발 때문에 자원 소비량이 많아져서 당장은 다들 좋아하고 있지만..�
entries.translation: Everyone happy for now because the Rockville redevelopment demands so many resources...�

entries.source: 북서쪽 갱도가 폐쇄된 뒤로, 동쪽 갱도의 채굴량이 너무 과다해졌어. 그게.. 제일 불안하군.�
entries.translation: Ever since the northwest shaft closed, the eastern shaft has been mined too aggressively. That is... what worries me most.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬은 공화국의 중앙에 위치해서.. 해상 교통의 요지로 발전시키면 좋을텐데 말이지.�
entries.translation: Cole Creek Isle sits right in the Republic center... It would make a great hub for maritime traffic.�

entries.source: 현실은 화물선, 화물선, 화물선 뿐이야. 아무리 봐도 위에서 뭔가 수를 쓰고 있는 거라고.�
entries.translation: Instead, it is just cargo ship after cargo ship. Someone up top is definitely pulling strings.�

entries.source: 이것 참.. 별다른 사건도 없는데 마을 분위기가 흉흉하니 내가 다 찝찝하군.�
entries.translation: Man... Nothing even happened, yet the gloomy mood around town is giving me the creeps.�

entries.source: 리드마이어 가문이 건재할 때는 안 이랬는데.. 사람들이 너무 비관적이 됐다니까.�
entries.translation: It was not like this when House Reedmeyer was around... People have become far too cynical.�

entries.source: 저희는 콜크리크 섬의 주요 갱도들을 관리하며, 외부로 나가는 광물들을 분류하고 검증하는 일을 주로 담당하고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: We manage Cole Creek Isle main shafts, sorting and inspecting minerals slated for export.�

entries.source: 에잉.. 이거 원, 동부 갱도 말고 다른 루트는 개발 못하는 건가?�
entries.translation: Sigh... Cannot we develop any route other than the eastern shaft?�

entries.source: 광물 심의 비용을 좀 더 늘려야 돼. 이런 식이면 인건비도 제대로 안나온다고.�
entries.translation: We must raise the mineral appraisal fees. At this rate, we will not even cover labor costs.�

entries.source: 이거 무게에 비해 순도가 너무 떨어지는데. 요즘 점점 질이 나빠져.�
entries.translation: The purity is way too low for its weight. The quality keeps worsening lately.�

entries.source: 이게 다 우리가 공인해준 장비를 사용하지 않아서 이런 거라니까. 왜 말들을 안 듣는지.�
entries.translation: It is all because they will not use our certified equipment. Why will not anyone listen?�

entries.source: 아하암.. 뭐.. 광물들이 다 거기서 거기긴 하지..�
entries.translation: *Yawn*... Well, minerals are pretty much all the same anyway...�

entries.source: 그래도 이래저래 제약을 좀 걸어줘야, 일꾼들도 우리를 쉽게 못 본다고.�
entries.translation: Still, we need some rules like this so the workers will not take us lightly.�

entries.source: 뒤에 쌓여있는 거 보이지? 이게 다 장부야.�
entries.translation: See those piles behind me? Those are all ledgers.�

entries.source: 내가 저걸 정리할 때마다 느끼는 건데.. 광산 협회는 진짜 도둑놈들이라고.�
entries.translation: Every time I balance these books, I realize the Mining Guild is a bunch of crooks.�

entries.source: 한동안 강제 이벤트가 진행되며 세이브/귀환이 제한됩니다. 계속 하시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?�
What happened...? There is no one here...�
Then it is okay for me to stay out, right?�

entries.source: 그러고보니까.. 난 카즈라는 사람 얼굴도 본적이 없네. 이름만 실컷 듣고..�
entries.translation: Come to think of it... I have never seen Kaze face. Only heard his name a lot...�

entries.source: 귀엽다. 어릴 때로구나. 뒤에 서있는 게 부모님?�
entries.translation: Cute. He was so young. Are those his parents standing behind him?�

entries.source: 지금은 없는.. 웨이드 가에게 숙청 당했다고 하더군.�
entries.translation: They are gone now... He said House Wade purged them.�

entries.source: 그래서.. 웨이드 가에 복수를 하려는 거고..�
entries.translation: So... that is why he wants revenge against House Wade...�

entries.source: 3년전에.. 의뢰 수행하다 큰 부상을 입은 적이 있는데, 그때 신세를 졌어.�
entries.translation: Three years ago... I was badly injured during a contract, and he helped me out.�

entries.source: 그녀석은 웨이드 가가 숨기고 있는 인간 이외의 힘에 대해 이야기를 했고.. 함께 그 배후를 찾아 복수를 하자고 하더군.�
entries.translation: He told me about the non-human power House Wade was hiding... and suggested we find who was behind it and get revenge.�

entries.source: 하지만 그러면.. 정령에 대해서도 이해해 주지 않았을까? 왜 나를 숨긴거야?�
entries.translation: Then would not he have... understood about Spirits too? Why did you hide me?�

entries.source: .. 글쎄.. 난 그녀석이.. 인간의 것이 아닌 힘에 대해 증오하고, 경멸한다고 생각했거든.�
entries.translation: ...Well... I thought he hated and despised any power that was not human.�

entries.source: 어째서인지 웨이드 가보다 그 배후에 더 집착하는 듯하고..�
entries.translation: For some reason, he seemed more obsessed with the mastermind than House Wade itself...�

entries.source: 그래서 말하기 힘들었어. 오히려 의심 받을 수도 있고..�
entries.translation: So it was hard to tell him. It might have even made him suspect me...�
Th-The Black Guard? Did the Listeners find us?�

entries.source: 젠장, 건물안에 고립되기 전에 빠져 나가야 해!�
entries.translation: Damn it, we have to get out before we get trapped inside!�

entries.source: 엘바니움 광석이 유통 제한에 걸렸다는군. 협회에서 승인이 안났데, 별 쓸데없는 이유로.�
entries.translation: Elbanium ore got hit with trade restrictions. The guild did not approve it, over some pointless excuse.�

entries.source: 아니 대체, 광석이 어디 쓰이는지도 제대로 모르는 놈들이 뭘 승인하겠다는 건지..�
entries.translation: I mean, what are they approving when they do not even know what the ore is used for...?�
Welcome! Please assist the Arcane Society with inspecting magic wares!�

entries.source: 최고의 재료로 만든 최고의 아이템만을 제공합니다. 보고 가세요.�
entries.translation: We only offer the finest items made from the best materials. Take a look!�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬의 공화국에서 가장 위험한 지역 중에 하나지. 수련을 게을리해선 안돼.�
entries.translation: Cole Creek Isle is one of the most dangerous places in the Republic. Do not neglect your training.�

entries.source: 콜크리크 섬의 대장장이들에게 광물은 평생의 동반자와도 같아.�
entries.translation: To the blacksmiths of Cole Creek Isle, minerals are lifelong companions.�
To the east... East. I can feel her...�
The east mineshaft, then... Let us go!�
I have to find Tiana... She is to the }east{.�
Phew... Did everyone... make it out safely...?�
Lord Schultz... Are you all right?�

entries.source: 아.. 조금 피로가 쌓였던 것 뿐이야.�
entries.translation: Ah... I guess exhaustion just caught up with me.�

entries.source: 그보다 너는..? 크래드를 만난 뒤로.. 계속 숨어있었잖아.�
entries.translation: More importantly, what about you...? You have been hiding ever since you met Krad.�

entries.source: 정신 바짝차리고.. 날 잡아먹을 생각만 하지마.�
entries.translation: Keep your wits about you... and stop looking like you want to eat me alive.�
Th-That is not it at all!�
Good enough, then. Keep your mind on that.�

entries.source: 웨이드 가와 듣는 자들을 무너뜨리면.. 우린 이대로도 괜찮을테니까.�
entries.translation: Once we bring down House Wade and the Listeners... we can finally live in peace like this.�

entries.source: 신 따위를 만들기 위해 누군가가 희생해야 하는 일은 만들지 않을거야.�
entries.translation: I will not let anyone be sacrificed just to manufacture some false god.�
Do you really think... things will go the way you want?�

entries.source: 그들의 말이 옳아.. 결국 모두 죽고.. 신은 만들어져서 누군가에게 이용당할 거야.�
entries.translation: They are right... In the end, everyone dies... and a god will be made, only to be used by someone else.�

entries.source: 힘이 있는 이상.. 세상은 우리를 그냥 두지 않을거라고..�
entries.translation: As long as power exists... the world will never leave us alone...�

entries.source: 크리스. 너희는.. 도대체 무슨 일을 당했던 거냐?�
entries.translation: Chris. What on earth... did they do to you two?�
We were }test subjects{... to the Listeners...�
Test... subjects? Just like those ancient beasts...?�

entries.source: 실험관에 잠겨있다가, 매일 매일 이상한 주사를 맞고.. 약을 먹고.. 때로는 괴물 우리에 던져졌지.�
entries.translation: Submerged in test tubes, injected with strange drugs every day... fed pills... and sometimes thrown into beast cages.�

entries.source: 티아나가 저렇게 말을 잃은 건.. 그것 때문이야?�
entries.translation: Is that why... Tiana lost her voice?�

entries.source: 정령을 계승할 때.. 저 녀석의 }과거{를 몽땅 지워버렸거든.�
entries.translation: When the Spirit was passed on... I completely wiped away her }past{.�

entries.source: 그렇지 않으면.. 제대로 살아갈 수 없을 것 같았어. 그 끔찍한 과거를 지우는 것이 우리의 소원이었다..�
entries.translation: If I had not... I do not think she could have gone on living. Erasing that horrific past was our only wish...�

entries.source: 그 후로는 방주를 찾아 헤맸지. 듣는 자들이 방주로는 절대 들어갈 수 없었다고 했던 걸 기억하니까..�
entries.translation: After that, we wandered in search of the Ark. We remembered the Listeners saying they could never enter it...�

entries.source: 하지만 이젠 어떻게 하지? 난.. 방주에 도달하면 모든 게 평온해질거라 생각했는데..�
entries.translation: But what do I do now? I... I thought once we reached the Ark, everything would be peaceful...�

entries.source: 티아나와 둘이서.. 아무에게도 간섭받지 않고 살 수 있는...�
entries.translation: Just Tiana and me... living free without anyone interference...�

entries.source: 걱정하지마. 이곳도 나름대로.. 편안한 안식처가 될거다.�
entries.translation: Do not worry. This place will serve as a restful sanctuary in its own way.�

entries.source: 적어도 너희들이 오기전까지, 이 폐쇄된 갱도는 나만의 공간이었다.�
entries.translation: At least until you two arrived, this abandoned mineshaft was my private haven.�
Why should I trust anything you say...?�

entries.source: 모르겠다. 물론 날 믿을 수 없겠지. 삶의 가장 큰 목적조차 스스로 내팽겨친 망나니에 불과하니까..�
entries.translation: Fair enough. I would not trust me either. I am just a wreck who threw away his life greatest purpose...�

entries.source: 나도 내가 왜 너희를 지켜주고 싶은건지는 모르겠지만..�
entries.translation: I do not even know why I want to protect you two, but...�

entries.source: 내게는 지금 그것 말고는 삶의 목적이 없어. 믿어주었으면 좋겠군.�
entries.translation: Right now, I have no other purpose in life. I hope you can believe that.�
I do not know... Right now, I just...�

entries.source: 쉬어라.. 방주만큼은 아니어도, 쉽게 누군가 들어올 수 있는 곳은 아니니까.�
entries.translation: Rest... It may not be the Ark, but it is not a place outsiders can easily find.�

entries.source: 그래. 너무 오래 쉬었다. 더 이상 시간을 지체할 순 없어.�
entries.translation: Yeah. I have rested long enough. I cannot delay any longer.�

entries.source: 이곳은 확실히.. 완벽한 은신처인 것 같군. 다행이야.�
entries.translation: This place really is... a perfect hideout. That is a relief.�

entries.source: 크리스와 티아나는 나에게 맡기고.. 몸 조심해라.�
entries.translation: Leave Chris and Tiana to me... Watch your back out there.�

entries.source: 내가 좀 둘러봤는데.. 모든 마물들이 포악해져있어. 여행길이 훨씬 험난해 질거야.�
entries.translation: I took a look around outside... All the monsters have turned vicious. The journey will be much more perilous.�
Vicious...? Could that also be the Ark doing?�

entries.source: 그나저나 루퍼스도.. 그 놈과 싸워주던 남자도 결국 돌아오지 않았군.�
entries.translation: Regardless, neither Rufus... nor the man who fought him ever returned.�

entries.source: ... 티르는 괜찮을거야. 루퍼스의 죽음은 느껴지지 않지만, 그렇다고 그 남자가 죽었을 거라고도 생각되진 않으니까.�
entries.translation: ... Tyr will be fine. I do not sense Rufus death, but I cannot imagine that man dying either.�
So... will you hide out here?�

entries.source: 그래. 이제 난 아무 힘도 없고.. 리드마이어 가의 이름을 잇고 싶지도 않다. 미안하지만 혁명같은 건 생각없어.�
entries.translation: Yeah. I have no power left... and no desire to carry the Riedmayer name. I am sorry, but I have no interest in revolution.�

entries.source: 여기서 저 녀석들이 편안하게 지낼 수 있도록 해주고 싶다.�
entries.translation: I just want those kids to live comfortably here.�

entries.source: 크리스가 더 강하겠지만.. 애들은 보호자가 필요하지.�
entries.translation: Chris might be stronger... but kids need a guardian.�

entries.source: 조심해서 가라. 우리걱정은 말고. 이곳은.. 아무도 찾아내지 못할거야.�
entries.translation: Take care on your way. Do not worry about us. No one will ever find this place.�
It certainly looks good for hiding, but...�

entries.source: 그럼 우린.. 다시 그 카즈란 사람에게 돌아가는 거야?�
entries.translation: Then... are we heading back to Kaze?�

entries.source: 그래야지. 결국, 강림자는 기술을 제공했을 뿐..�
entries.translation: We have to. In the end, the Descendants only provided technology...�

entries.source: 결판을 지어야 할 것은 웨이드 가.. 그리고 듣는 자들이다. 변한 건 없어.�
entries.translation: The ones we must settle things with are House Wade... and the Listeners. Nothing has changed.�

entries.source: 이 아이들은 나에게 맡겨. 그리고 너도.. 도움이 필요하면 언제든지 돌아오고.�
entries.translation: Leave the children to me. And if you ever need help... you can always return.�
I... will not trust you guys.�

entries.source: 길이 뚫렸대서 와봤는데.. 이건 사람이 있을 곳이 아니네. 얼른 빠져야겠어.�
entries.translation: Heard the path opened so I came... but no one could live here. I need to get out fast.�

entries.source: .. 무슨 배짱으로 내 앞에 혼자 나타났지?�
entries.translation: ...What nerve do you have, showing up before me alone?�

entries.source: 듣는 자들의 전언이다. 너에게.. 마지막 제안이야.�
entries.translation: A message from the Listeners. This is... their final offer to you.�

entries.source: 하.. 이제 완전히 놈들의 꼭두각시라는 거냐?�
entries.translation: Ha... So you are completely their puppet now?�

entries.source: 덕분에 여럿 죽었어. 이 상황에서 무슨 제안을 한다고?�
entries.translation: Many died because of them. What kind of offer could they make in this situation?�

entries.source: 지금 당장 너를 쳐죽여 달라는 제안 말고는 전부 사양이다, 꺼져.�
entries.translation: Unless the offer is to let me strike you down right now, forget it. Get lost.�

entries.source: 루퍼스에게, 흑의병이 괴멸되었다. 이제 남은 듣는 자는 몇 안돼.�
entries.translation: The Black Guard was wiped out by Rufus. Few Listeners remain now.�

entries.source: 그리고 고대신의 부활은 목전에 와있어. 시간이 없다.�
entries.translation: And the resurrection of the Ancient God is right before us. There is no time.�

entries.source: 듣는 자들은, 너를 최후의 승자로 만들어 준다고 해. 나도.. 그걸 원하고.�
entries.translation: The Listeners say they will make you the final victor. And... I want that too.�

entries.source: 슈르츠.. 지금 듣는 자들과 싸우는 건 답이 아니야.�
entries.translation: Schultz... Fighting the Listeners now is not the answer.�

entries.source: 인류는 힘을 합쳐 고대신이라는 더 큰 위협과 싸워야 할 때라는 걸 생각해야 해..�
entries.translation: We must realize humanity needs to join forces against a greater threat: the Ancient God...�

entries.source: 그러지 않으면.. 저 불쌍한 아이들같은 희생자들만 더 나올 뿐이니까..�
entries.translation: Otherwise... there will only be more victims like those poor children...�
So... what is your next move?�

entries.source: 베르날로 돌아가 봐야지. 아무래도 카즈가 걱정되는군.�
entries.translation: I should head back to Vernal. I am worried about Kaze.�

entries.source: 결국 우리에게 위협이 되는 건 듣는 자들이니까.�
entries.translation: In the end, our true threat is the Listeners.�

entries.source: 듣는 자들을 무너뜨리고.. 계승자 중에선 루퍼스 정도만 처리하면 돼.�
entries.translation: Tear down the Listeners... and among the Successors, we only need to deal with Rufus.�

entries.source: 그러면 적어도 }정령의 완성{을 기도하는 자들은 없어진다..�
entries.translation: Then at least, no one will plot the }Completion of the Spirit{...�

entries.source: 루레인이 고대신을 언제까지고 봉인할 수 있다면..�
entries.translation: If Lurain can seal the Ancient God forever...�

entries.source: 크래드가 강림자의 방주를 언제까지고 컨트롤 할 수 있다면.�
entries.translation: If Krad can control the Descendant Ark forever, that is.�

entries.source: .. 티르 오빠는.. 우리가 그들과 싸워야 한다고 생각하는 건가요?�
entries.translation: ...Tyr, do you think we should fight them?�
I do not wish for the Spirit completion.�

entries.source: 하지만 이런 위협들을 알고나니.. 웨이드 가에서 왜 그렇게 힘을 원하는 지, 이해가 갈 것 같기도 해서.�
entries.translation: Yet knowing these threats... I can sort of understand why House Wade craved power so badly.�

entries.source: 그렇다고.. 그 어린 애들을 실험체로 삼고, 누군가가 희생하면서까지 신을 만드는 것이 정당화되진 않아.�
entries.translation: Still... using young children as subjects and sacrificing lives to create a god can never be justified.�

entries.source: 놈들은 그런식이야.. 신을 만들기 위해서 }7명{의 인생 정도는 희생해도 된다고 생각했겠지.�
entries.translation: That is how they operate... They thought sacrificing the lives of }7 people{ was worth creating a god.�

entries.source: 인간을 위해.. 공화국을 위해.. 입버릇처럼 지껄이면서.�
entries.translation: Spouting nonsense like for humanity and for the Republic.�

entries.source: 뭘 그렇게 놀라. 콜크리크 섬에서 한 명 더 찾았어.�
entries.translation: Why so surprised? We found one more on Cole Creek Isle.�

entries.source: 그 시설..? 7명이라고 생각한 무슨 단서라도 있는거야?�
entries.translation: That facility...? Did you find clues pointing to seven?�

entries.source: 앞으로 한동안은 배 쓸일이 없을 것 같으니, 다른 섬에 갈 일이 있으면 그라함의 배를 쓰도록 해.�
entries.translation: I will not need the boat for a while, so if you need to travel to another island, use Graham ship.�

entries.source: 티르 오빠.. 뭔가 숨기고 있는 것 같은데.�
entries.translation: Tyr seems to be hiding something...�

entries.source: 다음 출발 때까지, 또 네오그라함호를 최고의 상태로 만들어 두겠어.�
entries.translation: I will make sure the Neo Graham is in peak condition by our next departure.�

entries.source: 내 전용 강화복의 역사적인 시운전 시간을 자네에게도 보여주지. 같이 가지 않겠나?�
entries.translation: I will let you witness the historic test run of my powered armor. Care to join?�
I do not want to go.�
I am busy with other things.�

entries.source: 으음. 괜찮아. 앞으로 전장에서 볼 수 있을테니.�
entries.translation: Mm. That is fine. You will see it on the battlefield soon enough.�

entries.source: 가고 싶지 않은 마음이 75%를 넘는 듯한 기분이 드는데?�
entries.translation: I feel like you are more than 75% reluctant to come along?�
Just your imagination. Do not worry about it.�

entries.source: 군인으로서 전장에 나가지 못하고 계속 배만 움직이자니... 솜씨가 녹슬겠어.�
entries.translation: As a soldier, just steering a ship without fighting... My skills will rust away.�
Do you even have skills to rust?�

entries.source: 무슨 소리야. 이래뵈도 강화복 조종은 일류라고.�
entries.translation: What are you saying? I am a top-notch powered armor pilot, you know.�

entries.source: 대전 때는 공화국의 하얀 악마라든가 하는 별명도 있었다고.�
entries.translation: During the Great War, they even called me the Republic White Devil.�
Self-proclaimed...? And where is this armor anyway?�

entries.source: 대전 중에 루레인 님의 손에 호쾌하게 파괴당했어... 그 때는 적이었거든...�
entries.translation: Lady Lurain gloriously smashed it during the war... We were enemies back then...�

entries.source: 아직 여기 보관하면서 짬짬이 고치고 있어. 재료가 모자라서 고생이지만.�
entries.translation: I am keeping it here and fixing it when I can. But I am low on materials.�

entries.source: 혹시 남는 재료가 있으며 좀 보태주지 않겠나?�
entries.translation: Could you spare some if you have any leftovers?�
I do not know how good you actually are...�

entries.source: 티르가 데리고 다니는 것 보면 허당은 아닐 것 같고. 없는 것보다는 도움이 되겠지?�
entries.translation: Seeing Tyr keep you around means you are no dead weight. Better than nothing, right?�

entries.source: 좋았어, 그럼 부탁한 재료가 다 구해지면 여기로 와서 바로 기동해 보지.�
entries.translation: Great! Once you gather the materials, come back here and we will boot it right up.�
Hey... is not this quite a lot?�

entries.source: 핫핫핫, 내가 조합을 배운 적이 없다보니 말이지.�
entries.translation: Hahaha, I never learned how to Combine, you see.�

entries.source: 내가 가장 좋아하는 일 중의 하나는 자기 스스로 강하다고 생각하는 놈에게 NO라고 거절해 주는 것이지.�
entries.translation: One of my favorite things to do is saying NO to guys who think they are hot stuff.�
You have got a terrible personality...�

entries.source: 지금부터의 싸움에 솔직히 말해서... 강화복 같이 둔하고 무거운 게 나올 여지는 없다.�
entries.translation: Honestly, a clunky powered armor has no place in the fights ahead.�
If we needed one, Tyr would have procured it already.�

entries.source: 으음... 그것도 그런가. 하지만 나는 포기하지 않아.�
entries.translation: Ugh... Fair point. But I am not giving up.�

entries.source: 어차피 나는 집요한데다 찰거머리야. 속칭 미움 받는 성격이지.�
entries.translation: I am stubborn and clingy like a leech anyway. The universally disliked type.�

entries.source: 자기 입으로 말하지 말라고 그런 서글픈 대사...�
entries.translation: Do not say something so pathetic about yourself...�
It is here, it is finally here! The time has come!�
I will fix it right up and test run it! On the ship!�

entries.source: 티르님이 시운전 할거면 배에서 하라고 하시더군.�
entries.translation: Tyr told me that if I am doing a test run, do it on the ship.�

entries.source: 그래야 남에게 피해도 안주고 여차하면 바다로 빠뜨리면 된다고.�
entries.translation: That way it will not hurt anyone, and in an emergency, we can dump it in the sea.�
...Why do I feel extremely... uneasy about this...?�

entries.source: 따라가려면 세이브라도 해놓아야 할 것 같은 강한 예감이 듭니다.�
entries.translation: I have a strong feeling I should save my game before tagging along.�
Hold on. Give me a moment to think.�

entries.source: 거래가 활발할 정도로 사람이 많은 건 아니지만, 물건은 항상 구비해두고 있습니다.�
entries.translation: There are not many people around to trade, but our wares are always stocked.�

entries.source: 다들 조금은 나태해졌지만, 혁명의 그 때를 위해.. 수련을 게을리해선 안돼.�
entries.translation: Everyone gotten a bit complacent, but for the revolution... we must not neglect our training.�

entries.source: 우리 손으로 직접 벼린 무기들이라면, 센트럴의 공장에서 찍어내는 무기들 따위 무섭지 않다고!�
entries.translation: With weapons forged by our own hands, we do not fear the mass-produced junk from Central factories!�
What do you mean by }that facility{?�

entries.source: 혹시.. 크래드 오빠가 절 만든 곳인가요?�
entries.translation: Could it be... where brother Krad made me?�

entries.source: 아마도.. 그럴거라고 생각해. 내가 그곳을 찾아냈을 땐 }7개의 관{이 있었고, 그래서 7명이라고 생각했어.�
entries.translation: Probably... I think so. When I found that place, there were }7 pods{, so I assumed there were seven of them.�

entries.source: 하지만 더 있다고 해서.. 별로 놀라울 건 없지.�
entries.translation: Still, finding out there are more... is not really surprising.�

entries.source: 어째서 그런 걸 숨겼나? 그 시설은 어디에 있지? 그곳에서 다른 정보를 얻었던 건 아닌가?�
entries.translation: Why did you hide that? Where is this facility? Did you find any other information there?�

entries.source: 너희는 갈 필요 없는 곳이야. 다 무너져가는 연구시설이고, 아무런 자료도 남아있지 않았다.�
entries.translation: It is not a place you need to visit. It was a crumbling research lab, and no data was left behind.�

entries.source: 나 역시 테오도어와 에블린을 만나기 전까지는 계승자에 대한 걸 몰랐으니까.�
entries.translation: I did not even know about the Successors until I met Theodore and Evelyn.�

entries.source: 얻을 것이 없어. 찝찝한 기계들을 보면 기분만 나빠질 거다.�
entries.translation: There is nothing to gain. Looking at those grim machines will only sour your mood.�

entries.source: 그런 곳보다는.. 앞으로의 움직임이 더 중요하니까.�
entries.translation: Rather than dwelling on such a place... our next move matters more.�
...Alright. Then... we will borrow the boat.�
Tyr... what do you plan to do?�

entries.source: 나는 루레인에게 가서 고대신의 상태를 좀 확인해 봐야 될 것 같군.�
entries.translation: I should go to Lurain and check on the ancient god condition.�

entries.source: 그런데 카즈라는 자는.. 믿을 수 있는 자인가?�
entries.translation: By the way, is that man Kaze... someone you can trust?�

entries.source: 하지만 혁명에 조심스러워진 것도 그렇고.. 갑자기 사라진 것도 그렇고.. 좀 석연찮은 구석이 있어 요즘에는.�
entries.translation: Between growing hesitant about the revolution... and vanishing so suddenly, things feel off lately.�

entries.source: 복수가 삶의 목표인 자는 잔혹한 선택도 서슴치 않으니까.. 조심해라.�
entries.translation: Those who live solely for revenge will not hesitate to make cruel choices... Be careful.�
I am going to check it out.�

entries.source: 그래. 당신이 찾지 못한 무언가가 있을지도 모르고..�
entries.translation: Yeah. There might be something you missed...�
I doubt it will do you any good.�

entries.source: 당신이 뭔가 숨기고 있는 것 같아서 그래. 직접 .. 보고싶다.�
entries.translation: It feels like you are hiding something. I want to see it... for myself.�

entries.source: 후우.. 그라함, 베르날 근해에서 듣는 자들의 동태를 감시해줘. 잠시 다녀오겠다.�
entries.translation: Phew... Graham, monitor the Hearers movements off Vernal. I will be back shortly.�
And you two, come to the }southwest{ of }Eastern Meadow Hill{.�

entries.source: 숨기고 있는 게 없는 건 아니지만..�
entries.translation: It is not like I was not hiding anything, but...�

entries.source: 굳이 모든 진실을 알아야 할 필요는 없다.�
entries.translation: You do not necessarily have to know the whole truth.�
Nothing. It just... left a bad taste in my mouth.�

entries.source: 듣는 자들을 상대할 때는.. 항상 네가 생각할 수 있는 최악 이상의 것을 각오하는 게 좋아.�
entries.translation: When dealing with the Hearers... prepare for something worse than your darkest thoughts.�

entries.source: 그들의 주인은 네베드의 고대신, 악몽을 지배하는 자다.�
entries.translation: Their master is the Neved ancient god, ruler of nightmares.�
What is it? Did the Hearers make a move?�
It looks like... a massive force this time!�

entries.source: 흑의병들이 전부 }콜크리크 섬{으로 향하고 있어요, }알프레드{까지 포함해서..!�
entries.translation: The Black Guard are all heading for }Cole Creek Isle{, even }Alfred{...!�
...What is left there? The Ark is already...�

entries.source: 알렉스씨와.. 크리스, 티아나가 숨어지내고 있어.. 설마 들킨걸까?�
entries.translation: Alex, Chris, and Tiana are hiding there... Could they have been found?�
Do not worry about it. Feel free to use }Graham boat{ anytime.�

entries.source: 그라함, 난 한동안 성지에 가서.. 고대신의 상태를 확인해볼테니, 한동안 슈르츠와 렌을 도와줘.�
entries.translation: Graham, I will be at the Sanctuary checking on the ancient god, so assist Schultz and Ren for now.�
Leave it to me! I will take you anywhere in the Republic in no time!�
Then I am off. We must hurry.�

entries.source: .. 렌.. 혹시 모르니.. 너는 알아두고 있어라.�
entries.translation: ...Ren... just in case, keep this in mind.�

entries.source: 나는 예전에, 슈르츠를 만난 적이 있어.�
entries.translation: I have actually met Schultz once before.�
You are here... You went to the Sanctuary?�

entries.source: 그래.. 고대신을 봉인할 방법을 알아보고 싶어서.�
entries.translation: Yeah... I wanted to find a way to seal the Old God.�
Hmm... How was the situation at the Sanctuary?�

entries.source: 한바탕 난리가 났었는데.. 지금은 일단 균열을 봉합.. 해놓은 상태라고 해.�
entries.translation: It was complete chaos... but they have temporarily sealed the rift for now.�

entries.source: 하지만 봉인은 이미 쇠약해져서, 완전히 새로 봉인하지 않는 이상 균열은 다시 벌어질 거라는군.�
entries.translation: However, the seal is already weakened. Unless a new seal is made, the rift will break open again.�

entries.source: 정령의 힘을 보태서.. 균열을 봉합한 건가.�
entries.translation: They used the power of the spirits... to patch the rift.�
Perhaps your control is still lacking.�

entries.source: 어느 쪽이든 지금 상태로는 고대신을 봉인할 수 없어.�
entries.translation: Either way, we cannot seal the Old God in our current state.�

entries.source: 테오도어가 기다리고 있다. 강림자의 유물에 대한 연구가.. 꽤나 진척이 되었나봐.�
entries.translation: Theodore is waiting. His research on the Descendant artifacts... seems to have made great progress.�
Did he find something? A way to control the spirits...�

entries.source: 음..? 결계는.. 면역이 된 것 아니었나?�
entries.translation: Hmm...? Was not I... immune to the barrier?�
No... This is different from back then.�
Did they cast a new barrier?�

entries.source: 아마 그때 고대종들의 대규모 습격이 있었으니까.. 그랬던 게 아닐까?�
entries.translation: Maybe it is because of that massive ancient beast attack back then?�
What a pain... Do I have to gather soul dust again...?�

entries.source: .. 근데 이거.. 영혼 가루 정도로는 안될것 같은데?�
entries.translation: ...Wait, soul dust alone will not be enough for this, will it?�

entries.source: 더 강한 게 필요해.. 예전에 그 }얼어붙은 바다{에서 구한 것 같은..�
entries.translation: We need something stronger... Like what we found in the }Frozen Sea{ before...�

entries.source: 응, 그것과 비슷한 것이 필요할 것 같아, 그것도 많이..�
entries.translation: Yeah, I think we will need something like that. And a lot of them...�

entries.source: 뭐야.. }얼어붙은 바다{까지 가야 한다고..? 더 귀찮아 졌잖아..�
entries.translation: What...? We have to go all the way to the }Frozen Sea{? This got even more tedious...�
You... seem kind of different somehow...?�

entries.source: 이런 거.. 원래 할 줄 알았던 거야?�
entries.translation: Did you... always know how to do this?�

entries.source: 아니야.. 아마도.. 나도 모르는 새에 더 많은 걸 알고.. 할 수 있게 된 거겠지..�
entries.translation: No... Perhaps without realizing it, I have come to know and do more things...�
I do not think... this path was here before.�
Did they cast a new barrier...?�
To be exact... the }Successor{ was created here.�

entries.source: 내가 보기엔.. 예전에 성지로 가기 위해 구했던 영혼가루로는 지나갈 수 없을 것 같아.�
entries.translation: From what I can tell... the soul dust we got to reach the Sanctuary will not let us pass.�

entries.source: }얼어붙은 바다{에서 구했던 }영혼석{과 비슷한 것이 필요해, 그것도 많이..�
entries.translation: We need something like the }Soul Stones{ from the }Frozen Sea{, and a lot of them...�
This is the facility I spoke of.�

entries.source: 나는 이곳에서.. 듣는 자들이 새로운 뭔가를 꾸미고 있다는 걸 알아냈지.�
entries.translation: Here, I discovered that the Listeners were plotting something new.�

entries.source: 만약 여기가 정말 계승자의 탄생지라면, 크래드도 같이 있었겠지. 그는 }기술제공자{니까.�
entries.translation: If this truly is the birthplace of the Successors, Krad was likely here too. He is the }technician{, after all.�

entries.source: 당신은.. 계승자를 듣는 자들이 만들었다는 걸 이미 예상하고 있었군.�
entries.translation: You already suspected... that the Listeners created the Successors.�

entries.source: 그래. 테오도어에게 들었듯이.. 난 정령이 고대신을 부활시키기 위한 힘이라고 생각했었어. 오판이었지.�
entries.translation: Yes. As you heard from Theodore... I thought the spirits were meant to revive the Old God. I misjudged.�

entries.source: 지금까지 알게된 걸로 보면, 크래드가 듣는 자들을 이용해 정령을 계승자에게 심었다고 하는 게 맞을거야.�
entries.translation: From what we have learned, it is more accurate to say Krad used the Listeners to plant spirits into the Successors.�

entries.source: 아무리 크래드라해도, 아무런 장비없이 정령이나 계승자를 만들어 낼 수는 없으니까.�
entries.translation: Even Krad could not create spirits or Successors without proper equipment.�

entries.source: 아마 여기서 계승자들에게 정령을 심는 작업을 했겠지.�
entries.translation: He likely performed the procedures to implant the spirits here.�
I... have no memory of coming here.�
That is why... I did not bring you before.�
This is it. The reason I thought there were... seven Successors.�

entries.source: 이게.. 계승자를 만들어 낸 장치라는 단서는?�
entries.translation: What is the proof... that this device created the Successors?�

entries.source: 고대신의 종복이 날 여기로 인도했다. 듣는 자들이 만들었고, 고대신과 관련 있는 존재라는 거지.�
entries.translation: A servant of the Old God led me here. It was made by the Listeners, and is tied to the Old God.�

entries.source: 케프네스가 소멸한 이상, 듣는 자들은 더 이상 늘어날 수 없어. 그렇다면 여기서 만들어진 건 뭘까?�
entries.translation: Now that Kefnes is gone, no more Listeners can be made. Then what was created here?�

entries.source: .. 해서 조사를 하다보니 나온 게 계승자였다.�
entries.translation: ...So after digging around, I found out about the Successors.�

entries.source: 그런가.. 하지만 난 이곳이 전혀 기억에 없는데..�
entries.translation: I see... But I have no memory of this place at all...�

entries.source: 케프네스는 기억을 조작하는 것도 가능했어. 나 역시 당한 적이 있었으니까.�
entries.translation: Kefnes could alter memories. It even happened to me before.�

entries.source: 아마도.. 너희들의 기억에도 뭔가 장난을 쳤겠지.�
entries.translation: He probably... tampered with your memories too.�

entries.source: 몰래 납치해와서 계승자로 만들고, 기억을 지웠다?�
entries.translation: Secretly kidnapped, made into Successors, and had memories wiped?�
For them... that would be child play.�

entries.source: 기억을 조작할 필요가 없는 계승자.. 듣는 자였던 }루퍼스를 제외한 7명{은 여기서 만들어진 거라고 생각해.�
entries.translation: Successors who needed no memory wipe... Except }Rufus, a Listener, the other 7{ were made here.�
So that is why... only he was from four years ago.�

entries.source: 루퍼스는 힘을 갖게 되자, 듣는 자들의 통제를 벗어났다. 그래서 듣는 자들은 인간을 이용하기로 했겠지.�
entries.translation: Once Rufus gained power, he went out of their control. So the Listeners chose to use humans.�

entries.source: 공화국 전체를 뒤져서 .. 크래드가 말한 극단적인 인간을 모아왔던 거로군.�
entries.translation: Scouring the Republic... to gather the extreme humans Krad mentioned.�

entries.source: 하지만 에블린과 테오도어는 혁명군인데.. 그럼 놈들은 혁명군의 존재를 이미 알고 있는 것 아닌가?�
entries.translation: Evelyn and Theodore are Rebels... Did they already know about the Rebels then?�

entries.source: 놈들에게 이용당한 과거 따위는 잊어버리는 게 앞으로를 위해서도 좋을거다.�
entries.translation: For your own sake, it is better to forget being used by them.�
Wrap it up and return to the }hideout{.�

entries.source: 신기하군.. 이런 것들도, 듣는 자들이 고대신에게 받은 기술인가..�
entries.translation: Incredible... Was this technology also given to the Listeners by the ancient god...?�
The letters are glowing. This is...�

entries.source: 힘을 갈구하는 자, 지식에 목마른 자..�
entries.translation: Those who crave power, those thirsty for knowledge...�

entries.source: 외로움에 파묻힌 자, 배고픔에 익숙한 자..�
entries.translation: Those buried in loneliness, those accustomed to hunger...�

entries.source: 과거에 구속된 자, 육체가 속박된 자..�
entries.translation: Those bound by the past, those bound in flesh...�

entries.source: 명예를 잃어버린 자, 지옥에서 살아가는 자..�
entries.translation: Those who lost their honor, those living in hell...�
As expected... does this mean the Successors...?�
They had to... }create{ people like this...?!�
What on earth... do they think we are?!�

entries.source: 여기인가? 복도 끝 구석 통로라는 건?�
entries.translation: Is this it? The passage at the corner of the hallway?�
Did the power come back on?�

entries.source: 뭐야.. 이건 예전에 왔을 때보다 상황이 심각한 것 같은데?�
entries.translation: What the... this looks way worse than when I was here before?�
They look much stronger than back then... and there are so many.�

entries.source: 고대신이 확실히.. 부활의 때가 가깝긴 했나보군.�
entries.translation: The ancient god resurrection... must truly be near.�
Do not tell me... the Guardian was defeated?�

entries.source: 후우.. 후우.. 미안해, 또.. 폐를 끼치는군..�
entries.translation: Huff... huff... I am sorry, causing trouble... again...�

entries.source: 그런 말 말아요. 당신과 다시 싸우고 싶진 않으니까.�
entries.translation: Do not say that. I do not want to fight you again.�
Who knows... At least, it is out of our hands now.�

entries.source: 인류의 신 }알테나{와.. 네베드의 신 }악몽의 주인{.. 그리고 }강림자{의 강림..�
entries.translation: }Altena{, God of Humanity... }Master of Nightmares{, God of Neved... and the coming of the }Descendants{...�

entries.source: 그들 사이에서, 우리가 할 수 있는 건 없어요.�
entries.translation: Caught between them, there is nothing we can do.�
All we can do is struggle to survive...�
But... you will not... give up, right?�
Let us struggle. One more time...�
That is... what we do best, after all...�
^I am the master of this world...�
^The inhabitants of this world are humanity.�
^This world belongs to me, and to humanity...!�
Whoa, whoa, wait! I am not an enemy!�
Was not the Guardian... waiting for Tyr?�

entries.source: 너희.. 예전에 왔던 티르와 함께 왔던 그 인간들이로군�
entries.translation: You... You are the humans who came here with Tyr before.�

entries.source: 으.. 응! 티.. 티르 오빠가 보내서 왔어. 루레인 언니를 만날 수 있을까?�
entries.translation: Y-Yeah! Tyr sent us. Can we see Lurain?�

entries.source: 우리가 고대신의 봉인을 위해 할 수 있는 일이 있다고 했어. 수호자는 어디에 있지?�
entries.translation: He said there is something we can do to seal the Ancient God. Where is the Guardian?�
The Guardian went into the }Center of the Seal{ herself.�

entries.source: 고대종들의 개체수도, 크기도, 그 위력도 차원이 다른.. 가장 깊은 곳의 놈들까지 기어올라오고 있어.�
entries.translation: The number, size, and power of the ancients are on another level... Even beasts from the deepest abyss are crawling up.�

entries.source: 결국 수호자님은 직접 봉인의 균열을 봉합하러 가셨고.. 인간들이 오면 자신에게 보내달라고 하셨다.�
entries.translation: In the end, the Guardian went to mend the rift herself... and told us to send any humans who arrive down to her.�
Naturally, we thought Tyr would be the one to come...�

entries.source: 정말 너희가 수호자님을 도울 수 있는 거냐?�
entries.translation: Can you really help the Guardian?�

entries.source: 수호자는 .. 우리가 올 걸 이미 알고 있었던 것 같군.�
entries.translation: It seems the Guardian... already knew we were coming.�
Then that must mean we can help.�

entries.source: 루레인 언니가 힘겨워 하는 게 여기까지 느껴져, 서두르지 않으면..!�
entries.translation: I can feel Lurain struggling even from here. We have to hurry...!�

entries.source: 수호자님이 봉인의 중심에 들어가신 것이 벌써 일주일 전이다..�
entries.translation: It has already been a week since the Guardian entered the Center of the Seal...�

entries.source: 우린 아무 도움도 되어드리지 못했어. 많이.. 쇠약해 지셨겠지.�
entries.translation: We could not be of any help. She must be... terribly weakened.�

entries.source: 여긴 우리에게 맡기고.. 봉인의 중심으로 가라.�
entries.translation: Leave this place to us... and head to the Center of the Seal.�
Please take care of the Guardian.�

entries.source: .. 4명이 남았다면, 그 정도의 힘이.. 완성체의 1/4 수준의 힘이라는 건가요..�
entries.translation: ...If four remain, does that mean their power... is about a quarter of a Complete Being?�

entries.source: 확실히 완성체가 되어 그 힘의 제어권을 얻는다면, 고대신 이상일지도 모르겠군요.�
entries.translation: Indeed, if one becomes complete and commands that power, it might rival even the Ancient God.�

entries.source: 하지만 완성할 생각은 없어. 그게 아무리 전 세계를 위한 일이라고 해도.�
entries.translation: Still, I have no intention of completing it. Even if doing so is for the sake of the entire world.�
...I thought you would decide that way.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 방금전에도 완전히 봉인한 건 아닌거지?�
entries.translation: Still... it was not completely sealed just now, was it?�

entries.source: 한번 찢어진 봉인은.. 봉합해봐도 다시 벌어질 뿐입니다.�
entries.translation: Once a seal is torn... mending it only causes it to tear open again.�

entries.source: 절대적인 출력으로 다시 봉인하는 것이 필요하고... 그러기엔.. 아직 힘이 모자라요.�
entries.translation: We need sheer, absolute power to renew the seal... and for that... we still lack strength.�

entries.source: 그럼 역시.. 완성되어야 하는 걸까, 나는..�
entries.translation: Then do I really... have to become complete? Must I...?�
Ren, there is never only one path in this world.�

entries.source: 제가 생명을 걸면.. 힘을 합해 재봉인을 생성할 수 있을 것 같아요. 하지만..�
entries.translation: If I stake my life... we might be able to forge a new seal together. But...�

entries.source: 누군가 희생하는 건 이제 진절머리 나.�
entries.translation: I am sick and tired of people sacrificing themselves.�
Schultz? What do you plan to do...?�
I will inherit the legacy of }Rufus{ and return.�

entries.source: 어차피 그 놈만큼은 계승권을 가지고 있어선 안돼.�
entries.translation: He should not have succession rights anyway.�

entries.source: 그의 계승권을 뺏으면, 정령의 힘도 좀 더 강해지겠지.�
entries.translation: If I take his succession, the Spirit power should grow stronger too.�
You are fighting... just for power? If you do that...�

entries.source: 피할 수 없는 싸움을.. 이용할 뿐이야. 그리고.. 거기서 끝낸다.�
entries.translation: I am just taking advantage of... an unavoidable fight. And... I will end it there.�

entries.source: 절대 완성은 없어. 거기서 끝낸다. 절대로.�
entries.translation: I will never become complete. I will finish it there. Absolutely.�
A third... of a god power...�

entries.source: 슈르츠.. 당신은 정말 이겨낼 자신이 있는 건가요?�
entries.translation: Schultz... Are you truly confident you can overcome it?�

entries.source: |(하지만, 지금 내 힘이라면 강제로 뚫고 들어갈 수 있을 것 같다...){�
entries.translation: |(Still, with my current strength, I should be able to force my way in...){�

entries.source: |(루레인의 말이 맞아. 지금 여기에 들어가는 건 어리석은 일이야.){�
entries.translation: |(Lurain is right. Going in right now would be foolish.){�
|(It is uneasy, but let us trust Lurain.){�
|(...It is pointless if Lurain cannot hold out.){�

entries.source: |(나도 그 때와는 달라. 충분히 할 수 있어.){�
entries.translation: |(I am not the same as back then. I can do this.){�
I am sorry for placing such a heavy burden on you.�
Are you all right? You look exhausted.�
Well, of course, it is not easy.�

entries.source: 고대신의 힘이 회복될 수록 저한테 미치는 영향도 커지니까.�
entries.translation: As the ancient god regains power, the toll on me grows heavier.�

entries.source: 늘 누군가가 보고 있는 듯한, 내 마음을 읽고 있는 듯한...�
entries.translation: Like someone is always watching, peering into my mind...�

entries.source: 마음 속 깊숙한 곳에서 가장 잊고 싶은, 알고 싶지 않은, 그러면서도 제일 바라는 것을 찾아내서 속삭여요.�
entries.translation: It finds what I want to forget, what I deny, yet yearn for most, deep inside, and whispers it.�

entries.source: 내 말을 들으라고, 네가 원하는 것을 이뤄주겠다고...�
entries.translation: It tells me to obey, promising to grant whatever I desire...�

entries.source: 불쾌하면서도, 달디 단 탈력감... 모든 것을 포기하고 그 말을 따르고 싶은.�
entries.translation: A repulsive yet sweet numbness... tempting me to give up and surrender to its voice.�
Because I have already made that mistake once before.�

entries.source: 거짓이라는 걸 알고 있으니까. 그 실수에도 불구하고 모두들 나를 믿고 의지하고... 용서해 주었으니까요.�
entries.translation: Because I know it is a lie. Despite that mistake, everyone trusted, relied on, and forgave me.�
I cannot make the same mistake twice.�

entries.source: 혼자가 아니니까. 그래서 불완전하지만, 그래서 버틸 수 있어요.�
entries.translation: I am not alone. Imperfect as that makes me, it is why I can endure.�

entries.source: 알 듯 말 듯한 소리로군. 뭔가 달리 도울 방법은 없어? 잠시라도 시간을 버는 거라도.�
entries.translation: I see... sort of. Is there any other way to help? Even just to buy a little time.�

entries.source: 균열에서 재구축되고 있는 고대신의 육신을 다시 파괴하면...�
entries.translation: If you destroy the ancient god vessel reconstructing in the Rift once more...�
You are... lying, are not you?�

entries.source: 균열에서 재구축되고 있는 고대신의 육신을 다시 파괴하면... 약간 시간을 벌 수 있는 것 아닌가?�
entries.translation: If we destroy the ancient god vessel reconstructing in the Rift... would not that buy us some time?�

entries.source: 그래요, 그랬죠. 조금은 들리겠군요. 정령은 또한 신에 닿아 있으니까.�
entries.translation: Yes, it would. You must be able to hear it slightly. Spirits also touch the divine, after all.�

entries.source: 틀리진 않아요. 당신이 처음 성지에 왔을 때처럼, 그렇게 하면 약간은 시간을 벌 수 있겠죠.�
entries.translation: You are not wrong. Just like when you first came to the Sanctuary, doing that would buy us some time.�

entries.source: 하지만 위험이 너무 커요. 꿈꾸는 자는 많은 힘을 회복했고, 그 때와는 비교가 되지 않을 거에요.�
entries.translation: But the danger is too great. The Sleeper has regained much strength it cannot compare to back then.�

entries.source: 하지만... 그게 들리다니. 정령이 완성에 가까워지는 탓인지... 아니면 성지라서 일어나는 일인지...�
entries.translation: Still... to think you heard it. Is it because your Spirit nears completion... or because this is the Sanctuary?�

entries.source: 당신은, 여기에는 오래 머물러 있지 않는 것이 좋겠어요.�
entries.translation: It would be best if you did not linger here for long.�

entries.source: 네. 그러니까 슈르츠는, 슈르츠의 일을 먼저 신경 쓰는 게 좋겠어요.�
entries.translation: Yes. So, Schultz, you should focus on your own tasks first.�
Schultz, what is that sticking out of your pocket?�

entries.source: |(센트럴 타워의 개인실에서 티르의 편지와 함께 발견한 여인의 초상이다.){�
entries.translation: |(It is the portrait of the woman found alongside Tyr letter in the private quarters of Central Tower.){�

entries.source: 센트럴 타워에 들어갔을 때 어쩌다보니 가지고 나온 건데.�
entries.translation: I just happened to bring it along when I broke into Central Tower.�

entries.source: 모르는 여자 그림을..? 오해받기 좋은 행동이로군요.�
entries.translation: A picture of an unfamiliar woman? Quite easy to misunderstand, would not you say?�

entries.source: 티르의 약혼녀 아냐? 티르가 옛날에 보낸 편지와 함께 보관되어 있던건데.�
entries.translation: Is not she Tyr fiancee? It was kept together with an old letter from Tyr.�

entries.source: 이자벨인가 하는 사람. 약혼녀라길래 그 사람 그림인 줄 알았지.�
entries.translation: Someone named Isabel, right? I heard she was his fiancee, so I thought it was her portrait.�
I was thinking of giving it to Tyr, you know?�

entries.source: |(...왠지 재밌긴 한데 이 상황... 후환이 두렵네.){�
entries.translation: |(This is amusing, but... I dread the fallout.){�

entries.source: 군 이야기 같은 게 적혀 있는 걸 보면 옛날 편지 아닌가 싶은데. 날짜도 4년 전이었고.�
entries.translation: Judging by the mention of military affairs, it looked like an old letter. Dated four years ago, too.�
Do you want to hear about the Sanctuary War?�

entries.source: 음, 당신이 아는 이야기랑 크게 다르지 않을텐데요.�
entries.translation: Well, it will not be much different from what you already know.�

entries.source: 기본적으로는 고대신의 부활을 노리는 자들의 음모였지만, 인간이나, 강림자나, 크래드 같은 사람이 복잡하게 얽힌 일이었죠.�
entries.translation: At its core, it was a plot by those seeking the Ancient God resurrection, but humans, Descendants, and people like Krad were all tangled up in it.�

entries.source: 시작을 거슬러 올라가면 고대신과 우리 네베드, 그리고 강림자의 역사부터랄까.�
entries.translation: Going back to the beginning, it is really the history of the Ancient God, us Neved, and the Descendants.�

entries.source: 이 세계를 창조한 것은 고대신- 악몽의 주인입니다. 불완전한 그냥 생물에 불과하지만 그 힘은 물질이나 생명을 창조할 정도로 강하니까요.�
entries.translation: The one who created this world was the Ancient God-the Master of Nightmares. Though merely an imperfect creature, its power was great enough to create matter and life itself.�

entries.source: 그 점만 보면 신이라고 불러도 무리는 없을 겁니다.�
