entries.translation: Looking at that alone, calling it a god would not be an exaggeration.�

entries.source: 그런 그 신이 최초로 창조한, 노예로 부리기 위해서 만든 것이 우리 네베드고...�
entries.translation: And the first beings it created, made purely to serve as slaves, were us Neved...�

entries.source: 우연히 이 세계에 방문한 강림자는 우리를 부추겨서 고대신에 대항하게 만들고, 결국 고대신을 이 곳 성지에 봉인했습니다.�
entries.translation: The Descendants, who happened to visit this world, incited us to rebel against the Ancient God, and ultimately sealed it here in the Sanctuary.�

entries.source: 지금 와서 생각하면 다른 꿍꿍이가 있었던 것이겠지만, 결과적으로 자유를 되찾은 우리는...�
entries.translation: Thinking back now, they must have had their own agenda, but having regained our freedom as a result, we...�

entries.source: 이곳을 성지라고 부르고 고대신의 봉인이 파괴되지 않도록 감시하고 있었죠.�
entries.translation: Named this place the Sanctuary and kept watch so the Ancient God seal would never break.�

entries.source: 고대신은 전쟁 중에 자신의 수족으로 부릴 부하를 여러 명 다시 창조했는데... 그 자들은 가디언이라고 불리웁니다.�
entries.translation: During the war, the Ancient God created several more subordinates to serve as its hands and feet... They are called Guardians.�

entries.source: 전쟁 중에 전부 죽거나 아니면 봉인되었다고 여겨졌었지만 살아 남은 가디언이 있었어요.�
entries.translation: Though all were believed killed or sealed during the war, some Guardians survived.�

entries.source: 그들은 주인의 부활을 위해 인간들을 이용하기로 했고, 인간들은 고대신의 힘에 이끌려서 그 힘을 이용하고자...�
entries.translation: They decided to use humans to revive their master, and humans, drawn to the Ancient God power, sought to harness it...�
And that gave birth to the Listeners.�

entries.source: 꿈 속에서 속삭임을 듣는 자...고대신의 일부를 몸에 받아 들인 자.�
entries.translation: Those who hear whispers in their dreams... Those who took a piece of the Ancient God into themselves.�

entries.source: 아마 통제할 수 있을 거라고 생각했겠죠. 그걸 이용해서 강림자를 막고, 네베드도 몰아내서 인간 만세의 세상을 세우자...�
entries.translation: They probably thought they could control it. Use it to stop the Descendants, drive out the Neved, and build a world ruled by humans...�
That is what they must have thought.�

entries.source: 고대신의 속삭임을 받아서 무기를 만들고, 힘을 키운 인간들은 네베드를 공격했어요.�
entries.translation: Guided by the Ancient God whispers, humans forged weapons, grew their power, and attacked the Neved.�

entries.source: 명분을 얻기 위해서 내 오라버니가 케프네스를 암살하려고 했다는 누명까지 씌우고.�
entries.translation: To justify it, they even framed my brother for attempting to assassinate Kefnes.�

entries.source: 하지만 그들 중에 섞여 있던 듣는 자이자... 가디언인 케프네스가 인간들을 배신하고 고대신의 부활을 시도했고...�
entries.translation: However, Kefnes, who was among them as both a Listener and a Guardian, betrayed humanity and attempted to revive the Ancient God...�

entries.source: 저와 티르는, 말하자면 거기에 휘말려 든 겁니다.�
entries.translation: Tyr and I, you could say, were swept up in all of that.�

entries.source: 어쨌든 그때 케프네스를 막을 수 있었던건, 거의 티르의 활약이었다고 생각해요.�
entries.translation: In any case, stopping Kefnes back then was almost entirely thanks to Tyr.�

entries.source: 우리가 여기서 사악한 신과 맞선다는 걸 알고있는 인간이 얼마나 될까?�
entries.translation: How many humans even know we are standing against an evil god here?�

entries.source: 진정 종말이 눈앞에 닥친다면, 함께 싸울수도 있을텐데..�
entries.translation: If the end truly loomed before their eyes, maybe we could fight side by side...�

entries.source: 조금 봤는데.. 이곳까지 오면서 상당히 격렬하게 싸우더군.�
entries.translation: I caught a glimpse... You fought fiercely to make it all the way here.�

entries.source: 너는 믿을 수 있는 인간이라고 생각해. 원한다면, 간단한 회복 정도는 시켜주지.�
entries.translation: I believe you are a human we can trust. If you wish, I can offer some basic healing.�

entries.source: 이제 봉인은 거의 다 찢어졌어. 수호자님이 직접 봉합을 하러 가야할 정도로..�
entries.translation: The seal is nearly torn apart now. To the point where the Guardian had to go mend it personally...�

entries.source: 고대종들을 언제까지 막을 수 있을까, 우리는?�
entries.translation: How much longer can we hold off the ancient breeds?�
Is there something I can help you with?�

entries.source: 그다지 할 이야기는 없는데... 나랑 엔야의 러브 스토리라도 들려줄까?�
entries.translation: I do not have much to say... Want to hear the love story between me and Enya?�
We first met in Meadow Hill...�

entries.source: 그래서 우리 사랑에 감동한 티르씨가 목숨을 걸고 길을 뚫어줘서 간신히 매도우 힐을 탈출할 수 있었어.�
entries.translation: So, moved by our love, Sir Tyr risked his life carving a path, and we barely escaped Meadow Hill.�

entries.source: |(그러고 보니 이 인간은 왜 성지에 있지?){�
entries.translation: |(Come to think of it, why is this guy in the Sanctuary?){�
Did you hear it from Sir Tyr or Lady Lurain?�

entries.source: 센트럴에서 론베르크라는 명공 가문 이야기를 들었는데...�
entries.translation: I heard about the master smith family named Ronberg back in Central...�
Have not heard that name in a while...�
You do not craft weapons anymore?�

entries.source: 무슨 소리를 들었는지는 몰라도 꽤나 과장된 소문을 들었을 것 같은데.�
entries.translation: I do not know what you heard, but it sounds like quite an exaggeration.�

entries.source: 애초에 나는 그 성을 못 써. 아버지가 서자라서 매도우 힐 쪽 상인 가문에 데릴사위로 들어가셨거든.�
entries.translation: First off, I cannot even use that surname. My father was born out of wedlock, so he married into a merchant family in Meadow Hill.�

entries.source: 무기 만드는 법이야 배우긴 했지만, 그건 음.�
entries.translation: I did learn how to forge weapons, but well...�

entries.source: 환상을 깨서 미안한데, 론베르크가 명공으로 유명했던 건 직계자손에게만 물려주는 마력이 깃든 제작도구 덕분이었다고 해.�
entries.translation: Sorry to burst your bubble, but Ronberg fame came from enchanted crafting tools passed only to direct heirs.�
Or so my late father told me, anyway.�

entries.source: 내가 그 도구를 가지고 있을리도 없고, 멸문당했다고 했으니 이제 무리지 않을까?�
entries.translation: I would not have those tools, and since their house fell, is not it hopeless now?�
|(Showed the broken magic device and blueprint.){�
I knew it, they wrecked it...�

entries.source: ...이건 아무리 별 상관없는 나라고 해도 좀 화가 나는데.�
entries.translation: ...Even if it does not concern me, this makes me mad.�

entries.source: 좋아, 이쯤 되면 오기로라도 어떻게 해보겠어. 설계도도 있고, 너도 고생해서 구해왔을 테니.�
entries.translation: Fine, out of sheer spite, I will make it work. We have blueprints, and you worked hard for them.�

entries.source: 좀 아쉽긴 한데. 그렇다면 할 수 없지. 나 혼자서는 무리고.�
entries.translation: It is a shame. But nothing I can do. I cannot do it alone.�

entries.source: 일단 <이터니움{이 필요해. 콜크리크에서 나는 특수한 금속인데.�
entries.translation: First, I need <Eternium{. It is a special metal found only on Cole Creek.�

entries.source: 광부들은 채광하지 않으니까 직접 캐야 해.�
entries.translation: The miners will not dig it, so you have to mine it yourself.�

entries.source: 위험하거든, 그게. 왠지 위험한 몬스터가 나타난다는 소문이 있어서.�
entries.translation: It is dangerous. Rumor has it some nasty monsters lurk there.�
Just be careful and bring it back.�

entries.source: 명공이라고 기대한 것 같은데 좀 미안하네...�
entries.translation: You expected a master smith, so I feel kind of bad...�

entries.source: L이니셜이 새겨진 건 전부 론베르크 작품이라던데.�
entries.translation: I heard anything engraved with an L is a Ronberg creation.�
|(Showed the broken weapon engraved with initials.){�
...What on earth did you do to wreck it like this?�

entries.source: 수리도 제작이랑 마찬가지야. 론베르크 가의 도구가 있어야 해.�
entries.translation: Repairs are like forging. You need the Ronberg tools.�

entries.source: 그게 아니면 그냥 보통 무기랑 다를게 없으니까.�
entries.translation: Otherwise, it will end up no different from an ordinary weapon.�

entries.source: 그리고 이 정도로 망가진 건 수리해도 의미는 없겠는데...�
entries.translation: Besides, fixing something this broken will not do much good...�

entries.source: 음... 하지만 원형으로는 쓸 수 있겠어.�
entries.translation: Hmm... But it could serve as a base.�

entries.source: 다른 마법 도구의 재료로 쓰거나, 론베르크의 도구가 있으면 이걸 수리해서...�
entries.translation: Use it for another magical tool, or if we had Ronberg tools, repair this...�

entries.source: 수리한 걸 원형으로 다른 마법 무기를 만들 수는 있을 것 같아.�
entries.translation: I think we could use the repaired piece as a base to forge another magic weapon.�

entries.source: 어쨌든 도구는 필요하다는거군. 어디에 있는지는 모르나?�
entries.translation: So we need the tools either way. Any idea where they are?�

entries.source: 의회에서 그 도구에 대해 알고 있었으면 연구를 위해 센트럴 타워로 보내지 않았을까?�
entries.translation: If the Council knew about the tools, would not they have sent them to Central Tower for study?�

entries.source: 이제 재료만 있으면 만들 수 있을 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Now with the materials, I think I can make it.�

entries.source: 처음에도 말했지만, 지금 있는 걸 그대로 수리할 수는 없고.�
entries.translation: Like I said before, I cannot restore it as it was.�

entries.source: 망가진 부분만 고친 후에 그걸 기반으로 새로 무기를 만들어 볼게.�
entries.translation: I will fix just the broken parts, then craft a new weapon based on it.�

entries.source: 세이브를 할 수 없는 지역으로 진행합니다.�
entries.translation: Proceeding to an area where you cannot save.�
|(It is blocked here too... Force your way through!){�
I believe I told you not to do this...�

entries.source: 굳이 여기를 들어가겠다고 하면, 저도 말리지 않을 수 없어요.�
entries.translation: If you insist on going in, I will have no choice but to stop you.�
I will stop you by force.�

entries.source: 루레인과 전투를 시작하면 세이브할 수 없습니다.�
entries.translation: You cannot save once battle with Lurain begins.�
I will give you a moment to think.�

entries.source: 돌아가지 않겠다면... 저도 강제로 저지할 수 밖에 없습니다.�
entries.translation: If you will not turn back... I will have to stop you by force.�
...Fine. I would rather avoid unnecessary conflict too.�
A wise choice. Then let us head back.�
If that is how it must be... so be it.�

entries.source: 언젠가.. 다시 깨어날 수도 있다는 건가?�
하지만 당장의 제어권은 나에게 있어. 손가락 하나 내밀지 못하게 하겠다.�
entries.translation: But right now, I am in control. I will not let her lift a single finger.�

entries.source: 나는.. 그런 괴물같은 병기보다 렌이 필요하니까..�
entries.translation: I need Ren... far more than some monstrous weapon.�

entries.source: 설마.. 고대신과 싸우기 위해 그 힘을 꺼내라는 건 아니겠지?�
entries.translation: Do not tell me you want that power unleashed to fight the ancient gods?�

entries.source: 절대 아니야. 나는.. 오히려 감사하고 있어.�
entries.translation: Not at all. In fact... I am grateful.�

entries.source: 이번에는.. 저 아이가 행복했으면 좋겠으니까.. 크래드도, 그걸 바랄거고.�
entries.translation: This time... I just want her to be happy. Krad would have wanted that too.�

entries.source: .. 저녀석이 엘렌이었든.. 내가 듣는 자들에게 기억을 조작당했든 그런 건 이제 신경 안써.�
entries.translation: Whether she was Ellen... or my memories were tampered with by the Hearers, I do not care anymore.�

entries.source: 결국 지금 함께 있는 건 나와 렌이니까.�
entries.translation: Because in the end, it is Ren who is here with me now.�
Still... that does not change how dangerous things are.�

entries.source: }고대신{의 봉인은 여전히 약해지고 있고.. }강림자{들도 강림의 때를 노리고 있겠지.�
entries.translation: The seal on the }Ancient God{ continues to weaken, and the }Descendants{ are waiting for their descent.�

entries.source: 그리고 무엇보다 }웨이드 가{와 }듣는 자{들은 그것들과 맞서싸울 힘을 원해.�
entries.translation: And above all, }House Wade{ and the }Hearers{ crave the power to fight them.�
Countless factions will come hunting for you two.�

entries.source: 전 세계가 적이 된다고 해도, 싸울거야.�
entries.translation: Even if the whole world turns against us, I will fight.�

entries.source: 슈르츠님! 저기, 엄청 큰 고래야, 저거 고래 맞지?�
entries.translation: Schultz! Look over there, an enormous whale! That is a whale, right?�

entries.source: 그래.. 티르의 말대로, 세계는 변하지 않았다.�
entries.translation: Right... Just as Tyr said, the world has not changed.�
The ancient god slowly tears at its seal,�

entries.source: 테오도어가 깨운 방주는 강림자들을 부르고 있으며�
entries.translation: the Ark Theodore awakened beckons the Descendants,�

entries.source: 웨이드 가와 듣는 자들은 알테나의 힘을 노리고 있다.�
entries.translation: and House Wade and the Hearers seek the power of Altena.�
Why act surprised? We knew this was coming.�

entries.source: 무슨 소리야? 등잔 밑이 어둡다고 센트럴은 안전할 거라며?�
entries.translation: What are you talking about? You said Central was the safest place!�
I said for a few days, remember?�
And those few days... was two days?!�

entries.source: 시끄럽네. 걱정말라고, 빠져나갈 길은 머릿속에 다 있으니까.�
entries.translation: Quiet down. Do not worry, I already have an escape route planned in my head.�

entries.source: 물론 걱정은 안해. 슈르츠님은 알테나의 심연까지 꿰뚫었던 사람인걸.�
entries.translation: Of course I am not worried. You are the one who pierced the depths of Altena, Schultz.�

entries.source: 전 세계가 적이라도, 나는 두렵지 않아.�
entries.translation: Even if the whole world is our enemy, I am not afraid.�

entries.source: 주입된 기억은 복수를 되뇌이지만,;나의 지금은 그런 것 따위 모른다.�
entries.translation: Implanted memories may whisper of revenge, but who I am now knows nothing of that.�

entries.source: 내겐 지켜야 할 사람과,;지켜야 할 약속이 있어.�
entries.translation: I have someone to protect, and a promise to keep.�
Greater foes may awaken one day.�

entries.source: 이제 나에겐;죽지 않아야 할 이유가 아닌..�
entries.translation: For now I have, not just a reason not to die...�
but a true reason to live.�

entries.source: 생각보다 나타나질 않아서.. 직접 찾으러 갈까 하던 참이었다.�
entries.translation: You took longer than expected... I was about to go looking for you myself.�
Ah... I found a decent hideout, you see.�

entries.source: 그보다.. 당신은 어떻게 트라이던트 섬에서 빠져나온거지?�
entries.translation: More importantly... how did you escape Trident Isle?�

entries.source: 트라이던트 섬을 조사하기 위해 그라함이 찾아둔 상륙포인트가 있었거든.�
entries.translation: Graham had scouted a landing point to investigate Trident Isle beforehand.�
Unfortunately... I could not finish off Rufus.�

entries.source: 전에.. 단순한 흑의병일 때 보다 압도적으로 강해졌더군.�
entries.translation: He was overwhelmingly stronger than back when he was just a Black Guard.�

entries.source: 정령의 힘이 더 강해진다면.. 나도 당해낼 수 없어질거야.�
entries.translation: If the spirit power grows any stronger... even I will not be able to handle him.�

entries.source: 지금 대등하게 싸우는 것 만으로도 말이 안돼..�
entries.translation: Going toe-to-toe with him right now is already absurd...�

entries.source: 그러게, 그 사람 정말.. 괴물 같이 강했는데.�
entries.translation: Yeah, that guy was ridiculously strong, like a monster.�

entries.source: 어쨌든.. 앞으로는 좀 더 피곤해 질 것 같다. 모든 게.�
entries.translation: At any rate... everything going to get a lot more troublesome from here on.�

entries.source: 느꼈는지 모르겠지만.. 전 세계의 마물들이 비정상적으로 진화하고 있어.�
entries.translation: I do not know if you have noticed, but monsters worldwide are evolving abnormally.�

entries.source: 역시, 콜크리크 섬에만 국한된 게 아닌가 보군..�
entries.translation: So it is not limited to Cole Creek Isle after all...�

entries.source: 아마도 방주가 기동된 탓이겠지. 세계가.. 강림자들이 원하는 형태로 변하는 게 아닐까.�
entries.translation: Probably because the Ark was activated. The world... it might be turning into what the Descendants wanted.�

entries.source: 고대신은 깨어나려 하고.. 강림자는 돌아오려 하고.. 점점 엉망이 되가는군, 이 세계.�
entries.translation: The ancient god is awakening... The Descendants are trying to return... This world is falling to pieces.�
Do not worry, I will get you there in no time.�
That was quite a long goodbye.�
Nothing, really. Just... sorry for making you wait...�
Is not it a relief...? That everyone safe...�
Um... are you angry about something?�
So }Ellen{ still lingers somewhere in your memories after all...?�
Wh-what are you talking about, all of a sudden?�

entries.source: 크래드의 동생이고, 티르가 아끼던... 그 엘렌 말이야.�
entries.translation: Krad sister, the one Tyr cherished so much... that Ellen.�
Still... you like Tyr, right? And feel close to Krad...�

entries.source: 신기하군. 알지도 못하는 사람인데.. 스스로는 모르는 어떤 기억때문에 친근하고.. 호감가고..�
entries.translation: Fascinating. To strangers... you feel warmth and affection just from memories you do not even know you have...�

entries.source: 게다가 그 사람들은 널 기억하고.. 지켜주려 하고..�
entries.translation: And they remember you... and want to protect you...�
Why are you... bringing this up all of a sudden...?�

entries.source: 나는 그저 목숨이 걸려있으니 널 데리고 다닐 뿐이고, 너 역시 주인을 선택할 기회 따윈 없었잖아?�
entries.translation: I drag you along only because my life depends on it. And you never had a choice in your master either, did you?�

entries.source: 그래, 차라리 티르가 계승자 였다면 너도 훨씬 행복했을 거야. 그렇.. 지?�
entries.translation: Yeah. If Tyr had been the successor instead, you would have been far happier. Right...?�

entries.source: 기억도 안 나는 과거의 나는.. 중요하지 않아. 모두를 힘들게만 만드는 그런 거.�
entries.translation: A past I cannot even remember... does not matter. It only brings pain to everyone.�

entries.source: 지금의 나는 렌이고.. 지금의 내가 제일 중요한 거잖아, 그렇지?�
entries.translation: Right now, I am Ren... and who I am now is what matters most, right?�

entries.source: 그러니까 슈르츠님.. 잃어버린 과거나 기억 따윈.. 이야기 하지 말자.. 응?�
entries.translation: So Schultz... let us not talk about... lost pasts or memories... please?�

entries.source: 난.. 슈르츠님과 있는 것도 충분히 행복하니까..�
entries.translation: I am... happy enough being with you, Schultz...�
That is... not what I meant to say.�
Damn it, what is wrong with me...�
She must have taken quite a shock.�

entries.source: 정령의 능력을 그렇게 소멸시키는 마법진이.. 그런 곳에 있을 줄은.�
entries.translation: Who knew there would be a magic circle capable of nullifying a spirit power like that, in a place like that...�
Who could have done it? Setting up something like that there...�

entries.source: 아무래도.. 듣는 자들의 함정은 아닌 것 같아.�
entries.translation: It does not seem like a trap by the Listeners.�

entries.source: 그럼? 우릴 노리고 있는 다른 적이 있다는 건가?�
entries.translation: Then what? Is there another enemy targeting us?�

entries.source: 그것도 아냐. 그냥 단지, 오래전부터 죽어있던 강림자의 유물들이 살아나면서 정령의 힘을 제한한 거야.�
entries.translation: Not that either. The long-dormant Descendant relics simply reactivated, suppressing the spirit power.�

entries.source: 강림자의 교단, 그 신도들의 제사 준비 과정에서 말이지.�
entries.translation: All thanks to the Descendant cult preparing their ritual.�

entries.source: 그 신자들도.. 아무 근거없이 지낸 제사는 아닐테니까. 생각은 없었던 것 같지만.�
entries.translation: Those zealots were not conducting rituals without cause, after all. Though they clearly lacked brains.�

entries.source: 그들은 강림자가 남긴 기록대로 제사를 지내고 있어. 그렇다면 유적이 살아난 것도 납득이 가지..�
entries.translation: They followed ancient records left by the Descendants. It makes sense that the ruins awakened...�

entries.source: 그때 마침 우리가 재수없게, 그 곳에 유적의 한가운데에 있었다고?�
entries.translation: And we just happened to be unlucky enough to be right in the middle of it?�

entries.source: 자, 자, 슈우. 너무 흥분하지 말고.�
entries.translation: Now, now, Schu. Do not get so worked up.�

entries.source: 재수가 없었지만.. 결국은 모두 무사하고, 그럼 결국 전화위복이 된 셈이야.�
entries.translation: We were unlucky, sure... but everyone made it out alive. In the end, it turned out to be a blessing in disguise.�

entries.source: 강림자의 유적이 정령을 제어할 수 있다는 걸 알았으니까.. 말이냐?�
entries.translation: Because we learned Descendant ruins can suppress spirits... is that it?�

entries.source: 빙고. 평소의 슈우라면 벌써 눈치챘을 텐데..�
entries.translation: Bingo. The usual Schu would have figured that out right away...�

entries.source: 우리도.. 활용할 수 있다는 건가, 그 기술을?�
entries.translation: So... you are saying we could use that technology too?�

entries.source: 당장은 안되지. 교리의 관에 있던 유물은 티르가 시원하게 날려버렸으니까.�
entries.translation: Not right away. Tyr completely obliterated the relic back in the Hall of Dogma.�

entries.source: 아니야, 급한 상황이었으니.. 오히려 고맙지. 농담이야, 농담.�
entries.translation: No, it was an emergency... If anything, thanks. Just kidding, just kidding.�

entries.source: 어차피 거긴 남의 땅이니까, 그걸 이용할 마음은 없어.�
entries.translation: It is someone else territory anyway, so I have no intention of using it.�

entries.source: .. 얼어붙은 바다에 있는 유적을.. 되살릴 생각이군.�
entries.translation: ... You intend to reactivate... the ruins in the Frozen Sea.�

entries.source: 그래. 이제야 정신이 좀 드는 모양이네.�
entries.translation: Yeah. Looks like your head is clearing up at last.�

entries.source: 강림자의 교단에서 빼돌린 문건도 있고.. 난 충분히 가능하다고 생각해.�
entries.translation: We have documents stolen from the Descendant Order... I think it is entirely possible.�

entries.source: 하지만.. 위험할거야. 그 지하시설과 같은 반응이 일어난다면..�
entries.translation: Still... it will be dangerous. If a reaction like the underground facility occurs...�

entries.source: 위험은.. 감수해야지, 슈우. 어떻게든 방법을 찾지 못하면 언젠가는 놈들의 뜻대로 되고 말테니.�
entries.translation: We have to take risks, Shuu. If we do not find a way, things will go according to their plan eventually.�

entries.source: 정령의 힘을 완전히 무력화시킬 수 있다고? 그 웃기지도 않은 종교단체가?�
entries.translation: Completely neutralize the spirit power? That ridiculous religious group could?�

entries.source: 그들이 한 짓은 아냐. 그들의 제사가, 우연히 유물의 힘을 되살려낸 것 뿐이지.�
entries.translation: It was not their doing. Their ritual merely awakened the relic power by chance.�

entries.source: 어쨌든 }강림자의 유물{을 사용해 정령을 제어할 수 있다는 건 확실해.�
entries.translation: Regardless, it is certain we can control spirits using a }Descendant relic{.�

entries.source: 그럼.. 일단 그 교단이 보유하고 있는 강림자의 유물을 우리 통제하에 넣어야 겠군.�
entries.translation: Then... we must first bring the Descendant relic held by that order under our control.�

entries.source: 아쉽지만, 그 유물은 파괴됐어.. 일단 내가 살아야 했거든.�
entries.translation: Unfortunately, that relic was destroyed... I had to save my own skin, you see.�

entries.source: 목숨을 건 조사였다고.. 그정도는 이해해 줘, 슈우�
entries.translation: I risked my life investigating... Cut me some slack, Shuu.�

entries.source: 이해가 문제가 아니라, 그럼 뭐하러 이야기를 꺼낸거야?�
entries.translation: It is not about understanding why even bring it up then?�

entries.source: 워, 워. 걱정마, 그 유물은 파괴했지만.. 아직 강림자의 유물이 하나 남아있으니깐.�
entries.translation: Whoa, easy. Do not worry. That relic was destroyed, but... one Descendant relic remains.�

entries.source: 너도, 가본 적이 있는 곳이야. 좋은 기억은 아니겠지만..�
entries.translation: A place you have been to, as well. Though it might not be a fond memory...�
The ruins in the }Frozen Sea{... on the }Screaming Path{?�

entries.source: 빙고.. 내가 기억하기론, 적어도 교단 지하의 유적보다 훨씬 상태가 양호한 유적이지.�
entries.translation: Bingo... From what I recall, they are in far better shape than the ones beneath the order.�

entries.source: 뭐가 됐든.. 서두르는 게 좋을거야. 상황이 그렇게 여유롭지 않다..�
entries.translation: Whatever it is... you had better hurry. Time is not on our side...�
... Are the Listeners making a move?�

entries.source: 아니. 내가 너희들을 찾아온 건... 루퍼스 때문이야.�
entries.translation: No. The reason I came looking for you... is Rufus.�

entries.source: 그라함에게 들었다. 콜크리크 섬에서 놈이 무슨 짓을 했는지..�
entries.translation: I heard from Graham. What that bastard did on Cole Creek Isle...�

entries.source: 그 남자가 사냥한 계승자와 흑의병.. 알프레드까지, 지금은 전부 그 남자의 힘이 되어있겠지.�
entries.translation: The Successors and Black Guard he hunted... even Alfred. All of that must be his power now.�

entries.source: 웨이드 가는 뭘 믿고 그자를 방관하는지 모르겠지만..�
entries.translation: I do not know why House Wade stands by watching him, but...�

entries.source: 지금 그는 고대신에 필적할 정도로 위험할지도 몰라.�
entries.translation: Right now, he might be dangerous enough to rival an Ancient God.�

entries.source: 강림자의 유적을 사용하면.. 루퍼스를 막는 것도 가능할거야.�
entries.translation: If we use the Descendant ruins... stopping Rufus might be possible.�

entries.source: 흑의병이 괴멸되고 웨이드 가가 침묵하는 지금, 그 남자를 막을 수 있는 건 너희뿐일지도 몰라.�
entries.translation: With the Black Guard wiped out and House Wade silent, you might be the only ones who can stop him.�
And that bastard... will definitely come after you.�

entries.source: 어떻게든 결판을 내야하는 놈이야. 대화따윈 통하지 않으니까.�
entries.translation: He is someone we must settle things with anyway. Words are useless against him.�
We lure him to the ruins and finish it there.�

entries.source: 놈이 아무리 강해도.. 정령을 봉하면 세명의 계승자를 당해낼 수 없을거야.�
entries.translation: No matter how strong he is... seal his spirit, and he cannot match three Successors.�

entries.source: 강림자의 유적이 뜻대로 되지 않으면 곤란해질텐데.�
entries.translation: It will be trouble if the Descendant ruins do not work as planned.�

entries.source: 방법이 없어.. 최선을 다해보는 수 밖에.�
entries.translation: There is no other way... We just have to do our best.�
Just in case... I will come along as well.�

entries.source: 안돼, 티르. 누군가는 웨이드 가와 듣는 자들의 움직임을 봐야지.�
entries.translation: No, Tyr. Someone must watch House Wade and the Listeners.�

entries.source: 침묵하고 있다는 게, 오히려 더 불안한 놈들이니까..�
entries.translation: The fact that they stay silent is even more unsettling...�

entries.source: 그렇게 해. 이 문제는.. 계승자들끼리 결판을 짓겠다.�
entries.translation: Do that. This matter... will be settled among Successors.�

entries.source: 그럼.. 난 바로 얼어붙은 바다의 비명길로 가서 준비를 해둘게.�
entries.translation: Then... I will head straight to the Screaming Path on the Frozen Sea to prepare.�
Head to }Levan{ and join up with }Evelyn{.�

entries.source: 난장판이로군. 선내까지 이렇게 빨리 침투해 들어오다니..!�
entries.translation: What a mess. To breach the ship so quickly...!�

entries.source: 분명히 말했지, 그쪽까지 챙겨줄 여유는 없어!�
entries.translation: I told you, we do not have the luxury to worry about them!�

entries.source: 일단 이놈들을 다 처리해야 안전이 확보된다!�
entries.translation: We have to wipe these things out first to secure our safety!�

entries.source: 후우.. 안에 들어온 놈은 전부 처리했나.�
entries.translation: Phew... Did we clear out all the ones inside?�
Master Schultz, let us hurry and find Eileen..!�

entries.source: 자기 몸은 스스로 지킬 수 있다고 했어. 침착하라고.�
entries.translation: She said she can defend herself. Stay calm.�
Did you reach the ending you wished for?�

entries.source: 아직 부족하시다면, 렌을 위해 숨겨진 이벤트들에 대한 약간의 힌트를 드리겠습니다.�
entries.translation: If you still yearn for more, here are some hints about hidden events for Ren sake.�

entries.source: 황혼섬의 히든퀘스트 }고기수프{를 완료하신 뒤에도, 황혼수프가루는 필요합니다.�
entries.translation: Even after completing the Twilight Isle hidden quest }Meat Soup{, you still need Twilight Soup Powder.�

entries.source: 방주에 들어가기 전에 그라함을 만나셨다면, 티르가 오는 것을 기다려보세요.�
entries.translation: If you meet Graham before entering the Ark, try waiting for Tyr to arrive.�

entries.source: 여러분이 영웅서기5에 담긴 모든 이야기와 만나볼 수 있기를 기원하며...�
entries.translation: Wishing that you may uncover every story woven into Heroes Lore 5...�

entries.source: 다음 단계의 난이도로 게임을 재시작 합니다.�
entries.translation: Restarting the game at the next difficulty level.�
Paying tribute to you who have ventured this far-�
At least, mankind has obtained a god.�

entries.source: 어쩌면 오르비스의 인류에게는, 가장 바람직한 결말일지도 모르겠군요.�
entries.translation: Perhaps for the people of Orbis, this is the most desirable outcome.�
However... if any regrets still linger in your heart...�

entries.source: 진정 지켜야 할 }어떤 한 사람{을 선택하세요.�
entries.translation: Choose the }single person{ you truly wish to protect.�

entries.source: 에블린을 선택했다면, 히든 퀘스트 }맹목적인 믿음{과 }경계 태세{를..�
entries.translation: If you chose Evelyn, pursue hidden quests }Blind Faith{ and }High Alert{...�
If you chose Tiana, pursue hidden quests }Silver Earring{ and }Nightmare{...�

entries.source: 그리고 }모든 선택지{에서, 지키고픈 그 한 사람만을 생각해야 합니다.�
entries.translation: And at }every choice{, think only of that one person you wish to protect.�

entries.source: 슈르츠가 가장 지켜내고 싶은 사람을 얻고, 그녀가 슈르츠에게 마음을 연다면..�
entries.translation: If Schultz wins the one he wishes to protect most, and she opens her heart to him...�

entries.source: 이 칠흑같이 어두웠던 계승자들의 싸움도.. 다른 결과를 얻을 수 있을 지 모릅니다.�
entries.translation: This pitch-black struggle of Successors... might just lead to a different outcome.�

entries.source: 매도우힐의 히든퀘스트 }분홍머리소녀{는 너무 성급하게 완료하지 마십시오.�
entries.translation: Do not rush to finish the Meadow Hill hidden quest }Pink-Haired Girl{.�

entries.source: 슈르츠의 과거, 그리고 듣는 자들과의 싸움은 최후의 엔딩을 위해 거쳐야 할 과정입니다.�
entries.translation: Schultz past, and the battle against the Hearers, is a path you must walk toward the true finale.�
If only I were ten years younger...�
You startled me! Where did you come from?�

entries.source: 설마 위에 있는 그 밀수업자 놈이 이 샛길을 정부군에게 알려주지는 않았을테고...�
entries.translation: Do not tell me that smuggler up there tipped off the government troops about this path...�

entries.source: 밀수업자? 용병? 아니면 혁명군? 뭐 난 어느 쪽이든 환영이지만.�
entries.translation: Smuggler? Mercenary? Or rebel? Well, I welcome either way.�

entries.source: 흑의병을 보고 밀수업자 말을 듣고 도망쳤는데... 몬스터한테 좀 쫓기다보니 여기 갇혔어.�
entries.translation: I saw the Black Guard and fled on the smuggler word... but ran into monsters and got trapped here.�

entries.source: 아냐아냐. 좀 이상한 놈이 하나 섞여 있었어.�
entries.translation: No, no! There was a really strange one mixed in with them.�
Please. Help me get out of here.�

entries.source: 이제 팔 것도 없고... 어떻게 하지...�
entries.translation: I have got nothing left to sell... What do I do...?�

entries.source: |(그러고 보니 이 녀석이 무슨 집세로 고민한다고 하지 않았었나?){�
entries.translation: |(Come to think of it, was not this kid worrying about rent?){�
|(Told her about the house on 17th Street.){�
Putting it nicely, that just means it is an orphanage, right?�

entries.source: 그 아줌마 본인은 어떻게 생각할지 모르겠지만 그런 셈이지.�
entries.translation: I do not know what the lady herself thinks, but pretty much.�

entries.source: 저랑 제 동생이 가서 잘 지낼 수 있을까요? 그런 곳에.�
entries.translation: Could my brother and I really get along well in a place like that?�

entries.source: 그런 식으로 어린애들을 모아서 어디 팔아 넘기는 사람도 있다고 하던데요.�
entries.translation: I heard people gather kids like that just to sell them off somewhere.�

entries.source: 어딘가에서 몰래 생체실험용으로 쓴다고 하기도 하고...�
entries.translation: Or use them in secret human experiments somewhere...�
I cannot say... that never happens.�
...Still, she is... probably a decent person.�

entries.source: 하긴, 어차피 선택의 여지 같은 건 없네요. 공화국에서는.�
entries.translation: Then again, it is not like we have a choice. Not in the Republic.�

entries.source: 안타깝게도 그렇지. 이 세상은. 선택의 자유 같은 건 없어.�
entries.translation: Sadly true. In this world, freedom of choice does not exist.�

entries.source: 부모님이 전쟁 중에 실종되시고 저랑 오빠만 여기 살고 있었는데...�
entries.translation: Our parents went missing during the war, so only my brother and I lived here...�

entries.source: 집주인이 집세를 올린다고 해서 다음 달이면 쫓겨날 것 같아요...�
entries.translation: The landlord says the rent is going up, so we will probably get kicked out next month...�
The wharf seems rather noisy for some reason.�
So Jake was chased by someone and fled to Irem,�

entries.source: 서류를 회수하던 과정에서 습격까지 당하셨다는 거군요.�
entries.translation: and you were even ambushed while retrieving the documents.�

entries.source: 죄송합니다. 엉뚱한 일에 말려들게 하고 말았군요.�
entries.translation: I am so sorry. I dragged you into a terrible mess.�
Jake and I are veterans who fought in the Sanctuary War.�

entries.source: 인간들은 추운 북쪽의 땅에서 떨고 있는 것은, 선주종이 인간을 대등한 종족으로 인정하지 않고�
entries.translation: Humans shiver in the cold northern lands because the Ancients refuse to acknowledge us as equals,�

entries.source: 단지 편하게 부릴 수 있는 노예나 다름 없는 종족으로 보고 있기 때문이다.�
entries.translation: viewing mankind merely as convenient slaves.�

entries.source: 공화국 수장인 케프네스가 전쟁을 일으킬 때 한 말입니다.�
entries.translation: Those were the words of Kefnes, Head of the Republic, when he started the war.�

entries.source: 저와 제이크는 저 말을 철썩같이 믿었습니다. 사실 케프네스는 우리 손으로 뽑은 지도자였으니까요.�
entries.translation: Jake and I believed him wholeheartedly. After all, Kefnes was a leader we elected ourselves.�

entries.source: 전쟁의 시발이 된 누아다 왕자의 케프네스 암살 시도 사건도 있었고, 의심할 이유가 없었죠.�
entries.translation: There was also Prince Nuada attempt to assassinate Kefnes, which sparked the war. We had no reason to doubt.�

entries.source: 하지만... 우리가 전쟁에서 본 것은 지옥이었습니다. 티르의 오른팔이었던 브리안의 갑작스러운 배신과...�
entries.translation: However... what we saw in that war was hell. The sudden betrayal of Brian, Tyr right-hand man...�

entries.source: 케프네스의 실종. 전선은 혼란하기 이를데 없었고 우리는 점령했던 베쓰무라를 지키라는 명령을 받았죠.�
entries.translation: And the disappearance of Kefnes. The front fell into utter chaos, and we were ordered to hold Bethmura, which we had taken.�

entries.source: 그리고 그 괴물들이 나타났습니다. 지금은 물고기라고 부르면서 깔보는 것 같지만, 그건 직접 싸워보지 않은 사람들이나 하는 말입니다.�
entries.translation: Then those monsters appeared. People mock them as fish now, but only those who never faced them in battle could say that.�

entries.source: 그 때의 티르 대장은 뭔가 이상했습니다. 뭔가에 씌인 사람 같았어요. 케프네스, 티르, 브리안. 원정대의 세 축을 이루던 사람들이�
entries.translation: Commander Tyr was strange back then, like a man possessed. Kefnes, Tyr, Brian... the three pillars of the expedition...�
All vanished, went mad, or betrayed us...�

entries.source: 그 때 이상한 걸 느낀 겁니다, 저와 제이크는.�
entries.translation: That was when Jake and I realized something was terribly wrong.�

entries.source: 이 전쟁은 대체 누구를 위해, 뭘 위해 일어난 거죠?�
entries.translation: Just who was this war for, and what was it fought to achieve?�

entries.source: 네베드의 성지를 공격해서 파괴하자마자 고대종이 나타나다니, 우연의 일치치고는 지나치지 않습니까?�
entries.translation: The moment the Neved Sanctuary was attacked and ruined, ancient beasts appeared. Is not that too much of a coincidence?�

entries.source: 티르, 브리안, 케프네스 세 사람이 그 즈음에 이상한 행동을 하기 시작한 것도 우연일까요?�
entries.translation: Was it also mere coincidence that Tyr, Brian, and Kefnes all began acting strangely around that time?�

entries.source: 고대종들 손에 매도우 힐이 불타던 날, 우리 부대가 최후로 철수할 수 있게 도와준 것은 웃기게도.�
entries.translation: On the day Meadow Hill burned at the hands of the ancients, the ones who helped our unit make a final retreat were, ironically...�

entries.source: 그 때까지 배신자로 불리던 브리안과, 그라함이라는 부관이었습니다.�
entries.translation: Brian, who had been branded a traitor, and an adjutant named Graham.�

entries.source: 돌아온 제이크와 저는 성지전쟁에 숨겨진 음모가 있다고 확신하고, 그걸 밝히기 위해 노력해 왔습니다.�
entries.translation: Upon returning, Jake and I were convinced there was a hidden conspiracy behind the Sanctuary War, and we worked to expose it.�

entries.source: 그리고 배후에 웨이드 가가 있다고 확신해요. 이번 습격으로 더 확실해졌습니다.�
entries.translation: And I am certain House Wade is behind this. This attack only proves it.�

entries.source: 염치없는 부탁입니다만, 좀 더 도와주실 수 없습니까?�
entries.translation: I know it is shameless of me to ask, but could you help us a little more?�

entries.source: ...여기서 포기할 수는 없습니다. 진실을 밝히고 싶어요.�
entries.translation: ...I cannot give up here. I want to uncover the truth.�

entries.source: 예. 이렘으로 가서 그를 찾아 주세요.�
entries.translation: Yes. Please head to Irem and search for him.�
I am washing my hands of this.�
I see... That cannot be helped.�
Thank you for all your help so far.�

entries.source: 옛날이었으면 이런 상처 정도는 네베드들에게 마법으로 고쳐달라고 할 수 있었는데 말이죠.�
entries.translation: In the old days, we could have asked the Neved to heal wounds like this with magic.�

entries.source: 여객선 운항이 중단되었되고 화물선만 다닌다는 이야기가 들리더군요.�
entries.translation: I heard passenger ships have stopped running and only cargo vessels are operating.�

entries.source: 아까부터 여관이 소란스럽던게 그 일 때문인가 보네요. 곤란한데...�
entries.translation: The inn has been noisy since earlier. That must be why. How troublesome...�

entries.source: 아, 죄송합니다. 괜찮으시면 부탁 하나 들어주시지 않으시겠습니까?�
entries.translation: Ah, pardon me. If you have a moment, could you do me a favor?�

entries.source: 저 대신 록빌에 가 줄 수 있는 사람을 고용해 줄 수 있냐고 상점의 점주에게 전해주시면 되는데...�
entries.translation: Could you ask the shopkeeper if they could hire someone to go to Rockville in my place?�
I am heading to Rockville anyway.�

entries.source: 아, 정말이십니까? 그러면 간단한 부탁을 하나 드려도 될까요?�
entries.translation: Oh, truly? Then may I ask a small favor of you?�

entries.source: 록빌에 있는 제 옛 동료인 <제이크{를 만나서 서류를 받아 주시기만 하면 됩니다.�
entries.translation: All you need to do is meet my old comrade <Jake{ in Rockville and collect some documents.�

entries.source: 제가 직접 가고 싶기는 한데, 다리가 불편해서요.�
entries.translation: I wanted to go myself, but my leg is in bad shape.�

entries.source: 여객선이라면 어떻게 해보려고 했는데... 아무래도 화물선은 무리군요.�
entries.translation: I thought I could manage on a passenger ship... but a cargo ship is out of the question.�

entries.source: 원래는 제가 직접 가기로 했던 것인만큼, 혹시 제이크가 확인을 해보고 싶어 할 수도 있습니다.�
entries.translation: Since I was originally supposed to go, Jake might want to confirm your identity.�

entries.source: 저희가 원래 정했던 암호는 사랑이란 뭐라고 생각하냐?였습니다.�
entries.translation: Our agreed secret question was, What do you think love is?�

entries.source: 아무튼 저렇게 물어보면 망설이지 않는 것이라고 대답해 주세요...�
entries.translation: Anyway, if he asks that, please answer: To never hesitate...�
|(Should I turn him down right now?...){�

entries.source: 그럼 제이크는 록빌에서 누군가에게 쫓기다가 실종된 것이군요.�
entries.translation: So Jake was pursued by someone in Rockville and went missing.�
I knew it, I should have gone myself...�

entries.source: 그 사이에 제이크가 다녀갔습니다. 이야기는 대강 들었어요.�
entries.translation: Jake dropped by earlier. I heard roughly what happened.�
|(I told her what I heard from Graham.){�
Welcome back. Did you meet the Neved Guardian?�
This is... I hardly know what to say.�

entries.source: 듣기만 해도 엄청난 모험을 하고 오신 것 같습니다.�
entries.translation: It sounds like you went on an incredible adventure.�

entries.source: 지금까지 저와 제이크가 모은 정보에, 슈르츠 씨가 전해준 이야기를 합쳤습니다.�
entries.translation: I combined what Jake and I gathered with your account, Schultz.�

entries.source: 센트럴에서는 이걸 출판해 줄 곳이 없을 것 같으니 전 다른 지방의 신문사나 출판사를 찾아봐야겠습니다.�
entries.translation: No publisher in Central will print this, so I will check other regions.�

entries.source: 한 부는 슈르츠 씨가 가지고 있어주지 않겠습니까?�
entries.translation: Would you hold onto one copy, Schultz?�

entries.source: 어디라도 좋아요. 어딘가에 전해 주세요. 진실이 널리 퍼져서 살아남을 수 있게.�
entries.translation: Anywhere is fine. Please pass it on, so the truth survives and spreads.�

entries.source: 어차피 아무도 믿지 않을텐데, 이런 이야기는. 이게 무슨 의미가 있는거지?�
entries.translation: No one will believe this story anyway. What is the point?�

entries.source: 믿지 않아도 상관없습니다. 의회는 아직 강력하죠. 저는 거짓말장이로 몰리고 쫓기는 몸이 될지도 모릅니다.�
entries.translation: It does not matter if they do not believe it. The council is still powerful. I might be branded a liar and hunted.�

entries.source: 그래도 됩니다. 그로 인해 누구 한 명이라도 의회에 대해 조금 다르게 생각하게 되면, 의심을 품게 되면.�
entries.translation: Even so, it is worth it if even one person begins to doubt the council.�

entries.source: 사람들이 조금이라도 의회가 이끌고 있는 공화국이 어디로 가는지 감시할 생각이 들게 되면, 그걸로 충분합니다.�
entries.translation: If people start keeping watch on where the republic is headed, that is enough.�
At least, I think that is enough of a start.�

entries.source: 개인적인 사정이라는게 있어서. 그렇게 한가하지는 못해.�
entries.translation: I have personal matters to attend to. I do not have time for that.�

entries.source: 하지만 아직 뭔가 부족합니다... 매도우 힐까지 가셨다면, 혹시 네베드를 만나보셨습니까?�
entries.translation: Still, something is missing... Since you went to Meadow Hill, did you meet any Neved?�
I saw a woman who claimed to be the current Guardian...�

entries.source: 수호자... 혹시 가능하시면, 그 사람에게도 성지전쟁의 이야기를 물어볼 수 있으실까요?�
entries.translation: The Guardian... If possible, could you ask her about the Holy War?�

entries.source: 성지에 다시 갈 일이 있을지는 모르겠지만, 해보지.�
entries.translation: Not sure if I will return to the Sanctuary, but I will try.�

entries.source: 아닙니다. 미안해 하실 건 없어요. 무리한 부탁이라는 건 저도 알고 있고...�
entries.translation: No, do not apologize. I know it is an unreasonable request...�
I should look for a way to reach Meadow Hill myself.�

entries.source: 도움에 감사드립니다. 슈르츠씨 덕분에 생각보다 훨씬 빠르게 일이 진행되었어요.�
entries.translation: Thank you for your help. Thanks to you, Schultz, we made fast progress.�

entries.source: 저와 제이크는 좀 더 증거를 모은 후에 이걸 사람들에게 알릴 방법을 생각해 보겠습니다.�
entries.translation: Jake and I will gather more evidence and find a way to make it public.�
Sorry, we have no vacancies right now.�

entries.source: 갑작스럽게 여객선이 출항 금지가 되는 바람에 발이 묶인 사람들이 많아서요.�
entries.translation: Ferry departures were suddenly halted, so many travelers are stranded.�

entries.source: 갑자기 여객선 운항을 중단하다니! 의회 놈들은 무슨 생각인지 모르겠어!�
entries.translation: Halting ferry service out of nowhere! What is the council thinking?!�

entries.source: 다 좋으니 얼른 집에 가고 싶어요.�
entries.translation: Whatever happens, I just want to go home.�

entries.source: 이게 다 의원들을 잘못 뽑아서 그래.�
entries.translation: This is what happens when we elect the wrong councilors.�

entries.source: 이름만 공화국이지 옛날 귀족 가문이라는 것들이 그대로 남아서 지들 멋대로 한다니까?�
entries.translation: Call it a republic, but those old noble families still run everything!�
Dear! I told you to watch your mouth!�

entries.source: ...남편이 한 소리는 못 들은 걸로 해주지 않을래요?�
entries.translation: ...Could you please pretend you did not hear my husband?�

entries.source: 저 사람은 언젠가 저 싼 입 때문에 경을 칠거에요.�
entries.translation: He will get into serious trouble one day running his mouth like that.�

entries.source: |(기분 좋게 졸고 있는 노인이다. 건드리지 않는 것이 좋겠다.){�
entries.translation: |(An old man dozing pleasantly. Best not to disturb him.){�

entries.source: 저 친구는 머리는 좋은데 겁이 많아서 큰일이야.�
entries.translation: That fellow is smart, but he is far too timid.�

entries.source: 센트럴에서 고대종과 관련한 일은 웨이드 가에서 틀어 막고 있단 있으니 직접 보려면 성지로 가는 수 밖에 없는데...�
entries.translation: Central suppresses ancient species info via the Wades, so we must visit the Sanctuary to see one...�

entries.source: 그게 단순한 괴물이 아니라 지성을 존재일지도 모른단 말일세.�
entries.translation: They might not be mere monsters, but intelligent beings!�

entries.source: 뭐 그래봤자 고블린 정도가 아닐까 싶지만.�
entries.translation: Well, at best they are probably just like goblins.�
It is a relief the boats stopped running.�

entries.source: 저 노인네는 이틀 전까지 성지에 보내달라고 의회에 탄원하고 있었다니까요.�
entries.translation: That old man was petitioning the council to send him to the Sanctuary until two days ago.�

entries.source: 그런데 당신은 남의 방에서 뭐하는 겁니까?�
entries.translation: By the way, what are you doing in someone else room?�

entries.source: 4년 전에 벌어진 이렘의 혁명에도 사실 꽤 흥미가 있는데...�
entries.translation: I am quite interested in the Irem revolution from four years ago, too...�

entries.source: 이렘의 사람들도 웨이드 가가 벌인 폭정의 피해자니까.�
entries.translation: The people of Irem were also victims of House Wade tyranny.�

entries.source: 진압 당해서 붙잡힌 애들은 극소수인데. 남은 애들은 어디 숨어서 후일을 도모하고 있지 않을까?�
entries.translation: Very few were caught when it was suppressed. Wonder if the rest are hiding somewhere, biding their time?�

entries.source: 마을 봉쇄는 대충 풀린 것 같던데. 나는 로건이 걱정되서 센트럴로 돌아갈 생각이야.�
entries.translation: The blockade seems mostly lifted. I am worried about Logan, so I plan to head back to Central.�
|(Were not these people looking for Tyr?){�

entries.source: 맙소사, 그 사람을 직접 만난데다가 어쩌면 당분간 같이 다닐 수도 있다고?�
entries.translation: Good grief, you met him in person, and might travel together for a while?�

entries.source: 끄응. 하지만 난 지금 센트럴로 돌아가는게 먼저인데다가 내가 만나고 싶다고 해도 쉽게 만나기도 힘들겠지...�
entries.translation: Ugh. But returning to Central comes first, and meeting him would not be easy even if I wanted to...�

entries.source: 당분간 같이 다닐 수도 있다고 했지?�
entries.translation: Did you say you might travel together for a while?�

entries.source: 성지 전쟁에 대해서 좀 듣게 되면 나중에 9번가로 와서 이야기를 좀 들려줘.�
entries.translation: If you hear anything about the Sanctuary War, come find me on 9th Street and tell me.�

entries.source: 로건이랑은 분위기가 많이 다른데. 당신은 꼭... 특종을 찾는 신문기자 같군.�
entries.translation: Your vibe is very different from Logan. You act just like... a reporter hunting for a scoop.�
Of course. Because I am a reporter.�

entries.source: 성지전쟁에도 종군기자로 따라 간 거였어. 가서 직접 보니까 이거 심상치 않다 싶어서 캐고 있는 거지.�
entries.translation: I went to the Sanctuary War as a war correspondent. Seeing it in person felt fishy, so I have been digging.�

entries.source: 그래도 진실을 밝히겠다는 내 마음만은 로건이랑 다르지 않아.�
entries.translation: Still, my desire to uncover the truth is no different from Logan.�

entries.source: 내 태도가 경박해 보여서 오해를 많이 사기는 하지만.�
entries.translation: Even if my flippant attitude causes a lot of misunderstandings.�

entries.source: 그럼 나중에 보자고. 신세 많이 졌어.�
entries.translation: See you around, then. Much obliged for everything.�

entries.source: 뭐 이 동네에 자주 오는 것 같으니 역시 직접 기다려 보는 수 밖에 없나.�
entries.translation: Well, he seems to visit around here often, so I guess I will just have to wait for him myself.�

entries.source: 자네가 고블린 잡는 걸 보고 나도 잽싸게 밖으로 나왔지.�
entries.translation: I saw you handling the goblins and slipped outside right away.�
Thanks for the help. I am Jake.�

entries.source: 당신이 제이크? 혹시 센트럴 9번가의 로건을 아나?�
entries.translation: You are Jake? Do you know Logan from Central 9th?�

entries.source: 아, 그야 물론 알고 있지. 그 친구가 보냈나? 날 찾으라고?�
entries.translation: Ah, of course I do. Did he send you? To find me?�

entries.source: 이거 신경을 쓰게 해버렸군. 곧 돌아갈테니 그 때는 숨겨둔 서류도 가지고...�
entries.translation: I made him worry. I will head back soon, grab the hidden documents...�

entries.source: 그건 내가 찾아 줬어. 애한테 아주 위험한...�
entries.translation: I already found those. Sending a kid on something so dangerous...�
...Wait, what was with that bizarre password?�

entries.source: 벌써 신세를 여러 번 졌는데 이거. 음... 암호는 뭐 적당한게 생각이 안나서 말야.�
entries.translation: Man, I owe you multiple times now. Well... I could not think of anything decent for a password.�

entries.source: 아무튼, 그래. 그러면 어차피 브리안은 놓친 것 같으니 나도 일단 철수할까나.�
entries.translation: Anyway, yeah. Since it seems Brian got away, I guess I will pull back for now too.�

entries.source: 브리안이나, 아니면 그라함이나... 제일 좋은 건 네베드의 새 수호자인 루레인을 만나보는 것이겠지만.�
entries.translation: Brian, or Graham... Best case would be meeting Lurain, the new guardian of the Neved.�
Did you hear the story from Logan?�

entries.source: 남부원정의 진상을 파헤치기 위해서는 핵심인물과 접촉하는 수 밖에 없어.�
entries.translation: To uncover the truth of the Southern Expedition, contacting key figures is the only way.�

entries.source: 그런데 뭐 다들 도망자 신세다보니 좀처럼 만나기가 어렵네.�
entries.translation: Though since they are all fugitives, they are pretty tough to meet.�

entries.source: 로건의 일도 있고 하니 난 일단은 센트럴로 돌아가야겠군...�
entries.translation: With Logan matter too, I should head back to Central for now...�
The town entrance should be blocked by the Black Guard, though.�

entries.source: 그럼 뭐 당분간 여기서 시간을 죽이고 있어야지.�
entries.translation: Then I will just have to kill some time here for a while.�

entries.source: 여기 재미 없어요. 아빠랑 엄마는 매일 한숨만 내쉬고...�
entries.translation: It is no fun here. Mom and Dad only sigh every day...�

entries.source: 가끔 무섭게 생긴 아저씨들이 와서 소리를 지르는 데다가 요즘은 밖에 나가서 놀지도 못해요�
entries.translation: Scary-looking men come shouting sometimes, and lately I cannot even go outside to play.�
Mister, did you come to bully my mom too?�
Mom only ever tells me to study all day.�
I was completely duped. Huh? Cheated blind.�

entries.source: 처음에 센트럴에서 이주할 사람을 모을 때는 좋은 제안이라고 생각했지.�
entries.translation: When Central recruited settlers, it seemed like a good offer.�

entries.source: 반란이 일어났던 곳이라 좀 찜찜했지만 이미 제압되었으니 별 일 없을 거라고 생각했어�
entries.translation: A rebellion happened here, but it was quelled, so I thought nothing of it.�

entries.source: 처음 한동안은 좋았지. 땅값이야 매년 조금씩 갚으면 된다고 생각했거든.�
entries.translation: It was fine at first. I thought paying off the land yearly would be easy.�

entries.source: 그런데 그게 함정이었어. 농사 짓는데 필요한 장비며, 매년 새로 사야 하는 종자나, 비료나...�
entries.translation: But it was a trap. Farming tools, seeds to buy each year, fertilizer...�

entries.source: 이런 건 전부 따로 계산하면서 빚을 늘리는데다가 세금도 엄청나게 걷잖아? 거기에 이자도 물린다고?�
entries.translation: They bill everything separately, piling up debt, and tax us heavily! With interest!�

entries.source: 그러면서 이제는 아주 대놓고 할당량을 채우라고 그래.�
entries.translation: And now they openly demand we meet their quotas.�

entries.source: 두 걸음만 나가면 몬스터가 나오는데 잘난 군대는 반역자를 잡을 때는 쏜살같이 달려오더니.�
entries.translation: Two steps out and monsters appear, yet their fine army only rushed in to hunt rebels.�
Now they do not even show their faces.�

entries.source: 빚더미지. 이제 끝났어. 내가 멍청했지. 자진해서 소작농이 되겠다고 한 거나 다름없으니.�
entries.translation: Drowning in debt. I am ruined. I was a fool who practically volunteered to be a serf.�
Ever been to Rockville? Redeveloping it in full swing, right?�

entries.source: 장담하지. 재개발 끝나면 거기 사람들도 나랑 다를 게 없는 빚쟁이가 될거라고.�
entries.translation: I bet you once it has done, they will end up as indebted as I am.�

entries.source: 여기 사람들이 왜 반란을 일으켰는지도 알 것 같아.�
entries.translation: I can see why the people here rebelled.�

entries.source: 이렇게 고생만 할 줄 알았으면 이주하지 않는건데 그랬어.�
entries.translation: If I knew I would suffer like this, I never would have moved.�
...Is that... really the only way left?...�

entries.source: 결심했어. 곧 여기를 뜰거야. 이제 더는 못 참겠어.�
entries.translation: I have decided. I am leaving soon. I cannot take this anymore.�

entries.source: 땅 파먹고 사는 것도 힘든 일이에요. 애들은 어떻게 해서라도 출세시켜야지...�
entries.translation: Tilling the soil is hard. My kids have to make something of themselves...�
I heard the cargo ship was attacked...�

entries.source: 그 다음날 보니 문 앞에 누가 곡물이 든 자루를 던져 놓고 갔어요.�
entries.translation: The next day, someone left a sack of grain at our door.�

entries.source: 챙겨 놓기는 했는데... 잡혀가는 건 아니겠죠?�
entries.translation: I kept it... but I will not get arrested, right?�
Are you here to press for payment again?�

entries.source: 벌써 몇 번이고 말한 것 같은데, 올해는 작황도 좋지 않고 몬스터들 때문에 수확도 거의 못했어요.�
entries.translation: I have said it many times: crops failed, and monsters left us with barely a harvest.�

entries.source: 거기서 요구하는 할당량을 채우면 우리 가족은 겨울에 굶어 죽고 말거에요.�
entries.translation: If we meet their quota, my family will starve this winter.�

entries.source: 그렇다고 버티고 있으면 당신같은 용병을 보내서 계속 협박한단 말이에요.�
entries.translation: Yet if we hold out, they keep sending mercenaries like you to threaten us.�

entries.source: 밭에 나가면 수확을 하다가 몬스터들 때문에 버리고 온 곡물 상자들이 있는데...�
entries.translation: There are grain crates abandoned in the fields after monster attacks...�

entries.source: 몇 개만 있으면 그 쪽에서 말하는 할당량을 채울 수 있겠지만...�
entries.translation: Just a few would be enough to fill that quota...�

entries.source: 아무 것도 모르는 우리 애들 얼굴을 봐서라도...�
entries.translation: Even if just for my innocent children sake...�
Thank you. Thank you so much.�
Satisfied now? Will you please stop tormenting us?�
Please take this to the sailor in Irem.�

entries.source: 이걸로 어떻게 겨울은 넘길 수 있을 것 같네요.�
entries.translation: With this, we might make it through the winter.�

entries.source: 같이 이주한 사람들도 있었는데 요 몇 년 사이에 한 명, 두 명씩 도망쳤어요.�
entries.translation: Others settled here too, but over the years, they fled one by one.�

entries.source: 그러다가 잡히면 어디로 가는지는 아무도 몰라요. 센트럴의 친구들에게 연락해 봐도...�
entries.translation: No one knows where they go if caught. Even asking friends in Central...�

entries.source: 재판을 받은 것도 아니고, 감옥으로 간 것도 아니래요. 그대로 사라졌어요.�
entries.translation: No trials, no prison records. They simply vanished.�

entries.source: 무서워서 도망도 가지 못하고 이렇게 남아 있는 거에요.�
entries.translation: We are too terrified to run, so we just stay here.�

entries.source: 얼어붙은 바다를 건너가면 세금을 안내도 되는 마을이 있다던데 진짜일까요?�
entries.translation: Across the Frozen Sea, is there really a tax-free village?�
My crew and I will secure the inside of the ship.�

entries.source: 짐은 배 옆을 폭파하고 실어낼 테니까 그 동안 갑판을 지켜줘.�
entries.translation: We will blow the hull to unload cargo, so hold the deck until then!�

entries.source: 내가 제일 힘든 일인 것 같은데?�
entries.translation: Feels like I got stuck with the hardest job.�

entries.source: 약한 소리 하지 말라고! 그럼 잘 부탁한다!�
entries.translation: Stop whining! I am counting on you!�

entries.source: 도적놈들이... 너희들은 즉결 처분이다! 모조리 고깃밥을 만들어주마!�
entries.translation: You filthy thieves... Summary execution! I will turn you all into mincemeat!�

entries.source: 요즘 세상에 그런 대사는 삼류 악당도 안한다고...�
entries.translation: Even third-rate villains do not use lines like that anymore...�

entries.source: 어이, 어때!? 좀 더 버틸 수 있겠어?�
entries.translation: Hey, how is it going!? Can you hold out a bit longer?�

entries.source: 제길... 할 수 없지. 그럼 이만 철수한다!�
entries.translation: Damn it... No choice. We are pulling out!�
Then hold out just a little longer!�
That is enough! Let us get out of here!�

entries.source: 생각해보면, 케프네스가 선출될 때부터 뭔가 이상했어.�
entries.translation: Come to think of it, things felt off ever since Kefnes was elected.�

entries.source: 자네는 지금의 공화국은 뭔가 이상하다고 생각하지 않나?�
entries.translation: Do not you think something is strange about the Republic right now?�

entries.source: 맞아. 지금 공화국을 지배하는 건 케프네스와 그 뒤에 있는 웨이드 가문이지.�
entries.translation: Right. Kefnes and House Wade behind him are running the Republic now.�

entries.source: 남부원정이 시작될 때 그들이 주장한 것은 살기 좋은 땅을 전부 선주종이 차지하고 있다는 거였어.�
entries.translation: When the southern expedition began, they claimed the primitives held all the fertile land.�

entries.source: 사실, 솔직히 말해서 지금 북쪽의 땅으로도 그렇게 부족하지 않거든.�
entries.translation: Honestly speaking, northern land alone is not really lacking.�

entries.source: 원정 자체에 다른 꿍꿍이가 있었다는 의심을 지울 수가 없어.�
entries.translation: I cannot shake the feeling that the expedition had a hidden agenda.�

entries.source: 공화국 국민을 위해서가 아니라, 자신들의 뭔가를 위해서... 그런 느낌이야.�
entries.translation: Not for the Republic people, but for their own ends... that kind of feeling.�
Not really. Think carefully about it.�

entries.source: 의회가 정말로 공화국을 발전시킬 생각이라면 이렘이나, 남쪽의 킹스포트를 좀 더 개발했어야 했어.�
entries.translation: If parliament truly meant to develop the Republic, they should have built up Irem or Kingsport in the south.�

entries.source: 하지만 지금 의회는 그 두 곳을 곡물 창고와 광산으로 밖에 취급하지 않고 있다고.�
entries.translation: Instead, parliament treats both places as merely grain storehouses and mines.�

entries.source: 센트럴에서 진행되는 국가 프로젝트 연구의 대부분은 일반인에게 공개되지 않고 있고�
entries.translation: Most state research projects in Central are kept secret from the public,�

entries.source: 이렘이나 킹스포트로 가야 하는 예산의 대부분이 비밀스럽게 센트럴의 어딘가로 흘러들어가고 있다고.�
entries.translation: and most of the budget meant for Irem and Kingsport flows secretly into Central.�

entries.source: 센트럴에 있을 때 들은 소문인데 무적의 군대를 만들어 내려는 인체실험이 있었다고 해.�
entries.translation: When I was in Central, I heard rumors of human experimentation to create an invincible army.�

entries.source: 어떤 명령이라도 절대 복종하는 군인을 만드는 건데, 그 결과가 흑의병이고.�
entries.translation: Soldiers who follow any order unconditionally... and the result was the Black Guard.�
They said the commander is Kefnes. Could it be true?�

entries.source: 탄압을 피해서 이 마을에 쳐박혀 있기는 하지만 계속 놀고 있는 건 아니야.�
entries.translation: We are lying low in this village to avoid the crackdown, but we have not been idle.�

entries.source: 웨이드 가에 타격을 줄 수 있는 일이라면 꾸준히 찾아서 하고 있다고.�
entries.translation: We keep finding ways to strike at House Wade.�

entries.source: ...웨이드 가는 테러리스트니, 도적떼니 하고 흑색 선전을 하고 있긴 하지만.�
entries.translation: ...Though House Wade spreads propaganda calling us terrorists and bandits.�

entries.source: 조금 있으면 이렘에 모인 곡물을 센트럴로 보내는 화물선이 출발한다는 정보를 입수했어.�
entries.translation: I got intel that a cargo ship carrying grain from Irem to Central is leaving soon.�

entries.source: 테오나 에블린은 너무 튀는 행동은 하지 말라고 하지만...�
entries.translation: Theo and Evelyn tell me not to stand out too much, but...�

entries.source: 착취에 가깝게 모인 그 곡식들로 귀족들의 배를 불려줄 걸 생각하면 구역질이 나.�
entries.translation: It makes me sick to think that grain extorted from people will line the nobles pockets.�

entries.source: 아무래도 그냥 둘 수는 없어. 습격할 생각이야.�
entries.translation: I cannot just let it go. I plan to raid it.�

entries.source: 혹시 도울 생각이 있으면 <모이투라 남쪽에 있는 선착장{으로 오라고.�
entries.translation: If you want to help, come to the <pier south of Moytura{.�

entries.source: 수고했어. 그럭저럭 한 사람 몫은 한 모양이더군.�
entries.translation: Good work. Looks like you pulled your own weight.�
That was quite a performance. I am impressed.�
...You are incredible. Even at your young age...�
Perhaps you could even go toe-to-toe with <Tyr{.�

entries.source: 나중에 꼭 우리와 합류해 줘. 너와 티르, 테오, 에블린의 힘을 빌릴 수 있으면 혁명도 다시 성공할 수 있을 것 같아.�
entries.translation: Please join us later. With you, Tyr, Theo, and Evelyn, the revolution could succeed again.�

entries.source: 여기 모인 사람들은 사연도 목적도 다 제각각이야.�
entries.translation: Everyone gathered here has their own stories and motives.�

entries.source: 누군가는 구심점 역할을 해야 하는데, 테오도어나 에블린이나 요즘은 무슨 생각인지 모르겠어.�
entries.translation: Someone needs to be the central pillar, but I do not know what Theodore or Evelyn are thinking lately.�

entries.source: 전 이렘 출신이에요. 4년 전에는 저도 열심히 싸웠지만, 지금은...�
entries.translation: I am from Irem. 4 years ago I fought hard too, but now...�

entries.source: 그 때, 센트럴에서 진압군이 와서 싸우다가 결국 밀려서 도망칠 때 마을 사람들은 우리를 숨겨주지 않았어요.�
entries.translation: Back then, when Central suppression forces came and drove us back, the villagers refused to hide us.�

entries.source: 오히려 적극적으로 군에 협력했죠. 우리는 그 사람들을 위해서, 그 사람들을 구하기 위해서 싸운다고 생각했는데.�
entries.translation: Instead, they actively helped the army. We thought we were fighting for them, fighting to save them.�

entries.source: 제 동생은 그 사람들에게 붙잡혀서, 결국 처형당하고 말았어요.�
entries.translation: My brother was caught by those people and ended up being executed.�

entries.source: 그 사람들은 오히려 우리를 원망했어요. 혁명 때문에 군대가 오고, 혁명 때문에 반란분자라는 낙인을 받아서�
entries.translation: They blamed us instead. They said because of the revolution the army came, and they were branded as rebels...�
And ended up facing discrimination, unlike Rockville.�

entries.source: 그러면서 말하더군요. '우리가 언제 너희들에게, 우릴 구해달라고 했느냐?'�
entries.translation: They told us: 'When did we ever ask you to save us?'�

entries.source: 너희가 멋대로 우릴 구해주겠다고 설레발을 떤 게 아니냐?�
entries.translation: Did not you just run your mouth about saving us of your own accord?�

entries.source: 과연 그랬을까요? 우리가 한 행동은 쓸데 없는 거였을까요?�
entries.translation: Was that truly so? Was everything we did completely pointless?�
What was the right thing to do, then?�
There is no need to help such people.�

entries.source: 도움을 요청하지 않는 사람은 구할 필요가 없나요?�
entries.translation: Should we not save people just because they did not ask for help?�

entries.source: 저는 아니라고 생각해요. 사람은 너무 쉽게 현실에 길들여지고 마니까...�
entries.translation: I do not think so. People adapt far too easily to their harsh reality...�
Still, it was something that had to be done.�

entries.source: 동생이 헛되게 죽은 것이 아니었으면 좋겠어요.�
entries.translation: I hope my brother did not die in vain.�

entries.source: 당신도 언젠가는 이런 고민을 하게 될 때가 있을 것 같아요.�
entries.translation: I feel that someday, you too will have to grapple with these questions.�

entries.source: 요즘 저 사람이 좀 위험한 소리를 하고 다녀요.�
entries.translation: That person has been saying some dangerous things lately.�

entries.source: 어딜가나 리더가 아니면 만족하지 못하는 사람이었긴 하지만...�
entries.translation: They were always the type who is never satisfied unless they are leading, but...�
I just hope it does not stir up trouble.�

entries.source: 의회나 웨이드 가의 첩자만 아니라면 얼마든지 환영이야.�
entries.translation: As long as you are not a spy for the Council or House Wade, you are more than welcome.�

entries.source: 이걸로 다른 포션을 만들 수도 있겠는데...�
entries.translation: I might be able to brew another potion with this...�
I had no interest in revolution or rebellion.�

entries.source: 4년 전 그 자리에서 다친 사람을 보고 치료를 해준 것뿐인데 어느 틈엔가 지명 수배가 되어 있더라고.�
entries.translation: 4 years ago, I just treated an injured person on the spot, and before I knew it, I was on the wanted list.�

entries.source: 같이 있던 친구가 누명을 벗겠다고 센트럴로 갔는데 그 뒤는 어떻게 됐는지 몰라.�
entries.translation: A friend with me went to Central to clear our names, but I have no idea what happened after that.�

entries.source: 이쯤되면 뭐 반란군에 참여하라고 등 떠미는 거지 뭐.�
entries.translation: At this point, they practically pushed me to join the rebels.�
Well... I have no regrets, though.�

entries.source: 보면 알겠지만 일단은 내가 이 곳 의사야.�
entries.translation: As you can tell, I am the doctor around here for now.�

entries.source: 테오씨도 약학은 꽤 밝은 편이지만 나돌아다닐 때가 많아서 대개 내가 마을 사람들을 돌보고 있어.�
entries.translation: Theo knows quite a bit about medicine too, but he is out roaming a lot, so I mostly care for the villagers.�

entries.source: 어디 아픈 곳이 있으면 찾아 오라고 하고 싶지만... 보다시피 아무 것도 없어서 말야.�
entries.translation: I would tell you to come by if you are sick, but... as you can see, I have almost nothing here.�

entries.source: 다른 곳과 정식으로 교역할 수 없으니 밀수하거나 자급자족해야 하는데, 의약품은 늘 우선 순위가 밀리더라고.�
entries.translation: Since we cannot trade officially, we rely on smuggling or self-sufficiency, and medical supplies always get pushed down the list.�

entries.source: 아직까지는 크게 다치거나 아픈 사람이 없었으니까 다행이지만...�
entries.translation: Thankfully, no one has been seriously injured or sick so far, but...�

entries.source: 이 주위에서 약재로 쓸만한 것을 조사해 보고 싶은데 좀 도와줄 수 있나?�
entries.translation: I want to investigate medicinal ingredients around here. Could you lend a hand?�
If I get good results, I will share them with you.�

entries.source: <물개{나 <얼음덩어리{를 살펴보면 될거야. 설녀나 얼음정령은 이미 조사를 해봤으니까...�
entries.translation: Check <Seals{ and <Ice Clods{. I have already examined the Snow Maidens and Ice Spirits...�

entries.source: 얼어붙은 바다 동쪽에 있는 동굴의 결계가 갑자기 사라졌잖아?�
entries.translation: You know how the barrier on the cave east of the Frozen Sea suddenly vanished?�

entries.source: 뭐 약으로 쓸게 없나 하고 서식물을 조사해 달라고 밖에 있는 아저씨한테 부탁했지.�
entries.translation: I asked that guy outside to check the flora and fauna to see if anything could be used as medicine.�

entries.source: 근데 오히려 다쳐서 왔어. <얼음혼{을 잡고 있었는데 갑자기 커다한 웜이 나타났데.�
entries.translation: Instead, he came back injured. He said while hunting <Ice Souls{, a giant worm suddenly appeared.�
Did you come to rescue me...? How did you know?�

entries.source: 아니, 그보다 이러고 있을 때가 아냐!�
entries.translation: No, wait, this is no time for that!�

entries.source: 광산조합에서 고용한 용병들이 날 잡아서 여기에 가둔 후 하는 소리를 들었는데,�
entries.translation: I overheard the mercenaries hired by the mining guild talking after they locked me in here...�

entries.source: 그 놈들, 서명에 참가한 광부들을 전부 손봐주겠다고 하고 있어!�
entries.translation: Those bastards plan to rough up all the miners who signed the petition!�

entries.source: 무슨 짓을 저지를 지 몰라! 막아야 해!�
entries.translation: No telling what they will do! We have to stop them!�

entries.source: 광산 근처에 있는 낡은 창고를 집합처로 사용하고 있지만... 설마 혼자 가려고?�
entries.translation: They are using an old warehouse by the mine as a hideout, but... are you going alone?�

entries.source: 짐덩어리를 달고 가는 것 보다는 혼자가 나으니까...�
entries.translation: It is better to go alone than drag dead weight around...�

entries.source: 고마워. 처음에 쓴소리를 해서 미안해. 내가 잘못 생각했어.�
entries.translation: Thank you. Sorry for the harsh words earlier. I was wrong about you.�

entries.source: 네가 도와주지 않았으면 지금쯤 다들... 어떻게 되었을지.�
entries.translation: If you had not helped, who knows what would have happened to everyone...�

entries.source: ...그래도 난 포기하지 않겠어. 용병들이 사라졌으니 광산조합도 당분간은 해를 끼치지 못하겠지.�
entries.translation: ...Still, I will not give up. With their mercenaries gone, the mining guild will not dare touch us for a while.�

entries.source: 센트럴로 가서 이 일을 공론화시켜서라도 꼭 광산조합을 무너뜨리겠어.�
entries.translation: I will head to Central and expose them to the public. I swear I will bring the mining guild down.�

entries.source: 광산조합에서 이런 짓까지 저지를 줄은 몰랐어...�
entries.translation: I had no idea the mining guild would go this far...�
...A mercenary hired by the miners? How amusing.�
How much are they paying you? Pennies, undoubtedly.�

entries.source: 차라리 광산조합쪽의 일거리를 알아보지 그랬나? 어차피 이제와서 후회하기는 늦겠지만!�
entries.translation: You should have looked for work with the mining guild instead! Too late for regrets now, though!�

entries.source: ...보통 그 대사 다음이면 돈을 더 줄테니 우리 편이 되라고 설득해야 하는 거 아닌가?�
entries.translation: ...Is not that usually where you offer more money to get me on your side?�

entries.source: 이래서 어린애는 안 돼. 좋은 걸 가르쳐 주지.�
entries.translation: This is why I hate dealing with brats. Let me teach you a lesson.�

entries.source: 배당을 나눌 사람은 적으면 적을 수록 좋고...�
entries.translation: The fewer hands splitting the reward, the better...�

entries.source: 추가 수당을 요구할 수 있는 일은 마다하지 않는게 용병의 도리라고!�
entries.translation: And a mercenary never turns down a job that pays extra hazard fees!�

entries.source: 용병이 아니라 돈에 길들여진 개의 도리겠지?�
entries.translation: Sounds less like a mercenary and more like a hound leashed by coin.�
What does this even say... The handwriting is terrible.�
Well... somehow, the handwriting feels familiar...�
Is not this Schultz? When he was little...�

entries.source: 계승자들의 어릴 적 사진인가.. 이 돼지는 마르크일테고.�
entries.translation: Photos of the Successors as kids, huh... This fat one must be Marc.�

entries.source: 여기 이거, 알렉스씨 아냐? 수염 없으니 굉장히 동안인데?�
entries.translation: Wait, is not this Alex? He looks so young without the beard!�

entries.source: 크리스랑 티아나, 언니들도 있고.. 근데, 사진들 배경이 다 똑같은 걸?�
entries.translation: Chris and Tiana are here too... But wait, the background is identical in all of them?�

entries.source: 사진을 찍은 것도, 이런 배경도 기억이 전혀 안나는데..�
entries.translation: I have no memory of taking these photos, or of this place...�

entries.source: 티르 말대로.. 찝찝해질 뿐인건가. 기억을 조작당했다는 건.�
entries.translation: Just like Tyr said... having your memories manipulated just leaves a bad taste in your mouth.�

entries.source: 네 사촌이라고 하는 그라함이라는 얼간이가 오늘 배속되었다.�
entries.translation: Some idiot named Graham, claiming to be your cousin, was assigned to my unit today.�

entries.source: 자꾸 빽써서 이상한 놈 들여보내면 죽는다.�
entries.translation: If you keep pulling strings to shove weirdos my way, you are dead.�

entries.source: PS. 자꾸 나랑 브리안 가지고 이상한 소문 내지마.�
entries.translation: P.S. Stop spreading rumors about me and Brian.�

entries.source: PS2. 약혼 선물로 받고 싶은 것 있으면 미리 이야기 해.�
entries.translation: P.S. 2. If you want something specific for an engagement gift, tell me now.�

entries.source: |(4년 전 날짜... 아직 공화국 군에 있을 때 보낸 건가?){�
entries.translation: |(Dated four years ago... Was this sent while he was still in the Republic army?){�

entries.source: |(편지 옆에는 이자벨로 보이는 작은 초상화가 하나 놓여 있다.){�
entries.translation: |(Next to the letter lies a small portrait, likely of Isabel.){�

entries.source: |(보라색 머리의 조금 우울해 보이는 인상의 아름다운 여자다.){�
entries.translation: |(She is a beautiful woman with purple hair and a somewhat somber gaze.){�

entries.source: (아무래도 론베르크의 마법기를 분해 해석한 결과를 설명하는 문서인 듯 하다.){�
entries.translation: (It appears to explain the analysis of disassembled Rohnberg magitech.){�

entries.source: |(이니셜 L이 새겨진 도구가 놓여 있다. 심하게 손상된 것 같다.){�
entries.translation: |(A tool engraved with the initial L lies here. It seems heavily damaged.){�
|(...Why do I have such a bad feeling about this?){�

entries.source: 자 간다! 그라함 호! 나에게는 작은 한 걸음이지만 인류에게는 큰 한걸음!�
entries.translation: Here we go! Vessel of Graham! One small step for me, one giant leap for mankind!�
What the hell are you doing?!�

entries.source: 내, 내가 그런 게 아냐! 힘이 제멋대로... 으아아악!�
entries.translation: I-it is not me! It is moving on its own... Aaaargh!�
Shut that thing down right now!�
Wait, why is not it working?!�
There seems to have been a <minor glitch{ in the AI...�
|(I am never helping this guy again...){�
For now... yes. Call me Rabi.�
I did not ask for your name.�

entries.source: |(강림자의 유적에 있는 걸 보면 크래드와 동류인가?){�
entries.translation: |(Finding him in Descendant ruins... is he like Krad?){�

entries.source: 당신들이 말하는 고대신의 수하... 정도가 될 것 같소.�
entries.translation: I suppose I am what you would call a servant of the Ancient God.�
I have no wish to fight you... not yet.�

entries.source: 또인가... 그리 길게 이야기 할 시간은 없는 것 같구려.�
entries.translation: Again, huh... It seems we do not have much time to talk.�

entries.source: 당신이나, 혹은 다른 계승자가 어떤 선택을 하든 간에... 재강림은 일어날 것이오.�
entries.translation: Regardless of your choice or that of the other Successor... the Second Advent will occur.�

entries.source: 인간이나, 네베드나 모두 그 때에 올바른 준비가 되어 있기를 바라오.�
entries.translation: I only hope that humans and Neved alike are properly prepared when the time comes.�

entries.source: 고대신의 종복이라면서 쓸데없는 걱정을 다 하는군?�
entries.translation: Quite thoughtful for a servant of the Ancient God, are not you?�

entries.source: 강림자를 직접 보지 못한 그대가 그런 소리를 하는 것은 당연한 일이니. 도발하려는 것이라면 쓸데없는 짓이오.�
entries.translation: It is only natural for you to say that, having never seen a Descendant. If you are trying to provoke me, save your breath.�
I have seen one... in the Ark.�
That was a defective product. Like me, and like you.�

entries.source: 아니, 그것보다. 마치 자신은 직접 본 적이 있는 것처럼 말하는군?�
entries.translation: Wait, you sound as if you have seen one yourself.�

entries.source: 알고 있소? 오래 전 고대신이 강림자와의 대전에서 자신의 손발이 될 수하를 창조했다는 이야기.�
entries.translation: Do you know the tale? Long ago, during the Great War against the Descendants, the Ancient God created servants to act as his hands and feet.�

entries.source: 루칸이라는 이름을 가진 늑대를 닮은 마수. 그리고 인간에게 붙잡혀 케프네스라는 이름을 받았던 자.�
entries.translation: A wolf-like beast named Lucan. And one who was captured by humans and given the name Kefnes.�

entries.source: 그리고 동족의 배신자였던 나. 가디언이라고 불리던 존재.�
entries.translation: And I, a traitor to my own kind. A being once called a Guardian.�

entries.source: 세계에 좌절하고, 강림자를 불러들이고, 그와 함께 세계의 적이자 배신자가 되어 버린.�
entries.translation: Despairing of the world, I summoned the Descendants, and in doing so, became an enemy of the world and a traitor.�
I have no idea what you are talking about.�

entries.source: 이해할 필요는 없소. 어차피 나는 지난 세계의 망령 같은 것.�
entries.translation: You need not understand. I am merely a ghost of a bygone era.�

entries.source: 이 시대까지 살아남기 위해서는 고대신의 힘이 필요했을 뿐. 그대나 티르가 원하는 바가 이루어지면.�
entries.translation: I only needed the Ancient God power to survive until this age. Once your wish or Tyr is fulfilled...�
I too shall fade away alongside the Ancient God.�

entries.source: 그대가 방주에서 만났던 것과 비슷한, 강림자의 그림자가 이 세계로 침입하려는 것 뿐이오.�
entries.translation: It is merely a shadow of the Descendant invading this world, akin to what you faced in the Ark.�
Where did you run off to?!�

entries.source: 봉인은 일시적인 유예에 불과했어. 재강림을 늦추기 위한. 재강림은 이런 지능도 없는 괴물이 이 세계를 침입하는 정도가 아니야.�
entries.translation: The seal was merely a brief respite to delay the Second Advent. The Second Advent is far more than mindless beasts invading this world.�

entries.source: 세계는 곧 원래의 모습을 되찾을 거다. 그들이 원했던 대로.�
entries.translation: The world will soon reclaim its original form. Just as they wished.�

entries.source: 매도우 힐로 티르를 안내한 후 너를 죽 지켜봤다.�
entries.translation: After guiding Tyr to Meadow Hill, I watched you the entire time.�

entries.source: 아마 너라면 좋은 신이 될지도 모르지. 아니면 지금의 신만큼이나 악신이 될 수도... 아니면 감당할 수 없는 힘을 가진 인간이 될지도 모르지. 어느 쪽일까.�
entries.translation: Perhaps you might become a benevolent god. Or an evil god, no better than the current one... Or perhaps a mortal burdened with power beyond control. I wonder which.�
I hope the other side... goes just as well.�

entries.source: 이쯤 해두도록 할까요? 아니면 계속 할까요?�
entries.translation: Shall we call it here? Or would you prefer to continue?�

entries.source: ...관두지. 이 이상은 둘 중에 한 명이 죽어야 끝나겠군.�
entries.translation: ...Let us stop. Any further, and one of us will not walk away alive.�

entries.source: 하지만 센트럴의 소문과는 다른걸? 대단한 검사...라고 하던데.�
entries.translation: Though, you are different from the rumors in Central. Were not you supposed to be a master swordsman?�

entries.source: 아... 확실히 대전 때는 검을 주로, 마법을 보조로 썼어요.�
entries.translation: Ah... Indeed, during the Great War, I relied primarily on the sword with magic as support.�

entries.source: 그래도 결국 마법이 더 강하니까 바꿨어요.�
entries.translation: Still, magic proved to be stronger in the end, so I made the switch.�

entries.source: 정화의 심판이라던가... 일 대 다수 전투를 벌일 일이 많아서 결국 검으로는 한계를 느껴요.�
entries.translation: Facing multiple foes at once, like with the Judgment of Purification, made me realize the sword limits.�
Besides, my arms were getting too thick.�

entries.source: 팔은 농담이고, 티르와 맞추기 위한 것도 있어요. 둘이서 검을 휘두르는 것보다는...�
